jobs.title: Initiativbewerbung
jobs.excerpt: deine aufgaben • Erzähl uns was Du kannst und worauf Du Bock hast und wir quatschen darüber was Du bei uns machen kannst!
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

  • Erzähl uns was Du kannst und worauf Du Bock hast und wir quatschen darüber was Du bei uns machen kannst!

dein profil

  • Du hast eine unbändige Lust auf Software und brennst für die Digitalisierung?
  • Du bist einfach ein:e gute:r Typ:in und glaubst, du könntest perfekt zu uns passen?
  • Du hast richtig Bock drauf, als Team mit der richtigen Strategie und Kreation noch bessere Lösungen zu finden?
  • Du bist entweder super vernetzt in der Steuerwelt oder kannst das Team durch andere Qualifikationen und Kenntnisse bereichern?
  • Du hast ein riesen Talent für analytisches Denken und strukturiertes Vorgehen
  • Du möchtest nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern Wirkung für Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen schaffen?

warum wir?

Unsere Haltung
Die Basis für uns und unsere Zusammenarbeit ist gegenseitiges Vertrauen. Damit wir dieses aufbauen und langfristig zusammenarbeiten können, sind uns folgende Punkte besonders wichtig:

  • Persönliche Reife: Verantwortung bedeutet für uns, dass wir bewusst handeln und uns um die Auswirkungen unseres Handelns kümmern. Wir sind uns unserer Aufgaben und Pflichten bewusst und in der Lage, unser eigenes Verhalten zu hinterfragen. Wir holen uns aktiv Feedback zu unserem Handeln ein und können uns Fehler eingestehen. Wir kommunizieren klar miteinander und können auch unbequeme Themen im Sinne des Ganzen ansprechen und Spannungen aushalten.
  • Ehrgeiz und Qualitätsanspruch: wir sind sehr ehrgeizig und wollen das, was wir tun, immer und zu jeder Zeit richtig gut machen. Fehler gehören dazu und sind vollkommen in Ordnung. Wichtig ist uns, offen darüber zu sprechen, daraus zu lernen und es beim nächsten Mal besser zu machen.
  • Freundschaftlichkeit: Wir schätzen unseren freundschaftlichen Umgang miteinander sehr. Dazu gehört, dass wir offen und ehrlich miteinander umgehen und uns füreinander interessieren. Wir sind uns als Menschen wichtig und nehmen uns ernst.
Wir suchen vor allem nach Menschen, die zu uns passen. Das Teilen dieser Haltung und Werte erwarten wir von jedem, der neu zu uns dazu kommt. Wir nehmen die Probezeit ernst und wollen in diesen ersten sechs Monaten gemeinsam herausfinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen.

Unsere Erwartungen
Wir wollen eine Arbeitswelt schaffen, in der Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht und in der hochwertige Lösungen entstehen, die Menschen wirklich voranbringen. Das gelingt nur, wenn unsere Erwartungen nicht unausgesprochen im Raum stehen, sondern klar und nachvollziehbar sind. Wenn du bei kanzlei.land arbeitest, sollst du deshalb wissen, was wir von dir erwarten – und was du von uns erwarten darfst.

  • Wir wissen, wofür wir etwas tun.
  • Wir übernehmen Verantwortung und machen Probleme sichtbar.
  • Wir handeln eigenständig und gehen offen mit Unsicherheiten um.
  • Wir kommunizieren klar, früh, direkt und fair.
  • Wir sind verlässlich und schaffen dadurch Vertrauen.
  • Wir wählen Qualität und Aufwand passend zum Zweck.
  • Wir arbeiten für das Ganze, nicht nur für den eigenen Bereich.
  • Wir verbinden Menschlichkeit mit hohen Ansprüchen.

Arbeiten mit uns
Unsere Mission ist es, mit unseren Software-Produkten die digitale Zusammenarbeit zwischen Steuerberatern und deren Mandanten zu vereinfachen. Wir glauben, dass wir mit Menschlichkeit, Teamgeist, Fleiß und Humor auch als kleines Team Großes leisten können. Wir begegnen einander mit Respekt und auf Augenhöhe. Werde auch du Teil des Teams und lass deine Ideen einfließen.

Attraktiver Standort
Du arbeitest wahlweise zentral in Bremen oder einfach von zu Hause aus. Das Büro verfügt über perfekte Verkehrsanbindungen.

100% Home Office möglich
Arbeiten von überall? Bei uns ist das in den allermeisten Fällen überhaupt kein Problem. Ob Nord, Ost, Süd oder West. Die Arbeitsorte sind jetzt schon kunterbunt über Deutschland verteilt.

Gutes Arbeitsklima
Uns ist ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima besonders wichtig. Wir lieben den lustigen Umgang miteinander und pflegen eine kooperative und hilfsbereite Kultur der Wertschätzung.

Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung
Unser Vergütungssystem stellt deine Leistung und die Qualität deiner Arbeit in den Vordergrund. Denn hervorragende Leistungen müssen auch entsprechend honoriert werden.

Flache Hierachien
Gute Ideen und Entscheidungen werden bei uns gemeinsam umgesetzt. Jeder übernimmt die Verantwortung für sein Handeln. Bei uns zählt das bessere Argument und nicht der Berufstitel.

Fort- und Weiterbildungen
Konstantes Lernen: Für uns ein Schlüssel zum Erfolg! Wir planen mit dir gemeinsam deine Fort- oder Weiterbildung bei uns. Sei es Literatur, Seminare, Online-Kurse oder ein Studium? Sprechen wir einfach darüber.

Regelmäßige Team-Events
Egal ob vor Ort oder virtuell. Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Events, damit wir uns gegenseitig besser kennenlernen können. Ob einen virtuellen Escaperoom oder eine echte Hamburger Kiez-Tour – der Mix macht’s!

Keine Investoren
Wir sind an einem gesunden Unternehmen interessiert. Daher haben wir uns gegen die Beteiligungen von Investoren entschieden. Wir wollen gemeinsam Herr unserer Entscheidungen sein.

Viel Arbeit

... alles andere wäre glatt gelogen ;-)

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOur client is a Meta advertising agency built around paid growth for e-commerce and personal brands, including some built around well known public figures.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a Meta advertising agency built around paid growth for e-commerce and personal brands, including some built around well known public figures. The team has grown from around 10 to 20 people over the past year and expects to double again in 2026.

Your Role

This role splits evenly across three connected pieces of the account: creative strategy, Meta ads management, and client communication, each carrying roughly a third of the job. You will research what an audience actually responds to, turn that research into ad creative and copy, manage the campaigns that run it, and explain the results to the client in plain terms.

You'll

  • Research audience pain points, objections, and desired outcomes through Reddit threads, reviews, competitor ads, and social listening

  • Build persona profiles and identify the angles that will resonate with each audience

  • Write hooks, scripts, and body copy that drive engagement and conversions

  • Direct creative production, including shot selection and visual storytelling, while keeping brand consistency

  • Set up and manage Meta ad campaigns, from audience targeting to budget allocation

  • Read CPM, CTR, conversion rate, and CPA/CPL to identify which creative is winning and why

  • Translate performance data into recommendations the client can act on

  • Lead client meetings, set the agenda, and keep documentation current between calls

You Bring

  • Strong copywriting, the kind that reads like it was written for the person scrolling, not for the client

  • A habit of studying ads while scrolling and reverse-engineering what makes a campaign work

  • Working knowledge of core ad metrics: CPM, CTR, CVR, CPA/CPL

  • Comfort driving your own projects: telling us what you are doing, why, and how you would solve a roadblock if one comes up

  • Confidence leading client relationships and strategy conversations, not just supporting them

What's Offered

  • Competitive base compensation plus performance-based incentives; compensation based on experience, share your target range

  • Remote-first, flexible scheduling; you do not need to be based in New York, just somewhere in PST, CST, or EST

  • Direct work with premium e-commerce and personal brands, including some built around public figures with large audiences

  • A team culture built on entrepreneurial initiative, currently around 20 people and growing after doubling in the past year

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.excerpt: For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success.
jobs.description:
For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success. For ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), SIS provides comprehensive software and services, including ASC management, electronic health records (EHRs), patient engagement capabilities, compliance technology, and revenue cycle management and transcription services, all built specifically for ASCs. For hospital perioperative teams, SIS offers an easy-to-use anesthesia information management system (AIMS).

Serving over 2,900 surgical facilities, SIS is committed to delivering solutions that enable surgical providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care and outcomes.

Recognized as the No. 1 ASC EHR vendor by Black Book for 11 consecutive years and honored with the Best in KLAS Award for ASC Solutions in 2026, 2025, 2023, and 2022, SIS remains the trusted choice for surgical providers seeking to enhance their performance.

Discover how SIS can help you Operate Smart™ at sisfirst.com.

Surgical Information Systems (SIS) is seeking a Chief Marketing Officer to lead marketing across its healthcare SaaS and revenue cycle management portfolio. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, the CMO will prioritize product marketing—strengthening positioning, packaging, pricing, launches, and sales enablement—while advancing the SIS brand and driving pipeline, revenue growth, and customer engagement. The CMO will align Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success around a unified go-to-market strategy. Partnering with the Chief Growth Officer, you will set market direction, messaging, and enablement strategy while supporting sales execution and revenue delivery. The role also presents marketing strategy, performance, and investment recommendations to the Board of Directors.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Go-to-Market and Product Marketing

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for SIS, owning its creation and execution for new and existing products, services, and market segments. Establish target customer profiles, positioning, launch plans, and measures of success, and align marketing, sales, product, and customer success against them.
  • Lead product marketing for the full SIS portfolio, including product positioning, value propositions, buyer-specific messaging, competitive differentiation, and launch readiness.
  • Own pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with the CEO, product, and finance leaders, informed by market research, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback.
  • Direct market research, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and inform product strategy and investment decisions with business leaders.
  • Lead sales enablement, ensuring the sales team has clear value propositions, buyer-specific messaging, customer evidence, and tools that support the sales process.

Executive Leadership and Marketing Strategy

  • Set the enterprise marketing vision, annual plan, and long-term priorities in support of SIS business strategy and growth objectives. Serve as the executive voice of the market and customer in company decisions.
  • Present to the Board of Directors on market opportunities, brand strategy, marketing performance, and return on investment. Recommend priorities, resources, and adjustments based on results.
  • Partner with the Chief Growth Officer, who leads the sales organization, to translate go-to-market strategy into pipeline goals, customer acquisition, and expansion priorities. The CMO owns go-to-market strategy, messaging, and enablement content; the Chief Growth Officer owns sales execution and quota attainment.

Brand and Corporate Communications

  • Own SIS brand strategy, positioning, and standards, including leading brand evolution or rebranding from research and brand architecture through messaging, visual identity, rollout, and measurement, aligning internal and external audiences.
  • Direct corporate communications, public relations, analyst relations, thought leadership, and executive visibility. Partner with executive leadership on reputation management and sensitive external communications.

Demand Generation and Customer Marketing

  • Oversee integrated demand generation across digital, content, email, search, social media, events, account-based marketing, and partner channels to generate qualified pipeline and support revenue goals.
  • Align with sales on lead qualification, handoffs, conversion, and pipeline reporting. Adjust campaign and channel investment based on performance and customer acquisition costs.
  • Partner with customer success, product, and sales to strengthen customer engagement, advocacy, retention, and expansion through education, customer stories, reference programs, and lifecycle marketing.

Marketing Operations and Investment

  • Own the marketing budget, resource allocation, and agency investments. Balance near-term growth needs with long-term brand development and demonstrate financial discipline.
  • Set performance measures for marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, revenue contribution, conversion, acquisition efficiency, brand awareness, and customer engagement. Provide clear reporting and use results to improve execution.
  • Oversee marketing operations, technology, automation, analytics, and data quality. Establish consistent processes and responsible use of customer data in partnership with IT and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure marketing claims, content, and data practices meet healthcare regulatory and customer requirements, including HIPAA and the protection of patient information, in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and IT.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the marketing team, which reports directly to the CMO and translates strategy into coordinated execution. Set priorities, expectations, and accountability for the marketing organization.
  • Build the team’s capabilities, succession plans, and operating structure, including product marketing depth. Oversee agency and vendor relationships and promote effective collaboration across SIS business units.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Assess current product positioning, the competitive landscape, the marketing team, and results to date. Align with the CEO and Chief Growth Officer on go-to-market priorities and the metrics used to measure marketing’s contribution.
  • By month 6: Deliver refreshed positioning and messaging for priority products, a sales enablement program in active use by the sales team, and a marketing plan and budget tied to agreed pipeline targets.
  • By month 12: Execute go-to-market and launch plans for priority products and segments, show measurable growth in marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and have the right team structure and capabilities in place.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 15 or more years of progressive marketing experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility for a broad marketing function in a B2B SaaS, technology, or services business. Healthcare technology experience preferred.
  • Proven leadership of product marketing, including product launches, positioning, competitive differentiation, and pricing and packaging input, ideally in healthcare technology.
  • Proven success creating and executing go-to-market strategies in close partnership with sales, building qualified pipeline, and delivering measurable revenue growth across multiple products or services.
  • Experience presenting to boards and executive teams, managing budgets, and leading senior marketing leaders through organizational change.
  • Experience leading a company rebrand or brand repositioning from strategy through implementation, with demonstrated results in brand positioning, market recognition, or business performance, strongly preferred.

Knowledge and Leadership Skills

  • Strong command of product marketing, go-to-market strategy, brand strategy, demand generation, customer marketing, communications, and marketing operations.
  • Commercial and financial judgment; ability to turn market insights and analytics into clear investment decisions and measurable priorities.
  • Clear executive communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across functions.

Benefit package including:

  • Medical, Vision, Dental, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Vacation/Sick time
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid Holidays
  • SIS Cares Day

jobs.excerpt: Academic Success Manager Are you skilled in driving meaningful engagement to achieve client success?
jobs.description:
Academic Success Manager


Are you skilled in driving meaningful engagement to achieve client success?


Are you passionate about helping academic institutions maximize the value of innovative healthcare education solutions?


About our Team


Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient outcomes.


About the Role

The Academic Success Manager (ASM) is responsible for driving customer retention, renewals and account growth for Elsevier Health's education solutions across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and South Korea.

With a primary focus on protecting and renewing existing business and identifying upselling opportunities, the ASM works closely with academic institutions to ensure successful adoption, continued engagement and value realization of Elsevier's education solutions. Serving as a trusted advisor to universities, medical schools, nursing schools and other healthcare education institutions, the ASM builds strong relationships with academic stakeholders, supports faculty enablement and demonstrates the ongoing value of Elsevier's solutions.

The ASM collaborates closely with Sales, Product, Training and Support teams to maximize customer satisfaction, secure renewals and identify opportunities for account expansion.

Responsibilities

1. Drive Customer Retention and Renewals

  • Proactively manage customer relationships to support timely renewals and minimize customer churn.
  • Develop and execute customer success plans that strengthen engagement, adoption and long-term retention.
  • Identify renewal risks early and implement appropriate customer engagement and recovery strategies.
  • Collaborate with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure successful renewal outcomes.

2. Build and Strengthen Academic Relationships

  • Develop trusted relationships with academic leaders, faculty members and key institutional decision-makers.
  • Identify and nurture academic champions who advocate for Elsevier Health education solutions.
  • Understand institutional priorities, curriculum requirements and evolving educational needs.

3. Drive Product Adoption and Value Realization

  • Support onboarding and ongoing adoption of Elsevier Health education solutions.
  • Work with faculty members to integrate digital learning resources into teaching and learning activities.
  • Monitor product usage, engagement and customer feedback to identify adoption gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Demonstrate continued value through usage insights, customer success stories and academic outcomes.

4. Deliver Faculty Training and Enablement

  • Conduct online and face-to-face product demonstrations, training sessions and workshops.
  • Support educators in maximizing the effectiveness of Elsevier's digital education solutions.
  • Develop scalable customer engagement and enablement initiatives to improve adoption and satisfaction.

5. Identify Upselling and Account Expansion Opportunities

  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer subscriptions, product usage and institutional adoption.
  • Recommend relevant Elsevier Health education solutions based on customer needs and academic priorities.
  • Collaborate with EPSM and Esales Teams to develop and progress upselling opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Leverage customer relationships, usage insights and institutional feedback to support account growth.

6. Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Training and Customer Support teams to ensure a consistent customer experience.
  • Share customer feedback, market insights and success stories to support continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate internal resources to resolve customer challenges and strengthen long-term partnerships.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Business or a related discipline.
  • 5 years of experience in customer success, account management, academic engagement or education technology.
  • Experience engaging universities, medical schools, nursing schools or healthcare education institutions would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of subscription-based digital solutions, customer retention and renewal processes.
  • Strong relationship management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to interpret customer usage data and identify risks and growth opportunities.
  • Experience conducting product demonstrations, customer training and workshops.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across regional teams.
  • Verbal and written fluency English and Korean
  • Willingness to travel across assigned markets.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous well-being initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working for you

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Long Service Award: Recognition for your dedication and loyalty.
  • Flexible Working Arrangements: Balance work and personal life effectively.
  • Access to Learning and Development Resources: Empowering your professional growth.

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

jobs.title: Indigo Premier Research Mentor
jobs.excerpt: Indigo Research provides a unique opportunity to mentor highly motivated high school students from around the world, helping them learn about academic research and complete a college-level project.
jobs.description:
Indigo Research provides a unique opportunity to mentor highly motivated high school students from around the world, helping them learn about academic research and complete a college-level project. Our program offers high-quality research mentorship to aspiring students from diverse backgrounds, with the goals of giving them valuable experience in academic research and making a significant impact on their future academic and professional careers.

We're looking to connect with current faculty members at top 15 US or top 10 UK universities who would enjoy sharing their academic expertise and helping young people discover what they're capable of.

As an Indigo Research Mentor, you'll work remotely with high school students from around the world, supporting them as they turn their interests into a research project of their own. This could involve exploring a new question, making sense of existing literature, developing an argument, or working towards a research paper or other academic output.

More than simply teaching a subject, you'll help students learn how to think critically, ask better questions, and approach challenges with greater independence. You don't need to have all the answers; what matters is your ability to guide students through the process and make academic research an engaging and rewarding experience.

Qualifications:

  • Currently hold a faculty position at a top 15 university in the US or a top 10 university in the UK.

  • Have strong subject knowledge and can help students explore a research topic with academic depth and rigour.

  • Enjoy mentoring and are patient, empathetic, and encouraging when working with high school students.

  • Are comfortable working with students from different cultural and educational backgrounds.

  • Are open to feedback and willing to adapt their approach to each student's needs.

  • Can work independently, exercise sound judgment, and are comfortable in a collaborative, evolving startup environment.

By joining Indigo Research as a mentor, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of aspiring students, helping them to break down geographic barriers and access high-quality research mentorship.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm.
jobs.description:
Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.


Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential


Responsibilities

State Farm is on the cutting edge with the use of technology to support claim employees in developing enhanced skillsets to support and protect our policyholders. Not Human or Digital. Human + Digital, working together.

Our Claim Specialists are committed to helping our customers through the claims process while providing Remarkable® service.

Auto Injury is a customer-facing segment handling bodily injury and uninsured/underinsured claims along with property damage claims involving injuries. Claims will be tiered within Injury based upon their claim characteristics, complexity, and severity. This could range from non-attorney represented bodily injuries, up to attorney represented and/or litigation claims.

Helping people recover from the unexpected can be one of the most rewarding aspects of the Injury claims position. We empower our claim handlers to take ownership of the customer experience, demonstrate learning agility, apply their knowledge, and lead through the eyes of our customers.

Responsibilities for this role include:

  • Reviewing and analyzing injury claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages
  • Conducting thorough investigations by gathering relevant information, interviewing involved parties, and reviewing supporting documentation
  • Evaluating medical records, police reports, and other related documents to assess the extent of injuries and liability
  • Negotiating settlements with claimants, ensuring fair compensation is provided within policy limits
  • Documenting all claim activities, maintaining accurate records, and preparing reports as required
  • Collaborating with internal teams, including legal, medical, and risk assessment, to ensure proper claim handling
  • Claims employees may occasionally deal with difficult and emotional investigations which include traumatic injury and loss of life
  • Handling may include lawsuits and/or demands as well as working with Attorneys
  • This is a remote position; however candidates must reside within 50 miles of New Albany, OH

Hours of operation and/or work arrangements are continually evaluated and may change based on business need. Successful candidates are able and willing to work flexible work shifts and may be asked to work overtime and/or irregular hours.


Qualifications

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree is preferred

Competitive candidates also demonstrate the following:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with clients, agents, and other stakeholders
  • Proven effective empathy and de-escalation skills to handle difficult/emotional conversations with a customer-minded focus
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
  • Ability to multi-task across technical platforms
  • Accountability
  • Resourcefulness

Additional Details:

  • Employees must successfully complete all required training, including applicable proficiency, licensing exam(s) and background checks required of various state(s)
  • State Farm recently implemented new pre-employment assessments. Candidates that have previously taken an assessment may be asked to participate in additional testing

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

  • Potential starting salary range: $70,101.85 - $83,535.93
    • Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience
    • High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience
  • Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary

At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

  • Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.
  • Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
  • Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
  • Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
  • Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
  • Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
  • Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

jobs.title: Specialty Pharmacy Liaison
jobs.excerpt: As a pharmaceutical support industry leader, UBC is devoted to empowering health solutions for a better tomorrow.
jobs.description:
As a pharmaceutical support industry leader, UBC is devoted to empowering health solutions for a better tomorrow. We take pride in improvingpatient outcomes and advancing healthcare.At UBCwe provide services to enhance the entire drug development process and commercialization lifecycle - From clinical trial support to real-world evidence generation.

Embark on a rewarding career journey with UBC!Grow your career while making a meaningful impacton the world around you. UBC fosters a culture built on our Core Values being: Collaborative, Conscientious, Curious, Consultative, and Compassionate. We believe in an inclusive workplace that fosters creativity.

If you are seeking a career that will challenge, inspire, and reward you, join us at UBC!

Brief Description:

Patients are at the center of our business strategies. This role serves as a single point of contact for program specific Specialty Pharmacies (SPs), Specialty Distributors (SDs) and/or the manufacturer’s Sales Force. Responsible for reviewing, analyzing, identifying, and solving problematic issues and escalations. Provide timely and accurate reconciliation of SP and/or SD dispensing/shipping information, builds and develops strong SP-HUB relationships, and support all activities that facilitate patient access. As applicable, builds and develops strong Sales Force-HUB relationships. Utilize knowledge of specialty pharmacy processes, dispensing patterns and reimbursement issues to effectively detect and investigate potential gaps in care.

Specific job duties:

  • Service Provider will provide dedicated full-time equivalent Specialty Pharmacy Liaison(s) (SPL) to serve as the primary resource managing the coordination of specialty pharmacies within HUB operations.
  • The SPL manages the SPPs by conducting teleconferences with each SP.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Sicherheitsvorfälle, die von unserem Security Operations Center (SOC) identifiziert werden, analysierst und erklärst du verständlich und lösungsorientiert

  • Risikomanagement und Schwachstellenbewertung gehören zu deinem Repertoire
  • Kommunikation liegt dir – schriftlich wie mündlich, auf Deutsch und Englisch
  • Mit Kunden pflegst du professionelle Beziehungen und verstehst es, Vertrauen aufzubauen

Technische Kenntnisse in mind. 4 der Bereiche:

  • Netzwerksicherheit: Umfassendes Wissen in Netzwerkarchitekturen, Firewalls, IDS/IPS und VPN-Technologien
  • Betriebssysteme: Du bist versiert in der Härtung von Windows-, Linux- und Unix-Systemen
  • Verschlüsselung: Gängige Verfahren und Protokolle sind dir vertraut
  • Penetrationstests: Die Auswertung von Pentests liegt dir, ebenso wie die anschließende Beratung
  • Sicherheitstools: Der Umgang mit SIEM, SOAR, EDR, UTM und Honeypots ist dir vertraut
  • Cloud Security: Du verstehst die Sicherheitsmechanismen moderner Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS, Azure)
  • Security Frameworks: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse von Frameworks wie MITRE ATT&CK und NIST
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Umgang mit Tools wie Nmap, Nessus oder OpenVAS.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

  • Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

  • Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

  • Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

  • Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

  • Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

  • Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

  • Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

  • A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

  • University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

  • Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information:

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $220,000 - $288,750. The estimated base salary for this role is $165,000 - $216,562.
  • Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: SVP,  Enrollment
jobs.excerpt: Who is American College of Education Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs.
jobs.description:
Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and

collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating

with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As the Senior Vice President (SVP) of Enrollment, you are responsible driving enrollment growth and building

a high-performing, scalable enrollment organization at ACE. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the

student acquisition journey from lead through enrollment, including Enrollment Operations and related

enrollment support functions, with leadership responsibility for an organization of approximately 70

employees.

You will be accountable for achieving ACE’s enrollment growth objectives while continuously improving

conversion, productivity, service levels, and the prospective student experience. You possess the ability to

anticipate prospective student needs, define service standards, and measure experience quality. You will

combine deep enrollment expertise with strong operating discipline, evolving ACE’s processes, systems,

organizational structure, and capabilities as the institution scales.

You will work closely with the CMO to optimize lead quality and funnel performance, with the CIO and IT

organization to ensure technology and data enable enrollment performance, and with other functional

leaders across ACE to drive coordinated execution.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality,

affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $175,000 plus all full-time

employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and

expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Develop and execute the College's enrollment strategy to achieve enrollment growth and long-term institutional objectives.
  • Lead and optimize the end-to-end enrollment organization, ensuring alignment of people, processes, technology, and resources.
  • Establish enrollment goals, forecasting models, performance metrics, and accountability frameworks that drive measurable results.
  • Partner with Marketing leadership to maximize lead quality, conversion performance, and enrollment funnel effectiveness.
  • Build and develop a high-performing enrollment leadership team and culture focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee enrollment budgeting, workforce planning, and resource allocation to support growth and operational excellence.
  • Champion enrollment transformation through technology, automation, AI, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to align enrollment strategies with institutional priorities, market opportunities, and long-term growth plans.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including 7+ years leading scaled enrollment, admissions, or analogous student/customer acquisition organizations.
  • Deep enrollment leadership experience within primarily online higher education or a closely adjacent
  • environment, such as an OPM or EdTech organization with a comparable high-touch, high consideration go-to-market model.
  • Experience leading a sizable enrollment/contact-center organization, including frontline enrollment teams and supporting capabilities such as operations, analytics, workforce management, training, or quality.
  • Expertise in training and quality, including the strategy and oversight of a training and quality program that includes scalable counselor onboarding, coaching, program knowledge, interaction quality standards, and quality assurance.
  • Proven track record of delivering enrollment growth, with direct accountability for enrollment targets and measurable improvement across the lead-to-enrollment funnel.
  • Track record of materially improving enrollment productivity and funnel economics, such as conversion rates, speed-to-lead, advisor effectiveness, lead utilization, yield, or cost efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve and scale an enrollment organization, including improving processes, workflows, organizational structures, systems, and talent to support growth and efficiency.
  • Experience owning enrollment operations and governance, including counselor expectations, inquiry management standards, policies, procedures, controls, and responsible and compliant recruitment practices.
  • Strong data and analytics orientation, with experience establishing dashboards, operational KPIs, forecasting processes, performance-management cadences, and clear accountability for results.
  • Expertise in enrollment operations business acumen, including direct ownership of the enrollment budget, headcount plan, resource allocation, and workforce/capacity planning that is aligned with inquiry volume and enrollment goals.
  • Experience change leader and people leader who can upgrade capabilities, develop strong leaders, make necessary talent decisions, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, urgency, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Marketing, IT, and other functions while maintaining clear ownership of enrollment outcomes.
  • Strong technology and systems orientation, with experience defining business requirements and improving CRM, lead-management, workflow, reporting, and automation capabilities in partnership with technology teams.
  • Extensive experience with student information systems and end-to-end integration to positively impact the lead-to-enrollment handoff across the CRM, SIS, telephony, workflow, reporting, and related systems.
  • Executive presence and enterprise mindset, with the maturity and credibility to operate effectively with the CEO, board, and executive leadership team while remaining hands-on enough to drive execution.
  • Mission-oriented, believes in the transformative value of accessible, high-quality higher education.

Strong Preferred Qualifications

  • A mix of large- and small-company experience, ideally having brought structured operating rigor, systems, processes, and management disciplines from a scaled organization into a leaner, faster moving environment.
  • Familiarity with the online higher education ecosystem, including academic calendars, accreditation, regulatory considerations, and working-adult student populations.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, Salesforce, or comparable CRM and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve lead prioritization, advisor productivity, workflow efficiency, forecasting, or enrollment conversion.
  • Experience working in a Private Equity-backed or similarly performance-oriented environment.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6

consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for

medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a

USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to

creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following

benefits:

  • Medical, dental, & vision Insurance
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Tuition reimbursement & reduction programs
  • Generous PTO
  • 401k and employer match
  • Full-service wellness and EAP program
  • Employee recognition and awards programs
  • Employer paid life & AD&D insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Employer paid long-term disability
  • And more…

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to

successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee

is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in

real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Software Development Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing applications across all layers of the software stack, from database development through front-end functionality. Working within an Agile development environment, this role partners with business and technical teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, implement enhancements, and perform unit testing to support application quality, reliability, and performance.

The Software Development Engineer II works across multiple projects and technical environments while collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, and Architecture teams throughout the software development lifecycle. This position requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, adaptability to changing business and technology needs, and the ability to develop effective solutions to business and client challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications across multiple tiers of the software architecture.
  • Support complex and highly visible development initiatives across multiple projects and technical environments.
  • Gather and evaluate business and technical requirements to develop effective application solutions.
  • Prototype, develop, test, and implement software solutions that address business and client needs.
  • Design, develop, and extend back-end web services using JSON, .NET web services, SQL, and related technologies.
  • Create, consume, maintain, and enhance RESTful APIs.
  • Develop and execute unit tests to support application quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Support application releases and development activities using Agile software development practices.
  • Apply Test Driven Development (TDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams throughout requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation.
  • Work closely with architects to ensure applications and technical solutions align with Fleet Response IT's long-term strategy and architectural standards.
  • Participate in solution scoping by identifying technical requirements and developing solutions to business and client challenges.
  • Apply knowledge across multiple technical environments and business areas when developing and supporting applications.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and identify appropriate technical solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation related to applications, enhancements, and development activities.
  • Manage multiple development priorities while adapting to changing business requirements, technologies, and project needs.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform duties outside their normal responsibilities as business needs dictate.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Three to five years of software development experience.
  • Proficiency with API and web application development technologies.
  • Proficiency with C#, Angular 10+, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, LESS, Node.js, or similar development technologies.
  • Experience creating and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, or other source control and code repository tools.
  • Experience working within a predominantly .NET-based codebase.
  • Ability to work effectively within a predominantly Windows-based development environment.
  • Experience writing T-SQL and working with Microsoft SQL Server.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS, with Microsoft Azure preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of full-stack application development across database, back-end, API, and front-end technologies.
  • Strong understanding of API and web development concepts and practices.
  • Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Understanding of Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to gather and evaluate business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ability to design and develop solutions across multiple technical environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to develop, test, implement, and support reliable software applications.
  • Ability to identify technical solutions to complex business and client challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, UX, Engineering, Architecture, business partners, clients, and vendors.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a development team.
  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies, business priorities, and technical requirements.
  • Demonstrated initiative, accountability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • Work is performed primarily in a professional indoor office or home-office environment.
  • Requires prolonged periods of sitting, typing, computer use, reading, and technical analysis.
  • Requires close visual attention when reviewing code, technical documentation, data, and computer screens.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de Clientèle – Logistique Import Chine - Freelance
jobs.excerpt: À propos de notre clientNotre client est une agence francophone de sourcing et de logistique import, implantée en Chine depuis plusieurs années.
jobs.description:
À propos de notre client

Notre client est une agence francophone de sourcing et de logistique import, implantée en Chine depuis plusieurs années. Elle accompagne les TPE et PME francophones qui achètent en Chine, du premier échange avec une usine jusqu'à la livraison des marchandises : recherche de fournisseurs, négociation, suivi de production, contrôle qualité, puis logistique internationale (fret maritime, aérien et ferroviaire, dédouanement, livraison, entreposage). Plusieurs milliers d'entreprises ont déjà été accompagnées.

L'activité logistique génère un flux quotidien de demandes de devis (formulaire de devis du site, e-mails, messagerie) émanant de dirigeants de petites structures, souvent primo-importateurs, qui attendent réactivité, pédagogie et un interlocuteur unique. C'est pour structurer ce suivi que notre client crée ce poste.

À propos du rôle

Au sein de l'équipe de notre client, vous êtes le premier point de contact des clients et prospects qui sollicitent l'agence pour un transport depuis la Chine. Vous prenez en charge chaque demande dès son arrivée, la qualifiez, l'enregistrez dans le CRM et la faites avancer jusqu'à la clôture du dossier, en assurant le relais permanent entre le client et les différents agents concernés. Le poste est très majoritairement téléphonique et e-mail, en lien avec une clientèle française.

Vos missions

Traitement des demandes entrantes

▪Réceptionner et traiter l'ensemble des demandes entrantes (formulaire de devis du site, e-mails, messagerie, appels) dans les délais fixés.

▪Prendre contact rapidement avec chaque prospect pour qualifier le besoin : nature de la marchandise, volume/poids, origine et destination, Incoterm, délais souhaités, documents disponibles.

▪Renseigner la fiche client dans le CRM Zoho, puis maintenir les données à jour tout au long du dossier (contacts, échanges, statut, pièces).

▪Orienter chaque demande vers le bon agent (cotation transport, sourcing, douane) avec un dossier complet, puis relayer la réponse ou le devis au client, répondre à ses questions et assurer les relances jusqu'à la décision.

Suivi des dossiers et relation client

▪Être l'interlocuteur(trice) unique du client pendant toute la durée du dossier : point d'avancement, informations sur les étapes (enlèvement, départ, transit, dédouanement, livraison), réponses aux sollicitations.

▪Faire le relais entre le client et les opérateurs internes et externes (agents en charge des cotations, équipe sourcing, etc.) et s'assurer que chaque demande trouve une réponse.

▪Collecter et vérifier les documents nécessaires à l'expédition et au dédouanement (facture, liste de colisage, certificats, mandats) et relancer les parties concernées.

▪Suivre la clôture des dossiers (livraison effectuée, facturation réglée) et contribuer à la satisfaction client, en transmettant les informations nécessaires à la personne en charge de la satisfaction client.

▪Tenir à jour le pipeline des demandes et des dossiers en cours dans le CRM et alerter sur les points bloquants.

▪Partager avec l'équipe un point régulier sur l'activité : demandes reçues, devis en attente, dossiers en cours, incidents.

Point d'attention

Son rôle est d'être l'interface entre le client et l'ensemble des agents concernés, de garantir la réactivité et la qualité du suivi, et de faire avancer chaque dossier jusqu'à sa clôture.

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

▪Formation Bac +2 à Bac +5 en logistique, transport ou commerce international.

▪Expérience confirmée en logistique et transport international (transitaire, commissionnaire de transport, service import/export, ADV ou Chargé de Clientèle d'un importateur), avec une bonne compréhension des flux depuis l'Asie : fret maritime et aérien, Incoterms, documents d'expédition, dédouanement.

▪Expérience de la relation client à distance (téléphone, e-mail) auprès d'une clientèle de dirigeants de TPE/PME.

▪Maîtrise d'un CRM – la connaissance de Zoho CRM est un vrai plus – et aisance avec les outils bureautiques et collaboratifs.

Compétences clés

▪Excellent français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit : élocution claire et neutre, orthographe irréprochable, aisance au téléphone avec une clientèle française.

▪Organisation et rigueur : suivre plusieurs dossiers en parallèle, ne rien laisser sans réponse, documenter chaque étape.

▪Réactivité et disponibilité : horaires alignés sur la France, traitement rapide des demandes.

▪Sens du service, pédagogie et autonomie : savoir rassurer un client qui importe pour la première fois, et travailler seul(e) à distance avec une équipe répartie entre la France et la Chine.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

What You’ll Do

  • Case Evaluation: Review and assess the merits of clients’ Personal Injury claims by analyzing records, documents, and evidence to determine liability and potential value
  • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients
  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement effective strategies to protect clients’ rights and interests. Conduct legal research, analyze medical records, gather evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies to achieve favorable settlements
  • Client Communication: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing updates, explaining legal processes, and advising them on their rights and options
  • Medical and Vocational Assessment: Collaborate with medical and vocational experts to evaluate the extent of injuries, their impact on clients’ ability to work, and appropriate future treatment requirements
  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

How This Role Drives the Business

  • Maximizes case value through strong case development, sound evaluation, and effective negotiation prior to litigation
  • Moves cases efficiently through the pre-litigation lifecycle, supporting faster resolutions and improved cash flow
  • Identifies cases that should be escalated to litigation early, enabling better strategy, resource allocation, and outcomes
  • Enhances client satisfaction and trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-through
  • Reduces risk and rework by spotting issues early, making decisive recommendations, and ensuring alignment across teams
  • Supports scale by holding case managers accountable to performance metrics and ensuring consistent, high-quality work product
  • Strengthens operational efficiency by reinforcing clear workflows between case managers and the medical records team to avoid delays in case development

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

  • You independently manage a robust pre-litigation caseload, moving matters efficiently from intake through resolution while maintaining high quality and attention to detail
  • You consistently maximize case value through strong case evaluation, strategic guidance, and effective negotiation
  • You identify cases that require escalation to litigation and make timely, well-reasoned recommendations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • You collaborate closely with case managers, holding them accountable to performance metrics by setting clear expectations, reviewing work product, and ensuring deadlines are met
  • You take ownership of outcomes by maintaining the same level of accountability you expect from your case managers
  • You review, refine, and approve demand packages prepared by case managers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strong positioning for negotiation
  • You ensure case managers are effectively coordinating with the medical records team to obtain all necessary records and bills in a timely manner
  • You maintain proactive, consistent communication with clients, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout the process
  • You identify issues early, make timely recommendations, and help prevent bottlenecks
  • You build strong cases that, if needed, can be taken into litigation and through trial

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active admission to the Georgia Bar
  • 5 - 10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust case load independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Georgia laws, regulations, and procedures required
  • Must be located in or near the State of Georgia
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Nice to Have:

  • Active Admission to one or more districts of the Georgia Federal Court
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Experience in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

jobs.description:
JOB ROLE: Client Project Manager

LOCATION: Remote

HOURS: Monday - Friday 8am-5pm (UK hours)

SALARY: 26,000-34,000 ZAR per month + Bonus based on performance

About the role:

We’re looking for a commercially driven Client Project Manager who can win new clients, turn enquiries into confirmed work and grow long-term client relationships within property maintenance and refurbishment.

You’ll take ownership of your client portfolio—from identifying opportunities and preparing competitive quotes to negotiating with suppliers and subcontractors, overseeing delivery and ensuring payment. Success means winning profitable work, delivering on your promises and giving clients reasons to come back.

We’re building our own system with AI and automations to reduce routine administration and help our team work more effectively. This will give you more time to focus on sales, client relationships and commercial decisions.

We want someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT, actively explores new AI capabilities and is keen to help improve how we work. You’ll also bring practical trade knowledge and a commitment to keep learning about property maintenance and refurbishment.

Key responsibilities:

Win work and grow client accounts

  • Proactively identify and win new clients through outbound sales, referrals and networking.
  • Convert inbound enquiries into booked work through responsive communication, persuasive proposals and consistent follow-up.
  • Build strong client relationships, understand their properties and priorities, and become their trusted point of contact.
  • Generate new quote opportunities by identifying maintenance and refurbishment needs within existing accounts.
  • Follow up confidently, handle objections and move opportunities towards a decision.
  • Take ownership of your sales pipeline, quote conversion and client revenue growth.

Build competitive, profitable quotes

  • Understand client requirements and coordinate engineers, subcontractors or suppliers for surveys and specialist input where needed.
  • Prepare clear, itemised quotes with accurate scope, pricing and exclusions.
  • Negotiate competitive prices, availability and terms with suppliers and subcontractors while maintaining quality and protecting profit margins.
  • Develop a reliable supply chain and build relationships that support competitive pricing and dependable delivery.
  • Use your trade knowledge to challenge costs, identify gaps and propose practical solutions.
  • Seek technical advice where needed before committing to a scope or price.

Own the client experience and project delivery

  • Act as the client’s main point of contact throughout the job lifecycle.
  • Coordinate engineers, subcontractors, materials and access so work runs smoothly.
  • Ensure work is allocated to the right trade, location and availability.
  • Provide clear work instructions and keep clients informed of progress.
  • Resolve issues proactively and escalate when necessary.
  • Verify completed work through photos, client feedback and completion checks.
  • Agree changes to scope and additional costs before extra work proceeds.

Manage invoicing, profitability and payments

  • Ensure jobs are invoiced within 24 hours of completion.
  • Follow up on outstanding payments and resolve billing queries promptly.
  • Monitor project profitability and identify where costs or scope changes affect margins.
  • Take responsibility for commercial outcomes, from the initial enquiry through to payment.

Use AI and automation to improve productivity

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT to support quote drafting, client communication, meeting preparation and sales follow-up.
  • Check AI-generated outputs for accuracy, particularly technical scope, costs and commitments to clients.
  • Learn and adopt our own system as its AI and automation capabilities develop.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work and improve speed, accuracy and the client experience.
  • Keep up with useful developments in AI, test practical applications and share improvements with the team.
  • Keep client, opportunity and job records accurate, and use approved tools responsibly.

Keep developing your trade knowledge

  • Continually build your understanding of maintenance and refurbishment trades, materials, labour requirements and pricing.
  • Learn from engineers, suppliers and completed projects to improve future quotes and decisions.
  • Ask practical questions, recognise gaps in your knowledge and seek specialist input when needed

How we measure success:

    • New clients won and quote opportunities generated.
    • Revenue and gross profit growth.
    • Quote conversion rates and turnaround times.
    • Repeat business and client retention.
    • Jobs booked and quality of project delivery.
    • Timely invoicing and payment collection.

Requirements

  • At least two years’ experience in property maintenance, refurbishment or a closely related trade services business.
  • A track record of winning work, converting quotes or growing client accounts.
  • Strong sales and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to approach new clients and develop repeat business.
  • Confident negotiation skills and a sound understanding of pricing, costs and profit margins.
  • Practical trade knowledge and a commitment to continually developing it.
  • Hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools, with examples of how they improve your productivity.
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to keep learning and adapting as our systems evolve.
  • Experience coordinating clients, engineers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Strong organisation, clear written and verbal communication, and reliable follow-through.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, job tracking software and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working towards targets, participating in daily stand-ups and contributing to process improvements.
  • A proactive approach—you follow up, solve problems and take responsibility for results.
  • A degree in any field and occasional weekend availability are advantages.

Additional requirements for remote roles

You must have:

  • Your own well-specified computer: A reliable, modern computer capable of smoothly running multiple business applications, AI tools and video calls at the same time.
  • Two screens: A dual-screen setup suitable for managing quotes, client communications and job information efficiently.
  • A good-quality camera: A webcam that provides a clear, professional image for client and team video calls.
  • A good-quality headset: Headphones with a clear microphone, suitable for regular calls.
  • Fast, reliable internet: A stable connection that supports uninterrupted video calls and cloud-based systems.
  • A suitable home office: A dedicated, quiet and professional workspace where you can focus and take client calls without interruptions.
  • Availability aligned with UK operations: The ability to work agreed hours supporting our UK clients and delivery teams.

You must be comfortable working independently, staying accessible to colleagues and clients, and taking ownership of your targets and results.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped bonus scheme.
  • Profit-sharing scheme.
  • Career development opportunities as the business grows across the UK and Dubai.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a business building its own AI-powered systems and automations.
  • A collaborative, performance-driven culture with clear targets and ownership of results.
