Blend360 is hiring a senior commercial leader to build and scale its Databricks partnership. This leader will own the external relationship with Databricks and translate it into a disciplined account, co sell, and market motion across Blend. The role connects Databricks field teams with Blend account teams, helps clients turn business priorities into credible Databricks opportunities, and builds the evidence needed for long term partner progression.

The successful candidate is commercially accountable, technically credible, and comfortable working in a matrix. They will not operate as a general alliance manager. They will create field confidence in a small number of differentiated, client backed Databricks offers while ensuring the joint motion produces measurable client outcomes, qualified pipeline, and referenceable work.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Databricks commercial partnership for Blend, including executive relationships, field mapping, partner planning, and an operating cadence with Databricks and Blend leaders.
  • Build and run joint account plans with priority Blend accounts, including named Databricks stakeholders, client sponsors, opportunity hypotheses, next steps, and success measures.
  • Establish co sell qualification rules that focus investment on opportunities with an active Databricks footprint, a business led use case, credible Blend access, and a path to measurable customer value.
  • Work with account, sales, solution, and delivery leaders to shape pursuits, executive workshops, proposals, and account expansion plans.
  • Develop a focused go to market narrative around governed data and AI applications, modernization, and industry specific use cases rather than generic implementation capacity.
  • Partner with the Databricks Field CTO/Technical Leader to ensure field commitments reflect Blend delivery readiness, architecture standards, certified capacity, and reusable assets.
  • Create the commercial evidence needed for partnership progression, including influenced or sourced pipeline, joint customer outcomes, references, partner plan execution, and market ready offers.
  • Maintain an accurate view of Databricks opportunity health, blockers, account coverage, and leadership decisions; escalate issues early and drive resolution across functions.
  • Represent Blend in relevant Databricks field events, executive meetings, and industry forums, using client value and delivery proof rather than unsubstantiated claims.

First 120 Days

  • Confirm Blend current partnership baseline, current program requirements, and the evidence required for the next tier with the Databricks Partner Account Manager.
  • Map priority Databricks field relationships and establish a weekly commercial operating cadence.
  • Launch five to eight joint account plans with clear owners, mutual next steps, and a defined value hypothesis.
  • Define co sell qualification, CRM visibility, and pipeline review practices for the partnership.
  • Align three to four priority use case wedges with Databricks field feedback and Blend technical readiness.

Success Measures

  • A predictable joint account cadence that produces clear client and Databricks next steps.
  • A qualified co sell pipeline tied to named accounts, use cases, and delivery capacity.
  • Referenceable customer outcomes and credible evidence of Databricks partner progression.
  • A focused market narrative that Databricks sellers and Blend teams can use consistently.

Senior commercial, alliance, practice, or solutions leadership experience in a consulting, technology, or data and AI services organization.

  • Demonstrated success building strategic platform partnerships and converting partner relationships into qualified joint opportunities and client outcomes.
  • Experience leading complex account and executive stakeholder conversations, including workshops, value cases, and technology enabled transformation discussions.
  • Working knowledge of the Databricks platform and the data, analytics, governance, AI, and cloud concepts that shape client buying decisions.
  • A track record of collaborating effectively with technical leaders, sellers, account teams, and delivery organizations in a matrix environment.
  • Strong commercial judgment: able to distinguish promising partner activity from pursuits that merit sustained investment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts in business terms.
  • Bachelor degree or equivalent experience; Databricks certifications and relevant cloud or data platform credentials are an advantage.

The starting pay range for this role is $275k - $325k. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 offers a competitive benefits program designed to support the health and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Benefits vary by role and eligibility and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, paid holidays, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts, life and disability insurance, and employee assistance programs.

Blend360 is a high-growth, AI-forward company at the forefront of data science, analytics, technology, and agentic AI solutions. We partner with leading enterprises to transform business performance by combining consulting expertise, world-class talent, and scalable technology solutions. Our mission is to fuel bold visions and deliver measurable transformation through the seamless alignment of human expertise and artificial intelligence.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

We are currently seeking a Sr. Manager, Security Operations to lead our Global Security Operations team within Addepar’s Information Security & Risk organization. In this role, you will own the day-to-day running of our detection and response function, act as incident commander for security incidents, and partner with our 24/7 MSSP to ensure threats are identified and handled quickly. jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

We need a versatile graphic designer who can flex across brand, packaging, and marketing. You’ll work closely with our Brand Creative team and collaborate across Brand Marketing, Operations, Regulatory, and Production — helping our visual identity and design come to life across every touchpoint.


You’re the designer who can go from a die-line spec to a presentation deck without missing a beat. You combine real technical chops with a genuine creative eye — comfortable with varnish layers and spot UV finishes as well as pulling together a compelling brand presentation. AI-assisted creative tools are already part of how you work.


Responsibilities will include:


Brand & Marketing Design

  • Develop marketing assets, pitch decks, comps, presentation visuals, and other creative materials as needed.
  • Ensure decks have a cohesive appearance — perfecting alignment, adapting existing brand assets, and elevating Marketing materials.
  • Design and refresh brand materials such as inserts and pamphlets while adhering to brand guidelines.
  • Help craft, execute, and enforce the brand visual identity across printed materials and digital assets.
  • Contribute creative concepts for design exploration: mockups, graphics, layout directions, and concepts.

Packaging & Production

  • Create and prepare print-ready packaging artwork files in Adobe Illustrator, including die-lines, production specifications, and finishing layers (varnish, spot UV, emboss/deboss, foil).
  • Support packaging updates, revisions, and versioning across SKUs, keeping files accurate, clean, and current.
  • Create and retouch photo-realistic imagery using Photoshop and generative AI tools.

Collaboration & Process

  • Collaborate across Brand Creative, Brand Marketing, Production, Regulatory, and Operations — communicating clearly and keeping everyone moving.
  • Use AI creative tools (NanoBanana, Firefly, and similar) to accelerate concepting and creative development.
  • Maintain organized, well-structured working files that anyone on the team can pick up and navigate.
  • Stay current on design and packaging trends and bring fresh visual references and perspective to the creative conversation.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven ability to design across formats: packaging, marketing decks, brand collateral, and digital assets.
  • Strong experience designing for print production — die-lines, print processes, and production-ready file setup are second nature.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Slack, Google Suite (Slides, Docs, Sheets), and Microsoft Office.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative and image-generation tools (NanoBanana, Firefly, etc.).
  • A genuine creative eye for modern design trends, visual storytelling, and brand impact.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and a near-obsessive approach to file organization.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who keeps the right people informed without being asked.

Core Compentencies

  • Packaging & production design — Creates accurate, complete, print-ready artwork files including die-lines, finishing specs, and color callouts. Vendors can work from the files without clarification.
  • Brand & marketing design — Flexes from a packaging comp to a pitch deck without losing quality or consistency. Keeps the visual identity coherent across every format.
  • AI-assisted creative — Uses tools like Firefly and NanoBanana as genuine workflow accelerators — not novelties. Knows when they help and when they don’t.
  • Cross-functional collaboration — Keeps Regulatory, Production, Marketing, and Operations moving by communicating clearly and delivering without friction.
  • File discipline — Maintains organized, version-controlled working files that anyone on the team can navigate. Never sends the wrong version.
  • Design trend awareness — Brings fresh visual references and perspective to the creative conversation. Keeps the brand’s visual language current and competitive.
  • Independent execution — Manages their own timeline, delivers without hand-holding, and flags blockers before they become problems.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market benchmarks.
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Paid time off and company-observed holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.
  • Access to tools, resources, and training to support success in the role.

jobs.description:
Senior 3D Character Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior 3D Character Artists with exceptional artistic skills and a passion for creating expressive, appealing, and memorable stylized characters for our game development and co-development projects.

We believe outstanding character art goes beyond technical execution. Every silhouette, proportion, material, and subtle design detail should reinforce a character's personality and make them instantly recognizable.

As part of our character art team, you will create high-quality, production-ready characters from concept through final in-engine implementation, collaborating closely with concept artists, animators, technical artists, and creative leadership.

This is a senior, hands-on role for artists who combine outstanding artistic taste with strong production skills and a deep understanding of real-time game development.

Key Responsibilities

Character Art Creation

  • Create high-quality stylized 3D characters with strong silhouettes, appealing proportions, and distinctive personalities.

  • Model, sculpt, UV, texture, and refine characters from early blockout through final production.

  • Translate 2D concepts into compelling 3D characters while preserving artistic intent and visual storytelling.

  • Develop convincing stylized materials, textures, and surface details.

  • Maintain a consistent visual language across characters while supporting individuality and creative variety.

Game-Ready Character Production

  • Prepare optimized character assets for real-time engines, particularly Unity3D.

  • Work with appropriate polygon budgets, UV layouts, texture atlases, LODs, and material constraints.

  • Collaborate with rigging and animation teams to ensure characters deform well and support expressive performances.

  • Integrate and review character assets in-engine, ensuring visual quality and technical correctness.

  • Balance artistic ambition with gameplay readability, mobile performance, and production requirements.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Work closely with Character Art Directors, Concept Artists, Animators, and Technical Artists.

  • Participate in artistic reviews and contribute to maintaining high character quality standards.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support other artists when needed.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve character appeal, visual consistency, and production workflows.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a 3D Character Artist in game development.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating high-quality stylized 3D characters and strong artistic fundamentals.

  • Excellent understanding of anatomy, stylized proportions, shape language, color, and character appeal.

  • Strong skills in 3D modeling, sculpting, UV mapping, texturing, and material creation.

  • Proficiency in Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance 3D Painter, or equivalent professional tools.

  • Experience preparing optimized characters for real-time game engines.

  • Understanding of character deformation, rigging requirements, and animation-friendly topology.

  • Ability to interpret concepts and maintain a consistent artistic style.

  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving.

  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with Unity3D and mobile game development.

  • Familiarity with pixel-inspired, simplified, or highly stylized visual aesthetics.

  • Experience creating humanoids, creatures, and non-human characters.

  • Knowledge of stylized shaders and character material workflows.

  • Experience with procedural workflows or character customization systems.

  • Experience mentoring other character artists.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to visually distinctive game projects.

  • High artistic ownership and influence over character quality and presentation.

  • Collaboration with experienced character artists, animators, and international creative teams.

  • Remote-friendly working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Create Characters Players Will Love?

Send us your portfolio and a short introduction. We would love to see stylized characters that demonstrate exceptional artistic quality, personality, and production-ready execution.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be. We believe that mobility is the gateway to opportunity—connecting people to housing, education, employment, commerce, and care. By making transportation more accessible, affordable, and sustainable, we empower communities to thrive and unlock economic and social prosperity.

Our mission is to revolutionize transit with a solution that delivers high capacity, exceptional user experiences, unmatched affordability, and minimal environmental impact.

The Glydways system is a groundbreaking network of carbon-neutral, interconnected transit pathways powered by standardized autonomous vehicles on dedicated roadways. Operating 24/7 with on-demand access, it offers personalized and efficient mobility—without the burden of heavy upfront infrastructure costs or ongoing taxpayer subsidies.

With Glydways, we’re building more than a transportation system; we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere, has the freedom to move.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team is where the vehicle comes to life. We write and load the firmware that turns raw hardware—sensor kits, custom boards, and main compute—into a reliable, safety-critical machine. Because our software touches nearly every subsystem, we collaborate with engineers from across the company and get hands-on with the newest hardware in the building.

About the Role:

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will own critical firmware domains, lead complex cross-functional projects, and help shape our embedded platform and engineering best practices. This is firmware that carries real passengers—on a Glydways vehicle, reliability is a safety requirement, not just a performance goal, and the code you ship is part of the safety case.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, build, and test production vehicle firmware for safety-critical systems.
  • Develop and optimize applications in RTOS environments, tuning for reliability, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and power on resource-constrained platforms.
  • Own and evolve the communication architecture between MCUs, sensors, and main compute, across both standard and custom protocols (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN, TCP/UDP, and more).
  • Lead bring-up and debugging for new boards and SoCs—bootloaders, drivers, and low-level diagnostics—partnering with electrical engineers and software developers to take new sensor and compute platforms from prototype to production.
  • Define and build automated testing frameworks and harnesses at the unit, integration, and system levels alongside test and platform engineers.
  • Mentor other embedded engineers, give thorough code reviews, and help set engineering standards, tools, and best practices across the team.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Core technical skills

  • Expert-level C and/or C++ for embedded systems; additional languages and tooling are a plus.
  • Strong command of communication protocols, from low level (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN) to higher level (TCP/UDP).
  • Experience developing on RTOS environments (e.g., PX5 or other POSIX/pthreads-based real-time OSes such as embedded Linux with pthreads, QNX, VxWorks, or RTEMS).
  • Experience with MCU bootloaders, device drivers, and new board or SoC bring-up.
  • Experience deploying firmware to multi-device systems or vehicles in a power-safe, fault-tolerant way.
  • Demonstrated speed and size optimization for resource-constrained platforms.

Process and quality

  • Experience with safety-critical systems and processes (e.g., ISO 26262 or similar standards) is highly valued.
  • Solid understanding of the embedded software development life cycle—version control, code review, CI, and automated testing.

Nice to have

  • Experience in automotive and/or transit domains.
  • Experience with automotive-grade safety MCUs — ideally the NXP S32K3 family, or comparable lockstep/ASIL-rated parts (e.g., Infineon AURIX, TI TMS570).
  • Familiarity with kernel internals and low-level OS concepts.
  • Experience with deterministic timing and networking, such as NTP, PTP, or time-sensitive networking (TSN).
  • Experience with CAN tooling and DBC-based workflows.
  • Comfort with electronics test equipment and hardware debugging (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.).
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for test automation and tooling.

Typical experience

  • Typically 7+ years developing embedded software for production systems, including substantial work on safety-critical or highly reliable platforms (automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, robotics, etc.).

*If you’re excited about this work but don’t check every box, we’d still love to hear from you. We know the best candidates don’t always match every line of a job description.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleRecurly Commerce is one of the company's most important growth bets, and we're looking for a Principal Product Manager to run it like a business — not just a product.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Recurly Commerce is one of the company's most important growth bets, and we're looking for a Principal Product Manager to run it like a business — not just a product. This is a founder-style role for someone who thinks like a mini General Manager: you'll own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Commerce, and you'll also roll up your sleeves to drive it forward across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams.

You'll thrive here if you've taken a B2B product from 0 to 1 at a startup, know the Shopify ecosystem inside and out, and are energized — not intimidated — by wearing whatever hat the day requires: strategist in the morning, deal-closer in the afternoon, and hands-on problem-solver by evening.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the Business, Not Just the Backlog — Act as a mini GM for Commerce: define the vision, product strategy, and roadmap, and take direct accountability for the commercial success of the product line, not just feature delivery.
  • Build the 0-to-1 Playbook — Bring proven instincts for taking a B2B product from early bets to scaled traction. Move fast, validate cheaply, and know when to double down versus cut losses.
  • Go Deep on Shopify — Use hands-on knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem (APIs, Shopify Plus, app/partner requirements) to build a roadmap that differentiates Recurly Commerce from native Shopify capabilities and third-party competitors.
  • Lead Cross-Functionally, Without the Authority — Be the connective tissue across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Align stakeholders, unblock decisions, and keep everyone rowing in the same direction.
  • Drive GTM as a Partner, Not a Bystander — Work side-by-side with Sales and Marketing on positioning, pricing, and enablement. Get in front of customers and prospects directly to pressure-test ideas and build pipeline confidence.
  • Execute with Discipline — Break big strategic bets into shippable, high-value increments. Own the end-to-end lifecycle from discovery through launch, with a bias toward speed-to-market and reliable delivery.
  • Measure What Matters — Define and own the KPIs that tell you whether Commerce is winning (subscriber growth, retention, merchant health, ACV). Use data to inform roadmap trade-offs and to communicate impact to leadership.
  • Do Whatever It Takes — Whether that's writing a spec, jumping on a customer escalation, drafting sales talk tracks, or debugging a webhook issue with Engineering — you don't wait for it to be "your job" to help solve it.

Why This Role

This isn't a maintenance role on an established line — it's a build role on a product with real momentum and real stakes. You'll have the autonomy of a founder with the resources and distribution of an established company behind you.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 0-to-1 Startup Experience: You've built and scaled a B2B product from the ground up in a startup environment, and you know what it takes to go from an unproven idea to a product customers rely on.
  • Shopify Expertise: Deep, hands-on familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem — API architecture, Shopify Plus, partner/app requirements — ideally with experience in subscription, billing, or commerce-adjacent products.
  • Entrepreneurial, GM Mindset: You think like an owner. You're comfortable with ambiguity, move without waiting for perfect information, and take full accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: A track record of driving alignment and results across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer teams — influencing without relying on formal authority.
  • Core Product Management Craft: Strong fundamentals in vision-setting, strategy, and roadmapping, paired with the execution skill to actually ship what you plan.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable in technical conversations with Engineering (APIs, infrastructure, data) — you don't need to write code, but you can credibly reason about technical trade-offs.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Able to flex your message for a customer, a sales rep, an engineer, or an executive — and to build confidence and trust with each.
  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including direct 0-to-1 ownership.

Benefits

As a full-time employee, Recurly offers competitive benefits programs, perks and options designed to fit your needs and the needs of your family. We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and a menu from which to choose options that work best for you and eligible dependents. We also offer life insurance, short and long-term disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness coverage, employee accident protection, health savings account (HSA) with company contribution & flexible spending account (FSA) options, employee assistance program, Legal and Pet Insurance.

Other perks may include:

401(k) Retirement Plan and company match

Flex Time Off

Company Events

Training/Development

Tuition reimbursement

Commuter benefits

Volunteer opportunities

Recurly is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law. Recurly is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

jobs.excerpt: AlphaGov is seeking a Construction Research Scientist to support research and consulting opportunities involving construction schedules, workforce capacity, labor costs, and project delivery risk.
jobs.description:
AlphaGov is seeking a Construction Research Scientist to support research and consulting opportunities involving construction schedules, workforce capacity, labor costs, and project delivery risk.

We are looking for someone who can evaluate how delays, competing projects, and limited skilled labor affect a project’s cost and completion date—and translate those findings into practical recommendations.

Scope of Work

  • Analyze how project delays change workforce requirements, crew availability, and labor costs.
  • Model resource constraints across multiple projects, including situations where crews remain on one project longer than planned.
  • Develop and test scheduling, simulation, and forecasting methods using historical project data.
  • Evaluate alternatives such as resequencing work, reallocating crews, overtime, and subcontracting.
  • Define data requirements, validation methods, and measurable research objectives.
  • Contribute technical methods, work plans, and findings to proposals and client deliverables.

Requirements

  • PhD preferred in construction engineering, civil engineering, construction management, operations research, industrial engineering, or a related field. Comparable applied research experience will be considered.
  • Experience with construction scheduling, resource allocation, project controls, or construction productivity research.
  • Demonstrated experience with quantitative modeling, simulation, optimization, or statistical analysis.
  • Familiarity with Primavera P6, critical path scheduling, resource-loaded schedules, or comparable methods.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to project leaders and nontechnical decision-makers.

Experience with electrical and mechanical construction, data centers, utilities, energy, or major infrastructure projects is especially relevant.

Benefits

Assignments are scoped individually, with compensation and time commitments agreed upon before work begins. Opportunities may include proposal development and delivery of awarded projects. Project delivery assignments depend on contract or funding awards and confirmed availability.

Applicants may opt into consideration for future AlphaGov proposals and consulting engagements. Applying does not guarantee an assignment. Any opportunity with a separate affiliated company would be discussed and confirmed separately.

To apply: Submit your résumé or CV highlighting relevant projects, research methods, publications, and your specific contribution.

jobs.excerpt: It’s inspiring to work with a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they’re doing!
jobs.description:
It’s inspiring to work with a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they’re doing!

When you become part of the Chapters Health Team, you’ll realize it’s more than a job. It’s a mission. We’re committed to providing outstanding patient care and a high level of customer service in our communities every day. Our employees make all the difference in our success!

Job Profile Summary
The Resource Nights & Weekend (ReNW) Nurse Practitioner (NP) is an active member of Chapters Health System’s Medical Staff and provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care. This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.

Experience Requirements:

Must have a minimum of 3 years of recent clinical experience, including substantial experience in hospice, palliative care, and/or acute inpatient care.

Education Requirements:

Must hold a Masters or Doctors degree in Nursing from an accredited Family or Adult Nurse Practitioner Program.

Certificates and/or Licenses:

The ReNW NP must hold national certification, licensure, and prescriptive authority from the appropriate governing body for advanced nursing practice in their home state and in additional state(s) where care is provided. Licensure and prescriptive authority must be obtained and maintained for all required jurisdictions. Applications for required licenses must be submitted within 60 days of the date of hire and/or receiving notification. Must hold and maintain Basic Life Support certificate from an approved organization and compact RN license in their home stateby date of hire.

Schedule:

Shifts may vary and can include nights, evenings, weekends, and/or holidays based on the needs of the business.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Quality Provision of Services:

  • Provides fully remote virtual serious illness care management to patients and families throughout our continuum of care; This continuum may include but is not limited to home-based, facility-based, and inpatient adult and pediatric hospice; palliative care; PACE, and additional service lines and programs offered or supported by Chapters Health System.
  • Consults with medical staff, and/or other members of the IDT as indicated to ensure optimal patient care in an effective and efficient manner.
  • Performs virtual assessment of patient/family/caregiver needs.
  • Identifies, manages, orders, and prescribes medication and equipment as appropriate.
  • Adjusts and supports the plan of care in accordance with Chapters policies and procedures and within the guidelines of the corresponding nurse practice act.
  • Assesses the caregiver’s ability to meet the patient’s immediate needs and confidence in the patient’s plan of care.
  • Provides education to increase the caregiver’s confidence as necessary and appropriate.
  • Supports staff by answering clinical questions, entering orders and prescriptions, and supporting the clinical needs of patients and families.
  • Maintains access to all electronic medical records (EMR), electronic prescribing systems, and other required websites and applications.
  • Documents all interactions as appropriate in the corresponding EMR in a timely manner.
  • Communicates and collaborates with the primary team to ensure continuity of care.
  • Supports with discharge planning including prescribing medications, entering discharge orders and instructions, etc.
  • Participates in Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities as needed, including regular medical record reviews and medical peer reviews. Seeks to continually improve the care practices of Chapters to assure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.
  • Keeps knowledge base and skill levels current to assure quality patient care and professional growth.

2.Organization/Regulatory Compliance:

  • Maintains current knowledge of the latest research and trends in Hospice and Palliative Medicine.
  • Maintains continuing education as required for licensure and to ensure specialty level expertise in end-of-life care.
  • Obtains & maintains hospital/facility credentialing as required.
  • Participates in departmental and medical staff activities as requested.

3.People/Communications:

  • Communicates and collaborates with team members, patients/families/caregivers, partnering providers and staff as required & appropriate within HIPAA guidelines to help provide comfort & deliver upon Chapters core values.
  • Provides patient and family education as needed to maintain quality care, to decrease patient and family anxiety, to facilitate the patient living with the highest quality care, and to assure both the patient and the family have the skills to care for the patient.
  • Participates as a member of the interdisciplinary team to develop by implementing a patient-directed individualized plan of care and assures the availability of information to team members. Provides teaching to staff as required.
  • Functions as a role model in providing exceptional customer service to patients and families through effective and timely communication. Supports organizational changes.
  • Demonstrates flexibility in providing coverage and/or availability,

4.Financial Stewardship:

Achieves expected productivity standards as defined by the organization and in alignment with best practices/the Chapters model. If /when Telemedicine billing is accepted, implements time-based billing procedures using the electronic medical record system software and other appropriate methods to capture timely billing (weekly for home and nursing home; daily for inpatient and clinic charges).

The above statements are intended to be a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. The incumbents may be requested to perform job-related tasks other than those stated in this description.

Overall Skills:

The ability to work both independently and as part of a team; demonstrate excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills; demonstrate organizational skills with the ability to delegate and follow up; manage multiple tasks and stressful situations with a positive attitude; demonstrate a strong work ethic and attention to detail.

Physical/Mental/EmotionalSkills:

The ability to see, hear, grasp, lift, speak, sit and walk or otherwise perform essential functions with or without reasonable accommodations; demonstrate the mental and emotional ability to work with death/dying; demonstrate the maturity, customer service skills, and flexibility to work with individuals under stress; work in a fast paced and quickly changing environment; work under pressure and deadlines; effectively recognize and appreciate the diversity in the workplace; develop coping mechanisms in order to care for patients who are terminally ill and to work in a stressful environment; provide care for highly emotional patients/families.

TechnologicalSkills:

The ability to learn and efficiently use patient health information systems and software required for the provision of care; demonstrate technical competency in the use of computer telephony systems and computer applications used in the organization; demonstrate proficiency with the use of all Microsoft Office programs, specifically Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Reasoning Ability:

The ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written or oral form and expert, advanced clinical judgment to problem solve.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, speak, and hear. The employee is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics are representative of those an employee would normally encounter while performing in an office environment. Employees are required to maintain a HIPAA compliant, temperature controlled, noise-free work environment at all times. They must maintain reliable HIPPA compliant high-speed (100mb) internet with hardwired backup copiers, fax, scanner, shredder, etc. Patient privacy must be protected at all times, which includes, but is not limited to using headsets for all verbal communication, utilizing company approved devices, websites, and applications, and other HIPAA guidelines. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation Pay Rate:

$62.50

jobs.description:
Senior Actuary, Health Plan Analytics

Remote Opportunity

About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

About the role

Reveleer is hiring a senior actuary to lead health plan and risk adjustment analytics for each line of business for Reveleer customers across Medicare Advantage (MA), Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MAPD), Affordable Care Act (ACA), Medicaid, and provider value-based contracts. This role builds member-level actuarial models that quantify risk adjustment performance, HCC (Hierarchical Condition Category) capture, medical economics, utilization, and population health trends, and translates those models into customer-facing dashboards that inform pricing, forecasting, and program strategy.

This actuary works directly with customer success, analytics, product, operations, and clinical teams to convert raw claims, encounter, member, provider, and clinical data into decision-ready outputs. The role requires both technical model-building skill and the ability to explain actuarial and risk adjustment concepts to non-actuarial stakeholders, including provider and health plan executives.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain member-level actuarial models covering risk adjustment (RAF) performance, HCC capture and recapture, medical economics, utilization patterns, and population health metrics across MA, MAPD, ACA, and Medicaid populations.
  • Develop analytics that can support rate-setting for Medicare Advantage Bids, ACA rate filings, Medicaid capitation arrangements, and value-based contract terms.
  • Reconcile RAF calculations against source files, including the Monthly Membership Report (MMR), Model Output Report (MOR), MAO-004, and the Beneficiary-Level file, and extend that reconciliation logic into customer-facing reporting.
  • Design the actuarial and analytic logic behind customer-facing dashboards, partnering with data engineering and product teams to translate member-level models into usable, accurate, and timely visualizations.
  • Produce forecasting and accrual models that support midyear and final settlement estimates, transfer payments, capital planning, and financial reporting for risk adjustment programs.
  • Analyze utilization trends, medical loss ratio (MLR) drivers, and cost-of-care patterns to identify actionable opportunities for customers managing value-based contracts.
  • Support MA and HHS RADV (Risk Adjustment Data Validation) readiness by modeling audit exposure and prioritizing chart review and coding efforts based on financial impact.
  • Communicate model methodology, assumptions, and results clearly to actuarial and non-actuarial audiences, including customer executives.
  • Partner with clinical, coding, retrieval, and provider engagement teams to align analytic outputs with chronic HCC recapture, care gap closure, and quality initiatives.

What you bring

Required qualifications

  • Seven or more years of actuarial or actuarial-adjacent analytics experience in health plan pricing, risk adjustment, or medical economics.
  • Direct pricing or performance modeling experience across at least three of the following: Medicare Advantage, MAPD, ACA, Medicaid, and value-based contracts.
  • Working knowledge of the CMS-HCC and ACA risk model, RAF score calculation, and the relationship between ICD-10 diagnosis coding and risk adjustment revenue.
  • Demonstrated experience building member-level data models that feed reporting or dashboard tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one statistical or scripting language, such as SAS, R, or Python.
  • Proficiency in utilizing AI tools to support modeling
  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting actuarial findings to executive audiences.

Preferred qualifications

  • Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation or Fellowship (FSA) or progress toward.
  • Experience with CMS files, including the MMR, MOR, MAO-004, and Beneficiary-Level file.
  • Experience with EDPS & EDGE encounter submissions and encounter data quality processes.
  • Prior experience supporting RADV & IVA audit readiness or chart review prioritization.
  • Familiarity with provider incentive program design tied to chronic HCC recapture or quality performance.
  • Experience with financial forecasting, including ACA transfer payments and MA settlement accruals

Tools and technical skills

SAS (Enterprise Guide), SQL, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, R and RStudio, Python, Microsoft Access, and Microsoft Visual Basic (VBA) are all relevant to this role. Reveleer does not require proficiency in every tool listed; candidates should be strong in at least three of these and comfortable learning the rest on the job.

WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:

• Competitive salary 

• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits 

• 401k match

• Generous PTO plan 

 Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Reveleer E-Verifies all new hires.

Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

Salary: $150,000 – $185,000 / year

Student Success Specialist

MedSchoolCoach | Full-Time | Remote

About the Role

MedSchoolCoach is seeking a compassionate, organized, and solutions-oriented Student Success Specialist to join our Student Success team. In this role, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for students and families, helping ensure they receive exceptional service, timely support, and a positive experience throughout their journey with MedSchoolCoach.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who brings patience, empathy, and professionalism to every interaction, particularly when navigating sensitive situations or resolving concerns. This individual should be comfortable managing competing priorities, addressing challenging conversations with confidence, and balancing a supportive approach with the ability to set clear expectations and drive resolutions. We are especially interested in candidates with backgrounds in higher education, admissions, student affairs, academic advising, counseling, or other student-facing roles who understand the unique pressures students and families face throughout the academic and medical education journey.

Key Responsibilities

Student & Family Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for students and families, providing thoughtful, responsive, and professional support via email and phone.
  • Manage incoming student inquiries, concerns, and complaints, ensuring timely acknowledgment and follow-up, typically within 24–48 hours.
  • Approach sensitive or emotionally charged situations with patience, empathy, and sound judgment, recognizing when conversations require additional time, care, or escalation.
  • Build positive relationships with students and families, establishing trust and confidence in

MedSchoolCoach's services.

  • Conduct proactive check-ins with students, particularly during onboarding and early stages of service, to ensure satisfaction and address potential concerns.

Issue Resolution & Relationship Management

  • Investigate and resolve student concerns related to service delivery, scheduling, communication, and other aspects of the student experience.
  • Serve as a liaison between students, families, advisors, tutors, and internal teams to facilitate effective communication and timely resolutions.
  • Exercise sound judgment when addressing complaints, balancing student satisfaction with company policies and service expectations.
  • Identify situations requiring escalation and collaborate with leadership to determine appropriate next steps.
  • Maintain a calm, professional, and confident approach during difficult conversations while setting clear boundaries and expectations.

Student Success Operations

  • Coordinate student onboarding and transitions between internal teams, advisors, and tutors to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of student interactions, concerns, follow-up actions, and resolutions.
  • Monitor ongoing student needs and proactively identify opportunities to improve satisfaction and engagement.
  • Assist with student satisfaction surveys, feedback collection, and other initiatives designed to evaluate the student experience.
  • Identify recurring concerns or service gaps and recommend improvements to processes, policies, and communication practices.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and documentation to support consistent service delivery.
  • Collaborate with Student Success leadership and cross-functional teams on additional projects and initiatives as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Experience in a student-facing, client services, customer support, or relationship management role.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and thoughtfully with diverse audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build rapport with students and families.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate difficult conversations, manage complaints, and resolve conflicts with empathy and confidence.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting established response timelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise independent judgment when evaluating situations and determining appropriate next steps.
  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt communication styles based on individual needs and circumstances.
  • Proficiency with common productivity and communication tools, including Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Willingness to learn about MedSchoolCoach's services, medical education pathways, and the unique needs of our students.

Preferred

  • Experience working in higher education, college admissions, student affairs, academic advising, enrollment services, or counseling.
  • Advanced degree in education, higher education administration, counseling, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting students and families through academically demanding or high- stakes processes.
  • Previous experience in complaint resolution, student advocacy, or service recovery.
  • Familiarity with student support systems, CRM platforms, or case management tools.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Our ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and understands that exceptional student support requires more than simply answering questions. It requires listening carefully, communicating clearly, following through consistently, and knowing when to offer reassurance versus when to take decisive action. You will thrive in this role if you are naturally patient and approachable, but also confident and comfortable taking ownership of challenging situations. You recognize that students and families may be navigating stressful or uncertain circumstances, and you take pride in helping them feel heard, supported, and confident in the services they receive. Above all, you are a strong writer, a thoughtful problem solver, and someone who can be trusted to manage sensitive student concerns with professionalism, discretion, and care.

Compensation & Benefits

MedSchoolCoach offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

- Up to four weeks of vacation

- Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible work schedule

- Remote work environment

We are hiring a Senior Business Data Analyst who acts as the connective tissue between our clients' business stakeholders and the data they need to run their companies. You will own client engagements end to end: sitting in the room with operators and executives, translating their messiest business questions into clean analytical problems, and delivering data products that change how decisions get made.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or the tool the client lives in

  • Drive proactive analysis: surface trends, anomalies, and opportunities the client did not ask about but needs to see

  • Set the cadence for client communication: status updates, demos, working sessions, and stakeholder reviews

  • Expert SQL: window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, and the ability to sanity-check your own numbers before anyone else has to

  • Strong data modeling fundamentals (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, dbt or equivalent transformation tooling)

  • Demonstrated ability to lead client conversations: running requirements workshops, pushing back constructively, and driving alignment across stakeholders with different priorities

  • Working fluency with AI tools for analytical work (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, AI features inside BI and SQL tools) and a clear point of view on where they speed you up vs. where they introduce risk

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgment to scale your message to the audience in front of you

  • Bias toward action: You would rather draft a working hypothesis and a v1 dashboard than wait for perfect requirements

Nice to Haves

  • Domain experience in commercial real estate, financial services, healthcare technology, or insurance

  • Python for analytical workflows (pandas, notebooks, light scripting against APIs)

  • Experience scoping and pricing analytics work, or contributing to SOWs and statements of work

  • Familiarity with data quality frameworks, observability tools, or governance practices

About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap

This team owns the shared security and identity foundations that every other engineering team at Reap builds on: authentication and identity, fraud and account takeover protection, access governance, data residency and routing, and notifications infrastructure. As we expand into new markets and products, these foundations must help teams ship faster while protecting our business and clients from unnecessary loss.

This role is a senior individual contributor position, acting as the Tech Lead for our Security and Identity Platform. You'll own technical direction, architecture, and delivery while staying hands-on with the code — no people management is required. You'll build these capabilities as one connected, trusted platform, rather than separate solutions that each product team has to reinvent. It's an opportunity to make security an enabler of growth in a regulated, global fintech.

Your Mission Awaits

  • Authentication & identity: Architect, build, and operate the shared identity layer across Reap's products, including login, session management, and multi-factor authentication. Design secure, reusable APIs and services that other engineering teams can adopt confidently.

  • Fraud & account protection: Build platform capabilities that detect and prevent unauthorised access and account takeover before funds move. Partner with product and risk stakeholders to translate threats into practical controls that protect clients without unnecessary friction.

  • Access governance & auditability: Develop consistent authorisation and access controls, with reliable audit trails that support access reviews, incident investigation, and regulatory, partner, and client security requirements.

  • Data residency & routing: Design secure data and traffic routing that supports jurisdiction-specific requirements as Reap enters new markets, working with relevant stakeholders to turn those requirements into reusable platform capabilities.

  • Notifications infrastructure: Build reliable, correctly targeted infrastructure for security, risk, and transaction alerts, with the delivery speed and visibility needed when something goes wrong.

  • Secure delivery & reliability: Build and operate services on AWS using CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code (IaC). Embed threat modelling, security testing, monitoring, logging, and alerting into delivery; investigate incidents and address root causes to prevent recurrence.

  • Technical leadership & platform adoption: Own architecture and design reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on. Partner with the Knox PM and other engineering teams to prioritise work that reduces risk, unlocks markets, and removes duplicated effort. Provide clear APIs, defaults, and documentation that make the secure path easy to adopt.

  • AI-assisted engineering: Use AI tools responsibly for coding, debugging, tests, and documentation, with appropriate review and safeguards for sensitive data and security-critical code.

Your Superpowers

  • Experience: 8–10+ years in backend or platform engineering, including hands-on ownership of security-critical services or shared identity and access infrastructure in production.

  • Leadership: At least 2+ years in a technical leadership role (Tech Lead or Engineering Manager), with a track record of owning architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and delivering complex projects end to end. Comfortable leading through technical expertise in an individual contributor role.

  • Security & identity engineering: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, session security, MFA, and access control. Experience implementing identity standards such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and applying secure-by-design practices, threat modelling, and least privilege.

  • Backend: Preferably Node.js + TypeScript, with strong experience building APIs and event-driven/serverless systems. Open to strong backend engineers using other languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python) who can ramp up quickly.

  • Cloud & delivery: Strong AWS experience, including securing and operating production services, with solid CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.

  • Data & auditability: Hands-on experience with relational databases (AWS Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL), schema design, and ORM frameworks such as TypeORM. Able to design for sensitive data protection, traceability, and reliable audit trails.

  • Systems thinking & problem solving: Able to reason about threats, failure modes, and dependencies across services; debug complex issues; and balance security, reliability, developer experience, and delivery speed.

  • AI-assisted coding: Comfortable using AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex), with sound judgement about data handling and validation of generated code.

  • Domain advantage: Experience with fraud prevention, account takeover protection, data residency, or security platforms in fintech, payments, crypto, or other regulated environments is a plus.

  • Cybersecurity credentials: Relevant cybersecurity certifications are a plus.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech startup

  • Flexible remote work environment with a global, collaborative team

  • Use of AI tools at work, and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them

  • A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning

jobs.description:
Global Partnerships & Channels (GPC)

At ServiceNow, we put AI to work for people. Our AI platform connects any AI, any data, and any workflow to help organizations work smarter, move faster, and reinvent how business gets done. Global Partnerships & Channels extends that impact through a worldwide ecosystem of strategic, technology, cloud, service, and solution partners.

Role Overview

The Executive Administrative Assistant (EAA) to the GPC Leader is a highly trusted administrative partner responsible for maximizing the effectiveness, productivity, and operating capacity of a global executive leading one of ServiceNow’s most strategic and fast-moving organizations.

This is an AI-forward executive support role requiring demonstrated proficiency with AI-enabled Executive Assistant (AI EA) tools and platforms, in addition to broader AI and automation capabilities. The successful candidate already uses AI EA tools as an integrated part of how they manage executive calendars, scheduling, meeting preparation, follow-up, travel, communications, task management, and executive-office workflows.

We are looking for someone who can show how they have personally used AI EA technology to improve the way an executive office operates—not simply someone who is familiar with AI, uses a general-purpose AI assistant, or is interested in learning these tools.

The GPC Leader operates at an exceptionally fast pace across a global ecosystem of ServiceNow executives, customers, partners, industry leaders, and employees. Priorities can shift rapidly and often require immediate action. The EAA must operate with exceptional agility, adaptability, flexibility, judgment, and precision while maintaining accuracy and continuity across a constantly changing executive agenda.

This role goes well beyond traditional calendar administration. The EAA is a force multiplier for the executive, combining exceptional executive support capabilities with AI EA technology, automation, and modern productivity practices to anticipate needs, eliminate friction, create operating leverage, and continually improve how work gets done.

What You’ll Do

AI EA Tools, Automation & Executive Productivity

  • Demonstrate advanced, hands-on proficiency using AI-enabled Executive Assistant tools and platforms specifically designed to support executive administration and executive-office workflows.

  • Integrate AI EA tools into daily work to improve complex scheduling, calendar optimization, meeting preparation, briefing and context development, action and commitment tracking, follow-up, travel coordination, communications, and executive workflow management.

  • Use AI EA capabilities to anticipate conflicts, identify scheduling and workflow dependencies, surface outstanding actions, organize executive priorities, and reduce administrative friction.

  • Determine which work is best performed through specialized AI EA tools, broader AI platforms, workflow automation, or direct human judgment and intervention.

  • Build and continually improve an AI-enabled administrative operating model that increases executive capacity while maintaining exceptional accuracy, discretion, responsiveness, and stakeholder experience.

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient administrative processes and redesign them using AI EA capabilities, automation, integrations, templates, and other productivity technologies.

  • Apply appropriate quality controls to AI-supported work, independently validating outputs and maintaining accountability for accuracy, confidentiality, and final execution.

  • Remain current on emerging AI EA technologies and proactively evaluate and adopt capabilities that can measurably improve executive and administrative productivity.

Executive Calendar, Time & Priority Management

  • Own a highly complex, dynamic global executive calendar involving C-suite leaders, senior internal executives, customers, strategic partners, industry leaders, and employees.

  • Manage the calendar as a strategic business tool, ensuring executive time is aligned to the highest-value business, customer, partner, talent, and leadership priorities.

  • Make rapid, thoughtful decisions when priorities change, understanding what can move, what cannot, who needs to be informed, and what downstream implications must be addressed.

  • Anticipate conflicts, preparation requirements, decision points, travel implications, and follow-up needs before they become issues.

  • Reprioritize quickly and confidently in an environment where the executive’s schedule may change multiple times in a day.

  • Protect focus time while preserving the flexibility required of a highly visible global leader.

Internal & External Executive Engagements

  • Orchestrate internal and external executive engagements from initial request through preparation, execution, and follow-up.

  • Coordinate engagements with ServiceNow executives, customers, partners, industry leaders, external organizations, and other high-priority stakeholders.

  • Ensure the executive enters critical engagements with the right context, objectives, participants, materials, logistics, and preparation.

  • Maintain visibility to commitments and follow-up resulting from executive engagements and ensure actions move forward quickly.

  • Coordinate across executive offices and external organizations to create a highly professional, responsive, and seamless stakeholder experience.

  • Represent the GPC Leader with discretion, confidence, sound judgment, and strong executive presence.

GPC Leadership & Operating Rhythm

  • Enable the operating rhythm of the GPC leadership team, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, executive offsites, talent discussions, company events, and key partner engagements.

  • Partner closely with the Chief of Staff to translate business priorities into an effective executive cadence and use of the leader’s time.

  • Maintain a working understanding of GPC priorities, key decisions, leadership commitments, and upcoming milestones so administrative decisions can be made with appropriate business context.

  • Connect meetings, decisions, commitments, and follow-up rather than treating individual calendar events as isolated activities.

  • Anticipate what the leader and leadership team will need next and initiate action without waiting for direction.

Cross-Functional Executive Office Partnership

  • Work closely with the Chief of Staff, HR Business Partner, Executive Communications, Finance, Strategy, and other key functions to coordinate and sequence executive priorities.

  • Serve as a highly effective connector across teams, ensuring information, decisions, requests, and follow-up move at the pace required by the business.

  • Coordinate executive communications, leadership forums, company events, talent engagements, organizational activities, and external commitments.

  • Establish strong working relationships with executive assistants across ServiceNow and with the offices of customers, partners, and other external executives.

Global Travel & Executive Logistics

  • Manage complex domestic and international travel, including rapidly changing itineraries, executive meetings, partner/customer engagements, events, and associated logistics.

  • Anticipate travel dependencies and resolve issues quickly, often with limited notice and across multiple time zones.

  • Integrate travel, meetings, preparation, and executive priorities into a cohesive plan rather than managing each independently.

  • Remain highly responsive when critical executive needs or schedule changes require flexibility outside traditional working hours.

What You Bring

  • Certification in Certified Administrative Professional (CAP) or equivalent administrative credential preferred.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience supporting senior executives, preferably at the SVP, EVP, or C-suite level in a global technology, high-growth, or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI-enabled Executive Assistant (AI EA) tools and platforms. This is a core requirement of the role—not simply general familiarity or fluency with AI.

  • Proven experience personally incorporating AI EA tools into executive administrative workflows such as complex calendar and scheduling management, meeting preparation, executive briefing, action tracking, follow-up, travel, communications, and productivity management.

  • Ability to provide specific examples of AI EA tools used, the executive-administration problems addressed, how the tools were incorporated into daily workflows, and the resulting improvements in speed, efficiency, accuracy, or executive capacity.

  • Broader proficiency with generative AI, workflow automation, and productivity technologies, with the ability to combine these capabilities with specialized AI EA tools.

  • Demonstrated success supporting a global executive operating at exceptional speed, with complex stakeholder demands and priorities that can change rapidly.

  • Exceptional agility, adaptability, and flexibility, including the ability to reprioritize and execute quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated record of accuracy in high-volume, high-velocity executive environments.

  • Advanced ability to manage highly complex global calendars and make independent prioritization decisions with limited direction.

  • A productivity and continuous-improvement mindset: instinctively identifies opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, eliminate unnecessary work, and improve how the executive office operates.

  • Exceptional judgment, discretion, executive presence, and ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential information.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence engaging with senior internal executives, customers, partners, and external stakeholders.

  • A highly anticipatory working style—the ability to recognize what is needed, understand implications, and act before being asked.

  • Ability to remain composed and highly effective amid ambiguity, urgency, last-minute change, and competing demands.

What Success Looks Like

  • The GPC Leader has more capacity because of this partnership. Executive time is focused on the highest-value priorities, administrative friction is reduced, and the executive office operates at extraordinary speed without sacrificing accuracy or stakeholder experience.

  • AI EA technology is embedded in the day-to-day operation of the executive office. Specialized AI EA tools, broader AI capabilities, and automation are intentionally applied to reduce administrative burden, accelerate execution, improve accuracy, strengthen follow-through, and increase executive capacity.

  • Internal and external executive engagements are exceptionally well orchestrated. The leader has the right context at the right time; stakeholders receive timely, professional engagement; commitments do not get lost; and changes are absorbed without unnecessary disruption.

  • The EAA is a trusted extension of the GPC Leader—able to keep pace, anticipate what is coming, adapt immediately when circumstances change, and continually increase the productivity of the executive and broader leadership team.

Why This Role Matters

Global Partnerships & Channels is central to how ServiceNow expands customer value, scales innovation, and brings the power of the ServiceNow AI platform to market through a global partner ecosystem. The Executive Administrative Assistant is a critical enabler of that mission—creating focus, connectivity, productivity, and operating leverage for the GPC Leader and leadership team.
