jobs.description:
Job Title: Executive Director, Product Communications & Engagement – MariTide

Job Location: Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you are a part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

At Amgen, our mission is to serve patients by transforming the promise of science into life-changing medicines. Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide, translating the Obesity & Related Conditions Corporate Affairs vision into integrated communications that support launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion. Reporting to the Associate Vice President, Corporate Affairs, you will serve as the Corporate Affairs lead for MariTide, ensuring product communications, content, digital, and executive communications work together as one cohesive strategy. You will partner closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Enterprise Communications, and other cross-functional leaders to align Corporate Affairs priorities with business objectives while preserving the function's trusted role in scientific communications, disease education, stakeholder engagement, and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Product Communications Leadership

  • Lead the Corporate Affairs product communications strategy for MariTide across launch readiness, commercialization, lifecycle management, and future indication expansion

  • Develop differentiated product narratives grounded in science, patient insights and unmet need that reinforce MariTide's value and long-term impact

  • Translate the broader Corporate Affairs strategy into integrated communications plans that engage patients, healthcare professionals, policymakers, and other stakeholders

  • Provide strategic counsel to senior leaders on product communications opportunities, risks, and reputation

Communications Governance & Cross-Functional Integration

  • Lead integrated communications planning for MariTide, establishing priorities and ensuring alignment across Corporate Affairs and cross-functional partners.

  • Represent Corporate Affairs within cross-functional launch planning and governance forums

  • Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Advocacy, Market Access, and Enterprise Communications to ensure coordinated execution around key product milestones

  • Identify opportunities to amplify scientific, regulatory, and commercial milestones through strategic Corporate Affairs communications

Content, Digital & Engagement Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the Product Communications, Content and Digital Communications organization

  • Lead the teams responsible for editorial strategy, executive thought leadership, internal product communications, owned channels, patient storytelling, scientific storytelling, and digital engagement

  • Drive an integrated content ecosystem across earned, owned and digital channels while leveraging analytics, audience insights, and emerging technologies to optimize impact

  • Coach and develop direct reports while fostering a collaborative, high-performing and innovative team culture

Strategic Partnership with Media Relations

  • Partner closely with the Senior Director, Global Media Relations to ensure product communications strategy informs earned media engagement, executive visibility, thought leadership and issues preparedness

  • Ensure seamless coordination between product communications and media relations to deliver a consistent external narrative for MariTide across all stakeholder audiences

Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and influence decisions across a complex global matrix organization

  • Lead agency partners and communications investments with clear accountability for measurable business outcomes

  • Build strong partnerships across the Obesity Corporate Affairs leadership team to deliver an integrated communications approach

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of product communications experience OR

  • Master’s degree & 10 years of product communications experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of product communications experience AND

  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Executive-level experience leading Corporate Affairs or Product Communications for a late-stage or commercial biopharmaceutical product

  • Experience supporting major product launches, commercialization, and lifecycle communications

  • Experience leading integrated product communications in partnership with Commercial, Medical, and other cross-functional functions

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing communications teams.

  • Experience overseeing content strategy, digital communications, executive thought leadership, and internal product communications

  • Experience partnering with media relations leaders to deliver coordinated product communications strategies

  • Ability to translate complex science into compelling communications for diverse stakeholder audiences

  • Ability to influence senior executives and lead through a highly matrixed global organization

  • Executive presence, organizational leadership, and business acumen consistent with an Executive Director role at Amgen

  • Experience using communications analytics, audience insights, and AI-enabled communications tools to optimize strategy and impact

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection

  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders

  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $266,637 to $360,745. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

A little about us

Job Summary

The Manager of ERP Systems is responsible for the overall direction and coordination of technology that supports end to end ERP (Sage X3) operations. It also supports long term architectural planning, vendor coordination, financial oversight, and risk management to maintain stable and scalable ERP operations. Interesting? Here is a little more…

  • Oversee budgeting, financial planning, and resource allocation for ERP technology programs
  • while ensuring cost effectiveness and strong return on investment.
  • Anticipate and mitigate risks by monitoring system performance, addressing issues proactively, and establishing controls that protect ERP continuity.
  • Work with enterprise architecture to ensure all ERP platforms conform to organizational technology standards, integration models, and long-term architectural roadmaps.
  • Maintain accountability for optimizing ERP performance through effective use of technology and for ensuring strong performance and engagement among IT team members.
  • Support technology innovation by evaluating emerging tools such as automation, IoT, analytics platforms, and AI based solutions that enhance ERP capabilities.

You will be setup for success if you have…

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, ERP Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA is a plus.
  • Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in IT leadership roles, with a focus on ERP (Sage X3) technology.
  • ERP (Sage X3) Technology: In-depth knowledge of IT systems and technologies relevant to ERP management, including Finance modules, bolt-on applications, warehouse management systems (WMS), and transportation management systems (TMS).
  • Experience creating training materials and developing team capabilities for new systems and tools.
  • Proven experience in implementing IT solutions for ERP optimization.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and managing global, regulated, cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems, ERP management software, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of business processes related to ERP management.

Bonus points if you have…

  • Team Leadership: Proven leadership skills with the ability to inspire and lead a team of global IT professionals.
  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of ERP processes and business operations.
  • Project Management: Excellent project management skills, including planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Communication Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong understanding of data integration patterns, APIs, middleware, and system interoperability across ERP, WMS, TMS, and related platforms.
  • Ability to guide organizations through technology transitions, ensuring smooth adoption and minimal disruption.
  • Working knowledge of security practices, SOX and ITIL as they relate to ERP systems, data protection, and vendor-hosted solutions.
  • Ability to interpret operational data, identify trends, and guide technology decisions that support predictive and prescriptive analytics.
  • Skilled in evaluating, negotiating, and managing relationships with technology vendors and service providers.
  • Strong capability to assess current workflows, identify inefficiencies, and recommend technology driven improvements.
  • Understanding of scalable system design principles that support complex and evolving ERP operations.
  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and develop structured, data informed solutions.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks, validation procedures, and release management for ERP applications.
  • Ability to align technology roadmaps with long term business goals and operational strategies.
  • Competency in diagnosing system issues, coordinating resolutions, and preventing recurrence through root cause analysis.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights for nontechnical audiences.

Why you’ll love working at Aurora

  • Flexibility: you will enjoy a flexible work environment that is the perfect blend of work and fun! You will be empowered to achieve work-life balance with flexible hours, remote work options, meeting-free-Friday-afternoons and more!
  • Total Rewards: we will motivate you to go above and beyond with a competitive salary, professional development opportunities, company SWAG, team activities and modern technology.

The Field Support area is responsible for providing on-site technical or non technical product support and service to customers.

The Financial Markets Global IP Desk will contribute to the success of the team supporting the stability and availability of the TNS Financial Markets infrastructure and services by raising service incident tickets and assigning them to an appropriate engineer.

This will also include opening tickets with Vendor Help desks (Cisco and Juniper TAC) and escalating problems for engineering support when necessary. The technical support engineer will also be responsible for maintaining and updating assigned tickets providing peace of mind.

This is a customer facing role, with the individual responsible for delivering quality service and support to TNS customers. The role being within the Financial Markets industry, liaising with TNS customer’s technical representatives requires solid technical understanding in relation to network, systems infrastructure and datacenters, as well as understanding of Financial Markets and Financial Exchanges.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide support of global large scale TCP/IP, VPN and MPLS networks to include OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, RIP, IS-IS protocols
  • Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco, Arista and Juniper routers and switches

Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

jobs.description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Senior Director, Professional Services

Location:United Kingdom (Remote)

Experience: Managerial

Job Function:Professional Services

Employment Type:Full-Time

Industry: Cost of Goods Sold

Travel Requirements: 25%

About the position

The Senior Director of Global Professional Services, provides visionary leadership in Global Professional Services, driving strategic initiatives and overseeing transformational projects. Builds key executive relationships, ensures financial health, establishes global standards, drives innovation, and fosters a culture of high performance and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide visionary leadership for the entire Global Professional Services organization, driving strategic initiatives and organizational growth.
  • Develop and execute long-term strategies to enhance service delivery, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
  • Lead a team of Directors, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and strategic objectives.
  • Drive large-scale transformation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key executive stakeholders, both internal and external.
  • Oversee the financial health of the Professional Services organization, ensuring sustainable growth and profitability.
  • Represent the organization in top-tier customer engagements, industry conferences, and executive briefings.
  • Establish and enforce global standards, processes, and best practices for project delivery.
  • Drive innovation and the adoption of cutting-edge technologies to stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Ensure global compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and contractual obligations.
  • Champion a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the entire organization.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Deep knowledge in a technical, MSP, or software consulting capacity with commiserate leadership experience.
  • Capability to lead organizational change, influence company-wide strategy, and drive business growth.
  • Complex reporting capabilities with Excel, or other BI software with the ability to use the data to effectively communicate and persuade an audience.
  • Visionary leadership, advanced strategic planning, exceptional stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong and effective communication skills in a consultative manner with customers and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Advanced, methodical, and expedient business troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities without needing escalation to other leaders.
  • Consistently speaks with confidence to technical, non-technical, and executive audiences internally and externally, effectively de-escalating any situation.
  • Demonstrates advanced interpersonal communication and writing abilities with autonomy.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.excerpt: Turnitin is seeking a Frontend Engineer with strong expertise in modern frontend technologies such as web components, React, and microfrontends.
jobs.description:
Turnitin is seeking a Frontend Engineer with strong expertise in modern frontend technologies such as web components, React, and microfrontends. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about designing and delivering intuitive, high-performing, and reliable user interfaces that support our award-winning educational platform.

As a core contributor to our product development team, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience of both existing and new applications. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to create scalable and engaging solutions that meet the needs of educators and students worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Component Development:
    • Design, develop, and maintain highly efficient, reusable, and scalable web components using Stencil.js, TypeScript, Angular, and React.
    • Build modular and reusable UI components to ensure consistency and maintainability across projects.
  • Architecture & Best Practices:
    • Establish and enforce best practices for component design, including accessibility (WCAG compliance), performance optimization, and responsive design.
    • Collaborate with the team to define the architecture of the design system or reusable component library.
  • Integration & Collaboration:
    • Ensure seamless integration of web components into various applications, particularly within Angular/React projects.
    • Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs that enable efficient data flow and interaction with frontend components.
  • Code Quality & Standards:
    • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, adhering to modern standards and practices.
    • Perform regular code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards.
  • Testing & Debugging:
    • Create robust unit and integration tests for web components.
    • Debug and resolve performance bottlenecks and other frontend issues.
  • Collaboration & Mentorship:
    • Work closely with designers and product managers to understand requirements and provide technical insights during the planning phase.
    • Mentor junior frontend engineers, sharing knowledge on web components, Stencil.js, TypeScript, Angular, and React.
  • Performance Optimization:
    • Continuously improve the performance of web components, ensuring compatibility with various browsers and platforms.
    • Optimize assets and rendering pipelines for faster load times and better user experience.
  • Documentation & Support:
    • Create comprehensive documentation for the developed reusable components, including usage guidelines and examples.
    • Provide technical support to teams integrating the components into their projects.
  • Continuous Learning:
    • Stay up-to-date with emerging frontend technologies, particularly in web components and frameworks like Stencil.js and Angular/React.
    • Proactively suggest improvements to existing tooling, frameworks, or processes to enhance team efficiency and product quality.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration:
    • Collaborate with DevOps to streamline CI/CD processes for frontend builds and deployments.
    • Ensure smooth handoff of frontend deliverables to QA and collaborate on addressing issues during testing.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge/Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with at least 2 years working on web components and Angular/React projects and building micro-frontends.
  • Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining reusable component libraries or design systems used across multiple projects.
  • Strong expertise in web components development using Stencil.js or similar frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Angular/React and experience building reusable, high-performance components. Deep understanding of TypeScript, including advanced types, generics, and best practices for scalable codebases.
  • Extensive experience with HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Familiarity with CSS-in-JS libraries and best practices for managing styles
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library, or similar tools.
  • Strong debugging skills for browser-based issues and performance optimizations.
  • Knowledge of frontend performance best practices, including rendering optimization, lazy loading, and asset management.
  • Experience with modern build tools like Webpack, Rollup, or Vite.
  • Proficiency with version control systems like Git.
  • Familiarity with creating or maintaining design systems and component libraries.
  • Understanding of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and responsive design principles.
  • Proven experience collaborating effectively with designers, product managers, and backend teams across geographically distributed time zones, including Europe and the USA, to deliver seamless and cohesive user experiences.
  • Strong communication skills to articulate technical concepts and collaborate effectively.
  • Hands-on experience writing comprehensive test cases to ensure code quality and reliability.
  • Familiarity with integrating frontend builds into CI/CD pipelines, specifically using GitHub Actions.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge/Experience

  • Understanding or experience with AI/ML.
  • Understanding or experience with backend technologies
  • Knowledge of Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) and modern browser APIs.
  • Familiarity with tools like Storybook for component documentation.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams.

Tii Elements:

  • Action and Ownership, Accountability
  • Educator
  • Collaboration
  • Quality Focus
  • One Team

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage*
  • Education Reimbursement*
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays*
  • 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
  • Paid Volunteer Time*
  • Charitable contribution match*
  • Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/*
  • Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
  • Parental Leave*
  • Retirement Plan with match/contribution*

* varies by country

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.

jobs.description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Paid Social) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Media Buyer to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll own the full lifecycle of Facebook and Instagram (Meta) advertising campaigns—from campaign planning and creative strategy to optimization and scaling. You’ll collaborate with clients and internal teams to improve campaign performance, lower acquisition costs, and maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, enjoy testing new ideas, and thrive on delivering measurable business results, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Strategy & Management

  • Build, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through execution.
  • Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring each campaign achieves performance goals.
  • Optimize:
    • Campaign structures
    • Audiences
    • Placements
    • Bidding strategies
    • Budgets
  • Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze key metrics including:
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Cost Per Click (CPC)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Test:
    • New audiences
    • Offers
    • Ad creatives
    • Landing pages
    • Campaign strategies
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.

Creative Strategy

  • Develop creative concepts, messaging, and campaign angles.
  • Write detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing advertisements.
  • Analyze creative performance and recommend ongoing testing opportunities.

Client Communication & Reporting

  • Present campaign performance updates to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Recommend strategies to scale successful campaigns and improve underperforming accounts.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and strategic guidance.

Growth & Innovation

  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and results.
  • Test new automation tools, optimization techniques, and advertising strategies.
  • Contribute ideas that improve agency performance and client outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently meet or exceed performance goals.
  • Advertising budgets scale profitably while maintaining strong ROAS.
  • Acquisition costs decrease through continuous optimization.
  • Clients receive strategic recommendations backed by data.
  • Creative testing drives measurable campaign improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and long-term retention remain high.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine creativity with strong analytical thinking.
  • You enjoy testing, learning, and optimizing campaigns.
  • You can confidently manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions.
  • You communicate campaign performance clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where ownership matters.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing $10,000+ per month in advertising spend.
  • Experience managing five or more client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Meta Business Manager
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion API (CAPI)
    • Event Tracking
  • Experience optimizing campaigns for:
    • Lead Generation
    • Customer Acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make optimization decisions.
  • Experience developing creative strategies and writing detailed creative briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Experience working in a digital marketing agency.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Landing Page Optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance and creative workflows.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

Tech Stack

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Meta Business Manager
  • Meta Pixel
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Close CRM
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Workspace
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign performance dashboards.
  • Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion metrics.
  • Optimize audiences, creatives, placements, and bidding strategies.
  • Develop creative concepts and collaborate with designers.
  • Meet with clients to discuss campaign performance and recommendations.
  • Launch new campaigns and A/B tests.
  • Analyze results and implement optimization strategies.
  • Stay informed on Meta platform updates and emerging advertising trends.

In short: You’ll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of Meta advertising campaigns, helping clients achieve measurable business growth through data-driven paid social marketing.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  • Conversion Rate.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Campaign scalability and profitability.
  • Creative testing performance.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Lead high-impact Meta advertising campaigns for multiple client accounts.
  • Collaborate with clients and creative teams to deliver measurable business results.
  • Manage significant advertising budgets while driving continuous optimization.
  • Work with modern advertising tools and emerging AI technologies.
  • Fully remote work environment aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Career progression into:
    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Job Description

The Executive Lead for Global SMB Engineering is the senior technology executive for Global Payments' SMB business worldwide. The role reports to the Global CTO, sits on the CTO's leadership team and is the engineering counterpart to the President of SMB. It carries full accountability for technology strategy, engineering delivery and platform health across a global organization of around 3,500 people.


This role sets the leadership direction for SMB engineering and owns the platforms behind our SMB products, which serve over 6 million merchants.

The role has two priorities: keep delivering the products merchants rely on today, and modernize the platforms behind them for the next decade.


Modernization includes standardizing and simplifying our product estate to remove duplication. It also means moving to API first, cloud native, event driven architecture, setting one standard for how software is built, tested and operated across SMB, and making a step change in developer productivity.


The role partners closely with Product leadership and the business to decide what we build, what we buy, and which technology partners we work with. It leads engineering delivery against those plans and is measured on results against growth, reliability and security targets.


What you'll own

  • SMB engineering strategy, with every major investment tied to growth, reliability or security outcomes.
  • A global engineering organization of around 3,500 people, including its operating model and the strength of its leadership team.
  • Standardizing and simplifying the SMB product estate, and moving it to API first, cloud native, event driven design.
  • One standard for SDLC, testing and SRE practice across every SMB team, with developer productivity measured and improved.
  • Delivery of the largest SMB programs in modernization, resiliency, performance and cost, with the organization held to its commitments on scope, quality and timelines.
  • PCI DSS compliance and data privacy across all SMB platforms, working with Risk and Security on threat modeling and fraud mitigation.
  • Build or buy decisions, made together with Product leadership and the business, plus governance and performance management of strategic technology vendors.
  • Joint delivery with Product, Operations, Finance and Sales so that engineering work shows up in commercial results.
  • A clear point of view on unified commerce, embedded payments and AI in risk and operations, built into the roadmap.

What you bring:

  • You've led engineering at global scale on large, customer-facing platforms, at or close to the top technology seat.

  • You have a strong product engineering background and know how to run platforms that customers depend on every day.

What sets you apart

Leadership Competencies

This leader helps decide where Global Payments competes and how it wins. The role needs deep business knowledge, a global view and the ability to keep changing as the business and the market change.

  • Shape direction. Read change early, challenge assumptions and make the calls that set the company up for what comes next.
  • Transform to win. Redesign how work gets done, combining people, AI, automation and systems to make better decisions faster and raise performance.

Our Vision & Mission

We envision a world in which all people have access to high quality and enduring solutions to improve and maintain their health and well-being. MCD Global Health aspires to be a premier partner of choice and a recognized leader, innovator, and trusted partner in healthcare and public health program development, implementation and evaluation. Our mission is to improve the health and well-being of people worldwide through enduring, high-quality, cost-effective, and universally accessible public health solutions. MCD operates impactful programs both in the U.S.A. and internationally.

MCD seeks a Digital Health Program Manager for its new program that leads the administration and implementation of technology and innovation initiatives under the state of Maine’s new Rural Health Transformation Program.

This position is a remote position based in Maine; relocation expenses will not be provided. Some travel within the State of Maine will be required.

Requirements

Digital Health Program Managers

Grade Level: 6

Anticipated Salary: $74,000-$88,000

Reporting Relationship: Senior Program Manager, Augmented Intelligence (AI)

The Digital Health Program Managers will partner with sub-awardees and contractors to implement digital health projects and programs in varying topic areas and technical approaches, including but not limited to: telehealth integration in schools, long-term care facilities, acute care, oral health, maternal and perinatal behavioral health, implementation of peer-to-peer telehealth models, remote patient monitoring programs and digital health navigation. This will include provision of technical assistance and training where relevant and ensuring that sub-awardees are achieving project milestones on time and within budget allowances.  

The essential functions of the position include:

Program Management:

  • Support sub-awardees and contractors in implementing digital health projects across multiple domains. 

  • Provide technical assistance and training to ensure effective adoption of digital health tools. 

  • Monitor and report on project milestones, budgets, and deliverables. 

  • Facilitate integration of telehealth and digital health solutions into diverse healthcare environments. 

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation in Maine’s digital health initiatives. 

Teamwork:

  • Participate in relevant workgroups and/or committees

  • Participate in MCD Global Health strategic planning as required.

  • Lead by example, foster a sense of teamwork, inspire a sense of personal and professional accountability and promote positive morale that supports productivity and high quality of work for the individual team, the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

  • Work to ensure that project activities and planning are directed toward the advancement of the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

Business Development:

Strive to ensure that project implementation is responsive to the latest research and innovations and facilities growth in MCD Global Health's portfolio.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

  • Experience implementing telehealth programs across diverse settings (schools, long-term care, acute care, oral health, maternal/perinatal behavioral health).

El futuro ya llegó y tiene licencia bancaria. Vamos con todo. Con fuerza. Con visión.

Con N de Neobanco. #TenpoConNdeNeobanco 💚

Como Especialista en Inteligencia Artificial en Tenpo, diseñas, optimizas y despliegas arquitecturas de inteligencia artificial generativa —desde transformers y modelos de atención hasta sistemas multimodales— que combinan profundidad técnica con impacto de negocio real. El seniority en este rol no se mide por antigüedad sino por evidencia de impacto: tu progresión depende de tu capacidad creciente para autogestionar proyectos de forma autónoma, capturar y comunicar el valor de negocio que generas, y multiplicar ese conocimiento en el resto del equipo.

Responsabilidades del cargo

1. Arquitectura y Optimización de Sistemas GenAI

Diseña y optimiza arquitecturas de deep learning y transformers para tareas específicas de alto impacto, optimizando modelos transformer para inferencia y escala en entornos productivos críticos.

2. Fine-Tuning y Servicios de IA Generativa a Escala

Lidera iniciativas de fine-tuning a escala usando datos propietarios del dominio, construye servicios GenAI escalables con caching, batching y foco en costo-eficiencia, e integra sistemas multimodales en casos de uso productivos de alto impacto.

Define y construye frameworks de evaluación de prompts y calidad de output para todo el equipo, aplica la metodología de evaluación human-in-the-loop en proyectos críticos, y audita y mejora la seguridad y alineación de los outputs de los sistemas del equipo.

Cuantifica y comunica el impacto estratégico (revenue, eficiencia, riesgo mitigado) de sus soluciones a nivel ejecutivo, traduciendo el trabajo técnico en métricas que el negocio y el liderazgo pueden usar para decidir.

Autogestiona un portafolio de proyectos GenAI de alto impacto priorizado por valor de negocio, colaborando con equipos de producto para definir el roadmap de iniciativas GenAI.

6. Multiplicación del Conocimiento Técnico del Equipo

Multiplica el conocimiento técnico del equipo vía mentoría formal, code reviews y documentación de mejores prácticas, elevando el estándar técnico general.

Título profesional de Ingeniería Civil Informática, Ingeniería en Computación, Estadística, Matemáticas, Física o carrera afín con fuerte componente cuantitativo y computacional. Se valorará posgrado o doctorado en Machine Learning, Deep Learning o Ciencias de la Computación.

Deseable: Conocimiento de NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 o EU AI Act; experiencia con RLHF; modelos GenAI aplicados a finanzas (scoring, detección de fraude, NLP financiero); arquitectura sobre Vertex AI o SageMaker.

Who We're Looking For:

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Global Marketing Director, Oncology


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world!


In this vital role you will be a strategic thought partner to brand and cross-functional teams, independently owning the integrated insight agenda for a pipeline asset, brand, or disease area. You will generate business-relevant insights that shape global commercialization planning, brand strategy, lifecycle management, and critical decision making.


The Global Marketing Director is a critical role in the organization and has a significant impact on driving strategy and execution on products at all stages of the product lifecycle. For peri-launch products, including IMDELLTRA® (tarlatamab), the Global Marketing Director is responsible for maximizing the value of the asset within key indications, providing commercial guidance and vision, developing global launch strategies, anticipating lifecycle management opportunities to enhance the customer experience and competitive position, and optimizing the impact of marketing budgets.


IMDELLTRA® is currently being developed for the treatment of both extensive and limited-stage small-cell lung cancer (ES- and LS-SCLC); providing commercial leadership to the development organization, you will be responsible for ensuring that this compound is developed with the future market in mind and in-parallel to late-stage indications.


This role will involve working with leaders across oncology to ensure that the insights and market learnings generated for other thoracic oncology marketed products, and other peri-launch assets are appropriately incorporated into the commercial strategy for IMDELLTRA®. It will also involve working closely with Amgen’s integrated brand team and brand working group selected local countries to integrate local market insights, and ‘Global-with-Local’ engagements, including launch readiness plans.

This role will report to the Executive Director and Global Marketing Lead for IMDELLTRA®.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Working with the Global Marketing Lead (GML) to develop a “gold standard” commercial strategy (based on deep insights into the customer, marketplace, competitors, and business drivers) designed to optimize the future value of key indications for IMDELLTRA® (including limited stage and extensive-stage front-line).
  • Lead key marketing deliverables requiring cross-functional stakeholder alignment and input (e.g., Brand Planning, Commercial advisory board leadership, etc.) and ensure that all portal decisions are supported by a robust commercial assessment including but not limited to an understanding of portfolio fit and organizational impact.
  • Ensure all marketing deliverables for assigned brands are on time and of expected quality in alignment with Amgen’s processes and requirements. These include contributions to Global Product Strategy, competitive insights, patient-centric deliverables, robust Target Product Profiles, Forecasts, and strategies to enhance program value including lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Aligned with Amgen’s Global-with-Local model, lead forums that facilitate cross-sharing between local markets, seek market input on global deliverables, and support launch readiness reviews to ensuring rapid integration of local insights into global strategy.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The marketing professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Master's degree and 4 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • Associate's degree and 10 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization; OR
  • High school diploma / GED and 12 years of marketing and/or business experience in a role aligned with a Marketing/Sales commercial organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • An MBA, coupled with a life sciences educational background.
  • 8+ years of experience and a track record of success in a series of commercial roles of increasing scope, scale and complexity, with leading companies in the biopharmaceutical industry.
  • A best-in-class marketer with experience developing and implementing innovative global marketing and commercial strategies for pipeline products, successfully launching therapeutic products and repositioning products to maximize commercial value. Prior experience launching multiple products in diverse therapeutic areas. A solid foundation in strategic marketing.
  • Strong experience in Oncology therapeutic area, and solid tumor immuno-oncology. Keen understanding of the science, market trends, and future opportunities and hurdles.
  • Strong experience in “beyond the molecule” value drivers such as patient services or CDx/IVD space.
  • Prior experience in commercial positions with global responsibilities is important. Experience living and working outside the United States is highly desirable. Possesses an understanding of broad, global market dynamics and the cultural awareness and sensitivity to form relationships and work effectively with colleagues around the world.
  • Broad therapeutic area expertise. Has worked in diverse commercial roles supporting several different disease states, on products in various stages of the lifecycle, with a diverse set of customers in challenging and competitive markets. Experience supporting partnered assets/programs.
  • Prior experience in a tactical, “line” marketing role, implementing marketing strategies in local markets. Solid understanding of global market access, pricing and reimbursement issues.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, managing global projects involving multiple functions and shared accountabilities.
  • A scientifically curious mind.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Facebook Ads Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

We’re looking for a Facebook Ads Specialist to take ownership of Facebook advertising campaigns from strategy and setup through ongoing optimization. You’ll manage campaign performance, audiences, budgets, testing, and reporting while working closely with the marketing team to improve results.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Planning & Strategy

  • Design and build Facebook ad campaigns from the ground up.
  • Align targeting, creative direction, and budget allocation with business objectives.

Ad Execution & Management

  • Set up, launch, and actively manage Facebook campaigns.
  • Monitor delivery, pacing, and performance on an ongoing basis.

Audience Development

  • Research, build, and refine audience segments.
  • Use custom audiences, lookalikes, and interest-based targeting to improve reach and relevance.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Track key metrics across active campaigns.
  • Analyze campaign data and identify trends.
  • Turn findings into clear recommendations for improving performance.

Creative Collaboration

  • Work with the marketing team to brief, review, and iterate on ad creatives and copy.
  • Ensure assets are optimized for their placement and campaign objective.

Budget Management

  • Manage daily and monthly ad spend responsibly.
  • Adjust bids and budgets to meet efficiency targets without overspending.

Testing & Optimization

  • Run structured A/B tests across audiences, creatives, and landing page combinations.
  • Apply learnings systematically across campaigns.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven hands-on experience planning and running Facebook ad campaigns, ideally in a marketing agency or similarly fast-moving environment.
  • Strong command of Meta Ads Manager, including campaign structure, pixel setup, conversion tracking, and attribution settings.
  • Experience managing ad budgets and being accountable for performance results.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify trends.
  • Experience with A/B testing and a disciplined approach to applying campaign learnings.
  • Confident communication skills with the ability to present performance updates and recommendations clearly.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of campaign outcomes from launch through optimization.
  • You’re comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • You communicate proactively and flag issues early.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions or habits.
  • You’re detail-oriented while keeping the broader campaign strategy in focus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns are launched with clear targeting, creative direction, and budget strategy.
  • Campaign performance is consistently monitored and optimized.
  • Ad spend is managed responsibly against performance targets.
  • A/B testing generates actionable insights that improve campaign results.
  • The marketing team receives clear, useful performance updates and recommendations.

Typical Day

Your day centers on the Focusmediahouse ad accounts. You’ll start by reviewing overnight performance across live campaigns and identifying opportunities for budget adjustments, creative changes, or targeting improvements.

You may then prepare performance reports, brief a designer on a new creative concept, or build the structure for an upcoming campaign. Testing is an ongoing part of the role, including reviewing active experiments, deciding what to scale or cut, and setting up the next round.

Most collaboration happens asynchronously, so strong written communication and clear documentation are important.

jobs.description:
Call Center Agent / Mitarbeiter Telefonvertrieb (m/w/d) – 100 % Homeoffice

Teilzeit (ab 30 Stunden) oder Vollzeit | Montag bis Freitag | unbefristete Festanstellung

Telefonieren liegt Ihnen? Dann machen Sie daraus Ihren Job – von zu Hause aus.

Sie sprechen gerne mit Menschen, können sich gut ausdrücken und suchen eine Tätigkeit, die sich dauerhaft aus dem Homeoffice erledigen lässt?

Für unseren Mandanten, ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit professioneller Vertriebsorganisation, suchen wir Verstärkung im telefonischen Kundenkontakt.

Ihre Aufgabe ist klar: Sie kommen mit Gewerbekunden ins Gespräch, erkennen Interesse und vereinbaren qualifizierte Termine für den Außendienst. Sie müssen dabei keine Verträge am Telefon abschließen. Stattdessen schaffen Sie den ersten guten Kontakt und unterstützen damit direkt den Vertriebserfolg.

Dabei arbeiten Sie mit klar definierten Zielgruppen, professionellen Gesprächsleitfäden und strukturierten Prozessen. Die Terminvereinbarung mit potenziellen Interessenten und bestehenden Kunden bildet den Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeit.

Das erwartet Sie in Ihrem Arbeitsalltag

  • Sie sprechen Geschäftskunden aktiv telefonisch an und kommen mit ihnen ins Gespräch.

  • Sie vereinbaren Termine für die Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Außendienst.

  • Sie kontaktieren sowohl potenzielle Neukunden als auch bestehende Kunden.

  • Sie arbeiten mit einem erprobten Gesprächsleitfaden und klar definierten Zielgruppen.

  • Sie dokumentieren Ihre Gespräche zuverlässig im CRM-System.

  • Sie unterstützen die Termin- und Routenplanung des Außendienstes.

  • Sie arbeiten digital und eng mit Ihrem Team zusammen.

Neben der Telefonie gehören CRM-Datenpflege und organisatorische Aufgaben zum Stellenprofil.

Requirements

Was Sie mitbringen sollten

Sie müssen keinen perfekten Vertriebslebenslauf haben.

Viel wichtiger ist, dass Sie gerne telefonieren, offen auf Menschen zugehen und sich durch ein „Nein“ nicht sofort aus der Ruhe bringen lassen.

Besonders gut passen Erfahrungen aus dem Call Center, Telefonvertrieb, Kundenservice, Vertriebsinnendienst oder der Terminvereinbarung. Aber auch Bewerberinnen und Bewerber aus Hotellerie, Gesundheitswesen, Büromanagement, Assistenz oder anderen kundenorientierten Tätigkeiten können gut zu dieser Position passen.

Sie sollten außerdem sicher Deutsch sprechen und schreiben, mit gängiger Bürosoftware umgehen können und selbstständig sowie zuverlässig im Homeoffice arbeiten.

Noch keine klassische Outbound-Erfahrung? Wenn Sie gerne telefonieren, kommunikativ sind und bereit sind, aktiv auf Geschäftskunden zuzugehen, freuen wir uns ebenfalls auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Darauf können Sie sich freuen

100 % Homeoffice

Nach Ihrer Einarbeitung arbeiten Sie dauerhaft von zu Hause – unabhängig davon, wo Sie in Deutschland wohnen.

Planbare Arbeitszeiten

Die Position ist bereits ab 30 Stunden pro Woche möglich. Die Arbeitszeit liegt montags bis freitags im Tagesbereich – aktuell bei 30 Stunden beispielsweise von 8:00 bis 14:30 Uhr inklusive Pause.

Unbefristete Festanstellung

Sie werden direkt bei unserem Mandanten eingestellt. Keine Zeitarbeit, keine Arbeitnehmerüberlassung.

Attraktives Vergütungsmodell

Sie erhalten ein festes Gehalt sowie eine zusätzliche variable Vergütung. Das Fixum wird 13-mal jährlich gezahlt. Für die ersten neun Monate gibt es eine Garantieprovision, damit Sie in Ruhe in der neuen Aufgabe ankommen können.

Struktur statt Sprung ins kalte Wasser

Sie erhalten klare Prozesse, Gesprächsleitfäden, digitale Arbeitsmittel und eine professionelle Einarbeitung.

Keine Wochenend- oder Schichtarbeit

Die Tätigkeit findet regulär von Montag bis Freitag statt.

Ihre Einarbeitung in Hannover

Damit Sie anschließend sicher und selbstständig aus dem Homeoffice arbeiten können, lernen Sie zu Beginn die Aufgaben, Abläufe und Systeme persönlich kennen. Dafür findet eine ca. zweiwöchige Einarbeitung in Hannover statt. Die Kosten für die notwendige Anreise und Unterbringung werden übernommen. Danach arbeiten Sie dauerhaft im Homeoffice.

Für wen ist die Position besonders interessant?

Vielleicht arbeiten Sie heute bereits als Call Center Agent, Kundenberater, Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice oder Telefonvertrieb.

Vielleicht kommen Sie aber auch aus einer Arztpraxis, einem Hotel, einem Büro, einer Assistenzfunktion oder einer anderen Tätigkeit mit viel Kundenkontakt. Entscheidend ist nicht Ihre bisherige Stellenbezeichnung.

Entscheidend ist, dass Sie gerne kommunizieren und Lust darauf haben, Menschen am Telefon für ein Gespräch mit dem Außendienst zu gewinnen.

Klingt nach einem Job, der zu Ihnen passen könnte?

Dann machen wir es Ihnen einfach.

Bewerben Sie sich direkt mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben benötigen wir nicht.

Im nächsten Schritt stellen wir Ihnen einige kurze Fragen zu Ihrer bisherigen Telefonerfahrung, Ihren Arbeitszeiten und der Einarbeitung in Hannover.

Wir, die persoperm GmbH, vermitteln ausschließlich in unbefristete Festanstellungen bei unseren Mandanten. Für Sie als Bewerberin oder Bewerber ist unsere Dienstleistung selbstverständlich vollständig kostenfrei.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.

Highlights

100 % Homeoffice,30–40 Std. pro Woche und freie Wochenenden: Nutzen Sie Ihre Kommunikationsstärke im telefonischen B2B-Kundenkontakt – mit strukturierter Einarbeitung und Festanstellung.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows.

This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff.

Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it.

What You'll Do

    From Customer Need to Product Superpower

    • Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better

    • Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol).

    • Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all.

    • Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure.

      • Prove It and Make It Felt

      • Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships.

      • Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up.

      • Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it.

        • Deliver

        • Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff.

        • Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform.

Who You Are

    The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped.

    The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket.

    The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever.

    We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you!

    HOW WE WORK

    We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge.

What You"ll Bring

    • Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users.

    • AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure.

    • Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls.

    • Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number.

    • Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better.

    • Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them.

    • Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces.

    • Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster.

    • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams.

      • Bonus Points For:

      • LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize).

      • Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt).

      • Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains.

      • Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction.


        • Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups.

        Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US

  • Laid back but focused: We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment and a passion for developing innovative, best-in-class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers.

  • Impact-driven: We care deeply and deliver services and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses.

  • Trust & Inclusion: We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust and mutual respect.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED

  • Competitive company pension scheme with employer match.

  • Generous holiday allowance / flexible time off plus UK bank holidays.

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, and parental leave policies.

  • Ongoing learning resources.

  • Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing free 24/7 mental health, legal, and financial guidance.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the Equality Act 2010.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you feel you could make a great impact in this role, we encourage you to apply anyway!
