jobs.excerpt: Grasshopper Bank is a client-first, digital bank built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.
jobs.description:
Grasshopper Bank is a client-first, digital bank built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.
We are a highly experienced team who pride ourselves on diversity of thought and perspective. Nationally chartered, our portfolio of products and services range from VC, PE & Portfolio Companies to SBA Lending, as well as direct SMB and Embedded Banking.
Our entrepreneurial drive allows us to support the growth and success of a wide range of clients at every stage of their business through inclusive partnership. We seek out team members who will enable both our organization and our people to grow and thrive through collaboration and acting with integrity and respect.
Our focus on cross-functional teamwork provides a culture where ideas are valued, accountability is encouraged, and successes are celebrated. We welcome all those searching for the opportunity to contribute to banking innovation that influences and supports the emerging digital world of Financial Services.
Our digital first approach enables our teams the flexibility to work remotely. We have offices in NYC and Boston.

What you'll do:

As a Customer Analytics Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of modern data engineering, customer behavior analytics, and growth enablement. Reporting to the Director of BI & Analytics, you will serve as the technical engine and strategic architect behind our bank-wide Customer 360 and customer lifecycle analytics initiatives.
In this high-impact role, you will move beyond standard descriptive reporting to build the foundational data models, pipelines, and semantic layers that explain who our clients are, how they interact with our digital banking platforms, and what drives long-term customer lifetime value (LTV). You will be responsible for modeling complex customer event streams, digital touchpoints, and transaction histories into analytics-ready models in Google BigQuery, powering executive Tableau reporting and directly activating customer data downstream into marketing and engagement engines (such as Braze).
If you love writing clean, performant SQL/Python transformation logic, unraveling complex customer journeys, and partnering with Product and Marketing leaders to unlock top-line revenue, this role is for you.
  • Customer 360 & C-MDM Modeling: Design, build, and optimize scalable dimensional models (Kimball methodology) and One Big Table (OBT) datasets in Google BigQuery that unify core banking records, digital session logs, and touchpoints into a trusted, bank-wide customer master (C-MDM) and single source of truth.
  • Identity Resolution, Governance & Attribution: Establish robust customer identity mapping and multi-touch marketing attribution models across diverse platforms, while championing master data management (C-MDM) principles, data quality, and governance across all customer data pipelines.
  • Semantic Layer & Master Data Development: Formalize bank-wide customer entities, core segmentations, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs)—such as Active User definitions (DAU/MAU), primary operating account status, feature adoption, and dormancy thresholds—to align business and technical definitions under a unified C-MDM framework.
  • Scalable ELT Pipelines: Design, deploy, and maintain resilient ELT/ETL pipelines (using SQL, Python, and orchestration tools) to ingest, clean, and enrich raw customer interaction data, API payloads, and core snapshot tables.
  • Downstream Marketing & Activation Sync: Engineer reliable pipelines and reverse-ETL workflows that sync enriched customer traits, behavioral events, and engagement tiers directly into marketing automation platforms (e.g., Braze) and CRM systems to power automated lifecycle campaigns.
  • Data Quality & Observability: Implement automated testing, anomaly detection, and schema validation across customer data pipelines to guarantee platform accuracy, uptime, and alerting.
  • Customer Journey & Cohort Dashboards: Design and maintain intuitive, executive-ready Tableau dashboards focusing on customer acquisition funnels, retention curves, product penetration, churn indicators, and deposit velocity.
  • Storytelling with Data: Translate complex, multi-layered data into clear, actionable narratives that answer the "so what?" for business line leaders and product managers.
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor and tune BigQuery queries and Tableau extracts to ensure rapid workbook performance and cost-efficient query processing.
  • Strategic Growth Partner: Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, and Business Line leaders to translate business hypotheses into quantitative frameworks and tracking requirements.
  • Data Stewardship & Literacy: Champion data governance best practices, document customer data lineages and KPI definitions in the Data Steward Playbook, and coach end-users on self-service data discovery.

What you need:

  • Experience: 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in a hybrid data role such as Analytics Engineer, Customer Data Engineer, BI Developer, or Marketing Data Engineer. Prior experience in fintech, commercial banking, or digital banking platforms is preferred.
  • Advanced SQL & BigQuery: Expert-level SQL skills, including advanced analytical window functions, complex CTEs, array/struct unnesting, and performance tuning within cloud data warehouses (Google BigQuery strongly preferred).
  • Dimensional & Event Data Modeling: Strong experience with dimensional modeling, star schemas, and structuring behavioral/event-based data models (hands-on experience with dbt for modeling transformations and lineage is a strong plus).
  • Python & Pipeline Engineering: Demonstrated experience using Python for data transformation, API integrations, and workflow automation. Experience scheduling and orchestrating DAGs using tools like Apache Airflow or Google Cloud Composer is preferred.
  • Tableau Expertise: Deep proficiency in Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud, including Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, and thoughtful dashboard UX/UI design principles.
  • Customer Analytics Acumen: Strong conceptual understanding of customer lifecycle metrics: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), cohort retention, and churn. Familiarity with reverse-ETL workflows or customer data activation is a plus.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Proven track record of presenting complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Company Overview:

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency specializing in mission-driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. Since launching in 2020, the agency has built a strong reputation for combining strategic thinking, creative execution, and data-driven marketing to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth.

Your Role:

The Senior Web Analyst sits at the center of the agency's Data and Analytics function, connecting every paid media platform and CRM the agency touches into a single, reliable source of truth. You'll own the full path data takes: from a client's ad accounts and CRM, through Adverity, into a BigQuery warehouse, through modular dbt/Dataform transformations, and out to the Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports the team and its partners rely on daily. Reporting to the Data and Analytics Manager, you're joining at a pivotal moment — the agency is scaling its roster of education and nonprofit partners, and this role is instrumental in evolving the automated reporting suite that makes that growth possible without sacrificing data quality or client trust.

You'll:

  • Own data ingestion & pipeline architecture — connect and maintain API pipelines from paid media platforms (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic) into Adverity, build custom Python connectors for anything not natively supported, and architect scalable pipelines from source system through to dashboard

  • Own CRM integration — build and maintain reliable CRM data connections (Slate, Salesforce, HubSpot) so lead and enrollment data flows cleanly into the warehouse

  • Own the data warehouse — route, optimize, and store raw and processed data in Google BigQuery; design efficient schemas for complex, multi-source marketing data (granularity, normalization, slowly changing dimensions); manage partitioning, clustering, and storage strategy to control query cost and performance

  • Own transformation & mapping — build SQL schemas that map, blend, and organize multi-channel data accurately for each client, in modular, version-controlled, documented dbt or Dataform pipelines, with standardized naming conventions and metric definitions across platforms and clients

  • Own CI/CD & data segregation — maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, automated testing) for robust, version-controlled releases, and enforce strict data segregation across multi-client environments

  • Enable the reporting layer — create clean, performant data views built specifically for fast Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports, and partner with the Data and Analytics Manager and client teams to translate reporting requirements into warehouse models

  • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, ideally in a marketing or agency environment

  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)

  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling

  • Expertise in dbt or Dataform, managing modular, version-controlled, documented SQL transformation pipelines

  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation

  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)

  • A deep understanding of marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC) and paid platform schemas, with a proven track record of structuring data to optimize Looker Studio performance

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi-client data environments with strict data segregation

  • An analytical, solution-driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non-technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points:

  • Experience integrating AI-driven insights or machine learning models into marketing data pipelines to sharpen predictive analytics and data utility

  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows

  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture

  • Experience using AI/ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

What’s Offered:

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async-friendly team

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location

  • A pivotal, high-visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the agency's reporting infrastructure

  • The chance to build the data backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world

  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A-players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal

  • Direct impact: the pipelines and models you build directly shape how partners see (and trust) their own performance data

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Application Review (resume + a few questions)

  • 2️⃣ Screening Call with Atomic HR

  • 3️⃣ Hiring Team Interview (walkthrough of a pipeline or data model you've built)

  • 4️⃣ Technical Assessment (a real-world data engineering case study)

  • 5️⃣ Final Interview with company leadership

jobs.title: Director, Data and Analytics
jobs.excerpt: About Ritual Ritual is a personal health brand that is raising the bar for daily wellness.
jobs.description:
About Ritual

Ritual is a personal health brand that is raising the bar for daily wellness. Known for our best-selling, clinically backed prenatal, we create science-backed supplements with transparency at their core. We believe women deserve products they can trust, backed by real evidence—not just promises.

We started by reinventing the multivitamin with the first visible supply chain of its kind. Today, we’re expanding into new categories with the same high standards that built our reputation. Hundreds of thousands trust Ritual, and we’re growing fast.

Our team of 120+ scientists, creatives, and skeptics is raising the bar for women’s health. We’re venture-backed, based in sunny Los Angeles, and always looking for people ready to challenge the industry—and do the best work of their careers.

About the role

We're looking for a Director, Data & Analytics to own how Ritual measures its business as we grow from a DTC-first brand into an omnichannel one. Ritual now reaches consumers through our own ecommerce site, Amazon, and national retail partners, and we're investing in upper-funnel media to reach new audiences. That makes leadership's questions harder: Is retail growing the brand or moving demand we already had? What is brand media actually buying? Where should the next dollar of growth capital go? You'll own those answers and bring them to our CGO, CFO, and executive team in a way that changes decisions. Reporting to our SVP, Product & Engineering, you'll lead a team of analysts and data engineers. You'll be a strategic partner to leaders across the business, working as a peer to our VP, Omnichannel Media and alongside our DTC, Wholesale, Amazon & Marketplaces, Brand, and Finance teams. You'll inherit a modern, stable data platform. Your job is to scale what it delivers, grow the people on it, and shape the team for its next stage.

What you'll do

  • Own Ritual's omnichannel measurement: Build and run a single connected view of customer value and acquisition cost across DTC, Amazon and marketplaces, and retail: LTV:CAC, payback, and contribution profit by channel. Explain how channels interact, including halo, cannibalization, and whether new distribution expands the market or shifts it.
  • Own the read on marketing investment: Partner with our VP, Omnichannel Media to plan, test, and optimize the full media budget; you own the measurement ecosystem across MMM, attribution, geo-lift, and incrementality, including what upper-funnel investment is buying in reach and household penetration.
  • Measure every channel on the same terms: Bring retail and Amazon up to the standard we hold DTC to, covering sell-in versus sell-through, distribution and velocity, promotions, syndicated and panel data, and new-to-brand customers.
  • Shape decisions at the top: Be the executive voice on business performance for our CGO, CFO, and leadership team. Own the reporting the business runs on, partner with Finance on plan, mine the insight that matters, and build the artifacts that move planning, budget, and board conversations.
  • Lead and build the team: Grow analysts into domain experts and coach them to build influential analysis and the narrative around it. Lead data engineering and own how our stack and project architecture evolve with the changing needs of the business.

Who you are

  • Executive Translator: You turn complex, multi-channel analysis into a clear recommendation a CFO can act on, and you're comfortable defending it in the room. Leaders seek out your point of view before they make the call.
  • Healthy Skeptic: You know when a number is wrong before anyone else does, and you say the inconvenient thing plainly and kindly. You'd rather surface a hard finding early than defend a comfortable one later. When priorities compete, you negotiate calmly and constructively, holding to what the data supports while staying open to what others need.
  • Omnichannel Systems Thinker: You see DTC, marketplace, and retail as one portfolio. You think in contribution profit, not channel silos, and you understand how media, distribution, and retention work together.
  • Storyteller and Teacher: You can turn a messy dataset into a sharp narrative, and you teach others to do the same. Your feedback on a draft makes the analyst better, not just the deck.
  • Focused Operator: You've led a lean data team inside a growing business with many internal customers. You check that the work ladders up to Ritual's goals, protect your team's capacity, and take on ad-hoc asks selectively instead of chasing every fire drill.
  • Listener and Team Builder: You listen as closely to your team as you do to the business, and you find the balance between what each needs. You grow analysts into leaders, and you're credible with engineers on the tradeoffs that keep a data platform trustworthy.

What you'll need

  • 8+ years in analytics, data science, or marketing measurement, starting as a practitioner analyst with strong business instincts, and including several years leading lean, technical data teams of analysts and data or analytics engineers, with credibility on pipeline, modeling, and data-quality tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on marketing measurement expertise across MMM, multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing, and geo-lift, including where each method breaks, and a track record of using it to rationalize upper-funnel spend.
  • Experience measuring marketing efficiency at a consumer brand that sells both DTC and through retail, including marketplace channels, subscription or e-commerce economics, cohort retention, and cross-channel effects.
  • Retail data experience, including POS and sell-through data, retailer data portals, syndicated and household panel data, and reconciling sell-in to consumer takeaway. CPG or health and wellness experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated executive influence and storytelling: a portfolio of analyses and executive artifacts that changed decisions at the C-suite or board level, and experience coaching analysts to produce them.
  • Deep experience with dbt and a modern data stack (Snowflake and a BI semantic layer, with Omni a plus), as a hands-on practitioner or as the manager of the engineers who own it. Amazon Marketing Cloud experience is a plus.

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed above. We’re committed to building a diverse team and recognize that skills can be developed in many different ways.

Compensation

  • Pay Range: $170,000 - $205,000
  • Your base salary is one part of your total compensation package. The salary range represents the entire compensation range for this position. Exact compensation will depend on a number of factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, level, years of experience, technical expertise, and other qualifications. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. This role is also eligible for equity + generous benefits + 401k + unlimited PTO etc - see our list of perks/ benefits below.

What We Offer

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Healthcare & Dependent Care FSA
  • Mental health support via Wellness Coach
  • Pet insurance discount
  • 10 Wellness Days per Year (Final Friday of every month)
  • Free Ritual subscription during your tenure
  • Annual Wellness Stipend
  • Monthly wellness activities

Financial & Career Support

  • 401(k) Match (up to 4%)
  • Equity participation through stock options
  • Monthly Technology Stipend
  • New Hire Work From Home Stipend

Family & Flexibility

  • 5 months of gender-neutral parental leave for eligible team members
  • Flex Time for birthing parents
  • Family Planning via Maven Clinic
  • Monthly Childcare Allowance

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO (with a 10-day minimum to recharge)
  • 11 Paid Company Holidays
  • Additional company time off for holidays that fall around a weekend
  • Winter Break (Christmas - New Years)
  • Holiday Diversity Policy
  • 2 Days to volunteer (Days of Action)
  • Focus Fridays for self-development and deep work

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

The AI Enterprise Architect partners with Account Executives and pre-sales Solutions Engineers on Gong's highest-value and most technically complex enterprise opportunities, particularly where customers are evaluating how to operationalize AI securely, responsibly, and at scale. The role serves as a trusted technical and business advisor to CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, AI councils, enterprise architects, data leaders, security leaders, and revenue executives.

You will help customers understand how Gong's AI capabilities, APIs, MCP, Gong Assistant, Deep Research, integrations, and broader platform fit into their enterprise AI strategy, technology ecosystem, and revenue workflows. You will lead advanced AI architecture conversations, reduce technical risk, shape solution strategy, and create differentiated executive engagement. You will champion Gong’s cause during “build versus buy” discussions wherein prospects are considering building their own revenue intelligence platforms in lieu of Gong’s commercial offerings.

This is not a replacement for core SE coverage. You will be brought into opportunities after product fit has been established, while also scaling the broader SE organization through reusable assets, technical enablement, thought leadership, and external evangelism through channels like LinkedIn and Medium.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on strategic enterprise opportunities involving AI architecture, governance, integrations, and complex technical requirements.
  • Lead executive-level discovery, AI strategy discussions, architecture assessments, and technical design workshops with CIO, CTO, AI council, security, data, and enterprise architecture stakeholders.

  • Architect how Gong can be used within and alongside a customer's AI ecosystem, including through Gong APIs, MCP, Gong Assistant, Deep Research, integrations, and workflow automation.

  • Show thought leadership on AI architectures and guide customers on best practices for using Gong data and capabilities in AI-enabled and vibe-coded applications.
  • Assess customer requirements around data governance, data residency, identity and access management, agent permissions, auditability, human-in-the-loop controls, agent guardrails, and enterprise AI risk.

  • Position Gong credibly within customers' existing AI ecosystems, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and enterprise governance tooling; articulate both better-together integration patterns and clear product boundaries.
  • Create and present customer-specific AI reference architectures, integration patterns, technical roadmaps, validation plans, risk registers, and implementation recommendations.
  • Act as the senior technical voice in complex pursuits, including executive presentations, security and architecture reviews, RFPs, proofs of concept, and technical win plans.
  • Translate complex AI concepts, technical tradeoffs, and product boundaries into clear business value for executive and technical audiences.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Professional Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure customer requirements are represented and solution designs are feasible to implement and operate.
  • Develop reusable field assets, including AI discovery frameworks, CIO architecture narratives, governance guidance, integration patterns, demo narratives, and objection-handling materials.
  • Enable Solutions Engineers and account teams on AI positioning, enterprise AI conversations, advanced solution design, CIO persona engagement, and complex-deal execution.
  • Bring structured market feedback to Product and Engineering, identifying recurring enterprise governance, observability, compliance, control, and adoption requirements.
  • Serve as a competitive expert capable of representing Gong versus other vendors’ AI offerings. Contribute knowledge and content to Gong’s competitive team.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, sales engineering, consulting, AI strategy, or a comparable customer-facing technical leadership role.
  • Experience working with large, complex enterprises and engaging CIOs, CTOs, Chief AI Officers, enterprise architects, security leaders, data leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated expertise in generative AI, large language models, AI agents, MCP, APIs, integrations, data flows, vibe coding, and enterprise software architecture.
  • Practical familiarity with leading AI platforms and ecosystems, such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Google Vertex, Salesforce, Microsoft, and related enterprise AI technologies.
  • Experience discussing AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, identity and access management, security, compliance, observability, auditability, and enterprise deployment considerations.
  • Proven ability to lead architecture workshops and translate ambiguous business needs into clear, executable technical designs.
  • Experience advancing complex enterprise opportunities through technical discovery, security reviews, RFPs, pilots, and proofs of concept.
  • Strong executive communication, influence, and storytelling skills, with the ability to move comfortably between C-suite conversations and detailed technical design.
  • Ability to translate AI capabilities into practical, measurable outcomes for revenue organizations.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a demonstrated ability to enable and scale the impact of a broader technical field organization.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Strategic customers view Gong as a governed, enterprise-ready component of their AI strategy, not solely a sales productivity application.
  • CIOs and AI leaders understand how Gong supports their architecture, governance, security, integration, and value-realization priorities.
  • Account teams can confidently navigate sophisticated AI, architecture, governance, and integration conversations, including mixed-vendor environments.
  • Complex technical risks are identified early and addressed with clear, practical solution designs and validation plans.
  • Customers have a credible plan for deploying Gong AI in alignment with security, governance, integration, and compliance requirements.
  • Account teams can quantify the value, cost, and risk tradeoffs of Gong AI relative to internal development or broader platform alternatives.
  • The SE organization becomes more capable of positioning Gong in AI-led opportunities through your enablement and reusable assets.
  • Field insights meaningfully influence Gong's product strategy, enterprise readiness, messaging, and go-to-market execution.
  • Your work accelerates strategic opportunities, improves customer confidence, and helps revenue organizations realize greater value from Gong.

PERKS & BENEFITS

Oktopost helps B2B companies turn social media into a measurable growth channel. Our platform powers social media management and employee advocacy for brands like AllianceBernstein, Finastra, and Factorial, and plugs into the marketing tech stack they already use.

You'll win enterprise accounts: full-cycle deals with several economic buyers and longer, more involved sales cycles. We use the Sandler method as a way of working, not a one-off course. You'll diagnose real business pain before proposing anything, treat prospects as equals, and set clear expectations at every stage. You'll also be someone the wider team turns to for how to run a deal well.

You'll report to our Director of Sales and work alongside the US sales team.

Why You'll Want This Role

  • A seat at the table with marketing leaders. You'll sell to CMOs and senior marketing teams, on deals that span several departments and decision-makers.
  • A product that proves its value. You'll sell a platform that helps marketing leaders turn social into a channel they can measure and grow.
  • Pipeline support. Alongside your own outbound, you'll get inbound from marketing and opportunities from our SDR motion.
  • Someone fully dedicated to helping you sell. Our Sales Enablement Manager works only with our sellers: getting you up to speed fast, coaching you on Sandler as you go, and making sure you know exactly how to position every new feature and update with prospects.

What You'll Do

  • Build and work a named list of enterprise target accounts, running every deal from first conversation to signature.
  • Lead discovery across every stakeholder in the deal, from day-to-day users to the economic buyer, using Sandler's pain-first approach.
  • Own an accurate forecast for your book, with a reliable weekly commit.
  • Generate most of your own pipeline through targeted outbound.
  • Close new enterprise business every quarter against your target, and hand accounts over cleanly to the Account Management team.
  • Coach newer AEs informally on deal planning and Sandler discovery, and help shape how we run enterprise deals.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B SaaS sales, including closing enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders.
  • A track record of meeting or beating enterprise quota that you can evidence.
  • Real depth in a consultative method (Sandler, MEDDPICC, Challenger or similar) that you can talk through in detail.
  • SDR/BDR early career experience.
  • The ability to run a meeting with a CMO: frame their problem in business terms, handle pushback, and agree next steps.
  • The right to work in the US. We can't offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice To Have

  • Experience selling to B2B marketing leaders, or in martech or adtech.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot or Marketo.
  • An active, genuine presence on LinkedIn.
  • A track record of promotion into more senior or strategic roles.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching newer AEs.

What You'll Get

  • Pay: competitive base, uncapped commission and stock options.
  • 401(k): 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Growth: a formal learning and development program, including Sandler training.
  • Time off: flexible time off with no fixed cap. Take the time you need to rest and recharge, just plan it with your manager. You also get paid company holidays and a quarterly Recharge Day.
  • Health: private health insurance.
  • Extras: $100 monthly allowance.

Life as an Oktoposter

At Oktopost, we’re a curious, collaborative, and driven bunch who believe in doing great work, and having fun while we’re at it. We value ambition, creativity, and a healthy dose of team spirit, all wrapped up in a culture that encourages growth, innovation, and delivering real impact.
No matter what department or region you join us from, you’ll be part of a team that supports, celebrates, and challenges one another. From day one, we want every Oktoposter to feel empowered, inspired, and truly at home.
We're a team that’s genuinely passionate about B2B social. We believe social media can shape brands, spark meaningful conversations, and drive real business results, and we'd love for you to be part of our journey.

You'll help leaders navigate competing priorities, organizational complexity, and change while creating the structure and alignment needed to move critical initiatives forward.

Success in this role isn't measured by how many initiatives you lead. It's measured by your ability to help the organization execute better, make informed decisions, and deliver lasting business value.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with executive leadership to define initiative objectives, establish governance, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop execution strategies that balance business value, organizational capacity, and risk.

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it.

Our Core Values:

  • Constant elevation
  • Customer first

Benefits

jobs.excerpt: About IFS LogisticsIFS Logistics (built and launched as 7bridges, now part of IFS) is an AI-native enterprise logistics platform.
jobs.description:
About IFS Logistics

IFS Logistics (built and launched as 7bridges, now part of IFS) is an AI-native enterprise logistics platform. We unify transport data, optimise carrier spend, and automate execution for enterprise shippers and logistics companies. We are a small, dedicated product and engineering team inside IFS, reporting into the commercial organisation rather than central R&D. Pure SaaS, zero consultancy: if a customer needs us to operate the software for them, we have failed.

The role

This is not a traditional "add AI to an existing system" role. You will set the technical direction for our Experience squad — the layer where the whole platform meets the customer: SSO and identity, IFS Intelligence integration, the demo environment, and the cross-product surface that ties Data Connect, TPAO, Shipper TMS and Revenue Protect into one product.

The squad does not exist yet. You will help build it, set its architecture and standards, and be accountable for what it ships. You stay hands-on — this is not a management-only role. You are the squad's technical voice to the VP Product and Chief Architect.

Your depth is backend and platform. Every engineer here is expected to be genuinely fullstack; the profile describes where your depth is, not a boundary you stay inside. You will review React as readily as Django.

What you'll work on

  • API v3 and the service boundaries that let four product areas share one identity, permission and navigation model without a shared mess.
  • SSO, tenancy and permissions done once, properly — "all data visible by default, restricted only by exception".
  • A demo environment that is a real product surface, not a fixture — commercially load-bearing and used every week.
  • IFS Intelligence and IFS Cloud integration, including the embedding path opened up by Project Oliver.
  • Where the agent sits in each new surface, and the guardrails, observability and cost controls that make agentic behaviour safe to ship.

What we're looking for

  • Around eight years or more building and running production software, with real depth in Python/Django REST API design, data modelling and service reliability.
  • You have set technical direction for a team: chosen the approach, written it down, defended it, and changed it when you were wrong.
  • Strong on performance, cost and observability. You have owned the pager as well as the design doc.
  • Genuinely fullstack — comfortable in React and able to raise the bar on frontend work you do not write yourself.
  • You raise other people's standards. Review, pairing and honest feedback are things you do by default.
  • AI-native in practice: you build with Cursor and Claude daily, you know how to give an agent the right context, and you can tell when its output is wrong.
  • You form and state a view. Ambiguity is the job, not a blocker.

Nice to have

  • Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS, SSO/identity, or ERP integration experience.
  • LLM agent orchestration, RAG or evals in production.
  • Shipped agents into a product for real work, like agentic audit or agent-managed fulfilment rules, with a view on where an agent earns its place and where it does not.
  • Simulation or scenario modelling: synthetic data or replay used to prove out logic before it ships.
  • BigQuery, dbt, Pub/Sub, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform.
  • Logistics, supply chain or freight.

Tech stack

Python (Django REST), TypeScript/Node, React · BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud, Superset · Pub/Sub, Datastream · GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD · LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, evals · Cursor + Claude, Notion (SDD Central), Jira.

What success looks like — first 6 months

  • The Experience squad has a written technical approach that the rest of engineering uses as a reference point.
  • API v3 surfaces owned by the squad are in production, observable, and within cost budget.
  • SSO and cross-product permissions are shipped and self-serve.
  • Code review on all merge requests and no direct-to-prod are real in your squad, not aspirational.
  • The engineers in the squad are visibly better than when they joined.

Why this role exists now

We are shifting from feature-driven engineering to agent-led product architecture. The Experience layer is where that shift is most visible and where it currently hurts most: navigation has crept, data is hidden that should not be, and agent-first thinking is not yet applied systematically. That gap is the job. We are honest about it — and we need someone who will set the direction rather than wait for one.

You'll need to be based in either the UK or the Netherlands - we're a remote team with clusters of people in London and Amsterdam.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (Fully Remote)
jobs.excerpt: The Role We NeedPadSplit is growing its analytics platform and needs a hands-on Data Engineer to work alongside our existing DE lead.
jobs.description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit is growing its analytics platform and needs a hands-on Data Engineer to work alongside our existing DE lead. This person will build and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines across Dagster (or Airflow), dbt, and Snowflake, with supporting work in Python, Airbyte, and AWS. The role combines building new pipelines and data models with providing real coverage on critical paths — especially the daily Postgres → Snowflake → dbt flow and third-party API loads — all shipped through reviewed pull requests rather than one-off scripts.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a practitioner who thinks natively in dimensions, facts, and slowly changing dimensions — someone who knows when to use a full refresh versus an incremental load and how that choice affects idempotency and backfills. This person writes clear, reviewable PRs and gives equally thoughtful reviews, with attention to scoped diffs, sensible tests, and failure modes. They're comfortable in complex Python data flows and have enough AWS literacy to reason about task roles, buckets, and cross-account access without needing to own all of platform engineering.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • PR-driven shipping: Opening and merging pull requests for new or updated Dagster jobs, assets, schedules, and sensors, plus dbt models, tests, and documentation.
  • Infrastructure tweaks: Writing occasional Terraform for secrets, environment variables, or job sizing when a pipeline needs it.
  • Pipeline implementation: Building and debugging Python pipelines covering REST/API syncs, large Postgres extracts, Parquet loads, and Snowflake COPY operations.
  • Airbyte management: Configuring or troubleshooting Airbyte connections wherever managed sync is the right fit.
  • Production monitoring: Watching production runs and investigating failures related to IAM, OOM, Spot instances, or bad watermarks.
  • Backfills & catch-ups: Running backfills and incremental catch-ups with a clear story for what landed and why.
  • Modeling partnership: Working with analytics and product on dim/fct/x_fct design, incremental strategies, and data quality.
  • Code review & runbooks: Participating in code review, release prep, and writing short runbooks so others can operate your pipelines when you're out.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • Warehouse fundamentals: Solid grasp of relational databases and warehouse patterns — keys, grain, normalization vs. star schema, and how SCD behavior gets encoded.
  • Orchestration experience: Practical, hands-on Dagster (or Airflow) experience — not just writing SQL inside a scheduler UI.
  • dbt proficiency: Real experience building and maintaining models, tests, and documentation in dbt.
  • Python at scale: Comfort reading and writing Python that moves data at scale across extract, transform, and load steps.
  • AWS working knowledge: Practical familiarity with S3, IAM, and ECS/Fargate at a "debug my job" level.
  • EL tool familiarity: Experience with Airbyte or similar extract-and-load tools.
  • PR discipline: The discipline to write pull requests others can easily review, and to give equally rigorous reviews in return.
  • Reliability mindset: A track record of keeping pipelines healthy and modeling consistent across full refresh and incremental paths, without becoming a single point of failure.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Principal Data Scientist for forty-five (45) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one and a half (1.5) hours.
  • If warranted, the next and final step would be a video interview with a key leader in the company for thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

  • Fully remote position - we swear!
  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As Legal Counsel, you’ll help Alpaca navigate complex regulatory frameworks as we design and launch innovative financial products and services. You’ll provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance across U.S. broker-dealer regulation, digital assets, payments, and other evolving areas of financial services.
You’ll partner closely with teams across Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, AML, Sales, and Success, supporting everything from product and regulatory reviews to agreements, policies, regulatory engagement, and disputes. This is a highly cross-functional role with the opportunity to help shape how Alpaca scales in a fast-moving regulatory environment.

Job Responsibilities
  • Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to help the business design and implement innovative financial products and services.
  • Lead legal reviews of product design, marketing, and customer onboarding processes to ensure compliance with applicable regulations while enabling business growth.
  • Support other areas of the business, such as digital assets, payments, and data privacy, as needed.
  • Advise on the application of new or anticipated legal requirements and regulatory guidance to the firm’s systems, policies, and procedures.
  • Monitor regulatory developments at relevant governmental agencies and self-regulatory organizations, including the SEC, FINRA, CFTC, FinCEN, and OFAC.
  • Support the company’s engagement with regulators, including the SEC, FINRA, and other agencies.
  • Draft agreements, disclosures, policies, and procedures.
  • Conduct legal research and analysis on novel questions and provide clear, practical guidance to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage litigation, arbitration, and other disputes, including developing case strategy, coordinating with outside counsel, responding to claims and discovery, and advising the business on risk and resolution options.
  • Partner cross-functionally with teams outside of Legal, including the firm’s Product, Brokerage, Crypto, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Sales, and Success functions.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • J.D. degree (or foreign equivalent) and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 5-7+ years of legal experience, with at least 3 years focused on U.S. broker-dealer regulation, including the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, regulations and rules thereunder, FINRA rules, and other federal and state securities laws.
  • Familiarity with U.S. cryptoasset regulatory regimes, including the SEC, CFTC, NYDFS, FinCEN, and AML requirements.
  • Strong experience advising fintechs or financial institutions, ideally in a startup or growth-stage environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver strategic, business-oriented legal advice under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a practical, collaborative working style.
  • Strong judgment, self-motivation, and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a growth mindset in a fast-scaling company.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

jobs.description:
Kyverna Therapeutics is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Guided by our core values, Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome, we are committed to transforming the future of treatment for autoimmune disease. Join us at the forefront of cell therapy innovation and help redefine what’s possible.

Position Overview

Kyverna is seeking Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join the Medical Affairs organization. The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert supporting external engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) focused on autoimmune diseases and cell therapy.

The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific expertise, exceptional relationship-building skills, and experience supporting complex specialty therapies within biotechnology or pharmaceutical environments. This individual will play a critical role in communicating scientific and clinical data, gathering field insights, and supporting the continued development of Kyverna’s CAR-T therapy programs.

Location: Remote ideally based SoCal, AZ, NV, UT,

Travel: Approximately 50-70%

Responsibilities

  • Scientific Engagement & KOL Management
    • Identify, establish, and maintain high‑quality scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, academic medical centers, community physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and treatment centers within the assigned territory.
    • Serve as a trusted scientific partner by providing fair‑balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific exchange related to disease state, treatment landscape, Kyverna’s CAR‑T programs, and emerging clinical data.
    • Act as a primary scientific liaison to investigators interested in clinical research collaborations and investigator‑initiated research discussions, in alignment with company policies.
    • Territory Strategy & Field Medical Planning
      • Develop and execute geography‑specific Medical Affairs and KOL engagement plans aligned with therapeutic area objectives, investigator needs, and Kyverna’s medical strategy.
      • Demonstrate ownership of the assigned territory through stakeholder mapping, prioritization, and proactive planning to influence the patient journey and support optimal therapeutic decision‑making.
      • Partner with other Kyverna field medical colleagues to share insights and coordinate external engagement approaches where appropriate.
      • Clinical Development & Trial Support
        • Collaborate with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations colleagues to support Kyverna‑sponsored clinical trials, including:
        • Identification of potential trial sites
        • Engagement with participating investigators
        • Support of trial awareness and scientific dialogue
        • Contribute to efforts aimed at enhancing trial feasibility and enrollment through appropriate scientific engagement with investigators and treatment centers.
        • Medical Insights & Internal Collaboration
          • Capture and communicate timely, high‑quality medical insights related to the autoimmune and cell therapy landscape to internal stakeholders to support strategy and evidence planning.
          • Translate external scientific perspectives into actionable insights that inform medical, clinical, and development decision‑making.

            • Ensure timely completion of CRM documentation, administrative tasks, required training, and pharmacovigilance responsibilities, including adverse event and product complaint reporting.

    • Senior Medical Science Liaison (Senior MSL) requires Doctorate degree & 2 years of Medical Affairs experience OR Master’s degree & 6 years of Medical Affairs experience
    • Prior experience in cell therapy, CAR-T, immunology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, hematology/oncology, or rare diseases strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical development, and medical affairs functions.
    • Experience engaging with academic medical centers, specialty treatment centers, and/or infusion centers preferred.
    • Ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific and clinical information to diverse audiences.
    • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to build strong external relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
    • Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, high-growth biotechnology environment.
    • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within assigned geography.
    • Experience supporting pre-commercial or launch-stage biotechnology organizations.
    • Knowledge of autoimmune disease treatment landscapes and emerging cell therapy approaches.
    • Experience supporting investigator-sponsored research and clinical trial recruitment initiatives.
    • Familiarity with cell therapy operational concepts including chain of identity, chain of custody, and treatment center workflows.

jobs.excerpt: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform.
jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

We're looking for a Senior Director / VP, Customer Support to elevate customer service as a strategic lever for product excellence. This is not a traditional support leadership role—you'll own the end-to-end system that captures, routes, resolves, and learns from every support case, driving both immediate service quality and long-term case prevention through product roadmap influence.

You'll build and scale a new generation of technically-oriented support professionals, create career paths that retain top talent, and establish the operational rigor that scales with our growth. As a key partner to Product and Engineering leadership, you'll translate support insights into product improvements that prevent issues at the source.

If you see customer service as a product to be engineered, love building high-performing organizations, and want to shape how a healthcare technology company serves its customers, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Drive Operational Excellence & Service Delivery

  • Own SLA and case-resolution performance for the entire support organization, delivering on time-to-resolution, backlog reduction, and customer satisfaction targets
  • Build a high-functioning system, team, and operating model that exemplifies exceptional customer service standards
  • Design and audit the QA framework for AI-assisted case resolution—ensuring teams critically evaluate AI output and maintain quality over speed
  • Continuously optimize case triage, routing, and escalation systems, including seamless handoff processes to Product Development
  • Establish business operating procedures for all product support resolution, including monitoring, root cause analysis, and analytics
  • Report performance metrics to the CPO and cross-functional leadership, making support performance transparent and actionable

Build & Scale the Organization

  • Redefine the support hiring profile toward a materially more technical standard: professionals who resolve complex issues, reason about underlying systems, discern AI quality, and actively improve support operations for team-wide leverage
  • Build a credible in-function career ladder with clear levels, competitive compensation, and senior technical leadership roles that create real growth paths
  • Manage and develop Support Managers, instilling a high-performance culture with clear accountability, coaching rigor, and team development
  • Own training, enablement, and onboarding infrastructure that brings new hires to technical proficiency rapidly
  • Scale the team strategically while improving operational leverage—absorbing growth without proportional cost increases

Partner Cross-Functionally & Influence Product Direction

  • Own the case-to-roadmap feedback loop: translate support data into prioritized, evidence-backed recommendations that prevent future cases at the source
  • Partner closely with Product Leadership on roadmap prioritization decisions that materially impact case volume—acting as a strategic partner in product direction
  • Ensure customer feedback via support plays a critical role in the product development lifecycle
  • Collaborate with Customer Operations leadership to ensure holistic service standards across onboarding, customer success, and support

Engineer Systems for Scale

  • Treat support as a tunable system: continuously analyze the full case journey and engineer improvements to throughput, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction
  • Own workforce planning, capacity modeling, tooling investments, and the long-term operating model as case volume and product complexity scale
  • Build data infrastructure and dashboards that make support performance visible and actionable for stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

Short Term (First Year)

  • SLA performance consistently meets or exceeds targets
  • Case volume per active provider trending down through product-driven prevention
  • New technical support profile defined, hired, and successfully embedded in Product Development teams
  • In-function career ladder designed, communicated, and first promotions executed
  • Case-to-roadmap feedback loop established with measurable impact on Product backlog prioritization

Long Term

  • Support scales with greater operating leverage while maintaining or improving service quality
  • Top performers advancing through the career ladder; retention of high performers at 90%+
  • AI-assisted case resolution quality at 95%+ accuracy with strong human oversight
  • Support recognized internally as a strategic product partner and driver of product excellence

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 7+ years building or scaling technical support/TSE organizations, or 5+ years building and scaling consumer product services at software or SaaS companies with genuine tiered escalation models and technical depth
  • Proven track record running functions against hard SLAs and systematically improving them—not just maintaining baseline performance
  • Deep people management experience: Built strong teams, culture, and outcomes; developed high-performing teams through coaching, leadership, and accountability
  • Experience building or redesigning support career ladders and leveling frameworks that retain technical talent

Technical & Strategic Capabilities

  • Technically credible: You may have an engineering background but chose an operations/people-leadership path; you can speak engineer-to-engineer and assess technical problem-solving quality
  • Systems thinker: You see support as an end-to-end process to optimize, not just a service desk to staff; you've built or redesigned workflows, tooling, and operational models
  • Data-driven: You translate metrics into insights and insights into action; you've used case data to drive product roadmap prioritization
  • Proven ability to partner with Product and Engineering leadership as a peer—you've influenced roadmaps, secured resources, and navigated matrix structures
  • Lean Six Sigma or Process Engineering experience is a plus

Leadership & Culture

  • Customer Service as a Product mentality: You design for plans that anticipate problems before customers encounter them, treating support cases as trust-building moments rather than liabilities to manage

BlackCloak’s mission is to protect corporate executives and high-profile individuals in their personal lives, mitigating risks to their families, companies, reputation, and finances. We defend our clients’ digital lives from hackers, privacy leaks, and identity theft. If you are passionate about helping to protect others, then keep reading - this may be your next great opportunity.

BlackCloak is seeking a seasoned and highly skilled Senior Incident Responder to join our Technical Success Team. This is a senior, client-facing individual contributor role for someone who has spent years on both sides of the problem: the technical compromise of computers, phones, and online accounts, and the financial fraud that so often follows it. In this critical role, you will serve as the primary escalation point and lead investigator for complex security events; taking ownership of the full incident response lifecycle, from initial triage and containment through eradication, recovery, and post-incident reporting.

Our clients are executives, board members, and high-profile individuals whose personal accounts and devices are targeted precisely because their corporate ones are hard to breach. When something goes wrong in a client's personal digital life, you are the person who takes the call, works the incident end to end, and stays with them until it is resolved. You will also help us get better at preventing the next one: mapping how each incident unfolded against both the cyber attack kill chain and the personal attack kill chain, closing the gaps that made it possible, and mentoring the responders behind you.

If you excel at guiding clients through high-stress situations, possess deep technical expertise in digital forensics, and have a proven track record of handling sophisticated threats targeting high-profile individuals, this is an opportunity to elevate your career and make a tangible impact.

What You Will Do

    • Execute End-to-End Incident Response: Lead comprehensive incident handling consistent with core IR principles (NIST/SANS) from the initial client request and triage through containment, recovery, and post-incident lessons learned.

    • Investigate Complex Compromises & Targeted Attacks: Manage and remediate severe client security incidents, including but not limited to, compromised email ecosystems, SIM swap attacks, financial account takeovers, and targeted credential harvesting.

    • Device Analysis: Conduct analysis on client computers and mobile devices to assess the scope of compromise and implement effective remediation strategies.

    • Remediate Fraud & Identity Theft: Analyze and assess account activity and transaction records available to the client on their email, banking, retail, and social platforms to help establish what occurred, and support clients in their conversations with the platforms on fraud investigations, disputes, account freezes, etc.. Guide identity theft victims through the remediation process - credit bureau freezes and fraud alerts, IdentityTheft.gov and law enforcement reporting - and advise clients on the activity they should watch for and report back to the team.

    • Map the Attack Chain: Map observed activity against the personal attack kill chain - from data-broker reconnaissance and social engineering of the client's inner circle through device compromise, account takeover, and financial monetization - to identify the likely stage of an attack and the actions that break the chain, focusing on technique and exposure rather than actor attribution.

    • Provide White-Glove Client Support: Interface directly with clients and, where authorized, their families and support staff - assistants, family office, corporate security - during high-stakes emergency onboardings and active incidents, providing calm, clear, and authoritative guidance while communicating complex threat assessments.

    • Participate in On-Call Rotation: Serve in an on-call and escalation rotation that requires occasional nights and weekends to address client incidents, emergency onboardings, and time-sensitive issues.

    • Lead & Mentor: Serve as the highest technical escalation point in the on-call rotation, while actively mentoring Security and Client Success team members to elevate the team's overall technical proficiency.

    • Enhance Security Posture: Oversee network vulnerability scans of client infrastructure, proactively refine internal IR playbooks, and conduct periodic post-onboarding touchpoints.


      • Note: This role requires occasional nights and weekends to address emergency client incidents.

What You Need to be Successful

    • 5-8+ years of experience in a dedicated Incident Response, Digital Forensics (DFIR), or advanced cybersecurity analyst role.

    • Proven track record executing the full incident lifecycle, particularly involving personal/executive account takeovers, mobile threats, and endpoint malware.

    • Demonstrated experience investigating fraud in financial transactions, including direct coordination with banks and credit card companies - fraud investigation, disputes and chargebacks, transaction analysis, or account takeover response. This may have been gained at a financial institution, card issuer, payment processor, fintech risk team, financial crimes unit, or in a security role working these cases directly.

    • Deep technical expertise conducting forensics and vulnerability management across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux ecosystems.

    • Working command of identity theft remediation and attack kill chain models, with the ability to apply them to an individual and their family rather than an enterprise network.

    • Advanced industry certifications are highly preferred (e.g., GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, OSCP, or similar); fraud and financial crime credentials such as CFE, CFCS, or CAMS are a strong plus.

    • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical jargon into actionable advice for non-technical clients, maintaining deep empathy and composure during high-stress crises.

    • College degree in an Information Technology (IT/CS/CE) discipline or equivalent real-world experience, coupled with the ability to operate highly independently.

BlackCloak is an extremely fast-growing company in an entirely new product category. We have amazing product fit validated by industry awards and an impressive client base of Fortune 500 companies across all industries.
