jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

We're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead a high-performing team of Support Specialists and Support Engineers. This isn't traditional support management—you'll treat support as a product, using data to diagnose friction, design experiments to improve resolution speed and quality, and continuously optimize the system that delivers customer outcomes.

You'll be the operational leader for Elation's support experience, owning team performance, development, and the daily execution of SLA commitments. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Operations to translate support insights into product improvements, and build the analytics infrastructure that makes support performance transparent and actionable.

If you think like a Product Manager, love operations, and want to build a technically oriented team that drives real impact, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

Lead a High-Performing Team

  • Manage approximately 8–10 Support Specialists and Support Engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, development, performance management, and retention
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s focused on skill development, case quality review, and career growth
  • Coach your team to critically evaluate AI-generated recommendations and deliver exceptional customer outcomes—quality over speed
  • Hold your team accountable to SLA commitments, including time-to-resolution, backlog targets, and customer satisfaction scores

Own Support Operations & Processes

  • Manage the daily execution of case triage, routing, and escalation workflows to ensure efficient resolution
  • Monitor case queue health in real time and identify bottlenecks or quality issues before they impact customers
  • Design and run experiments to improve case resolution speed, first-contact resolution rates, and customer satisfaction
  • Build and maintain the Support playbook, including documentation, troubleshooting guides, and AI-assisted workflow standards
  • Own the QA process for AI-assisted case resolution; audit quality regularly and coach to gaps

Drive Data-Driven Insights

  • Treat metrics as your product: build dashboards, define KPIs, and make support performance visible and actionable
  • Run weekly case reviews with your team to identify patterns, high-volume issue types, and systemic product gaps
  • Translate case data into prioritized feedback for Product and Engineering teams
  • Own monthly reporting on team performance, SLA trends, top case drivers, and escalation patterns
  • Use data to forecast capacity needs, identify skill gaps, and recommend training investments

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Engineering Managers to keep support context present in product decisions
  • Collaborate with Customer Operations on service standards and cross-functional initiatives
  • Surface urgent product issues and provide context for prioritization decisions
  • Build feedback loops to ensure case-driving issues get resolved upstream

Improve Systems Continuously

  • Proactively identify inefficiencies in support workflows, tooling, or documentation and drive improvements
  • Recommend and implement automation that increases team leverage (e.g., AI response quality, case routing logic, knowledge base search)

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Build trust with your team through 1:1s, understanding strengths and challenges, and establishing clear expectations
  • Master the case data: know the top case drivers, current SLA performance, and team capacity model
  • Establish effective partnerships with Engineering Managers
  • Identify and fix 1–2 quick-win process inefficiencies

First Year

  • SLA performance: Your team consistently meets time-to-resolution targets and keeps backlog under control
  • Case quality: AI-assisted case resolution accuracy at 95%+; zero critical escalations due to poor case handling
  • Team development: At least one team member promoted or developing toward the next level; retention at 90%+
  • Product impact: Your case data analysis drives 3+ roadmap prioritization decisions that reduce case volume
  • Operational leverage: You've built analytics dashboards, improved documentation, and implemented at least one automation that increases team impact by 10%+

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in technical support, customer success operations, or technical account management, with at least 2 years managing people
  • Proven track record managing to SLAs in a technical support or customer operations environment
  • Experience with technical products (SaaS, B2B software, healthcare tech preferred) where support requires genuine technical troubleshooting, not just scripted responses
  • Data fluency: You've built dashboards, analyzed trends, and used metrics to drive operational improvements—not just reported them

Skills & Attributes

  • Systems thinker: You see support as a process to optimize, not just a queue to clear; you've redesigned workflows or implemented tooling that improved efficiency
  • Product management mindset: You understand root cause analysis and think about preventing issues upstream rather than just resolving them faster
  • Technical credibility: You can learn product architecture, understand complex workflows, and coach support engineers on technical cases
  • Coaching-oriented: You develop people through feedback, skill-building, and stretch opportunities—not just task assignment
  • High standards with empathy: You hold your team accountable while supporting their growth
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You've worked effectively with Engineering, Product, or Customer Success teams where success required partnership
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You're excited to build operations for a new support model without a perfect playbook on day one

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated industries
  • Exposure to AI-assisted support workflows or LLM-based tooling
  • Prior experience as a technical support engineer or individual contributor before moving into management
  • Familiarity with Notion, Linear, Salesforce, Intercom, or similar support/case management platforms

Salary range: $110,000-140,000 CAD

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director
jobs.excerpt: Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people.
jobs.description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a Strategic Account Director (SAD) to aggressively expand our Event Production footprint within Fortune 5000 companies. This pure Business Development position is for a hunter who thrives on building a book of business from scratch, as this role will not get any inbound opportunities.
You will drive our growth by targeting and securing $1M+ opportunities with brands that have multiple events throughout the year. You are the bridge between a client’s wildest creative vision and our technical production reality. You will guide a cross-functional team of Producers, Technical Directors, and Logistics experts to build multi-million dollar event programs.
SAD’s are successful in this role when they find clients who execute multiple events throughout the year, in a variety of locations around the globe, and Meeting Tomorrow can be their dedicated events partner in planning, creative, and production. This person is in front of clients all the time and can expect up to 30% of their time is traveling.

The Mission:

  • The First Year Benchmark: You are responsible for closing $1M in new business within your first 12 months.
  • Outbounding: You will build your pipeline through your own strategic outreach, industry networking, and deep-rooted relationships. We are looking for a track record of success built on zero inbound leads.
  • Strategic Hunting: You don't just sell services; you sell solutions. You understand the internal politics and needs of your client’s organizations and can navigate complex decision-making hierarchies.
  • Presence: You are "in the field" and in front of clients constantly. Expect at least 30% travel to build relationships, man booths attend industry events, and close deals in person.

What You Are Responsible For:

  • Closing Deals: This is the priority. You qualify, pitch, and close multi-million dollar event programs.
  • Full-Cycle Ownership: From the first "cold" touch to negotiating contracts and ensuring the first execution is flawless.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Constantly hunting for clients with global needs and high-frequency event calendars.
  • Relationship Architecture: Building personal and professional bonds with top-tier meeting planners and C-suite stakeholders.

What We Need:

  • Proven Track Record: You have built a book of business from the ground up and have a history of managing $10M+ in lifetime event revenue across a diverse client list.
  • Agency Veteran: At least 5+ years of Event Industry experience. We prefer agency-side experience over AV-only hardware sales.
  • Relationships established: Established, high-level relationships within our target sectors (Pharma, FinServ, Tech and Consulting).
  • Strategic Acumen: You know how to map a client’s business goals to a technical production reality.
  • Grit & Initiative: You don't wait for instructions; you identify the target and go after it.

What We Offer:

  • True Autonomy: You have the freedom to bring in business through your own creative lens.
  • Uncapped Earning Potential: We pay competitively, and for a hunter who hits their numbers, there is no limit to what you can earn.
  • A High-Performance Culture: You’ll be supported by technical masterminds (Production Managers) and logistics experts (Project Managers) who ensure that once you close the deal, the execution is world-class.
  • A Tight-Knit Team: We are a collaborative group of 90 pros
Benefits
  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
  • 401k with employer matching up to 4%
  • 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
  • Annual profit-sharing bonus
  • 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
  • $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
  • Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
  • Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
  • Regular social events and learning opportunities
At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourage BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.
What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Vice President Sales, Government to build and lead the team that puts Nearmap's aerial imagery and property intelligence into the hands of the agencies planning, protecting, and maintaining America's communities. You'll own net-new and expansion revenue across city, county, and state government accounts, coaching a team that spans SMB through enterprise and deals from five figures to $1M+. This is a build-and-scale leadership role: you'll set the sales strategy, create a culture of accountability and high performance, and represent Nearmap in front of senior public sector stakeholders. If you're energized by developing sellers, sharpening pipeline discipline, and turning a growing team into a predictable revenue engine, this is the role for you.

  • Own and drive both net-new bookings and expansion revenue within existing government accounts, partnering closely with Customer Success to identify and execute upsell opportunities (post-sale retention and renewal execution sit with CS)
  • Lead and coach a team of government sales reps spanning SMB through enterprise and strategic accounts, with deal sizes from five figures to $1M+ and wide variation in rep seniority and tenure
  • Coach up, and where needed coach out and backfill, supporting the team to find net-new and upsell opportunities across their territories
  • Cascade the company vision into individual goals, OKRs, and KPIs so the team's daily work ladders up to Nearmap's strategy
  • Manage sales engagement personally for high-value prospects and customers, building strong relationships with senior public sector stakeholders alongside our other sales leaders
  • Set, monitor, and drive weekly, monthly, and quarterly activity and performance targets for the government sales team
  • Plan, direct, and control sales strategy to meet targets for direct government accounts, and develop and execute a sales plan aligned to the broader strategic plan
  • Drive pipeline qualification rigor: enforce clear qualification criteria before opportunities enter forecast, and actively manage stage aging to eliminate stale pipeline
  • Analyze, evaluate, and optimize sales and customer processes, and manage initiatives aimed at improving the efficiency of the existing operation
  • Map key stakeholders, technical requirements, and business process for target accounts
  • Partner with Marketing on strategy, campaigns, and demand generation, and contribute input into new products, marketing techniques, and incentive schemes
  • Build and maintain healthy working relationships across Technology, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, RevOps, FlightOps, Customer Success, and People & Culture
  • Establish a high degree of Salesforce compliance and efficiency within the team, and build effective reporting using Salesforce, Looker, and Gong to manage performance and forecast accurately
  • Use AI tools for business analysis, forecasting, and strategic account planning at a leadership level
  • Provide detailed performance reporting, insights, and forecast accountability, and share sales data transparently across the business
  • Recruit and select high performers, own complete onboarding for new starters, develop talent, and recognize and reward performance
  • Create a culture of accountability with clear objectives, KPIs, and processes, and drive high performance through consistent coaching and quality feedback
  • Run regular team meetings, one-on-ones, coaching sessions, side-by-sides, and call shadowing to review performance, share knowledge, and develop the team
  • Identify training and development needs and provide the resources to close them
  • Drive additional revenue opportunities by applying incremental programs or projects initiated by the SVP Sales, Commercial and Government
  • 8+ years of experience managing quota-carrying reps, including at least 3 years in a SaaS sales leadership role
  • Experience selling into the public sector, particularly city and state government
  • Demonstrated ability to lead effective sales teams with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets
  • Proven leadership capability developing and coaching high-performing teams, with the ability to set high standards and mentor an evolving workforce at varying levels of experience
  • Strong command of sales numbers and daily sales metrics, with experience coaching using tools such as Gong
  • Thorough understanding of subscription business models and strong negotiation skills
  • Strong commercial acumen and the enthusiasm to coach at all levels
  • High competence with CRM platforms, ideally Salesforce
  • Excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation skills, with the ability to prepare reports, make a compelling sales argument, and sell value
  • Self-motivated and self-directed, with strong emotional intelligence, composure, tenacity, and a results-driven mindset
  • Exceptional collaboration skills and a hunger to exceed customer expectations, with a track record of building positive relationships with colleagues and management peers
  • Direct and respectful communication style and a strong brand ambassador for the business

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a business discipline
  • Experience in geospatial, imagery, mapping, or property intelligence
  • Experience leading sales teams through a period of rapid growth or transformation

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Why you'll love working at Nearmap:

We move fast and work smart; often wearing multiple hats. We adapted to remote working with ease and are continually looking at ways to improve. We’re proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, and maintain a safe environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging and can be themselves.

In addition to your annual leave, Nearmap offers:

  • 4 extra "YOU" days off each year—take a break, no questions asked!
  • Company-sponsored volunteering days to give back.
  • Generous parental leave policies for growing families.
  • Work from Overseas Policy - explore the world in the approved list of cities while you work!
  • Discounted Private Health Insurance plans.
  • A Nearmap subscription (naturally!).

Learn More About The Work We Do:

YouTube Page

LinkedIn Page

We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it. Job Title: Sr Director, Statistical Innovation

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr Director, Statistical Innovation

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will:

Advises Therapeutic Area and Product Strategy and Study Design

· Promotes conventional and innovative design options and fit-for-purpose analysis approaches that address appropriate clinical and development questions and balance speed, quality, operational feasibility, and cost.

· Provides senior advisory input in the development and review of the EGP and GSSP to align program design and statistical approaches with therapeutic area strategy, product strategy, and development objectives.

· Directs, applies, interprets, and communicates modeling and simulation in collaboration with the Modeling and Simulation group, the Analytics group, and other quantitative partners as needed.

· Review study design options and proposals prior to submission to GDRC and Key Design Elements (KDEs) prior to submission to TA TRC.

Provides Advanced Technical and Methodological Expertise

· Provides advanced technical and methodological expertise to Biostatistics TA leaders, Senior Director-level and Director-level GSLs, EGTs, and governance bodies on innovative study designs, advanced analysis methods, and complex development issues.

· Advises large and complex programs led by Senior Director-level and Director-level GSLs on statistical and methodological issues that may affect major development decisions, regulatory interactions, and filings.

· Reviews key development plans and Phase 2 and Phase 3 protocols and provides senior advisory input during TA TRC and other relevant governance reviews.

Builds Strategic Partnerships

· Develops strong partnerships with Biostatistics TA leaders and the Strategic Development Director to ensure an integrated CfDA team approach when consulting with EGTs and therapeutic area leadership.

· Builds trusted relationships with Senior Director-level and Director-level GSLs and other EGT functional leaders to embed Design & Innovation consultation throughout the end-to-end development process and determine the most effective approach for advising teams.

· Builds relationships with FSC members and other senior functional stakeholders to support alignment, escalation, and application of innovative design and analysis approaches.

Promotes the Advancement of Innovative Designs and Analysis Methods

· Promotes the advancement and appropriate application of innovative designs and analysis methods across products and programs within a therapeutic area.

· Connects insights, methods, and lessons across programs to promote consistency, build organizational capability, and enable broader application of successful approaches.

Authority

· Sign-off the simulation plan

· Advisory input and EGP/GSSP review

Outputs

· Design options for ECP

· Design simulation plan

· Design and simulation tools

· Detailed study specific design

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a Sr Director, Statistical Innovation with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree and 5 years of Statistics/Biostatistics or related subjects with high statistical content

OR

Master’s degree and 9 years of Statistics/Biostatistics or related subjects with high statistical content
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 11 years of Statistics/Biostatistics or related subjects with high statistical content

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have at least 5 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above

· At least 12 years of post-graduate statistical experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in clinical trial design, execution, analysis and reporting

· Statistical expertise and leadership across drug development phases, regulatory submissions, and payer interactions

· Strategic statistical leadership at product level of at least one complex program or multiple programs of moderate complexity

Preferred Qualifications

· Doctorate in Statistics/Biostatistics and post-graduate statistical experience in the pharmaceutical industry or medical research

· Therapeutic area leadership and experience advising large and complex programs across early development, late development, regulatory filing, and post-marketing support

· Solid real life experience with both conventional and innovative trial designs in different phases of drug development

· Expertise in advanced statistical analysis methods, and modeling and simulation

· Knowledge of disease areas and regulatory guidelines

· Experience in leading regulatory and/or reimbursement submissions

· Drive for innovation and quick adaptation to new industry trends

· Well recognized statistical and strategic leadership among statisticians and cross-functional teams

· External visibility (e.g., through industry committees/forums, links to academia)

· Scientific research/publications in one or more areas of statistical science

Competencies

Scientific / Technical Excellence

· Expertise in statistical principles, methods, and procedures and the ability to instruct others in these areas relating to randomized and non-randomized clinical research

· Excellent problem solving skills; uses technical expertise to solve real world problems

· Knowledge of and ability to propose and apply innovative study design and advanced statistical methods

Strong oral and written communication skills

· Ability to communicate complex and nuanced statistical concepts in a concise and impactful way to various audience

Strong influencing and negotiating skills

Excellent business acumen and strategic thinking

People/ Project management

· Interacts with multiple stakeholder groups with the abilities to advise/ influence / negotiate

· Organizational savvy; ability to navigate in a large global organization and builds partnership with members in FSC and EGT

· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize

· Ability to lead without direct authority

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Cloud Engineer Azure Databricks

Senior Cloud Engineer — Azure Infrastructure & Databricks Platform

Alternate titles that reach the same candidate pool: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (Azure & Databricks) · Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer — Data Platform · Senior Cloud Engineer, Databricks Platform

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and administer the Azure infrastructure behind our enterprise data and AI platform. This is a cloud infrastructure and platform engineering position centered on Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Machine Learning.

You will own the platform foundation — infrastructure as code, network and identity architecture, compute governance, observability, and cost management — and partner closely with our Databricks administration, data engineering, and data science teams. Our group defines the platform standards and reference architectures those teams build within, which means depth in Databricks administration matters here as much as depth in Azure. You should be equally at home provisioning a workspace through Terraform and advising on Unity Catalog design, cluster policy, or identity federation.

This role suits an engineer who enjoys being the technical reference point for a platform: setting the architectural direction, partnering with adjacent teams on complex problems, and translating business requirements into the platform capabilities needed to support them.

Part One — Infrastructure Ownership

Design, implement, and administer the Azure foundation the platform runs on.

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform-first): Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules that provision the Azure data estate — Databricks workspaces, ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault, networking, and Azure ML. Own remote state, module versioning, drift detection, and the pipelines that deploy them.
  • Network & Security Architecture: Design and implement the private networking and security posture for the platform — private endpoints, hub-and-spoke topology, VNet injection, NSGs and firewall rules, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, RBAC, and data exfiltration controls.
  • Data Lake Infrastructure: Own ADLS Gen2 at the infrastructure layer: storage account architecture, hierarchical namespace, container and ACL strategy, lifecycle and tiering policy, encryption and key management, and access patterns for Databricks and downstream consumers.
  • Data Factory Platform Operations: Own ADF from the platform side — integration runtime provisioning and scaling (self-hosted and managed VNet), linked service credential and managed identity design, environment promotion, deployment automation, and monitoring. Pipeline development sits with the data engineering team.
  • AI/ML Platform Infrastructure: Provision and operate the infrastructure supporting machine learning workloads: Azure ML workspaces and compute clusters, GPU quota and capacity planning, MLflow model registry integration, model serving endpoints, and the identity and networking connecting them to Unity Catalog.
  • Observability & Reliability: Build and maintain the monitoring layer — Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic settings, alerting, and operational runbooks across the estate.
  • FinOps & Capacity Planning: Own cost visibility and optimization across DBU and storage spend — tagging strategy, chargeback and showback, budget alerts, reserved capacity, and forward capacity planning.
  • CI/CD & Environment Management: Own the deployment pipelines and promotion path across development, test, and production environments.

Part Two — Databricks Platform Administration

Day-to-day Databricks operations are supported by a dedicated administration team. Required Qualifications

  • Deeply familiar with Arcadia's full data stack — from ingress through silver, gold, and downstream consumers
  • Driving at least one improvement project forward, whether technical (e.g. model refactor, new DQ framework) or process-focused (e.g. promotion playbook, triage workflow)

In 12 months

  • Recognized as a leader within the department — peers and stakeholders seek out your expertise on data modeling and quality
  • Operating independently across the full scope of the role with minimal guidance
  • Two or more improvement projects completed and in production, with measurable impact on data quality or operational efficiency

  • Author, review, and maintain DBT models using Spark/Hudi from ingest through bronze and silver
  • Help clients understand their data model, assumptions, and limitations through intentional validation
  • Troubleshoot and fix issues, then write DBT tests to catch issues proactively
  • Optimize SQL performance for slow-running jobs
  • Partner with Data Engineering on Hudi table design, partition strategy, and incremental patterns
    • DATA QUALITY OWNERSHIP
  • Triage and classify data quality alerts, distinguishing source-level issues from transform-layer failures
  • Design and maintain volume monitors and DQ monitors (null rate, distribution, future-date checks)

  • Own the ticket queue for DQ, attribution, hierarchy, and customer-specific data quality issues, writing clear customer-facing findings
    • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL QUALITY COLLABORATION
  • Lead data quality reviews during connector installation and promotion (UAT → PRD), including claims validation playbooks and null analysis
  • Partner with Data Engineering on root-cause triage for errors, ingress anomalies, and silver table issues surfaced through data quality monitoring

jobs.description:
About Karius

Karius is a life science, venture-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

Position Summary

We are building and operating a unique software stack of cloud infrastructure, software services, APIs, web and mobile interactive interfaces, and AI-driven data analytics pipelines to deliver life-saving results in the highly complex infectious disease landscape. We believe the success of Karius’ products is driven by both our unique technology and the elegance of the software solution.The Senior Software Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, reliable software solutions that support Karius’ products and mission. This role requires strong technical judgment, thoughtful problem-solving, and close collaboration across engineering, product, scientific, and clinical teams.

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The products Karius offers today are some of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our tests are the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life-changing impact on people, and at scale.

Reports to: Senior Director, Engineering

Location: Redwood City, CA (Hybrid) or Remote (USA)

Primary Responsibilities


  • Understand user needs, requirements and objectives by collaborating closely with cross-functional groups across Karius, including Engineering, Software Products, Analytics, Lab Operations, and other business partners, developing strong domain expertise to ensure software solutions align with operational and user needs.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation for system designs, software components, workflows, and operational procedures.

  • Implementation and end-to-end testing of software solutions and components.

  • Monitor the performance, reliability, and scalability of software systems and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Participate in design reviews and code reviews.

  • Support production deployments

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive solutions.

  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, and provide recommendations to support informed engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the engineering lifecycle by collaborating on enhancements to tools, processes, and ways of working.

  • Develop strong domain expertise to ensure software solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with user and operational requirements.

What’s Fun About the Job?

Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters.

Travel: Up to 10% for onsite team building activities.

Physical Requirements

Subject to extended periods of sitting and/or standing, vision to monitor and moderate noise levels. Work is generally performed in an office, lab or clinical environment.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related technical field involving significant coursework in software development, algorithms, or quantitative problem-solving, with 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience; or a master’s degree in a related technical field with 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience

  • Experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining backend software solutions in production environments

  • Advanced knowledge and 3+ years of experience building and maintaining substantial TypeScript and Node.js services in production

  • Experience contributing to the design and implementation of scalable, reliable, and maintainable software systems

  • Experience designing and operating microservices-based systems, including event-driven architecture, with a clear understanding of service boundaries, contract evolution, event and message design, error handling across synchronous and asynchronous service calls, and observability

  • Experience designing PostgreSQL database schemas, with a strong understanding of transactions, indexing, and migration strategy.

  • Working knowledge of containerized, cloud-based systems using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, GraphQL, and AWS or equivalent cloud platforms.

  • Experience with unit and end-to-end testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or similar, with strong test design skills and the ability to translate acceptance criteria or user stories into a balanced coverage strategy across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, source control, continuous integration, deployment, monitoring, observability, and technical documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical work, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver high-quality solutions across the software development lifecycle.

  • Production experience with Kafka or a comparable event-streaming platform is preferred, including topic design, partition strategy, consumer group behavior, idempotency, ordering guarantees, and handling delayed, failed, or unprocessable messages; Confluent experience is a plus.

  • Experience operating services in AWS or similar environments is preferred, including the ability to navigate services such as EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM and troubleshoot issues across application and infrastructure boundaries.

  • Hands-on experience using modern AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate development, code review, testing, and documentation is preferred.

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, healthcare domains, diagnostic laboratory environments, next-generation sequencing, or other regulated settings is preferred.

Personal Qualifications

  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering excellence, with a strong focus on testability, maintainability, reliability, and long-term system quality.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to develop clear design documents, pull request descriptions, test cases, and technical documentation. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop practical, scalable solutions to complex technical challenges.

  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across multiple systems, services, applications, and integration points while collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments by asking thoughtful questions, identifying assumptions and dependencies, and helping define a clear path forward.

  • Growth-oriented learning mindset, with the curiosity and adaptability to learn new technologies, deepen domain expertise, seek feedback, and continuously improve.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively managing shifting priorities, competing demands, and tight deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

    • Develop Multi-Agent Architectures: Build and configure modular, hierarchical agent networks (Root/Steering agents and targeted Sub-agents) using a combination of the CX Agent Studio canvas and programmatic Code Agents.

    • Leverage GECX Engineering CLI & Tooling: Run automated code-first developer workflows utilizing uv environments and the cxas CLI for structural static linting (cxas lint) and advanced semantic instruction validation (cxas llm-lint).

    • Automate Quality & Evaluation (CI/CD): Script programmatic, golden-scenario test cases and simulation evals using simulation frameworks to test multi-turn agent trajectories, preventing hallucinations and conversational regressions before sync-to-prod.

Skills and experience you will bring:

    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 3+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or programmatic AI workflows.
    • Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node.js, with hands-on experience handling complex JSON payloads, RESTful APIs, and cloud-hosted webhooks.

    • Experience deploying streaming, low-latency audio-to-audio (A2A) voice agents and integrating with telephony (SIP/RTP) or CCaaS partner environments.
    • Solid grasp of prompt engineering safety protocols, blocklists, and programmatic fallback behaviors (e.g., before_model_callback or after_tool_callback hooks).
    • Experience with BigQuery or Google Cloud Logging to programmatically extract conversation traces, search text transcripts, and build data-driven performance metrics.

The Director, Regulatory and Policy – ERCOT and Western markets will lead market engagement, regulatory strategy, state policy and legislative activities focused on the Texas and Western region of the US. This includes ERCOT, WECC and CAISO markets, as well as state regulatory and policy matters within these regions. The role supports business growth by influencing policy outcomes, monitoring regulatory developments, participating in ISO/RTO stakeholder processes, and developing strategies that advance Calibrant objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Acerca de Genetec:

Genetec es un proveedor líder de productos de gestión de vídeo, control de acceso y reconocimiento de matrículas. Uno de nuestros principales ámbitos de actuación son los sectores de la seguridad pública y la administración pública. Nuestra solución unificada de Genetec ofrece una amplia gama de productos que ayudan a las organismos a alcanzar sus objetivos operativos y optimizar sus flujos de trabajo.

Tu día de un vistazo:

Tu principal responsabilidad como representante comercial de Seguridad Pública y Administración Pública es aumentar la cuota de mercado y la adopción de los productos de Genetec. A continuación se detallan las áreas clave de actuación y la distribución estimada del tiempo:

Clientes actuales (30 %)

  • Ampliación de la cartera: comprender el entorno actual y los objetivos a largo plazo de cada cliente para ampliar de forma proactiva el uso de los productos de Genetec.
  • Adopción de productos: subsanar las deficiencias de uso ayudando a los clientes a aprovechar al máximo la plataforma y a convertirse en firmes defensores de Genetec dentro de su organización.
  • El cliente como referencia: fomentar relaciones sólidas que den lugar a la promoción de la marca por parte de los clientes dentro de la comunidad de seguridad pública.

Nuevos clientes (35 %)

  • Prospección: identificar y perseguir de forma proactiva nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Alineación con el ciclo de compra: comprender en qué fase del ciclo se encuentran los compradores, influir desde el principio, promover nuestro programa de subvenciones y posicionar a Genetec en las solicitudes de propuestas (RFP) cuando sea necesario.

Colaboración con socios (15 %)

  • Planificación de cuentas y cuentas objetivo: trabajar en estrecha colaboración con los clientes finales, los socios de canal y tu ejecutivo de cuentas de canal para alinear los objetivos y las estrategias con el fin de impulsar la demanda de la plataforma.
  • Colaboración interna: coordinarse con los ingenieros de ventas, los expertos en la materia (SME), los ejecutivos de cuentas de canal (CAE) y el equipo de socios de Genetec para minimizar los conflictos y satisfacer las necesidades de los clientes.

Marketing (10 %)

  • Ferias y eventos: asistir y contribuir a eventos centrados en los sectores de la seguridad pública y la administración pública.
  • Grupos de usuarios finales: liderar y apoyar a los grupos de usuarios regionales y nacionales para profundizar en la implicación de los clientes y conocer mejor sus necesidades.

Tareas administrativas (10 %)

  • CRM: mantener una actividad de CRM disciplinada, estratégica y oportuna
  • Formación y conocimiento de los productos: ampliar continuamente los conocimientos sobre los productos y el sector mediante los recursos de Genetec
  • Sistemas y procesos internos: aprovechar las herramientas internas, seguir los procesos internos y utilizar los sistemas de RR. HH. necesarios para el puesto de representante de ventas

¿Por qué eres el candidato ideal?:

  • Conocimiento profundo de las operaciones, los requisitos de cumplimiento normativo y los flujos de trabajo en los organismos de Seguridad Pública y Administración Pública
  • Relaciones consolidadas en el sector
  • Capacidad demostrada para vender ante comités y desenvolverse en entornos de contratación pública complejos y jerárquicos
  • Sólido conocimiento de cómo los productos de Genetec se adaptan a las operaciones y los flujos de trabajo de los usuarios finales
  • Familiaridad con ferias, asociaciones y publicaciones específicas del sector
  • Profundo conocimiento de los procesos y requisitos de contratación utilizados por los usuarios finales del sector público.
  • Capacidad para anticipar las necesidades de los productos y del mercado basándose en las tendencias específicas del sector.
  • Conocimiento exhaustivo de la plataforma de Genetec en lo que se refiere a la Seguridad Pública y la Administración Pública.
  • Habilidades excepcionales de gestión del tiempo y planificación territorial, especialmente en puestos que requieran viajar con frecuencia.

  • Ampliación de las ventas con clientes existentes
  • Nuevas ventas con cuentas de nuevos clientes
  • Desarrollo y participación en alianzas tecnológicas estratégicas
  • Clientes potenciales generados y convertidos
  • Número y calidad de las referencias de usuarios finales
  • Participación y eficacia en grupos de usuarios
  • Gestión y disciplina del CRM
  • Conocimiento del producto y del sector
  • Previsiones y precisión de las mismas

¡Hablemos de ventajas!

Genetec is a leading provider of video management, access control products and license plate recognition. A key area of focus is our Public Safety and Public Administration verticals. Our Unified Genetec Solution offers a comprehensive range of products that help agencies meet their operational goals and workflows.

Your day at a glance:

  • Strong understanding of how Genetec products align with end user operations and workflows

AEs will be evaluated based on their annual targets and performance in the following areas:

jobs.title: Senior Flutter Developer (freelance)
jobs.excerpt: In shortIf you're a Senior Flutter Developer who knows what flutter_blue_plus does in production, and you've shipped apps that talk to physical devices over BLE, we want to talk.
jobs.description:
In short

If you're a Senior Flutter Developer who knows what flutter_blue_plus does in production, and you've shipped apps that talk to physical devices over BLE, we want to talk. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. The first three months are about figuring out if we're a good match. When things work out, and that depends on the work itself, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to our core team with a permanent contract and full benefits.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. Our Flutter work isn't another generic app: it's cross-platform code talking to firmware, sensors, and real hardware behavior on both iOS and Android. If your Dart has ever made a physical device do something it couldn't do before, you already get why we love what we do.

Who this role is NOT for

If you like being told exactly what to build every morning, opening Jira, closing Jira, and logging off at 17:01, we're probably not your people. We look for engineers who ask "why" before "how", challenge assumptions, and occasionally break things because they were trying something new. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick. What we expect: ownership of what you touch, straight talk when things get complicated, and the kind of curiosity that makes you actually care about the device on the other end of your Bluetooth connection.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain Flutter apps that communicate with hardware peripherals over BLE

  • Make cross-platform code that behaves well on both iOS and Android, not just "compiles on both"

  • Take part in specifying, planning, and estimating new modules and features

  • Improve reliability by chasing down the issues QA finds, including the weird ones

  • Review pull requests and give your teammates feedback that actually helps

  • Share what you learn: tech talks, internal docs, pair sessions, whatever fits

  • Work side by side with firmware engineers, designers, QA, and PMs

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the Mobile chapter for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 90-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects

  • When the first 3 months work out, and that depends on the work, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to a permanent contract with a fixed monthly salary, 26 days paid leave, 10 sick days, Saltus medical care, and a training budget

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if the project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a technical buddy and tackle progressively bigger tasks, so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. If it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the technical team (may include live coding)

  4. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share something you've built that made you proud.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Strong commercial experience with the Flutter SDK (not "I built a side project once")

  • Advanced Dart skills, including state management and async patterns

  • Working knowledge of iOS and Android: enough to debug when the platform layer is the problem

  • Hands-on BLE experience, particularly with flutter_blue_plus or similar

  • English at B2+, written and spoken, because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Problem-solving over line-counting: we'll take a creative thinker over a fast typist any day

  • High coding standards and willingness to align with the team's patterns

  • Initiative: you bring new ideas in and you can also walk away from them when the evidence says so

  • Engagement and team-play, the kind where people actually want you in the room

Nice to have

  • Native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) experience for the moments when Flutter isn't enough

  • Previous IoT or connected device projects

  • Method channels and platform-specific plugin work

  • Scrum or other Agile delivery experience

  • Willingness to share publicly: hackathons, conferences, internal talks

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices you build for, not just the code behind them

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod
  • Assign and balance workloads across the team
  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards
  • Ensure case managers understand priorities and case progression expectations
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager
  • Escalate friction points between case managers and the attorney to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

  • Own MRI rates, advanced treatment rates, and ensure diagnostics are properly tracked and attended
  • Monitor and drive case velocity — ensuring cases move efficiently through each pre-litigation phase
  • Ensure settlements meet expected value targets relative to policy limits
  • Identify roadblocks to case progression and proactively clear them
  • Flag systemic medical management issues to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

3. Case Investigation & Documentation Oversight

  • Monitor progress of medical record collection and documentation gathering
  • Ensure case files contain required documentation and supporting evidence
  • Confirm liability and damages documentation is organized and complete
  • Review case files for completeness prior to escalation to the attorney
  • Maintain strong case file organization and documentation discipline

4. Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Actively use dashboards and reporting tools to evaluate team KPIs and identify underperformance
  • Identify process changes and efficiency improvements through direct case experience and data analysis
  • Surface operational gaps and improvement ideas to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager
  • Be comfortable building or pulling reports independently — data literacy is a core expectation of this role, not optional

5. Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding and training for new case managers joining the pod
  • Provide informal coaching and identify skill gaps requiring additional training
  • Promote consistency in case handling practices and ownership mentality across the team
  • Model best practices in case management, documentation, client communication, and ownership through personal caseload performance

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters
  • Be held to a higher performance standard than case managers given the complexity and value of the assigned caseload
  • Balance personal case execution responsibilities alongside team supervision duties
  • Demonstrate full ownership over cases — regardless of what other departments (medical records, CV specialists, settlement, etc.) have or haven't done, the Case Manager Lead is accountable for outcomes on their cases
  • Identify workflow challenges or process gaps through direct case experience and escalate operational improvements when needed

Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Business Title
Lead Data Engineer, Data Imports and Migrations

Role summary:
You will help move healthcare data into athenahealth systems with accuracy, consistency, and care. In this remote-US role, you will design and support data import, migration, transformation, and export processes that help practices transition from legacy EHR environments to athenahealth. You will work across sales, product, and operational teams to support reliable data movement, issue resolution, and validation. This position is based remotely in the United States.

Team summary:
The Data Imports and Migrations team supports customer implementations and data transition efforts by building repeatable, scalable processes for bringing in and transforming legacy healthcare data. The team works closely with product, implementation, engineering, and operations partners to define migration approaches, create ETL routines, validate data quality, and support export activities. The work is focused on delivering dependable data movement that helps customers get started on athenahealth with greater confidence and less disruption.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and support ETL workflows that extract, transform, and load data from legacy EHRs systems into athenahealth environments.

  • Write and maintain functions used for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.

  • Build Python and SQL scripts and utilities that support import, migration, and automation activities.

  • Partner with internal teams to define source-to-target mappings, business rules, and migration requirements.

  • Review inbound and outbound data to identify gaps, defects, and transformation issues.

  • Support interoperability workflows using HL7 and FHIR standards.

  • Perform EHI export-related tasks and validate output for completeness and accuracy.

  • Investigate data issues, document findings, and help drive resolution across teams.

  • Maintain technical documentation for processes, dependencies, and validation steps.

  • Use AI to improve productivity in data analysis and development tasks, while applying human review to confirm accuracy and align outputs to the needs of the work.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to process improvements that increase the scalability and repeatability of migration work.

  • Support testing and validation activities for data import and export processes.

  • Participate in project planning, status updates, and issue triage as needed.

  • Help maintain reusable tools, templates, and standards for migration work.

  • Assist with documentation updates and knowledge sharing across the team.

  • Support coordination across product, implementation, operations, and engineering partners.

  • Help identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation and better process design.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL, data migration, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience working with ETL, SQL, and Python.

  • Experience supporting data imports, conversions, migrations, or similar data movement work.

  • Familiarity with HL7 and FHIR interoperability standards.

  • Experience with EHI Export or related healthcare data export workflows preferred.

  • Experience working with healthcare data, healthcare technology, or implementation-focused teams preferred.

  • Ability to analyze data, identify issues, and document technical results clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Expected Compensation

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

MBA Intern – Commercial Leadership Program (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Commercial Leadership Program is Amgen’s MBA talent pipeline for future commercial leaders. Through this summer internship, you will contribute to a high-impact commercial project, build leadership and business skills, and gain exposure to the people, teams, and decisions that shape how Amgen brings medicines to patients.

The MBA internship is the pathway into Amgen’s full-time Commercial Leadership Program which includes 3 -12 month rotations that provides members with the unique opportunity to accelerate their commercial career in biotech through foundational sales & marketing experiences. Program graduates are now in leadership roles throughout Amgen.

Starting in 2021, Amgen initiated a company-wide virtual-first way of working with an option to be fully remote or partially onsite, thus allowing geographic flexibility.

During this internship program, you will:

You will be supported by a project manager, executive mentor, CLP peer buddy, and the broader CLP community to help you navigate the organization, build relationships, and make the most of the summer experience. Interns are evaluated not only on project delivery, but also on leadership potential, commercial thinking, learning agility, collaboration, communication, and readiness for future growth in Global Markets & Policy.

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.excerpt: Bei Instagrid bist du Teil der Clean-Tech-Revolution: Du bringst reine Energie in deine Region, unterstützt professionelle Anwender beim Umstieg von Verbrennungsgeneratoren und ermöglichst ihnen eine sichere, effiziente, saubere und leise Energielösung.
jobs.description:
Bei Instagrid bist du Teil der Clean-Tech-Revolution: Du bringst reine Energie in deine Region, unterstützt professionelle Anwender beim Umstieg von Verbrennungsgeneratoren und ermöglichst ihnen eine sichere, effiziente, saubere und leise Energielösung.

Deine Mission

Instagrid wächst – und mit uns wächst die Komplexität unserer Finanzprozesse. Wir suchen eine vielseitige Persönlichkeit, die sowohl konzeptionell als auch operativ stark ist: jemanden, der im Konzernrechnungswesen zuhause ist, aber auch anpackt, wenn es im Tagesgeschäft in AR, AP oder bei Bankthemen brennt.

Als Group Accountant bist du das Bindeglied im Finance-Team. Du begleitest Konsolidierungs- und Intercompany-Themen, tauchst ins operative Tagesgeschäft ein und bringst dich aktiv in Finance-Projekte ein. Du hast Lust, Dinge zu bewegen, Strukturen mitzugestalten, und bist dabei genauso souverän im operativen Tagesgeschäft wie in konzeptionellen Themen. Die Stelle berichtet direkt an den Senior Manager Accounting.

Dein Impact

Konzernrechnungswesen & Konsolidierung

  • Du steuerst und verantwortest die monatliche Konsolidierung nach HGB und IFRS (Intercompany-Eliminierungen, Abstimmungen, Reporting).

  • Du entwickelst die Konsolidierungslogik in NetSuite aktiv weiter.

  • Du analysierst und klärst IC-Salden und FX-Differenzen zwischen Tochtergesellschaften.

  • Du treibst den Jahresabschluss auf Konzern- und Einzelgesellschaftsebene mit an.

AR / AP – Operatives Tagesgeschäft

  • Du springst flexibel in AR- und AP-Prozesse ein – bei Urlaubsabwesenheiten, Peaks oder akutem Klärungsbedarf.

  • Du prüfst und buchst Vendor Bills, Gutschriften und Mahnläufe.

  • Du unterstützt bei der monatlichen OPOS-Prüfung (Kreditoren und Debitoren) und behältst den Überblick.

Finance-Projekte

  • Du arbeitest aktiv in internen Finance-Projekten mit: Prozessverbesserungen, Systemweiterentwicklungen, Reporting-Initiativen.

  • Du dokumentierst und rollst neue Finance-Prozesse aus.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für funktionsübergreifende Themen an der Schnittstelle Finance/Operations.

  • Du bringst dich bei Sonderprojekten ein – etwa Systemimplementierungen, Chart-of-Accounts-Anpassungen oder strukturellen Veränderungen im Unternehmen.

Weitere Aufgaben

  • Im Vertretungsfall: Unterstützung bei Bankbuchungen und Kontoabstimmungen.

  • Bei Bedarf: Mitarbeit bei USt-Voranmeldungen und steuerlichen Kontenkorrekturen.

Requirements

Fachlich

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder des Rechnungswesens; alternativ Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Proven Experience: mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Accounting, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Financial Analysis, mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Konzernbuchhaltung und Konsolidierung.

  • Kenntnisse in HGB; IFRS-Kenntnisse von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise NetSuite oder vergleichbar (SAP, Dynamics).

  • Verständnis von Intercompany-Strukturen, Elimination und FX-Bewertung.

  • Erfahrung im Projektkontext (Systemimplementierungen, Prozessveränderungen) willkommen.

Persönlich

  • Du bist ein Treiber – du erkennst, was getan werden muss, und packst es an, ohne lange zu warten.

  • Du tauchst gerne ins operative Tagesgeschäft ein und verlierst dabei den konzeptionellen Blick nicht.

  • Hohes Maß an Genauigkeit kombiniert mit einem pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsstil.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus AR, AP, Controlling und Steuer zusammen.

  • Flexibilität und Freude daran, verschiedene Themen parallel zu bearbeiten.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2+) sind zwingend erforderlich.

Deine Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage plus 5 Sonderurlaubstage und 5 Baby-Leave-Tage – anteilig je nach Arbeitszeitmodell

  • Rabatte bei nachhaltigen Online-Shops

  • Ein Unternehmen an der Spitze der Clean-Tech-Innovation – und ein Team, in dem du dich von Tag eins wohlfühlst

Das ist Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. Wir entwickeln die weltweit fortschrittlichsten mobilen Energiesysteme und schaffen damit neue Freiheit für die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir gestalten wir eine Zukunft, in der moderne Technologie und ökologische Verantwortung Hand in Hand gehen und nachhaltige Wirkung entfalten. Getrieben von Neugier und dem Anspruch, die Welt von morgen sauberer zu hinterlassen als die von gestern, treiben wir den Wandel von Verbrennungsgeneratoren hin zu einer sauberen Alternative voran – schnell, messbar und mit echtem Impact. Was wir bisher erreicht haben, ist erst der Anfang.

Bei Instagrid stehen wir für echte Chancengleichheit, denn wir glauben an die Stärke vielfältiger Teams. Wir schätzen Diversität nicht nur, wir suchen aktiv nach den besten Talenten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Nationalität. Wir arbeiten als Team, begegnen uns mit Respekt und schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven, um gemeinsam Großes zu erreichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
