Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior CRA at Worldwide


As a Senior CRA, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring clinical studies are conducted with the highest standards of quality, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. Your expertise will help drive the successful execution of studies from site qualification through closeout, supporting the delivery of reliable data that advances clinical research.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, study teams, and sponsors, building strong relationships while providing leadership, guidance, and oversight across clinical trial activities. You’ll have the opportunity to influence study success through proactive monitoring, site management, and collaboration with global teams.

Your contributions will directly support high-quality study delivery by ensuring protocol adherence, regulatory compliance, timely data collection, and effective site performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


Where You'll Work


This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across the West Coast of the United States. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.

To best support our sites, we're seeking candidates who are based in the West Coast of the United States. Travel will primarily be regional, with occasional travel to support sites in other locations as needed.


What You'll Do

  • Manage clinical research activities at investigative sites participating in Worldwide clinical studies.
  • Identify and assess potential research sites to support successful study execution.
  • Coordinate study start-up activities, including collection of regulatory documentation and support of contract and budget processes.
  • Conduct all types of monitoring visits: Pre-Site Selection Visits (PSSVs), Study Initiation Visits (SIVs),Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs) and Closeout Visits (COVs).
  • Train site personnel on protocol requirements, data collection processes, and safety reporting expectations.
  • Monitor site performance and provide ongoing support throughout study maintenance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with informed consent requirements, safety reporting obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Partner with sites and study teams to drive data quality, participant safety, and overall study success.
  • Support site closeout activities and ensure study requirements are completed at the conclusion of the trial.

What You'll Bring

  • Required experience monitoring Oncology (Hematology experience preferred) clinical trials.
  • Requires travel within the specified region; 8 – 10 DOS monthly
  • Experience in full-service monitoring preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, site management, and regulatory requirement

jobs.description:
Company: Lula Commerce

Role: E-commerce Product Lead, Lula Direct - 1st Party Ordering

Engagement type: Part-time contractor (1099)

Hours: 15–20 hours/week, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern time

Term: 3-month initial engagement, then ongoing

Location: Remote, US; US work authorization required

Department: Product

Reports to: Chief Product Officer

About Lula Commerce

Over 2% of convenience stores in the U.S. use Lula and are quickly growing, with several thousand locations using our product across 45+ states.

Lula Commerce is transforming everyday retail through the first digital commerce suite built specifically for convenience stores and retailers. As a leading provider of digital commerce solutions for the convenience retail industry, Lula Commerce empowers stores to modernize their operations and unlock new revenue streams. Our all-in-one platform combines inventory management, customer engagement, and business intelligence tools to help retailers streamline operations and drive growth. Lula Commerce connects retail locations nationwide to major marketplaces like DoorDash and Uber Eats while enabling their own first-party e-commerce channels.

For more information, visit

Role overview

Lula Direct is our first-party ordering platform. Lula Direct gives convenience retailers branded web and native storefronts to sell directly to their customers, with real-time inventory, promotions, and loyalty built in. It's live with chains across the country and is growing fast. We want it to continue to be the best online shopping experience in convenience retail, and then to go beyond what anyone in the industry is doing.

We're looking for an e-commerce-centric product lead who can both think and build. You'll set a roadmap and vision, and you'll also help design the entire experience. You'll work alongside our wider product team to bring a shopper-experience lens and the best e-commerce patterns. This is a hands-on, part-time role reporting directly to our CPO.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the shopper-experience vision: Define best-in-class for Lula Direct across the entire funnel: browse, search, product pages, cart, checkout, and reorder. Turn that into a clear, prioritized roadmap with the product team.

  • Design it yourself: Create flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and clickable prototypes. Start with the storefront and store page, category navigation, search, product detail pages, and item cards.

  • Fix conversion leaks: Find and remove friction between first visit and completed order, such as letting shoppers browse before entering an address, showing fees and totals upfront, fast add-to-cart, guest checkout, and saved payments. Base decisions on data and session review, not opinion.

  • Make discovery great for retail catalogs: Convenience stores carry thousands of SKUs plus made-to-order food. Design taxonomy, aisles, search, merchandising shelves, deal badges, and age-restricted item flows that work for a 100-item store and a 3,000-item store.

  • Write requirements: Turn designs into product requirements with clear scope, working alongside engineering.

  • Benchmark the market: Keep a running teardown of leading online ordering, grocery, and delivery experiences, and bring the best ideas back.

  • Talk to shoppers and merchants: Run quick usability tests and merchant interviews to validate ideas before we build them.

  • Bring visionary innovation: Shape where Lula Direct goes next.

Metrics you'll move

  • Visit-to-order and checkout conversion rate

  • Add-to-cart and search-to-cart rate

  • Average order value and repeat order rate

  • Page load and add-to-cart speed

  • Loyalty-linked orders

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of product management for consumer e-commerce, online ordering, grocery or delivery products, with a track record of driving outcomes that measurably improved conversion or retention.

  • Strong, hands-on design skills. Your portfolio shows flows, UI, and prototypes you made yourself.

  • Deep knowledge of e-commerce UX patterns: search, merchandising, product pages, cart, and checkout.

  • Able to write clear product requirements and work directly with engineers to scope and ship.

  • Comfortable with data: funnel analysis, A/B tests, and session recordings.

  • Proficient with AI tools such as Claude, Grok, and other AI assistants in daily work, for example, research, teardowns, prototyping, and drafting specs.

  • You take ownership, talk to customers, and move fast. You're comfortable working fully remote.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at an ordering/e-commerce company directly within the grocery or convenience industry.

  • Experience with multi-tenant, white-label, or B2B2C storefront products.

  • Experience with age-restricted products (tobacco, alcohol) or online SNAP/EBT.

  • Experience with AI-driven personalization, recommendations, or agentic commerce.

Why join Lula Commerce

  • Massive Market Opportunity: One-third of all Americans visit a convenience store daily. This vertical moves 4% of America's GDP, yet less than 10% of it is digitized. Lula is defining what digital ordering excellence looks like.

  • Proven Traction: Join a company with strong product-market fit, serving several thousand customers and striving to reach 10,000+ customers in the next 24 months.

  • Impact: Your work will directly help retailers compete and thrive in the digital age.

  • Culture: Work with a team of proven leaders from across the industry.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Remote work environment

  • Access to the latest tech tools and stack

Ready to help transform the digital backbone of retail?

Lula Commerce is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

jobs.description:
Location

Remote in Europe, ideally Zug or London. Reports to the CEO.

About Albatross
Albatross builds perception models: AI that understands human behavior and powers product discovery the way a great salesperson does, by observing the customer and adapting in real time. LLMs understand words. We understand behavior.

Our models power discovery for 50 million+ shoppers a month. The results are public. Wallapop: +119% homepage engagement, +35% overall engagement. OfferUp: +84% homepage engagement, +20% overall engagement.

One platform, four primitives: discovery feed, similar items, playlist, contextual search. A customer goes live in seven weeks. The pipeline is global. We are deployed in 12 countries.

About the Job

You own our contracts, end to end: the NDA, pilot and production agreements, renewals, DPAs and GTCs, and R&D agreements. Fast to sign, safe to run.

We want an owner who likes things simple. Not a reviewer who sends comments back, but the person who takes the pen, negotiates with the other side's counsel, and closes. Our contracts are short, clear and written for business people. Keep them that way. Today the CEO negotiates the contracts. He will hand them to you and expect you to close them faster than he does.

You understand what we build. Data flows in through an API, models learn from it, predictions flow out. Our contracts have to say exactly that, in plain words: what we process, what we learn, what we keep, what the customer owns. As our models grow, data processing and privacy become the heart of the job.

You build the legal frameworks the go-to-market team runs on: templates, standard positions, a playbook. One lawyer, outside counsel when it matters, and a contract stack Sales can run without you.

  • Own every customer contract end to end: draft, negotiate and close pilots, production agreements, data processing agreements, group agreements and partnerships, with marketplaces in Europe, the US, Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
  • Build and own the legal frameworks for the go-to-market team: templates, standard and fallback positions, a negotiation playbook, and a register of every commitment and renewal date, so Sales closes standard deals without you and escalates the rest.
  • Own the data and model terms in every agreement: what we process, what we learn, what we keep, in language a customer's product team can read.
  • Lead data protection and AI compliance: GDPR, the Swiss FADP, the EU AI Act, US state privacy law and international transfers.
  • Run security and compliance reviews with enterprise customers together with Engineering: the vendor due-diligence pack, DPIAs and transfer assessments, SOC 2, customer questionnaires.
  • Be the business partner to the CEO, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering: in the deal room, not after it, making sure every contract reflects how the technology actually works and stays short.
  • Handle the rest as it comes: corporate and investor documentation for our next round, employment across 10+ countries, intellectual property, and the judgment to know when to bring in outside counsel.

Requirements

Who you are

  • Qualified lawyer, min 6 years in: top-tier firm in M&A, venture or technology, then in-house at a technology company, ideally as its first lawyer.
  • You have negotiated technology contracts across the table from enterprise counsel and closed them: licensing, API and SaaS agreements, data processing agreements, partnerships.
  • You like simple and clear. You write contracts people actually read, you prefer a three-page offer to a thirty-page one, and you cut what does not matter.
  • You understand the technology. You can read an API specification and a data flow and turn them into terms: what is processed, what is learned, what is owned, what is promised on performance.
  • You know data protection cold: GDPR applied to a data-heavy product, international transfers, and what the EU AI Act will ask of us. Swiss law governs our contracts.
  • You own your work. You take the pen, you decide which risks matter, you explain the rest in one sentence to non-lawyers, and you close. You know when outside counsel is worth the money and when it is not.
  • You have worked cross-border, with US counterparties or US-law contracts, and you draft and negotiate in English at native level.
  • You are eligible to work in Europe.

You will not inherit a legal function. You will be one.

What success looks like

3 months:

  • You have read every signed contract and you know every commitment and renewal date. The register is yours.
  • The go-to-market frameworks are in place: templates and playbook updated, and Sales closes standard deals without you.
  • Every live customer is on the new contract stack.
  • Standard deals need no lawyer: NDA, pilot and production agreement go out on your templates and come back signed.
  • Data protection is in-house: the due-diligence pack is current.

12 months:

  • The CEO is out of contract negotiations. You lead every open one.
  • Every customer is on one contract stack. No legacy terms, no surprises.
  • Security and privacy reviews pass without a fight: the due-diligence pack answers the questions before customers ask them.

Benefits

  • Europe-based: €100k-€120k gross salary.
  • Full remote flexibility across Europe.

jobs.excerpt: what to expect We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.
jobs.description:
what to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same. But all of our days are agentic-first.


In ecommerce we design and build on Shopify and Next.js, with custom apps that take Shopify well past the defaults.


On the marketing side we create highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels.


In automotive and other industries we design full platforms, AI tools and integrations, from stock-car locators to configurators and a lot more.


Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.


Design at OH-SO covers both product design and communication design, and we treat UI and content as one craft. We design with AI as a collaborator and for AI as a material. The artefact is code in a user's hand, not a Figma file waiting for approval.


Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.


Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

your competencies

  • Fluent German (C1 or native) and very good English. Most of our clients for this role work in German, and you will present and run workshops in German every week.

  • Typically 5+ years of designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership from concept to launched product.

  • Recognised expertise in two or three areas, for example AI-native design, design systems, brand in product or communication design.

  • Hands-on experience designing for generative or agentic AI, and a clear view of where these interfaces fail and how to design for those moments.

  • AI as a daily working tool for research, exploration, prototyping and production. Every output passes through your craft and judgement before it ships.

  • A working understanding of modern web development: components, states, responsive layout, performance and animation in React and Next.js. You can read code, prototype in it, and talk with engineers in their terms.

  • Expert Figma skills (auto layout, variables, components, Dev Mode, Code Connect) and experience building design systems that engineering teams adopt and maintain.

  • Writing as part of the design. You don't design a screen without its language, and that includes copy for AI-driven interfaces.

  • Accessibility built in from the start (WCAG), and the habit of testing and validating your work and turning findings into design decisions.

  • The ability to translate business goals into design decisions, make trade-offs explicit, decide, and stand by it.

  • Confidence facilitating workshops, design sprints and critiques with clients, strategy and engineering

what you can look forward to

We're looking for a senior product designer who owns projects and their outcomes, sets the bar for craft, and makes both the team and the client better. You'll design products and platforms where AI is part of the experience: conversational and agentic interfaces, generative features, and the trust and error states that make them usable.

You'll do it close to the code, in modern web stacks, working with engineers from the first sketch to the live implementation.


As Senior Product Designer at OH-SO, you:


  • Own entire projects or major workstreams across product, content and brand in product, and define what "done" means in product and communication terms.

  • Shape the main creative idea together with Strategy and Content, and drive design direction across all surfaces.

  • Design AI-native experiences: conversational UX, prompt-aware patterns and agentic flows, along with the transparency, trust and error design that make them work for real users.

  • Own the design system architecture of a project, including tokens, components, governance, Code Connect and handover documentation.

  • Pair with engineering throughout the build, prototype in code when that is the faster way to an answer, and run design QA against the live implementation.

  • Act as the primary design contact for the client. You lead workshops, handle difficult conversations, defend quality and say no when needed.

  • Lead project teams of two to five designers and adjacent crafts, review and sign off their work, and mentor Junior and Intermediate designers.

  • Use AI to define new ways of working, and share what works with the whole team: prompt libraries, generation playbooks, skills and delivery patterns.

  • If you want: Represent OH-SO externally with case studies, talks and articles

we are looking forward to meet you

We are a bunch of colleagues originally from similar backgrounds who got tired of how things were usually done and set out to find better ways. That is the whole reason this company exists, and it is still what we are doing.


We are not a place of rockstars and egos. People here ask questions out loud, show rough work without flinching, and would rather help each other get something right than look clever alone. We push each other, in the good way, and we do not take ourselves too seriously while we are at it.


You would be joining that. You'll work closely with engineers, strategists and content people, and just as easily with the people steering the projects and the business. There is no wall between you and any of it. As a senior, you'll be in pitches, client conversations and the bigger calls from the start, and when you want more, speak up and the door is open.

jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts
Location: Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

One-liner

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

What you will own

  • Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.

  • Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.

  • Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.

  • Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.

  • Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.

  • Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.

  • Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.

  • Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

What success looks like

  • By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

  • By day 60: an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.

  • By day 90: brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.

  • By 6–12 months: citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

Evidence we want to see

  • 6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.

  • Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.

  • One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.

  • One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

  • AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.

  • Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.

  • Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

  • Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

What this role is not

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

How the process works

Application → 7 short questions sent to you by email → evidence review → live working session (diagnose a site → propose the AEO plan → measurement plan) → paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense → references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

jobs.description:
Myositis HIT Solutions Account Director will lead the myositis HIT strategic approach and customer engagement with identified leading health systems, academic medical centers, and specialty infusion pharmacy partners. Working with these customers to help harness their Electronic Health Record (EHR)/Computer-Based Patient Record (CPR) to improve awareness, recognition, diagnosis, and management of patients with dermatomyositis (DM) and polymyositis (PM) within aligned areas that Pfizer Key Account Management engages.

Myositis is commonly recognized late and frequently misattributed to other conditions, and the patients are often already visible in the customer’s own data before a diagnosis is made. A substantial portion of this role is therefore focused on disease awareness and the diagnostic pathway: educating customers on workflow approaches to use the laboratory, serologic, and clinical data to surface suspected patients earlier, standardize how those patients are evaluated and documented, and route them to the appropriate specialist.

Examples include helping customers understand the value of optimizing their clinical and pharmacy workflow within these therapeutic areas while leveraging EHR and CPR technologies to support earlier disease recognition and population health management. HIT Solutions Account Director provides strategic insights for leveraging e-platforms to facilitate the evolution of care from a reactive episodic based care model to a predictive and proactive management of chronic illness across the care continuum.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Fully Remote (Spain)
jobs.excerpt: If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us.
jobs.description:
If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us. At Metricool you will be able to do so with real ownership over how security and compliance get built into the product, not just audited after the fact.

You will have the possibility to work 100% remotely, working in a high-growth international B2B SaaS, in which all members love to create, work in teams, analyze and help Community Managers make their work easier.

Your mission is to become the dedicated owner of application, cloud and AI security at Metricool, relieving our Senior Developers and Leads from manual security reviews and building specialized security management across our core monolith (JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue), AWS infrastructure, AI-powered features and internal compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).

In this position, you will be able to make a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:

As Senior Security Engineer,

  • Application & Platform Security:Harden Spring Security, JavaEE filters, CORS, anti-CSRF protections, SameSite/HttpOnly cookie flags, and strict CSP headers.

  • AI Security & Testing: Run threat modeling and vulnerability testing on our AI/LLM features, protecting against the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs: prompt injection, data poisoning, data leakage, insecure output handling, and API abuse.

  • Compliance & Auditing (ISO 27001 / SOC 2): Define, audit and collect technical evidence for compliance controls (access management, encryption at rest and in transit, incident logs), lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, and evaluate third-party vendor risk.

  • Infrastructure & Cloud Security:Configure AWS load balancers, Nginx, Tomcat, container security (Docker), and HTTPS enforcement.

  • Code Reviews & Audits:Run regular code reviews, secret-detection audits, and third-party dependency reviews (Maven, Node.js).

  • Build automated security checks (SAST/DAST/ZAP) into our CI/CD pipelines.

As a Team Member:

  • Cross-functional Alignment:Work closely with Senior Developers and Leads to bring security into the development process from the start, rather than bolting it on afterward.

  • Continuous Improvement:Document controls, evidence and runbooks so compliance stays audit-ready year-round, not just ahead of a renewal.

  • Culture of Excellence:Drive a security-first culture that embraces secure AI adoption without slowing down developer velocity.

Long story short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

  • First month: Gain full context of the monolith architecture, the AWS stack and our current compliance posture.

  • First Quarter: CompleteAI feature threat modeling, execute security header hardening, and set up the ISO 27001/SOC 2 evidence collection matrix.

  • To the moon: Own platform security end to end, keep compliance continuous and seamless, and lead the secure adoption of new AI technologies.

Job requirements. You’ll be successful on your mission if you have:

  • The candidate must be located in Spain.

  • A senior profile, confident owning security end-to-end across application code, cloud infrastructure and compliance, not just reviewing it on paper.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in Spanish (mandatory) and English. A language proficiency check is part of the hiring process.

Hard skills:

  • JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue.js, Node.js, Docker, OWASP ZAP, AWS, Linux, MySQL, Maven, Git/Bitbucket.

  • AI & Security: Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, AI data privacy, and secure API/prompt engineering.

  • Compliance Frameworks: Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS controls, SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality), and vendor risk assessments.

Soft skills:

  • Hands-on mindset: comfortable writing and reviewing code, not a “paper compliance” auditor.

  • Pragmatic approach to security: applies controls without imposing heavy bureaucratic overhead on development speed.

  • Genuine curiosity about emerging risks, especially around GenAI/LLM adoption in software platforms.

  • Clear communicator, able to turn audit requirements into practical, developer-friendly processes.

Why will you fall in love with Metricool?

  • Truly Remote: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We provide the tools; you provide the talent.

  • 100% Flexible Schedule: We care about the work getting done, not the hours you’re sitting at the desk. You organize your own time so you can live your life, as long as you’re there to collaborate when the team needs you.

  • Health Insurance:We’ve got you covered so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: We’re an international team speaking English, Spanish, French, and German. We’ll help you learn a new language to help break down barriers and connect better with your colleagues.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, we all get together in person to hang out, touch grass, and remind ourselves we’re not just avatars on Slack.

  • Salary:We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. For this position we estimate between 55,000€ and 65,000€ (annually).

  • Growth: We’re a fast-growing company. If you’re curious and take ownership, there’s no ceiling here.

What are the steps of the hiring process?

  • First interview (30 minutes)with Horten People & Culture: culture fit, compensation alignment, and language check.

  • Second interview (60 minutes) with Marcos Cacabelos:a deep dive on SAST/DAST/ZAP tools, AI testing scenarios, and ISO 27001/SOC 2 practical cases.

If you are excited about the things that you just read, don’t hesitate to apply for the job position!

Job overview:

The Safety and Incident Response team is looking for individuals who exhibit strong empathy, positive attitude, and calm under pressure skill sets in a fast-paced working environment. These individuals will use their customer service and strong communication skills to aid in streamlining communication and operational incident response case management.
To be considered for this role, applicants must have a Panamanian passport or the legal right to live and work in Panama. Please submit your CV in English online. We will screen applications on a rolling basis.

Key responsibilities:

As a part of the Operations Emergency Support Team, you would join a group of trained team members who take shifts remotely (from home) throughout the year on weekdays, weekends, and public holidays, in the evening (1730-0130). There are also some occasions where you may be able to support the core Incident Response team during the weekday daytime as well.
You would need to have access to the laptop which you would be provided with (and a stable internet connection) so that you can respond to any incidents in a timely manner. Key responsibilities are as follows:

  • Answer all calls that come into the Operations Emergency line, open operational cases and assign to the correct specialist

  • Liaise with teammates across departments to ensure consistency of cases and case management procedures

  • Provide on-tour support and assist with the operational tasks required to produce a tour

  • Collaboration with internal stakeholders, such as Procurement, Invoicing, and the Tour Director Department to provide a beautiful customer experience

  • Assist the Safety and Incident Response team with administrative tasks as needed

Skills & Experience:

  • Complete fluency in English, confident and clear communication. Additional languages are a plus.

  • Excellent communication, customer service and organizational skills

  • Great attention to detail

  • Strong service mind and listening skills

  • Great team player

  • Positive attitude and empathy for others

  • Good judgement – ability to recognize when an issue should be escalated

  • Calm under pressure

  • Great sense of urgency and to act quickly

About EF Education First:

Founded in 1965, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that shares a common mission of opening the world through education, offering language, academic, cultural exchange and education travel programs.

Some companies are in the business of technology.

Others are in the business of finance, sports, or soft drinks.

At EF, we’re in a different kind of business.

One that’s a little less tangible, and a lot more important. We’re in the business of understanding.  

For 60 years we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and culturally rich travel experiences with the power to change how people think, feel and act. The programs we deliver open the world to students and travelers in ways that challenge biases, overcome barriers, and pave the way for a more understanding world.  You’ll find us working across more than 50 countries, with offices in some of the world’s greatest cities—each one filled with smart, driven people who push each other to be better every day.  And yes, we have technology, we have finance, we even have sports with our own professional cycling team.  But it’s what we do with it—building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world that makes all the difference.

About this role

If you are a civil engineer who thrives on technical precision, applied problem-solving, and infrastructure-focused reasoning, this is a unique opportunity to contribute directly to how the next generation of AI systems understand and communicate complex engineering concepts. We are looking for civil engineering specialists who can evaluate, challenge, and refine advanced language models on domain-specific topics. Your expertise as a Civil Engineer will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models, and will play an important role in shaping the future of AI.

This role is a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs.

Your profile

  • 4+ years of professional civil engineering experience, with significant hands-on work in infrastructure design, structural analysis, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, construction management, or a closely related civil engineering specialty.

jobs.excerpt: Senior VFX Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D)Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Senior VFX Artist with exceptional artistic taste and a passion for creating expressive, impactful, and visually memorable real-time effects for game development.
jobs.description:
Senior VFX Artist (Stylized Games | Unity3D)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior VFX Artist with exceptional artistic taste and a passion for creating expressive, impactful, and visually memorable real-time effects for game development.

We believe great VFX goes beyond visual spectacle. Every effect should communicate gameplay intent, reinforce the artistic direction, and make the player's experience feel more responsive, exciting, and rewarding.

From subtle environmental effects to powerful combat abilities, we want VFX that combine exceptional artistic quality with strong gameplay readability, personality, and technical efficiency.

As part of our co-development team, you will collaborate closely with VFX Leads, Art Directors, Game Designers, and Technical Artists to create and polish high-quality effects directly in-engine.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who combines strong visual instincts with practical real-time VFX production experience.

Key Responsibilities

Stylized VFX Creation

  • Create high-quality stylized real-time VFX for gameplay, combat, abilities, characters, and environments.

  • Develop visually distinctive effects with strong shape language, color, timing, composition, and artistic consistency.

  • Create compelling effects that communicate power, emotion, impact, and gameplay intent.

  • Work with particle systems, shaders, textures, flipbooks, meshes, and other real-time VFX techniques.

  • Maintain a cohesive visual language across different effects and gameplay features.

Gameplay Readability & Artistic Quality

  • Ensure effects communicate clear gameplay information without overwhelming the player.

  • Establish strong visual hierarchy across anticipation, impact, follow-through, and recovery.

  • Balance expressive visual effects with responsiveness and gameplay clarity.

  • Refine timing, motion, color, and composition to achieve satisfying gameplay feedback.

  • Iterate directly in-engine to evaluate effects in real gameplay situations.

Technical Implementation & Optimization

  • Create and implement real-time VFX in Unity3D or comparable game engines.

  • Optimize particle counts, overdraw, shaders, textures, and other performance-sensitive elements.

  • Work with Technical Artists and Engineers to solve implementation and rendering challenges.

  • Develop reusable VFX assets, templates, and production-friendly workflows.

  • Ensure effects meet quality and performance requirements across target platforms.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Game Designers, Animators, Technical Artists, and Engineers.

  • Translate creative direction and gameplay requirements into compelling visual effects.

  • Participate in VFX reviews and contribute to artistic quality standards.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support other VFX artists when needed.

  • Take ownership of assigned effects from early concept through final implementation and polish.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to elevate visual quality and gameplay feedback.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a real-time VFX Artist in game development.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Exceptional portfolio or VFX reel demonstrating strong artistic quality and polished in-game effects.

  • Strong experience creating stylized VFX with appealing timing, motion, shape language, and color.

  • Excellent understanding of composition, visual hierarchy, animation principles, and gameplay readability.

  • Proficiency with Unity3D particle systems, shaders, materials, and real-time VFX workflows, or comparable experience with other game engines.

  • Experience with texture creation, flipbooks, mesh particles, trails, and shader-driven effects.

  • Strong understanding of real-time rendering and VFX performance optimization.

  • Ability to independently develop effects from initial exploration through final in-engine implementation.

  • Strong artistic judgment, attention to detail, and creative problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with stylized mobile games.

  • Strong skills in Shader Graph, HLSL, or custom shader development.

  • Experience with Houdini, EmberGen, or other VFX content creation tools.

  • Familiarity with pixel-inspired, simplified, or highly stylized visual aesthetics.

  • Experience creating expressive combat, ability, and character-driven VFX.

  • Knowledge of mobile GPU optimization and performance-constrained platforms.

  • Experience mentoring artists or contributing to VFX quality benchmarks.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to create distinctive and impactful real-time effects for game development projects.

  • High artistic ownership and influence over gameplay VFX quality.

  • Close collaboration with experienced VFX Artists, Technical Artists, and Creative Directors.

  • Remote-friendly international working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Create Effects Players Can Feel?

Send us your VFX reel and a short introduction. We would love to see effects that demonstrate exceptional artistic quality, gameplay readability, creative timing, and the details that make real-time VFX truly memorable.

jobs.description:
want to make a difference?

Als Junior Graphic Designer (all genders) übernimmst Du das Design und die Realisation unserer Grafiken – mit allem, was dazugehört. Du unterstützt unser Art Direction & Graphic Design Team bei der Erstellung ansprechender Grafiken und Layouts für digitale und Print-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Nachhaltigkeitswerte, Brand Guidelines und Storytelling-Ansprüche visuell zum Leben erweckt werden. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen, um Design-Konsistenz, Markenkohärenz und wirkungsvolle visuelle Kommunikation sicherzustellen.

wer wir sind?

Seit 2007 beweisen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass Mode auch anders geht: innovativ und zeitlos, produziert nach verantwortungsvollen Standards für Mensch und Erde. Keine Lohnsklaverei, keine schädlichen Chemikalien, keine billige Massenware. Aus der einfachen Idee, T-Shirts zu bedrucken und über den Verkauf Spendengelder für Projekte und Organisationen zu sammeln, ist ein Unternehmen gewachsen, das heute zu den größten Nachhaltigeren Lifestyle Labels Europas zählt. Mit einem 190-köpfigen Team und vier Kollektionen im Jahr zeigen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass sich Verantwortung und gutes Produktdesign nicht ausschließen.

mit diesen aufgaben trägst du zum erfolg bei

  • Du erstellst Newsletter und CRM-Assets, einschließlich Marketing-, automatisierte und Transaktions-E-Mails für das CRM-Team.
  • Du unterstützt das Kreativteam bei Digital- und Print-Assets, einschließlich Grafiken für soziale Medien, Präsentationen und Website-Design.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle Design-Assets mit unseren Brand Guidelines und der Kreativstrategie übereinstimmen, und bringst eigene Ideen für die visuelle Weiterentwicklung ein.
  • Du beteiligst Dich an Brainstormings und Kampagnenabstimmungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team kreative Lösungen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit CRM-, Marketing-, Produkt- und E-Commerce-Teams zusammen, holst Briefings ein und lieferst Assets termingerecht.
  • Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit bei Designtrends, Tools und Software-Updates und bringst neue Impulse für unsere visuelle Sprache ein.

das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du besitzt einen (Fach-) Hochschulabschluss im Bereich der Grafikdesign, alternativ eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in diesem Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du hast bestenfalls schon erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Grafikdesign gesammelt.
  • Du hast bereits Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Suite, einschließlich Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign.
  • Du hast ausgeprägte Designfähigkeiten und ein gutes Auge für Details.
  • Die Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit in einem Team und ein ausgezeichnetes Zeitmanagement und Organisationstalent zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und Interesse an der Modeindustrie.
  • Du besitzt fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite in einem innovativen Unternehmen, das so nachhaltig wie möglich agiert und ständig neue Maßstäbe setzt.
  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die auf Vertrauen basieren, und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten.
  • Teamgeist: Freue dich auf fulminante Feste mit großartigen Kolleg*innen, ein Büro mit viel Geschichte und Liebe zu Hunden (die im Büro herzlich willkommen sind).
  • Benefits: Einkaufsgutscheine bei ARMEDANGELS, tolle Mitarbeitendenrabatte, ein Jobrad oder Deutschlandticket sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Support: Unser Employee Assistant Program steht dir unabhängig vom Arbeitgeber in jeder Lebenssituation beratend zur Seite.
  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – komm einfach, wie du bist (Kleidung ist natürlich notwendig!).

ein paar tipps zur bewerbung

Vielfältige Interessen, Mut und Drive, die Dinge anzupacken, sind bei uns sehr willkommen!

Bewirb Dich bitte online über den Bewerbungs-Button und ergänze in Deiner Bewerbung die Infos:

  • Deine Pronomen & ggf. Wunschname
  • Deinen CV
  • Dein frühster Eintrittstermin & Deine Gehaltsvorstellung
  • Ein paar Worte dazu, warum Du richtig Lust hast bei uns zu starten.
Dann können wir uns ein richtig rundes Bild davon machen, wie gut wir zueinander passen.
Das Ganze kannst Du an unsere Kollegin Annick adressieren.

Vielen Dank für Deine Zeit und Dein Interesse!

jobs.title: Appeal Specialist II - RN/PT/OT/SLP
jobs.excerpt: Benefits• Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy.
jobs.description:
Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Future Security: 401(k) with matching
  • Student Loan Support – Up to $10,000 repayment assistance, because we invest in your future.
  • Educational Tuition Assistance
  • Competitive Pay & Full Benefits – A salary and package designed to reward your expertise and dedication.
  • Paid Time Off

Job Summary

The Appeal Specialist II reviews, analyzes, and resolves insurance denials to ensure accurate reimbursement and regulatory compliance. This role logs and reviews denials for trend reporting, provides feedback to facilities, and communicates payer updates to relevant stakeholders. The Appeal Specialist II collaborates with internal teams to ensure timely and thorough appeal resolution and supports initiatives that improve denial prevention and recovery processes.

Essential Functions

  • Files medical necessity and level of care appeals using MCG, InterQual, CMS, and other guidelines as needed. Files other clinical appeals on in scope denial types including, but not limited to denials surrounding readmissions, experimental and investigational determinations, and coverage based determinations.
  • Monitors clinical appeal processes for issues and trends and provides guidance and feedback to related departments as needed.
  • Tracks and manages clinical denials using current tools (manuals, training programs).
  • Identifies patterns and trends in denials; communicates to appropriate persons.
  • Maintains documentation regarding all payer resources regarding denials and appeals processes.
  • Understands and applies CHS Appeal Process for denied claims.
  • Follows and enforces accepted safety practices for patients and the hospital. Reports safety hazards and initiates appropriate action. Participates in safety instructional programs.
  • Provides excellent customer service to patients, families, significant others, physicians, coworkers, and external vendors by communicating professionally, responding promptly to inquiries, and fostering positive working relationships.
  • Documents all actions accordingly by documentation standards within Artiva, HMS and other business office systems as required.
  • Understands and applies policy and procedure manuals and other reference materials from insurance companies, regulatory organizations, and other in scope applicable entities.
  • Ensures confidentiality of all patient accounts by following HIPAA guidelines.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in Nursing, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, or Speech Therapy required
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, or Speech Therapy preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in clinical operations in Nursing, Physical Therapy, Occupational Therapy, or Speech Therapy required
  • 1-3 years of experience in claims processing, healthcare billing, or revenue cycle management preferred
  • 1-3 years of experience in utilization review and/or case management experience leveraging MCG or InterQual preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Basic knowledge of medical billing, coding systems, and insurance claim processes.
  • Strong communication skills for interacting with insurance carriers, patient financial service units, and other departments.
  • Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills to manage a high volume of appeals.
  • Proficiency in using healthcare billing software and Google Suite.

Licenses and Certifications

  • RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure and/or Compact State Licensure required or
  • PT - Physical Therapist required or
  • OT - Occupational Therapist – Registered required or
  • SLP - Speech Language Pathologist required

The Payment Compliance and Contract Management (PCCM) team plays a critical role in ensuring that payments are made according to contractual agreements and regulatory requirements. The team oversees the full contract lifecycle, focusing on analyzing reimbursement discrepancies, improving revenue cycle processes, and ensuring compliance with contract terms to support financial accuracy and operational efficiency.

Community Health Systems is one of the nation’s leading healthcare providers. Developing and operating healthcare delivery systems in 40 distinct markets across 15 states, CHS is committed to helping people get well and live healthier. CHS operates 71 acute-care hospitals and more than 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care centers, freestanding emergency departments, occupational medicine clinics, imaging centers, cancer centers and ambulatory surgery centers.

Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation.   • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients

  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

What You Bring

Required:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school
  • Active admission to the Oregon Bar
  • 5–10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Must be located in or near the State of Oregon
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust caseload independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Oregon laws, regulations, and procedures
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Active admission to one or more Oregon Federal Court districts
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Background in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

  • Eligible for performance-based bonus

The Opportunity

Lesley University's Department of Education is seeking a highly qualified adjunct faculty member to teach: Linguistic Foundations of English Acquisition; Fall 2026 Term II. This course is taught remotely.


Course Description

This independent study builds on TSLA 5420: Linguistic Foundations of English Acquisition, a master’s-level course at Fairfield University which introduces language teachers to the principles of linguistic theory (phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics) and their relationship to oral language and literacy development for multilingual learners. The doctoral student will engage with this content at an advanced level through three elevations: serving as a teaching assistant in the master’s course, serving as a research assistant on a new educational linguistics study of multilingual educator leadership development, and writing a benchmark paper and designing an intervention that advance the student’s dissertation study and research trajectory. In place of the lesson plans required of master’s candidates, the doctoral student will produce discussion syntheses that connect class conversation to the literature, research documentation and analytic memos, and a benchmark paper with an accompanying intervention design. The elevation draws on the student’s professional expertise in speech-language pathology and dissertation interests in trauma, communication, and multimodal assessment.

Senior Technical Artist (Houdini | Procedural Game Art)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Artist specializing in Houdini with a passion for procedural workflows, creative problem-solving, and building scalable solutions for game art production.

We believe procedural tools should do more than generate content. They should empower artists to explore ideas, create variation, maintain artistic consistency, and produce high-quality assets efficiently.

In this role, you will design and develop procedural systems, tools, and production workflows that support environment art, asset creation, and other game development disciplines.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who combines deep Houdini expertise with strong artistic understanding and the ability to turn complex technical challenges into intuitive, artist-friendly solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Procedural Art & Houdini Development

  • Design and develop procedural tools, generators, and systems using Houdini.

  • Create scalable workflows for environment assets, geometry processing, modular content, and world-building tasks.

  • Develop reusable Houdini Digital Assets (HDAs) that give artists creative control while maintaining production consistency.

  • Build procedural systems that support artistic iteration, controlled variation, and efficient asset creation.

  • Explore new procedural techniques that improve production quality and efficiency.

Technical Art & Pipeline Integration

  • Integrate Houdini-generated content into real-time game development workflows.

  • Develop reliable asset export, validation, and optimization processes.

  • Collaborate with artists and engineers to integrate procedural solutions into Unity3D, Unreal Engine, or related production pipelines.

  • Ensure generated content meets artistic, technical, and performance requirements.

  • Troubleshoot procedural systems, geometry issues, and pipeline bottlenecks.

Tools & Automation

  • Build artist-friendly procedural tools with clear parameters and predictable outputs.

  • Develop workflow automation using VEX, Python, and Houdini's procedural toolset.

  • Create reusable templates, documentation, and best practices.

  • Prototype creative solutions and refine them into stable production tools.

  • Improve efficiency while preserving artistic flexibility and visual quality.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work closely with Environment Artists, Character Artists, Technical Artists, and Engineers.

  • Translate creative requirements into practical procedural solutions.

  • Provide technical guidance and support artists using procedural tools.

  • Take ownership of procedural systems from early exploration through production.

  • Proactively identify areas where procedural workflows can improve quality, consistency, or production efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Technical Art, procedural game art, or related disciplines.

  • Advanced Houdini experience with a portfolio demonstrating production-ready procedural systems.

  • Strong knowledge of procedural modeling, geometry processing, attributes, and node-based workflows.

  • Proficiency in VEX and Python scripting for Houdini.

  • Experience building reusable HDAs and artist-facing procedural tools.

  • Understanding of real-time game asset production, including optimization, UVs, materials, and geometry budgets.

  • Experience integrating procedural assets into Unity3D, Unreal Engine, or comparable real-time engines.

  • Strong artistic understanding of shape, composition, visual consistency, and production requirements.

  • Ability to design maintainable procedural systems and solve complex technical challenges independently.

  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with Houdini Engine integration in Unity3D or Unreal Engine.

  • Knowledge of PDG/TOPs and large-scale procedural asset processing.

  • Experience with procedural terrain, vegetation, architecture, or environment generation.

  • Familiarity with voxel geometry, destruction, or procedural simulation.

  • Experience with procedural animation, VFX, or simulation workflows.

  • Knowledge of mobile performance optimization and efficient real-time asset generation.

  • Previous experience creating procedural tools for international co-development teams.

What We Offer

  • High technical ownership over procedural tools and production workflows.

  • Opportunity to develop innovative solutions that directly improve game art production.

  • Close collaboration with experienced artists, engineers, and technical leadership.

  • Remote-friendly international working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Build Tools That Empower Artists?

Send us your portfolio, technical breakdowns, and a short introduction. We would love to see procedural systems you have personally developed, how they work, and the production challenges they solve.

Enterprise AI Architect

About the project
An international client engagement building an enterprise AI capability. You will be the technical lead of a three-person team: yourself plus two Lead AI Solutions Engineers.

About the role
We are looking for an Enterprise AI Architect to own the technical shape of the entire AI capability on the engagement: standards, shared components, and the evaluation and release strategy. You will work directly with the client's leadership (CTO, enterprise architects, senior business stakeholders), select platforms and approaches, and defend those decisions in front of both technical and business audiences. This is a hands-on architecture role with a strong consulting and presales component. You write and review code and personally own the quality of what reaches users.

What you will do

Shape the work

  • Work with senior business stakeholders and domain experts to define objectives, constraints and expected outcomes

  • Identify which processes are worth automating and which are not, and say so plainly, including when the answer is no

  • Select tools, platforms and approaches for each business problem and justify the choice to both technical and business leadership

  • Shape and present solution proposals: scope, approach, effort, expected impact. Presales is part of the job

  • Own outcomes with a product mindset: adoption, measurable time saved, and reliability for real users

Own the architecture

  • Own the technical shape of the whole capability: standards, shared components, evaluation and release strategy, backwards compatibility

  • Define what a well-formed skill looks like, what belongs in shared infrastructure, and what gets rejected in review

  • Make and justify platform-level decisions: agent harnesses, integration architecture, build vs adopt

  • Apply sound judgement on data handling, security and compliance when working with sensitive HR and compensation data

  • Provide technical leadership to two engineers: review, direction, unblocking

Build it

  • Design, build, test and maintain reusable AI skills: instructions, supporting scripts, validation logic, reference data, shared components

  • Write and review production-quality code and own it through review, CI and release

  • Build the evaluation layer: golden cases, acceptance criteria, regression checks

  • Debug agent behaviour: establish why a workflow produced the wrong result and fix the root cause

  • Integrate with the client's platforms and data sources

Drive it forward

  • Run pilots with real users, collect structured feedback and ship improved versions

  • Set and enforce standards for how skills are authored, reviewed, versioned and released

  • Track where AI tooling is heading and bring relevant parts into the engagement before the client asks

What we expect

  • Architect-level experience with proven ownership of real systems: module boundaries, reuse, versioning, integration, non-functional requirements

  • Still hands-on: you write and review production code today. This is not a role for pure managers

  • Strong engineering foundation in at least one modern stack. Our delivery stack is TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS, Angular); fluency is an advantage, not a requirement. Backgrounds in Python, Java or .NET are very welcome

  • Solid engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD

  • Real LLM-backed systems shipped to real users, not just prototypes

  • Broad hands-on knowledge of the current AI tooling landscape, not tied to a single vendor

  • Working command of agentic patterns: tool use / function calling, MCP, prompt and context engineering, structured instruction design, orchestration

  • Experience evaluating and improving non-deterministic systems with test sets and measurable acceptance criteria

  • Judgement on where AI fits and where conventional software is the better answer

  • Direct experience with external clients and senior business stakeholders, including CTO-level conversations

  • Presales experience: shaping, scoping, estimating and pitching solutions to decision-makers

  • Ability to explain a technical approach and its trade-offs to a non-technical audience

  • Ability to turn ambiguous requirements and tacit domain knowledge into a clear design and an executable workflow, comfortable working without a full specification

  • Product mindset: you optimise for user adoption and business outcome, not technical elegance

  • English C1: you run client conversations unaided

  • Sustained working-hours overlap with the client (US / Western Europe)

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code, especially authoring Skills, plugins or MCP servers

  • Experience with LLM evaluation tooling (promptfoo, LangSmith, custom harnesses)

  • Consulting or professional services background

  • Exposure to HR tech, compensation & benefits, payroll or workforce analytics

  • Experience building internal developer tooling or standing up a platform capability

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview: Our company is a start-up that specializes in episodes of care benefit plans.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our company is a start-up that specializes in episodes of care benefit plans. We have a deep expertise in episode pricing and analytics and our goal is to bring transparency and efficiency to the healthcare market. Our company is committed to providing high-quality, affordable healthcare to our customers.

Role Description
The Data Integration Engineer for Healthcare Transactions is a hands-on software engineer responsible for designing, building, and operating the data pipelines and integrations that move healthcare data, including claims, enrollment, and other transactions, into and out of the organization's systems. This is an individual contributor role on the engineering team: this person writes the code, mappings, and tests behind each feed, deploys it to production, and owns its reliability from there. The ideal candidate is an engineer who knows healthcare data standards in detail and treats integrations as production software.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and deploy inbound and outbound data pipelines with providers, payers, vendors, and network partners, covering Claims and Billing files, Provider Directory files, NPPES, ICD10 and other data sources.
  • Write the parsing, mapping, and transformation logic in Python and SQL that validates, normalizes, and loads partner data into internal data models.
  • Build and maintain the APIs and services that move integrated data into billing and other core systems.
  • Build automated data quality checks, validation rules, and exception handling so bad or incomplete files are caught before they reach downstream systems or clients.
  • Instrument pipelines with logging, monitoring, and alerting; investigate production failures, perform root cause analysis, and ship fixes that keep issues from recurring.
  • Build reusable components and templates that make each new feed faster to stand up than the last.
  • Optimize pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes and the number of partners grow.
  • Apply HIPAA and security requirements in code and infrastructure, including encryption, secure file transfer, access controls, and audit logging.
  • Own the technical side of new client and partner connections end to end: review file specifications, build and test the feed, run test cycles with the partner, and move to production.
  • Work directly with technical contacts at clients and vendors to troubleshoot data issues and agree on file layouts and requirements (e.g., custom 837 claims, 834 enrollment files).
  • Work with Product, account management, and operations teams to turn business requirements into technical designs with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Surface integration pain points and edge cases to inform the product and engineering roadmap.
  • Follow the team's software development practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD deployments.
  • Write and maintain technical specifications, mapping documents, and runbooks so integrations can be supported and extended by other engineers.

Qualifications

  • Describe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on software or data engineering experience building and supporting production data integrations, preferably within the healthcare sector (payer or health plan experience a plus).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare transaction standards, especially X12 837 and 834; experience with 835, 270/271, HL7, or FHIR a plus.
  • Experience building data pipelines on AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda).
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, JSON, and SFTP-based file exchange.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with an integration engine or orchestration tool (e.g., Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, InterSystems, Airflow) a plus.
  • Understanding of HIPAA requirements for handling protected health information.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, and clear written and verbal communication, including with external technical contacts.

Benefits

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement: 401(k) with company match
  • Paid leave: Vacation, Sick, and company holidays
  • Ancillary: Company-paid life and disability insurance

Job Title: Senior Director, Regulatory Strategy Leader-Oncology

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Overview-

Provide leadership and advice on the development of optimum regulatory and biostatistical strategies for drug development, product lifecycle management and portfolio management, particularly focussed on emerging biopharmaceutical company customer goals. Provides strategic regulatory and biostatistical advice towards efficient clinical development and navigation of US & European regulatory frameworks. Minimal participation in project-related work, as necessary as a subject matter expert. Provide scientific, regulatory, and product development leadership and consultancy expertise to support strategic business activities and investment opportunities. Support policy initiatives around the organization. Provide thought leadership by participation in publications, white papers, and blogs in areas of expertise and by participating in scientific conferences and webinars, as appropriate. Provide leadership in emerging novel trial designs/tools like digital twins in which the organization is heavily investing

Essential Functions-

  • Integrate strategic regulatory, statistical & drug development support services into emerging biopharmaceutical company clinical trial offerings. Interface with clients as part of the Therapeutic Science & Strategy Unit Centres of Excellence to provide strategic advice and incorporate regulatory and statistical guidance.
  • Support engagements with regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA) on behalf of customers, across the lifecycle of drug development from pre-clinical to licensing, including contribution to briefing documents and other meeting materials.
  • Support the emerging science and innovation around novel trial offerings including digital twins.
  • Support the innovative development of compounds to maximize technical, regulatory, and commercial success, including contribution to the development of Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Clinical Development Plans (CDPs), clinical study designs, synopses, and protocols, as appropriate.
  • Strategic leadership of the development of regulatory submissions, including INDs, marketing/licensing authorizations (NDA/BLA/MAAs), special designations (orphan drugs, pediatics plans, “fast-track”, “break-through” etc…).
  • Ensure high-quality, well-reasoned, objective deliverables (using data-driven design, where available and appropriate) that meet the highest standards of medical, ethical and scientific integrity and conduct.
  • Assume the role of customer senior management as requested, including membership of virtual cross functional drug development teams.
  • Provide regulatory strategy expertise to support strategic business activities and investment opportunities.
  • Assist in the development of programs to maximize the organization’s growth and profitability.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction by working closely with senior management, CRO operations, therapeutic units, and other operations heads to ensure optimum strategic consultancy to customers.
  • Provide internal and external strategic regulatory, statistical and pharmaceutical development-related educational services in support of all branches of IQVIA business.
  • Attend key scientific meetings/conferences and keep abreast of relevant scientific publications to maintain awareness of current scientific developments and progress in regulatory strategy.
  • As appropriate, represent IQVIA or the partner in such meetings.
  • Develop and maintain ongoing relationships with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, key opinion leaders.
  • Support policy initiatives within the organization
  • Compliance with all business office requirements for tracking time and effort.

Qualifications-

  • Bachelor’s Degree required or equivalent experience
  • 15+ years of relevant clinical research experience and/or regulatory experience with multi regional and global focus including significant experience in strategic role.
  • Required Broad Management and leadership knowledge to lead multiple job areas, the ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches.

  • Develop and modernize Java applications using microservices, APIs, containers, and Kubernetes/OpenShift.

  • Develop Generative AI applications using LLMs, vector databases, AI agents, and tool calling.
  • Implement CI/CD and GitOps workflows to automate application delivery and manage deployments.

  • Integrate on-premises models and cloud AI services into enterprise applications.
  • Collaborate with Senior Consultants, Architects, and customer technical teams.

The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. Key Responsibilities:

1. Corporate Strategy Development

  • Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.

2. Business Planning & Execution

  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.
  • Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.
  • Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

  • Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

  • Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.
  • Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.
  • Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.
  • Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.
  • Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

  • Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.
