jobs.title: Contract Operations Associate
jobs.excerpt: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform.
jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

  • Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.
  • Confirm the signed order form is complete: both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.
  • Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.
  • Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.
  • Verify approvals and required data: discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.
  • Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.
  • Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

  • Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.
  • Follow corrections through to completion: track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.
  • Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.
  • Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

  • Bring questions to the right person with full context: the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.
  • Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.
  • Track every open question until it's resolved, keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.
  • Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.
  • Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.
  • Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

  • Attention to detail: you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.
  • Process discipline: comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.
  • Clear, proactive communication: you ask questions early, write concise notes, and are comfortable working in Slack with a distributed team.
  • Collaborative and tactful: comfortable telling a sales rep or customer success manager their paperwork needs a fix, clearly and kindly, and working with them to get it right.
  • Follow-through: you keep track of open items and nudge politely until they're resolved.
  • Sound judgment about your limits: you recognize when something is unusual and escalate rather than guess.
  • Eagerness to learn: open to feedback and quick to pick up new systems and terminology.
  • Comfort with AI tools: willing to use AI-assisted tools as part of daily work and to verify their output.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM.
  • Familiarity with contracts, order forms, invoicing, or billing.
  • Prior experience in an operations, finance, or administrative role, or in a SaaS environment.
  • Coursework or interest in business, finance, accounting, or operations.
  • No prior Salesforce or revenue operations experience is required; we'll train you on our systems and procedures.

Engagement Details

  • Type: Contract
  • Hours: Part-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Reports to: Senior Director, Technical operations with day-to-day direction from the team's AI Operations Specialist
  • Compensation: $30/hr

Why This Role Matters

Contract reviews are the last checkpoint before a customer's billing and onboarding begin. By keeping this work accurate and on time, you protect the customer experience, reduce downstream cleanup for finance and customer success, and free up our specialists to build the automation and documentation that will make this process faster for everyone. That lets our teams spend more energy on what matters most: helping clinicians deliver excellent care.

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

Washington Rural Healthcare Quality, Compliance and Risk Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Washington to identify experienced leaders in quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, and regulatory readiness.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, and regulatory leadership opportunities across Washington.

These opportunities may include positions within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, community hospitals, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

This Is More Than a Compliance Role

In rural healthcare, quality, compliance, and risk leaders help protect patients, employees, and the long-term stability of the organization.

These professionals support safe care, strong systems, regulatory readiness, and a culture where concerns can be identified and addressed before they become larger problems.

The strongest leaders understand that quality and compliance are not simply about policies, audits, or survey preparation. They are about helping people do their best work, strengthening trust, improving outcomes, and making sure the organization can continue serving its community.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Quality Director or Manager
  • Compliance Officer
  • Director or Manager of Compliance
  • Risk Manager
  • Director of Risk Management
  • Patient Safety Director or Manager
  • Performance Improvement Director or Manager
  • Regulatory Affairs Director or Manager
  • Accreditation or Survey Readiness leadership
  • Infection Prevention Director or Manager
  • Privacy or Ethics leadership
  • Clinical Quality leadership
  • Quality Improvement Coordinator or Supervisor
  • Senior quality, compliance, risk, or regulatory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing leadership for quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, or regulatory programs
  • Supporting a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Monitoring quality indicators, patient outcomes, incidents, and performance trends
  • Leading investigations, root cause analyses, and corrective action planning
  • Developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and compliance programs
  • Supporting regulatory surveys, accreditation visits, audits, and readiness activities
  • Managing risk identification, reporting, mitigation, and follow-up
  • Supporting infection prevention and employee or patient safety initiatives
  • Educating employees and leaders on quality, compliance, privacy, and regulatory expectations
  • Partnering with clinical, operational, HR, finance, and executive teams
  • Preparing reports and recommendations for executive leadership and governing boards
  • Tracking improvement plans and helping departments sustain progress
  • Supporting grievance, complaint, incident, and event-review processes
  • Helping the organization respond to changing regulations and standards
  • Building systems that are practical, consistent, and understandable for employees

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive experience in healthcare quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, or regulatory affairs
  • Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, officer, supervisor, or comparable professional
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, quality improvement, and risk-management practices
  • Experience with audits, investigations, corrective action plans, or survey readiness
  • Strong analytical, communication, education, and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to work collaboratively across clinical and operational departments
  • Experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, public hospital districts, long-term care, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education, licensure, or certification based on the position
  • A practical, fair, and relationship-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may require or prefer credentials such as CPHQ, CHC, CHPC, CPPS, CIC, ARM, RN, or another quality, compliance, risk, privacy, safety, or clinical credential. Requirements will depend on the specific position.

Why Rural Washington?

Washington's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, islands, and coastlines. These organizations often operate with lean teams and broad responsibilities, making strong quality, compliance, and risk leadership especially important.

Working in this area within a rural organization offers the opportunity to create meaningful improvements, support employees directly, and help protect healthcare access for an entire community.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming quality, compliance, risk, patient safety, infection prevention, and regulatory leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Washington communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, position, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Work Where It Matters.

jobs.description:
Overview

Workforce Management Analyst

(Remote)

About Us:

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

Why Work at Matrix?

  • The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
  • A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
  • Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
  • Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

Responsibilities

About the role:

Type: Full Time, Salary

Compensation: $92,000-$138,000

Location: Fully Remote, must be in the United States

Hours: Full Time Days

Benefits Offered to include: Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

What to expect:

This role turns member demand into the production hours that deliver completed visits, and makes sure every hour Matrix plans foris delivered as planned. The person owns the outbound capacity model, issues the locked hours requirement to each BPO, and governs vendor workforce performance against the SOW. They are also the business owner of workforce management and outbound campaign strategy in Genesys Cloud.

The role starts with the contact center: learning how BPO capacity on Matrix's Genesys platform, the dialer and vendor performance drive completed visits. As that foundation is in place, scope expands to the other channels that generate visits, including text, IVR and print. After a 60–90 day ramp, the role holds bounded authority to reallocate volume across vendors and campaigns within the locked plan.

Key responsibilities

Demand-to-hours planning

  • Convert Enterprise Planning & Demand's forecast (required contacts and scheduled appointments by client, state and month) into production hours, using LCPH, contact rate, acceptance rate and dialable inventory.
  • Split required hours between inbound and outbound, and across each BPO.
  • Maintain the rolling 90-day plan and issue the 30-day locked hours requirement to each vendor monthly, by week and day-part.
  • Reconcile planned against actual hours weekly and report hours-requirement accuracy.
  • Check driven appointment volume against NP slot capacity with Clinical Operations before raising hours.

Vendor workforce governance

  • Measure staffed hours delivered by each vendor against the locked requirement, by week and interval, using Genesys data.
  • Enforce the SOW's workforce terms: interval staffing floor, billable hours cap, efficiency floor, adherence target, flex notices and overtime pre-authorization.
  • Reconcile invoiced payroll hours against Genesys login hours monthly, and document variances and credits owed.
  • Own the workforce measures in the joint vendor scorecard, and prepare workforce content for weekly reviews, monthly performance reviews and QBRs.
  • Track vendor attrition, ramp and hiring-wave delivery against plan.

Genesys Cloud workforce management (business owner)

  • Design the business unit and management unit structure (one unit per vendor), with adherence rules and permissions for each.
  • Define activity-code mapping so productive hours mean on-queue and campaign time, matching the SOW definition. Genesys defaults count meetings and training as work time.
  • Ensure every vendor's schedules exist in Genesys, built there or imported, so adherence is measured on Matrix's platform.
  • Own adherence, shrinkage and staffed-hours reporting from Genesys.
  • Use Genesys forecasting and capacity planning for inbound work such as member callbacks.

Outbound campaign strategy

  • Decide list segmentation and allocation by vendor and campaign. Each contact list runs on one campaign at a time, so list allocation is the main lever for splitting volume.
  • Set dialing mode, calling windows by member time zone, abandon-rate thresholds and attempt cadence within Matrix's dialer rules, including the 20-attempt annual cap.
  • Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
  • Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

Daily allocation and channel monitoring

  • Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
  • Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
  • Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
  • Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

Reporting and leadership support

  • Build and maintain the vendor scorecard and capacity dashboards in Power BI.
  • Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.
  • Contribute to ExCo materials, growing toward presenting portions of them.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in contact center workforce planning, capacity planning or operations analytics.
  • Direct experience with outbound dialer programs: pacing, list management, attempt strategy and calling-window compliance.
  • A track record of building capacity or demand models from first principles, not only maintaining inherited ones.
  • Experience governing outsourced or BPO capacity against SLAs, including hours, adherence and invoice reconciliation.
  • SQL and advanced Excel.
  • Ability to turn workforce data into recommendations that executives act on.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Genesys Cloud WFM and Outbound experience.
  • Python for modeling and automation.
  • Power BI or comparable dashboard development.
  • Healthcare or Medicare Advantage member outreach.
  • Multi-vendor BPO environments.
  • Working knowledge of TCPA and telemarketing calling rules.

Our Culture:

  • We have a clear vision of where we are going, and we are guided by core values that embody our organization and our culture.
  • We emphasizes innovation and growth, and you will be given the opportunities and tools to develop personally and professionally.
  • We encourage and celebrate collaboration.
  • We have a deep commitment to positively impact the communities in which we work and to make a difference in the lives of who we serve.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101827

Position Overview

At Autodesk, we empower our customers to make anything. As AI reshapes how people create, design, and work, we are advancing the next generation of Autodesk Assistant experiences across our products. Delivering a cohesive, high-quality experience at this scale requires exceptional program management embedded directly in the work.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Experience Program Manager to join the AEC Experience Foundations organization. This role will be deeply embedded with the Autodesk Assistant design team, working alongside designers and leadership to drive the day-to-day program, maintain clarity on priorities, and ensure work moves fluidly through the broader product development process.

You will be the connective tissue between Design and its partners across Product Management, Research, Engineering, Analytics, Content, and the broader Autodesk design ecosystem. You will participate directly in the team’s working rhythms, build a substantive understanding of the work, and connect signals across plans, decisions, dependencies, and teams. This is not a role focused simply on facilitating meetings or tracking milestones. Success requires understanding what the milestones mean, anticipating the impact of change, identifying risk early, and proactively bringing the right people together to keep the program moving.

Reporting to the Director of Experience Operations, you will work as part of a broader program management and operations team while remaining dedicated to Autodesk Assistant. You will also partner closely with operations leads to identify friction in the development process and help evolve the practices that enable Design to contribute effectively at scale in a rapidly changing AI landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the day-to-day design program for Autodesk Assistant, maintaining clear priorities, milestones, dependencies, capacity, design readiness, decisions, status, and risks across a complex, multi-product environment
  • Embed directly with designers and design leadership across planning sessions, stand-ups, design critiques, reviews, and share-outs; ensure these working rhythms are purposeful, effective, and evolve with the needs of the team
  • Build a deep working understanding of the program so you can connect decisions and signals across teams, identify downstream implications, surface conflicts or gaps, and proactively bring the right partners together to resolve them
  • Create strong connectivity between Design and Product Management, ensuring the design team has clear and current product priorities, roadmap context, requirements, and decision inputs needed to focus its work effectively
  • Coordinate design work through the broader product development process, partnering closely with Research, Engineering, Analytics, Content, and other program partners to ensure requirements, insights, dependencies, and deliverables move fluidly through the system
  • Anticipate program risks and friction before they become late-stage surprises; communicate impacts clearly, escalate through design leadership and the broader program team as appropriate, and drive follow-through on decisions and actions
  • Partner with Experience Operations and program counterparts to identify opportunities to improve development processes, team ceremonies, tools, and ways of working based on direct experience with the team and the work
  • Help the team balance near-term delivery with longer-term experience goals, supporting predictable execution while maintaining consistency and cohesion across Autodesk Assistant experiences
  • Keep user needs visible in product-development decisions by connecting research, analytics, and design intent into the program and making experience trade-offs explicit when business or technical constraints require them
  • Use AI fluently in your own work to improve quality and efficiency, and help identify opportunities for AI-enabled practices to increase the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of the design and product development process
  • Navigate Autodesk’s highly matrixed environment with urgency and initiative, building strong relationships across product teams, shared platforms, and the Autodesk design ecosystem, including partnership with the Weave design system team

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of experience in program management, design program management, product operations, or related roles supporting complex digital product development
  • Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional programs in large, matrixed organizations or similarly complex environments
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as an embedded program manager: close enough to the work to understand its substance, dependencies, and implications while maintaining the program systems required for reliable execution
  • Strong hands-on program management skills, including planning, milestone and dependency management, capacity and readiness tracking, risk management, decision tracking, status communication, and escalation
  • Working fluency with design and research processes, including design systems, prototypes, critical user journeys, qualitative research, testing, and the role of insight in product development. Design craft expertise is not required
  • Ability to work effectively with Product Management and Engineering partners and to understand technical constraints and concepts at the level needed to investigate implications, communicate dependencies, and connect technical decisions to the broader program
  • AI fluency, including regular use of AI tools to improve personal effectiveness and a demonstrated curiosity about how AI can improve product development practices, design workflows, quality, and scale
  • Excellent communication and synthesis skills, with the ability to translate complex and changing information into clear priorities, plans, risks, decisions, and executive-ready updates
  • Strong bias toward action, sense of urgency, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively build the relationships and context needed to move work forward

The Ideal Candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred or equivalent practical experience
  • Is a program manager at their core: proactive, deeply engaged in the work, and motivated by making complex teams and programs function exceptionally well
  • Understands the difference between tracking a milestone and understanding it, including why it matters, what it depends on, and what changes when it moves
  • Builds a mental map of the organization and knows how to find the right person, context, or decision quickly rather than waiting for direction
  • Is comfortable operating in ambiguity and rapid change, particularly in AI product development, while still creating enough structure for teams to execute predictably
  • Can move easily between detailed program mechanics and the broader product and experience context without losing sight of either
  • Brings a user-centered mindset to program decisions and helps ensure research, analytics, and experience quality remain part of the conversation alongside business and technical considerations
  • Brings adaptability and initiative: sees what needs attention, connects the right people, and follows through until the issue is resolved
  • Operates with low ego and high accountability, partnering effectively within a larger program management and operations team rather than working as a standalone function

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

Location Designation: Fully Remote

Job Title: New York Life Group Benefits Solutions (GBS) - Data Governance and Stewardship Leader

Location: Remote or Hybrid/Philadelphia, PA or New York Office
Reports To: GBS Business Data Strategy Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Business Overview:

The GBS Data Governance and Stewardship Leader will establish and scale a sustainable data governance framework as part of the Center of Excellence (COE). This role is responsible for driving data definitions and quality, delivering best‑practice training, and ensuring adherence to governance policies across the organization. As a key member of the COE Data & Analytics team, the leader will partner with IT and business teams to ensure that data can be trusted, remains secure, and is effectively leveraged to support strategic and operational decision‑making.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Data Governance and Stewardship professional to lead the development and execution of a data governance and management framework. This role ensures data consistency, compliance, and integrity across financial and operational domains, including Sales, Underwriting, Operations, Claims, Actuarial, and Finance.

Working closely with business leaders, technology teams, and data professionals, this role supports New York Life’s Data Strategy by enhancing data discoverability, quality, and compliance.

The leader will develop governance policies, standards, and best practices; drive stewardship and ownership across departments; and manage critical initiatives related to data classification, cataloging, quality, access, and usage. Additionally, this role monitors and reports on the performance and compliance of the overall data governance program, ensuring data is well organized, accessible, secure, and valuable.

What You'll Will Do:

  • Develop and lead the implementation of the data governance roadmap.
  • Play a key role in establishing an division-wide data governance framework, with a focus on governing data as an enterprise asset, addressing regulatory requirements, and protection of sensitive data through organizational behavior, policies and standards, governance metrics, processes, and related tools.
  • Support the mission and goals of the cross-functional Data Governance Council.
  • Collaborate with data product managers, SMEs, and engineers to capture business context, align it with technical architecture and strengthen metadata documentation.
  • Expand metadata repository to include source-to-target data lineage mapping and Business-friendly names for technical fields.
  • Drive adoption of governance tools through training sessions, user enablement, and data owner/steward playbooks.
  • Support Governance Technologies: Assist in the implementation and maintenance of platforms such as:
    • Data Catalog (e.g., Collibra, Atlan)
    • Master/Reference Data Management (MDM/RDM)
    • Data Quality tools

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Data Governance Strategy: Develop and execute a data governance framework that aligns with corporate priorities, regulatory compliance, and business needs.
  • Establish Data Stewardship: Build and manage a network of business and technical data stewards. Define roles, responsibilities, and operating procedures. Facilitate Data Stewardship meetings to drive adoption of standards and resolve issues.
  • Operationalize Data Governance: Help bring our Data Governance and Data Management framework to life by embedding best practices into project workflows and everyday work.
  • Organizational Alignment: Partner with New York Life’s Corporate Data Governance and Data Management teams to ensure alignment.
  • Ensure Data Quality & Integrity: Oversee data quality initiatives including management of consolidated data sets.
  • Enable Data Standardization: Provide data and business analysis support to harmonize data across the applications.
  • Data Ownership & Accountability: Promote accountability and best practices for data stewardship across the organization.
  • Policy and Standards Development: Establish data definitions, naming conventions, classification schemas, and metadata standards.
  • Regulatory and Risk Compliance: Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, FINRA, SOC 2, ERISA, GDPR, CCPA, NY DFS etc.).
  • Collaboration Across Functions: Serve as a liaison between Business and Technology to ensure that data related business requirements for governing data are clearly defined, communicated, and well understood and considered as part of operational prioritization and planning.
  • Tooling and Enablement: Assess and implement data governance technologies as needed and establish usage protocols.
  • Change Management: Lead communication, training, and engagement to cultivate a data ownership mindset across the organization.
  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor and measure the effectiveness and maturity of the data governance program, and report on key performance indicators and metrics.

What You'll Bring:

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in data governance, stewardship, or data management.
  • Proven experience leading data governance and management initiatives in complex environments.
  • Strong Insurance Industry Experience (Group Benefits Industry strongly preferred).
  • Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data quality frameworks, metadata management, and data classification.
  • Skilled in data lineage, master data management (MDM), and data cataloging tools.
  • Experience implementing and operating a data governance framework across business and technology.
  • Experience building governance in federated data environments and across complex/hybrid data ownership structures.
  • Strong experience in people and relationship management. Ability to effectively challenge all levels of an organization and offer value-add solutions to meet data governance objectives.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python and data modeling concepts. Working in Agile environments using Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with Atlan or similar metadata management tools. Familiarity with data quality and observability tools (e.g., Anomalo).

​

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $100,000-$143,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.
Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.
You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
  • Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
  • Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
  • Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
  • Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
  • Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
  • Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
  • Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

  • 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.
  • Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.
  • Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.
  • Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.
  • Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.
  • Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.
  • Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.
  • Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.
  • Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.
  • Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.
  • A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

As part of the M&S Software Engineering team, you'll be joining a well‑loved historic brand, working on solutions that serve millions of loyal customers and thousands of colleagues! With ethical values that run right through the company's core and technology leaders that truly understand software engineers and engineering, it's an exciting time as we're redefining ourselves into a digital‑first and engineering‑led organisation, with the quality of our engineering team being a key differentiator.

About the Role

The M&S Stock Domain team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. You will provide technical expertise, ship thoughtful solutions, and operate with excellence. Creative, curious and fearless, you will lead the modernisation of our order management software, to provide a seamless customer experience and enable the M&S online growth ambitions through a scalable, reliable, secure and cost-effective system.

The Stock team is on a multiyear journey to build the platforms and services that will manage how we track and move stock across our business – from suppliers to distribution centres to stores and digital channels. We sit at a critical junction in the retail ecosystem, and our ambition is to provide accurate, realtime stock visibility and availability so customers can get the products they want, when and where they want them. Our team is steadily evolving towards a future where reliable stock data and event streams power everything from forecasting and replenishment to digital experiences, all built on a robust, scalable stock platform.

In this role, you will play a key part in driving our ambition to create a best‑in‑class software engineering team, environment and culture. Join our community of engineers to help build a modern digital ecosystem, work with cutting‑edge technologies, and do the best work of your career.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve reliable data services – design and develop scalable, high‑performance pipelines and APIs in Java and Micronaut, integrating with event‑streaming platforms such as Kafka. Your work will ensure accurate, timely information reaches downstream systems and business users.

  • Own features end‑to‑end – take responsibility for everything from design through development, testing, deployment and production monitoring. You will balance delivery speed with sustainability, ensuring the platform remains maintainable over time.

  • Shape the technical direction of our Stock Platform – help design and evolve the services, APIs and event flows that power how we track and move stock across suppliers, distribution centres, stores and digital channels. You’ll craft solutions that balance data quality, integration reliability and operational resilience, using our modern toolchain (GitHub, CI/CD, observability and cloud infrastructure) to build a scalable stock platform that other teams can depend on.

  • Champion engineering excellence – write clean, maintainable, well‑tested code and help establish best practices across multiple teams. You will encourage a continuous improvement culture through code reviews, pair programming, and high‑quality documentation.

  • Drive operational excellence and observability – share responsibility for the reliability of our data integrations. Use observability tools such as Dynatrace to design for monitoring and alerting and participate in our support rota to ensure supply‑chain and pricing data remains accurate and available.

  • Collaborate widely – work closely with Product Managers, cross functional engineering teams and other Fulfilment teams to solve real business problems in thoughtful and innovative ways. Cross‑functional decision‑making and breaking down information silos are essential to shortening time to value.

  • Mentor and support colleagues – provide coaching and feedback to more junior engineers. Help grow our community of practice by sharing knowledge and fostering an inclusive environment.

Who you are

  • Experienced in data‑intensive distributed systems – 5+ years building and scaling services that handle large datasets, ideally serving millions of records or transactions. You understand both batch and event‑driven processing and can design systems that remain resilient at scale.

  • Skilled in JVM languages – proficient in one or more JVM‑based languages such as Java and Kotlin, ideally working with Micronaut, and comfortable writing clean, maintainable code.

  • DevOps and CI/CD practitioner – experienced in designing and running CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions) and driving improvements in developer productivity and release automation. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) helps automate repeatable infrastructure changes.

  • Cloud and data platform savvy – comfortable working in cloud environments (preferably Azure) and familiar with modern data processing and integration tools. Experience with Kafka for event streaming, SFTP for batch data ingestion, relational and NoSQL databases( MongoDB), and SaaS integrations for product lifecycle and pricing is highly valued. Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation with Terraform, is a plus.

  • Data modelling and integration expert – understand domain‑driven design, data contracts and schema evolution. You care about data quality and integrity and know how to integrate with third‑party systems without excessive customisation.

  • Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery – you can weigh long‑term architectural goals against immediate business needs, are sensitive to commercial impacts, and thrive in high‑autonomy teams.

  • Security and quality minded – experience using modern security and static‑analysis tools such as Snyk and Semgrep to identify vulnerabilities and enforce coding standards. A commitment to secure coding practices and compliance is essential.

  • Curious about AI‑assisted development – open to leveraging emerging tools like GitHub Copilot to enhance productivity and accelerate learning while maintaining code quality.

What’s in it for you

Being a part of M&S is exactly that – becoming a part and playing your part. We’re an inclusive, dynamic, exciting and always evolving business built on core values.
Here are some of the benefits we offer that make working for M&S just that little bit more special:

  • Attractive annual bonus, based on company performance and personal objectives.

  • Amazing perks and discounts via our M&S Choices website – including GymSave and the option to become an M&S Shareholder.

  • A very generous Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and Life Assurance.

  • Access to a fantastic range of wellbeing support – including our 24/7 Virtual GP and other wellbeing schemes.

Everyone’s Welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. Serve as the enterprise design authority for Workday PSA. Lead solution architecture across Projects, Project Billing, Customer Contracts, Customer Accounts, Time Tracking, Expenses, Revenue Management, Accounts Receivable, and Collections. Lead technical solutioning for major PSA initiatives from discovery and process design through configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and transition to steady state support. Partner with Workday Financials and HCM architects to ensure PSA designs align with the broader Workday platform, enterprise architecture, chart of accounts, organizational structures, worker data, and time entry requirements. Architect and oversee integrations between Workday PSA and adjacent platforms, including CRM, contract lifecycle management, ERP, tax, banking, data warehouses, reporting, payroll, and other enterprise applications. Own data integrity and control design across customer, contract, project, worker, time, billing, revenue, invoice, and receivables data, with clear reconciliation and auditability. Support the Workday security build, including security groups, domain and business process policies, role assignments, access controls, and separation of responsibilities. Lead reporting and analytics architecture using Workday report writing, calculated fields, dashboards, worksheets, and downstream data platforms to support operational and executive decision making. Evaluate Workday releases and new PSA capabilities, assess business and technical impacts, oversee regression testing, and guide adoption decisions. Provide support for complex production issues, root-cause analysis, defect resolution, and business critical support while strengthening preventive controls. Partner with application management service providers, implementation partners, and internal teams to establish clear delivery responsibilities, quality standards, documentation, knowledge transfer, and support boundaries. Support training, change management, and adoption by helping collaborators understand solution design, process impacts, controls, and new ways of working. Balance global standards with regional and business requirements, designing solutions that are scalable across countries, legal entities, currencies, tax regimes, and professional services business models. Play a central role in finance and operations transformation by simplifying fragmented processes, strengthening controls, improving data quality, and enabling more consistent client and colleague experiences. Operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership in a fast paced, matrixed environment, explaining complex designs, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs to both technical and business audiences. Influence platform strategy, sequencing, and investment decisions while remaining close enough to the technology to validate designs and solve difficult problems. Skills and experience that will lead to success Extensive hands-on experience architecting, configuring, and supporting Workday PSA and related Workday Financials capabilities in a complex global environment. 7+ years of demonstrated experience with enterprise financial systems or professional services technology, including 5+ years of Workday Financials and PSA implementation, configuration, architecture, or consulting experience. Deep functional knowledge of Workday Projects, Project Billing, Customer Contracts, Customer Accounts, Revenue Management, Time Tracking, Expenses, Accounts Receivable, Collections, and related accounting processes. Demonstrated success designing scalable global solutions for project-to-cash or order-to-cash processes across multiple countries, legal entities, currencies, and business models. Strong Workday configuration expertise, including business processes, condition rules, validations, calculated fields, custom reports, dashboards, worksheets, security, and release management. Solid understanding of financial controls, data governance, reconciliation, auditability, and segregation of duties. Experience leading testing strategy and execution across unit, end-to-end, integration, regression, user acceptance, and post-production validation. Experience working with implementation partners and application management service providers, including design review, quality assurance, delivery governance, and knowledge transfer. Good sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to lead architecture and delivery decisions through ambiguity. Solid ability to translate business needs into technical builds and clearly explain complex options and tradeoffs. Demonstrable ability to lead and influence multi-functional, global initiatives without direct authority. Ability to build trusted partnerships with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Commercial, HR, Data, Risk, Audit, and Technology collaborators. Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve design conflicts, and maintain momentum across concurrent projects and operational commitments. Experience mentoring team members and raising the quality and consistency of solution design and delivery practices. Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Ability to connect PSA technology decisions to business outcomes such as billing accuracy, revenue integrity, cash collection, utilization visibility, operational efficiency, and client service. Experience defining platform roadmaps, governance models, architecture principles, and release strategies. Strategic, systems thinking attitude with strong architecture capabilities and a focus on scalability, standardization, control, and user experience. Curiosity about emerging Workday capabilities, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled opportunities that can improve professional services operations and finance processes. Comfort operating in an environment passionate about delivering clear results, defined service responsibilities, and ongoing improvement. Workday Pro Financials certification preferred; current Workday Financials and PSA certifications are highly desirable. Advanced knowledge of professional services, project accounting, order-to-cash, billing, revenue recognition, and accounts receivable processes preferred. Experience with global Workday deployments and complex matrixed organizations strongly preferred. PMP, Agile, or related delivery certification preferred.   • Document patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons learned for broad internal reuse.
  • Stay current with LLM capabilities, tooling, and research, and translate advances into practical guidance.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of software engineering experience, with significant time on LLM-based applications.

  • Deep familiarity with modern LLM APIs and agent frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Experience designing evaluation pipelines for non-deterministic systems.
  • Strong Python skills and comfort with modern application frameworks.
  • Solid grasp of responsible AI principles, including safety and policy considerations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Public writing, talks, or open-source contributions on LLM application development.
  • Experience with multi-agent architectures and complex tool-use systems.
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning workflows and when to choose them over prompting.

  • Experience integrating LLMs into enterprise software systems with strict compliance requirements.

About RudderStack

RudderStack helps companies build on top of their own data. Our warehouse-native Customer Data Platform enables engineering, data, and AI teams to collect, unify, govern, and activate customer data while maintaining full ownership and control. By running directly on top of the customer's cloud data warehouse or lakehouse, RudderStack reduces data movement, improves governance, lowers infrastructure costs, and accelerates modern data and AI initiatives.

Leading companies including Lovable, Jaguar Land Rover, and Foot Locker trust RudderStack to power mission-critical customer data infrastructure.

EMEA is a critical part of that next chapter, and this hire will help define it.

About the role

This is a role for someone who enjoys ownership. You'll cover the EMEA region across both inbound and outbound, with proven processes and playbooks to start from, and the freedom to own your territory and bring your own ideas. You'll research target accounts, reach the right people with relevant outreach, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

You'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations. Our SDRs use AI research tools, intent data, and automation to handle the repetitive work, so you can spend more time on account research and real conversations. You'll learn how modern data infrastructure works and how technical buyers make decisions, which gives you a clear path into an Account Executive role.

  • Own your EMEA territory across inbound and outbound, including account plans, sequences, and messaging.

  • Research target accounts and buying committees across Data, Engineering, Analytics, Platform, AI, and Marketing teams.

  • Follow up quickly on inbound leads, product sign-ups, and intent signals, and qualify them before handoff.
  • Use AI research and writing tools, intent data, and sequencing platforms to work more accounts with better context.
  • Partner with Account Executives on account plans and with Marketing on campaigns and events.

  • Share what you hear from prospects so Sales, Marketing, and Product can sharpen messaging and targeting.

  • Curiosity about how technical products work and why companies buy them.
  • Comfort moving between technical and business conversations, from data engineers to marketing and MarTech leaders.
  • Comfort learning technical concepts such as data pipelines, cloud data warehouses, and APIs well enough to hold a credible first conversation.
  • Daily use of AI tools to research, draft, or organize work, with judgment about when the output needs your own edit.
  • Organization and follow-through: you plan your day, track your numbers, and adjust when something isn't working.
  • Resilience with rejection and a habit of asking for feedback.
  • Integrity in how you represent RudderStack to prospects and teammates.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience prospecting into engineering, data, marketing, or MarTech buyers.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, dbt, or other modern data tools.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo or Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or intent tools such as 6sense.

Extra Notes

If your experience isn't a perfect match for the job description, but you're still a good fit for the role, apply. We want to work with smart people who are good at their job, and, a lot of times, those people have non-linear career paths.

jobs.excerpt: deine aufgabenDu erkennst einen schwerwiegenden Fail schon beim Lesen des Inspektionsberichts und weißt, wie du ein Problem in der Produktion sauber löst, ohne den Liefertermin aus den Augen zu verlieren?
jobs.description:
deine aufgaben

Du erkennst einen schwerwiegenden Fail schon beim Lesen des Inspektionsberichts und weißt, wie du ein Problem in der Produktion sauber löst, ohne den Liefertermin aus den Augen zu verlieren? Als Quality Control Manager:in steuerst du unsere Inspektionen bei Lieferanten im Ausland, briefst unser eigenes QC-Team vor Ort sowie externe Dienstleister und sorgst dafür, dass Qualität an allen Standorten gleich bewertet wird. Du wertest Prüfberichte aus, triffst Entscheidungen bei Abweichungen und klärst Qualitätsmängel gemeinsam mit unseren Lieferanten bis zum Abschluss. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Supply Chain und Product Development zusammen und hältst Head QM mit den wichtigsten Kennzahlen auf dem Laufenden.
Wenn du Lust hast, die Qualität in einem schnell wachsenden House of Brands mitzugestalten und dich in der internationalen Kommunikation mit Lieferanten wohl fühlst, freuen wir uns auf dich!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Inspektionsplanung: Du gleichst Inspektionstermine mit den Produktionsplänen unserer Lieferanten ab, planst die Kapazitäten unseres QC-Teams in China und Pakistan sowie unserer Third-Party-Dienstleister ein und stellst alle Unterlagen bereit, von Spezifikationen über Checklisten bis zu AQL-Level.
  • Steuerung von QC-Team & Dienstleistern: Du briefst unsere Mitarbeitenden vor Ort und externe Inspektionsfirmen, klärst Rückfragen und stellst sicher, dass an allen Standorten mit derselben Prüftiefe gearbeitet wird.
  • Auswertung von Inspektionsberichten: Du prüfst Reports, bewertest die Ergebnisse als Pass, Fail oder Pending und erstellst Entscheidungsvorlagen, wenn eine Abweichung nicht eindeutig ist.
  • Fail-Management: Bei Fails klärst du die Ursachen mit unseren Lieferanten, legst entsprechende Maßnahmen fest und verfolgst die Umsetzung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Schnittstellen: Du informierst Supply Chain über Inspektionstermine und mögliche Auswirkungen auf Liefertermine und bindest Product Development bei wiederkehrenden Qualitätsthemen ein.
  • KPI-Reporting: Du behältst die wichtigsten KPIs im Blick und berichtest diese regelmäßig an unsere Head of QM.

dein profil

  • Ausbildung: Du bist staatlich geprüfte:r Bekleidungstechniker:in oder hast einen Bachelor in Textil- und Bekleidungstechnik. Alternativ bringst du eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung mit nachweisbarer Erfahrung in Textil-QC oder Sourcing mit. Eine Weiterbildung im Qualitätsmanagement, z. B. eine AQL- oder Inspektionsschulung, ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung: Du hast fundierte Jahre Erfahrung in Qualitätskontrolle, Sourcing oder Produktion im Textil- bzw. Bekleidungsumfeld und idealerweise schon direkt mit Produktionsstätten oder Inspektionsdienstleistern in Asien zusammengearbeitet. Disziplinarische Führungserfahrung ist nicht zwingend, Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Teams oder externen Partnern aus der Ferne aber ein deutliches Plus.
  • Prüfmethodik: Du kennst AQL-Stichprobenverfahren nach ISO 2859-1, Inspektionsarten wie DUPRO, PSI und Container Loading Check sowie die Fehlerklassifizierung in critical, major und minor. Du hast Grundwissen zu Maschenware und Konfektion und kannst cut and sewn von seamless unterscheiden. Erfahrung mit Lingerie, Socken, Swimwear oder Sleepwear sowie mit Messtechnik für Passform ist ein Plus.
  • Lieferanten- & Prozesswissen: Du verstehst Produktionsabläufe in China und/oder Pakistan, kennst Lieferantenaudits wie BSCI und hast bereits Reklamationen und Kostenclaims bearbeitet.
  • Tools: Du bist sicher in Excel bzw. Google Sheets, arbeitest mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Asana und erstellst KPI-Reportings. Kenntnisse in Looker Studio, SQL/BigQuery, PLM-Systemen wie Delogue oder Inspektionsplattformen wie Qarma, QIMA oder Bureau Veritas sind ein Plus.
  • Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und respektvoll mit Kolleg:innen, Dienstleistern und Lieferanten aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen, sprichst verhandlungssicher Englisch (C1-C2) und bleibst bei Fails konsequent.
  • Organisation & Entscheidungsstärke: Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Inspektionen, verschiedenen Zeitzonen und kurzfristigen Terminverschiebungen den Überblick, findest bei Problemen schnell pragmatische Lösungen zwischen Qualität und Liefertermin und weißt, wann du an Head QM eskalierst.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du arbeitest remote und bist bereit, ca. einmal im Monat zu unserem Lager innerhalb Deutschlands zu fahren. Gelegentlich stehen außerdem Reisen zu unseren Lieferanten an, unter anderem nach China.

warum wir?

Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

  • Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst.
  • Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt: Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget.
  • Echte Flexibilität: Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.
  • Onboarding: Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.
  • Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.
  • Einfach (dir) mal was Gutes tun: Ob „Social Day“, um dich sozial zu engagieren, oder „Power Days“, wenn die Periode mal richtig zuschlägt – diese Tage gibt es on top zu deinem Urlaub.
  • Alle zusammen: Wir sind ein Team aus A-Playern, die nach Wachstum streben, und leben den Team-Spirit bei unseren grandiosen SNOCKS Group Events oder einfach beim nächsten After-Work.
  • Office-Leben: Bei uns wird’s nie langweilig: ob Tischtennis, Fifa oder Mario Kart nach der Arbeit, gemeinsames Kochen und Lunch, frisches Obst, Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine oder die Müsli-Bar. Und das Beste: Dein Haustier darf natürlich auch mit ins Office!
  • Wir kleiden dich ein: Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.

We believe that games that deliver the most fun-per-minute have the highest chance of success. We are a start-up and not a big company, which means we’re a bit scrappy but we’re resourceful, highly collaborative and focused on outcomes and shipping builds over process and meetings.

We aim to hire multi-talented individuals who can operate autonomously and at speed, with every role at the studio being hands-on working directly on our games.

Role Overview

We’re looking to bring on a Senior Tech/VFX Artist for a 6 month contract, with potential to extend further depending on how things go.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Artist that has strong experience creating VFX and development tools to contribute to art production on an exciting unannounced co-op combat game, and support Tech Art on multiple projects across the studio.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Own VFX and Technical Art

You’ll mainly be making the VFX for the game, as well as identifying and creating solutions and tools where needed to speed up the art development pipeline.

Success looks like:

  • Owning the VFX pipeline and crafting fun, playful and physical visuals for a combat heavy game
  • Using VFX to clearly communicate gameplay, impacts and player feedback
  • Grasping the project art style and technical requirements and adapting quickly
  • Identifying repetitive or inefficient workflows and building lightweight tools, automation and procedural solutions to speed up content production

2 - Be a Force Multiplier, Not Just an Asset Maker

There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.

Success looks like:

  • Communicating and collaborating across disciplines, problem-solving the gaps between art, design and engineering
  • Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art
  • Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed
  • Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine

You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.

Success looks like:

  • Importing, setting up and hooking up assets
  • Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc
  • Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine
  • Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions
  • Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

  • Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility.

  • Bonus skills: Shader creation, Rigging, Animation Implementation / Set Up, C# Scripting

  • Affiliate-driven sales growing month over month across channels
  • Program profitability after samples, commissions, retainers, and product costs
  • Growth in sales from our top affiliates
  • Creators posting consistently and growing their results under your coaching
  • A program that runs on systems, not on one person

You are a clear communicator who can build trust fast. You care about excellence, follow through, and data driven decisions. You understand affiliate marketing and know how to motivate creators without hand holding. You thrive on structure, relationships, and momentum.

  • Built and scaled an affiliate or creator program for at least one other e-commerce brand, and you can show the numbers

jobs.description:
Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand committed to making early learning engaging, screen-free, and fun. Our journey began with hand-drawn educational tools and has grown into a beloved brand, trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. We design developmentally sound products for children ages 3 to 8, such as educational posters, busy books, and emotional learning kits. Our mission is to create tools that help children thrive through connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our vision is bold. We want to become the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes and passed down for generations, and we are building toward $100M in revenue by 2030.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Director of Ecommerce to own our Shopify business as its general manager. You will own the Shopify P&L and the growth engine that feeds it, from paid acquisition and creative testing to offers, funnels, and lifecycle marketing, and you will build the team and systems that let the channel scale without the founder in the day to day.

Shopify is our dominant D2C channel, and it does not stand alone. Our Amazon team owns Amazon, and TikTok Shop is an important part of our ecosystem. You will see the whole customer life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the halo our launches create on Amazon and how acquisition converts there, and you will connect the dots so a launch lifts all three.

Your target is to scale our direct-to-consumer business to $20M+ in profitable revenue, with a net margin of at least 15% on Shopify.

You will work closely with our CEO, partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts both channels, and lead our ecommerce team.

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Own Shopify revenue and profitability, with a net profit margin of at least 15%.
  • Customer acquisition. Run Meta and other paid media to unit economics, with a Meta ROAS of at least 2.5, and keep a high-velocity creative testing rhythm fed by our AI content engine, creator video, UGC, and in-house production.
  • Offers, funnels, and CRO. Launch new funnels that meet our KPI thresholds every month, build bundles and ascension paths, and keep homepage, collection, and product pages aligned with what converts.
  • Lifecycle and LTV. Drive email and SMS to at least 25% of Shopify revenue through Klaviyo and Postscript, and keep the 30-day GPLTV to CAC ratio above 3.
  • Channel connection. Partner with our Amazon team so every launch lifts Amazon too, understand TikTok Shop's place as a social-commerce channel, and keep each channel's role in the customer journey deliberate.
  • Team leadership. Lead our ecommerce operators with clear ownership, weekly operating rhythms, and scorecards, and bring in freelancers and contractors as output grows.
  • Reporting. Deliver a weekly scorecard and P&L review, and a monthly plan and forecast for the CEO.
  • Systems and compliance. Document a playbook for every working funnel, keep the store and ads compliant, and turn repeat work into AI-assisted workflows.
  • Brand. Protect and build what the brand stands for in every ad, page, and customer touchpoint.

How Success Is Measured

  • Profitable growth in Shopify revenue against the plan
  • Net profit margin of at least 15% on Shopify
  • Meta ROAS of at least 2.5
  • Email and SMS at 25% or more of Shopify revenue
  • 30-day GPLTV to CAC above 3
  • A team and operating rhythm that run without daily founder involvement

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a high ownership leader who thinks like a general manager, not just a marketer. You are energized by building systems, leading people, and owning outcomes.

  • You have 5 to 10+ years of experience scaling DTC ecommerce brands on Shopify with paid social.
  • You have a proven track record growing brands beyond $20M in revenue.
  • You have owned a P&L and hit revenue and profit targets.
  • You understand the full D2C life cycle across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop, including the Amazon halo, and you have run or worked alongside social commerce, not Shopify alone.
  • You have built and led a team, and the people who worked for you will say so.
  • You are deeply fluent in Meta ads and high-velocity creative testing, including AI-assisted creative pipelines.
  • You are hands-on with Shopify, Klaviyo, and Postscript.
  • You understand bundles, upsells, and LTV, and you can write and review a landing page that converts.
  • You are comfortable leading a remote team with weekly cadences.
  • You use AI every day to get more done with less. That is a capability, not a particular tool, and it is a must-have here. You also work inside a CRM and documented SOPs, and you want to build how we use all three now and going forward.

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

You will have real ownership. Real trust. And real impact. Hadley Designs is a remote first company built on autonomy, creativity, and accountability. You will work closely with our CEO and a leadership team that moves fast and expects results.

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process

Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today

If you are ready to own the growth of a brand families love, we would love to hear from you. Apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Ecommerce.

P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.
