jobs.title: Customer Service Analytics & Insights Analyst
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


Summary

The CS Analytics & Insights Analyst combines two areas of work within Customer Service (CS). The first is demand forecasting judgment: interpreting the output of the CS demand forecast, applying informed overlays for events the model cannot yet see, explaining variances, and pfroviding the final demand outlook used for staffing decisions. The second is CS Insights: using contact-driver analysis, customer-experience data and conversation analysis to explain why customers contact CS and where the opportunities are.

The two areas reinforce each other. Contact-driver insights improve the forecast, and forecast variances point to the questions insights work should investigate. This is an analytical and operational role; forecasting tools and statistical models are maintained by partner teams. This role focuses on data and insight generated through Customer Service, and works alongside enterprise consumer-insights teams rather than in place of them.

Responsibilities


Forecasting judgment

  • Interpret the CS demand forecast: review model output, identify where human judgment or overrides are warranted, and document the rationale.
  • Build overlays and scenarios for known upcoming events (product launches, pricing and policy changes, live events, outages, marketing activity, market-specific anomalies) and quantify likely demand ranges.
  • Perform forecast variance and root-cause analysis to understand not only how far the forecast missed but why, and identify systematic bias by market, channel, contact driver, horizon or event type.
  • Share learnings with the teams that maintain the forecasting tools, and translate operational context into clear requirements for improvement.
  • Maintain the forecasting calendar, assumptions, event inputs and forecast-accuracy measures.
  • Provide the final demand outlook to Workforce Management and Capacity Planning partners, including assumptions about GenAI deflection and contact mix.
  • Identify repeatable preparation, validation and QA work that can be automated.

CS Insights

  • Conduct CS contact-driver and customer-experience analysis to explain demand shifts, emerging friction points and the effect of product, pricing and policy changes on CS contacts.
  • Support launch tracking and post-launch evaluation, and deliver recurring insights through templates and reports.
  • Work with CS vendor partners to execute routine research tasks, provide clear instructions, and review outputs for quality.
  • Contribute quantitative analysis, and over time qualitative and mixed-methods work, to research projects scoped with the CS Analytics & Insights Lead.
  • Use GenAI and conversation-intelligence tools to analyze contacts at scale and surface emerging issues.
  • Package findings into clear stories and recommendations for CS leadership and cross-functional partners.

Across both areas

  • Partner with Data Analysts on data requirements, datasets and dashboards that support forecasting and insights work.
  • Support Streaming, Player Support and Games Moderation business units.
  • Share coverage and best practices with fellow analysts on the team.
  • Use GenAI tools as a standard part of how work is done, and continually look for ways to redesign forecasting and insights workflows around them.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years in analytics, customer insights, research, forecasting, workforce management or contact-center analytics, with a record of turning data into recommendations.
  • Proficiency in SQL and spreadsheet modeling, and the ability to interrogate a model or dataset rather than accept its output at face value.
  • Working understanding of forecasting concepts such as seasonality, event impacts, workload and forecast accuracy, or the ability to learn them quickly.
  • Experience analyzing customer or CS contact data to identify drivers, trends and root causes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining forecast changes and research findings to non-technical and senior audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience applying GenAI tools in analytical work.

Preferred

  • Direct experience owning or interpreting a contact-center demand forecast (interval, daily or weekly), including AHT and workload.
  • Experience with modern forecasting tools, or Python/R beyond spreadsheet-based forecasting.
  • Background combining forecasting with customer insights or research, with a strong foundation in statistics.
  • Experience with qualitative or mixed-methods research, or with GenAI/NLP analysis of unstructured customer data.
  • Experience in outsourced or multi-vendor contact-center environments.

The range for this role is $150,000.00 - $230,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

jobs.excerpt: Capricor Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CAPR) is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing transformative cell and exosome-based therapies for rare diseases.
jobs.description:
Capricor Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CAPR) is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing transformative cell and exosome-based therapies for rare diseases. At the forefront of our innovation is Deramiocel (CAP-1002), our lead cell therapy in late-stage development for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. We are also harnessing our proprietary StealthX™ exosome platform to unlock new possibilities in targeted delivery and vaccinology. Every program reflects our commitment to pushing the boundaries of science and delivering life-changing treatments to patients and families who need them most.

The Senior Director, Head of Patient Services will lead the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Capricor's U.S. patient services organization in support of the anticipated launch of deramiocel, Capricor's lead cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. This leader will establish a high-touch, compliant, and scalable support model that helps patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and treatment centers navigate access, affordability, and treatment initiation.

This is a hands-on launch leadership role with end-to-end accountability for patient services strategy, hub operations, affordability programs, site-of-care coordination, vendor performance, data and reporting, and team development. The position will partner closely with Market Access, Trade and Distribution, Commercial Operations, Finance, Medical, Quality, IT, Legal, and Compliance, as well as external hub, specialty pharmacy, distribution, and treatment-center partners.

Responsibilities

    Patient Services Strategy and Operating Model

  • Develop and execute the U.S. patient services strategy and launch-readiness plan, with clear milestones, decision points, risks, and accountabilities.
  • Build and lead an integrated patient support model spanning referral and enrollment, benefits investigation, prior authorization and appeal support, case management, affordability, treatment coordination, and ongoing patient support.
  • Map, standardize, and continuously improve the patient and caregiver journey to reduce access friction and support timely, coordinated treatment initiation.
  • Establish governance, escalation pathways, business continuity plans, and service standards across internal teams and external partners.

    • Hub, Access, and Affordability Operations

  • Lead the implementation and day-to-day oversight of hub and other patient services vendors, including workflow design, staffing assumptions, training, quality controls, and operational escalation.
  • Design and manage financial assistance and affordability programs, subject to applicable legal and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Market Access and field reimbursement colleagues to align patient services workflows with payer policies, reimbursement requirements, and access pathways.

    • Site-of-Care and Treatment Coordination

  • Lead patient services support for treatment-center onboarding and readiness, in coordination with Medical, Commercial, and operational partners.
  • Define clear handoffs among the hub, treatment centers, specialty pharmacy and distribution partners, field teams, patients, and caregivers.
  • Develop escalation protocols for access barriers, incomplete referrals, scheduling delays, treatment-center capacity constraints, and other launch-critical issues.
  • Support a consistent, high-touch experience for patients and caregivers before, during, and after treatment initiation, within the approved program scope.

    • Data and Performance Management

  • Lead vendor implementation, budget management, and ongoing business reviews in partnership with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and IT.
  • Establish service-level agreements, key performance indicators, quality measures, and launch-readiness dashboards that provide timely visibility into patient access, operational performance, patient experience, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with Commercial Operations and IT to define data requirements, integrations, reporting cadence, privacy controls, and issue-resolution processes across the vendor ecosystem.
  • Use operational insights to identify root causes, drive corrective actions, and continuously improve program effectiveness and scalability.

    • Compliance, Quality, and Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, training materials, and documentation standards for patient- and provider-facing activities.
  • Ensure patient services programs operate in alignment with applicable regulatory, legal, privacy, quality, and compliance requirements and Capricor policies.
  • Partner with Quality and Compliance on monitoring, auditing, deviation management, corrective actions, and vendor oversight, as appropriate.
  • Maintain inspection-ready documentation and promote a culture of patient focus, accountability, and disciplined execution.

    • Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the patient services organization, including future roles supporting treatment-center onboarding, nurse education, patient engagement, and reimbursement coordination, as business needs evolve.
  • Own workforce planning, role design, hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management to support launch readiness and post-launch scale.
  • Set clear objectives and operating norms, develop team capabilities, and foster effective collaboration across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serve as the senior internal subject-matter expert for patient services and provide concise updates, recommendations, and risk assessments to executive leadership.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the scope and seniority of the role.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Progressive experience in patient services, hub operations or a related function within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success building, launching, or scaling patient support programs for rare disease, specialty, or other complex therapies.
  • Deep working knowledge of benefits investigation, prior authorization and appeals processes, case management, affordability programs, and the operational realities of patient access.
  • Experience managing external vendors, budgets, contracts, implementation plans, service levels, and performance improvement.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate strategy into detailed execution.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment with evolving priorities and a high degree of accountability.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree or clinical credential, such as an MBA, MPH, RN, PharmD, or comparable qualification.
  • Experience with cell therapy, gene therapy, infused products, or other therapies requiring coordinated treatment-center readiness and high-touch patient support.
  • Experience establishing patient services capabilities from the ground up in a pre-commercial or early-commercial biotechnology company.
  • Familiarity with rare-disease patient communities, caregiver needs, and family-centered support models.
  • Experience with patient services technology, data integrations, dashboards, privacy requirements, and operational analytics.

Core Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Vendor management and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and documentation discipline.
  • Ability to influence without authority and collaborate effectively across functions.

Why Capricor?

Capricor Therapeutics is advancing cell and exosome-based therapies with a focus on serious diseases where patients and families need new treatment options. Our work is grounded in scientific rigor, collaboration, and a shared commitment to moving meaningful therapies forward. Joining Capricor means being part of a mission-driven team working at the intersection of innovation, execution, and patient impact.

Come Work With Us

At Capricor, you’ll join a collaborative environment where employees are encouraged to contribute, grow, and help build the systems, science, and operations needed to support our next stage of growth. We value people who are thoughtful, accountable, hands-on, and motivated by work that can make a real difference.

Job Title: Software Development Ops Engineer - Cloud Applications
Job Location: Remote (Toronto, ON)

Job Type: T4 Contract

Experience: 5+ Years

Rate: CAD 45 - 50 per hour

Role Summary: NearSource is seeking a Software Development Ops Engineer - Cloud Applications with strong software engineering and DevOps experience to maintain, secure, and support cloud-based and desktop software applications. The role focuses on cloud infrastructure management, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, technical documentation, software troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of deployment and maintenance processes.

About the Project: The role supports software products that enable customers to visualize 3D models in virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR). These products include cloud and web components for model uploading, processing, browsing, and synchronization, along with multiplayer capabilities and Unity clients for VR experiences across multiple devices.

The selected candidate will collaborate with Infrastructure, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to maintain reliable software operations, improve system documentation, and strengthen DevOps practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain cloud-based and desktop software products in collaboration with Infrastructure and Engineering teams, ensuring security, stability, and compliance with applicable Autodesk Platform policies.
  • Support the Customer Success team by troubleshooting customer-reported issues and implementing software fixes, patches, and maintenance updates.
  • Analyze the end-to-end architecture of supported products and reverse-engineer existing systems to create comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure and maintain CI/CD pipelines in alignment with established DevOps best practices.
  • Execute regular software patching, security updates, and performance tuning to maintain application reliability.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of deployment processes and software delivery workflows.
  • Document system architecture, operational processes, and maintenance procedures to improve knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
  • Take ownership of ongoing software support, infrastructure maintenance, and operational reliability for the supported products.

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field.
  • Experience working with full-stack models, services, and cloud deployment.
  • Proficiency in either Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Experience understanding and working with full-stack software using Go, JavaScript, and React.
  • Proficiency in databases, specifically NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and MongoDB.
  • Experience with either Jenkins or Buildkite for CI/CD.
  • Experience with DevOps tools, including Docker, Terraform, and Linux.
  • Proficiency in Git and knowledge of GitHub.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and the ability to maintain desktop and cloud-based software applications.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with a self-starter mindset.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field.
  • Proficiency in both Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Experience with C# for desktop application development.
  • Proficiency in gRPC and Protocol Buffers (Protobuf).
  • Basic experience with the Unity game engine.
  • Experience with TestFlight.
  • Knowledge of software installers.
  • Knowledge of Jenkins, Buildkite, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Electron.

Top 3 Must-Haves

  • Infrastructure and DevOps expertise: Demonstrated experience with AWS and/or GCP, including cloud infrastructure management and DevOps best practices.
  • Software engineering and application maintenance: Familiarity with understanding, supporting, and maintaining desktop and cloud-based software applications.
  • Ownership and independent execution: Evidence of a self-starter mindset and ownership of software support, maintenance, and DevOps responsibilities across multiple products.

Apply now, or share your resume with salary expectations at . Thank you for considering a career with us! Once you submit your application, our Talent Acquisition team will review your resume thoroughly. If there's a strong match, we'll reach out to discuss your experience, role details, benefits, compensation, and next steps. While we strive for transparency, we may not be able to respond to every applicant due to high volume, but we genuinely appreciate your time and interest

jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

The opportunity

Build the machine learning capabilities that help advertisers understand what they could achieve on Reddit and make better investment decisions.

You will lead models that estimate how campaign outcomes could change with different budgets, bids, audiences, creative performance, or objectives. The work connects supply and demand forecasting, audience availability, response prediction, and marketplace simulation to help advertisers compare alternatives and recognize valuable opportunities they may be missing.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role with ownership of modeling direction, evaluation standards, and reusable production capabilities across advertiser planning and recommendations.

What you’ll do

  • Lead forecasting and scenario modeling. Translate advertiser questions into models of delivery, reach, performance, and investment tradeoffs. Set technical direction and guide execution across the team.
  • Connect inventory, demand, and response. Combine forecasts of available advertising opportunities, audience activity, marketplace competition, and predicted response to estimate achievable delivery and performance.
  • Estimate outcomes under alternative choices. Develop models that account for changes in budget, bid, audience, and optimization objective, including interactions among these choices, auction dynamics, and campaign constraints.
  • Quantify unrealized opportunity. Incorporate creative-performance estimates from partner teams to assess how stronger creative could have improved campaign results. Translate those inputs into potential gains in delivery, efficiency, or advertiser value.
  • Build models that generalize. Apply probabilistic forecasting, multitask learning, transfer learning, hierarchical modeling, or related approaches to handle sparse segments, cold start, delayed feedback, and changing conditions.
  • Establish trustworthy comparisons. Evaluate numerical accuracy, calibration, uncertainty, and cohort-level performance. Define supported scenarios and identify when additional evidence or experimentation is needed.
  • Close the learning loop. Compare recorded predictions with mature outcomes, diagnose systematic errors, and validate scenario estimates through experiments and observed results.

  • Strong judgment in evaluation, including temporal validation, calibration, segment-level performance, and the assumptions required to estimate outcomes under changed conditions.

Preferred experience

  • Scenario evaluation: Counterfactual or off-policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation, or composition of multiple predictive models.
  • Reach and audience estimation: Population and overlap estimation, probabilistic reach/frequency models, sampling correction, or saturation modeling.
  • Advanced predictive methods: Mixture-of-experts, distributional or quantile prediction, temporal sequence models, or state-space models.

Accurate and calibrated forecasts across priority advertiser populations; credible comparisons of supported campaign alternatives; reusable capabilities across planning and recommendations; and evidence that advertisers identify valuable opportunities and make better investment decisions.

Ready to be a Titan?

We're looking for a seasoned technical leader who brings deep expertise, broad systems thinking, and the hands-on drive to take complex ideas from design through delivery. You'll work at the intersection of architecture and execution - shaping the technical direction of company-wide initiatives while staying close enough to the code to make them real.

We power thousands of home and commercial service businesses across the U.S. and beyond, helping them operate more efficiently through a platform that includes ML and AI-driven scheduling, dispatch automation, and real-time operational workflows. We're quality-minded, embrace modern engineering practices, and believe the best solutions come from engineers who are as invested in the craft as they are in the outcome. If that's how you think about your work, we'd like to talk.

What You'll Do

Own & Deliver: Define the technical vision for your domain, plan 18+ months ahead, and see it through - writing code, leading implementation, and taking end-to-end accountability for quality and outcomes.

Design & Build: Produce complete, production-ready system designs and then help build them. You write code and lead others in writing high-quality code. You drive and participate in major architectural decisions relating to scale, reliability, and security, and you're the person who makes those decisions real.

Set the Standard: Be the reference point for engineering excellence. Your implementations, code reviews, and technical decisions serve as the model others learn from. You conduct architecture reviews, identify systemic risks, and introduce improvements that make the entire organization more effective at shipping.

Discover & Generalize: Proactively identify opportunities to extract shared systems, define reusable patterns, and establish approaches that eliminate duplication and inconsistency across teams. You prevent the organization from diverging technically and build the foundations others build on top of.

Empower: Coach and mentor Staff and Senior engineers in technical design, architecture, and systems thinking. You create opportunities for others to grow, run cross-team knowledge-sharing sessions, and make the engineers around you demonstrably better.

Shape Strategy: Partner with engineering leadership on roadmap and resource planning across company-wide initiatives. Surface and advocate for non-functional requirements - scalability, resilience, security, performance - and make sure they are reflected in how teams plan and execute. Align technical direction with ServiceTitan's business priorities.

Recruit & Grow the Team: Assess candidates for senior technical roles, design interview plans, and make hiring recommendations. You help define and uphold the engineering bar.

What You'll Bring

  • 15+ years of industry experience in large-scale enterprise web or SaaS applications, with 7+ years in senior IC roles designing and building systems used by other engineers at scale

  • A proven track record of designing and shipping large-scale distributed systems - not just advising on them

  • Deep expertise in at least one primary technology stack (e.g. C#/.NET, Java,C++ or equivalent), with the ability to quickly ramp up on and contribute to any technology in ServiceTitan's stack

  • Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals: event-driven architecture, asynchronous programming, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including architecture, automation, and operational practices

  • Solid grounding in data architecture: relational, NoSQL, vector databases, and distributed persistence

  • Familiarity with AI/ML systems and LLM-based architectures - including orchestration, retrieval, and agentic patterns - aligned with the direction of ServiceTitan's platform

  • Experience leading monolith-to-microservices or service-oriented migrations through to completion

  • Strong command of modern engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), RESTful services, and observability tooling (e.g. Elasticsearch, DataDog, Prometheus)

  • B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

Preferred

  • A bias for execution: you are equally comfortable at the architecture whiteboard and in the codebase, and you hold yourself accountable for both

  • The communication skill to make complex technical decisions legible to any audience - engineers, PMs, and leadership alike - in writing and in person

  • A coaching mindset: you invest in the engineers around you and consistently leave teams, codebases, and architectures better than you found them

  • Breadth across the engineering landscape with deep mastery in at least one area, and the intellectual curiosity to quickly develop credibility in new domains

  • A habit of identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities before they surface as problems - and the ownership to address them

  • Strong empathy for end users and a consistent practice of grounding technical decisions in real customer impact

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

Priority Application Deadline: November 9, 2026

Location: This role is remote but must overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About this role

The Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Associate for Rapid Experimentation will support the execution and analysis of A/B tests across GiveDirectly’s programs, contributing to the use of data to inform program and product decisions. This role is fast-paced and iterative - the team runs frequent, lightweight experiments designed to generate actionable answers quickly, and then uses those learnings to refine and improve programs in real time. This includes:

  • Supporting the execution and analysis of rapid A/B tests across GiveDirectly projects, ensuring that experiments are implemented effectively and contribute to learning within and across projects
  • Ensuring experiments are implemented correctly, measured reliably, and analyzed to produce clear and credible results, working closely with Programs, Product, Research teams, and external academic partners to align experimental design with program delivery, data collection, and operational realities
  • Translating findings into actionable insights and well-structured learning products that serve multiple audiences - internal program and product teams, and external academic partners, ensuring results inform both immediate decisions and longer-term program direction

In practice, this role is about managing a high volume of rapid experiments and turning results into clear, credible evidence that continuously shapes how GiveDirectly’s programs are refined and improved.

Reports to: Senior Manager, Monitoring and Evaluation

Level: Associate

Travel Requirement: This role is based in Rwanda. Travel within East Africa is a regular part of the role, estimated at up to 25% of the time, to support field operations across country programs.Additional international travel may occur for trainings or team convenings, as needed (estimated up to 10%)

What you’ll do:

Execute and manage A/B tests across programs

  • Conduct power calculations to ensure experiments are both statistically rigorous and feasible to implement within program constraints
  • Set up pre-specified experimental designs, applying defined experimental groups, outcome measures, and measurement timelines
  • Review experiment setups prior to launch and flag execution and measurement risks that may affect interpretability
  • Ensure experiments are well-coordinated and executed as designed, aligning implementation with research plans and integrating smoothly into program delivery across Programs and Product teams
  • Work at a fast pace across a portfolio of 2–3 live A/B tests at any given time, designed to generate actionable answers quickly and feed rapid iteration of programs and products

Ensure accurate measurement and high-quality data for experiments

  • Collaborate with external Principal Investigators (PIs) to ensure measurement approaches and data collection are aligned with research design and implementation realities
  • Ensure experimental outcomes are captured accurately and consistently by applying established indicator and measurement approaches
  • Prepare and manage datasets that are clean, well-structured, and ready for analysis using survey, administrative, and product data
  • Identify and flag data quality risks (e.g., missingness, inconsistencies, measurement error) that could affect the validity of experimental conclusions
  • Conduct targeted literature reviews to ensure measurement approaches are grounded in evidence and aligned with best practices

Analyze experimental data and interpret results to inform decisions

  • Generate reliable and decision-ready analyses of experimental data from A/B tests
  • Assess the magnitude and direction of effects and highlight what the results do and do not suggest, noting key limitations
  • Ensure results are clearly understood and appropriately interpreted, given data quality, sample size, and implementation considerations

Translate results into actionable insights and learning across experiments

  • Translate experimental results into clear, actionable recommendations to guide program and product decisions for individual country programs, and for the direction of GiveDirectly’s programming as a whole
  • Structure results and key learnings so they can be reused to inform future experiments and program design
  • Prepare concise learning products (e.g., memos, summaries) that serve multiple audiences, including internal Programs and Product teams, and external academic partners, ensuring findings are clearly communicated for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Prepare and clean de-identified datasets for sharing with external PIs and academic partners, ensuring data is structured, well-documented, and ready for independent analysis
  • Contribute to cross-country discussions to ensure learnings from experiments are shared and applied across contexts, and maintain clear documentation so experiments are easy to track, understand, and build on over time

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem-solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field
  • 2–4 years of experience working with data in applied settings (e.g., experimentation, evaluation, analytics, or program learning), ideally in development, tech, or operations-focused roles
  • Solid understanding of experimental design and causal inference concepts (e.g., randomization, treatment/control groups, units of randomization, statistical power, bias) and how to apply them in real-world program contexts
  • Experience using R, Python, or Stata to clean, manipulate, and analyze data, including working with multiple data sources (e.g., survey or administrative data)
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., programs/operations, product, or research) and external partners to implement projects and solve problems
  • Fluency in English required
  • Comfort working at pace - able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, make progress with imperfect data, and iterate quickly based on emerging findings
  • Ability to interpret results beyond statistical significance and communicate clear, actionable insights to both technical and non-technical audiences

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

  • Base Salary: $46,930

  • Base Salary: £52,920

  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

  • Base Salary: $81,000

This role is fully remote, with a preference for candidates to be based in Kenya or Rwanda. If you’re located elsewhere, we’ll share an estimated salary benchmark for your country during the hiring process. You can find the full list of countries we’re currently able to hire in here.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A supportive team that works hard and cares hard
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take
  • Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Commitment to Safeguarding

To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Job Description:

We are Omnissa!

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance—into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values—Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value—we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.

At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

What is the opportunity?:

We’re hiring our first GTM Engineer!

As the founding hire, you will define what GTM Engineering looks like at Omnissa: the vision, the roadmap, the stack, and how the function grows from here. You get the scale of an established global business with the ownership of a startup seat.

Your mandate is to remove friction from how we go to market and amplify the efficiency of every GTM team. You’ll run GTM Engineering like a product, treating Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations as your customers, and you’ll build systems used by teams across every region we sell in. This is a builder-and-leader role. You will write the roadmap and you will also ship it.

Here is a breakdown:

Define the GTM Engineering roadmap at Omnissa:

  • Set the vision for GTM Engineering and own its product roadmap – building the use cases that take us from 0 to 1 and progress our GTME capabilities and maturity.
  • Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, RevOps, Product and Data, across regions and time zones, to align on priorities and drive adoption.

Build and ship across the entire customer lifecycle

  • Build the signal, enrichment and routing systems behind every stage of the funnel: account sourcing and scoring, top-of-funnel targeting and lead routing, and expansion, renewal and customer success signals.
  • Design and deploy agentic workflows that GTM teams can use every day.
  • Report impact through coverage, conversion, pipeline, attribution, time saved and cost per qualified account.

Own the GTM Engineering tools + platform

  • Ship production-grade systems with the documentation, monitoring, and testing that make them reliable and easy to adopt.
  • Shape the GTME tech stack: evaluate tools, manage vendors and recommend changes as we scale
  • Own Clay end to end, and build connected workflows across Salesforce, our enrichment providers and the rest of the GTM stack.

Meet GTM leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and RevOps globally, and audit the current stack, data quality and biggest sources of friction.Publish Omnissa’s GTM Engineering roadmap. Identify the foundational use cases to build first, plus quick wins to build momentum.Ship 1–2 quick wins in production.Assess and strengthen our Clay foundation. Ramp on what’s already built, find the gaps, and set the architecture future use cases will run on.

What will you bring to Omnissa?

  • 5+ years building GTM systems in B2B software, as a GTM engineer, growth or business systems engineer, data or analytics engineer, or software engineer.
  • Fluency across GTM Engineering use cases in pre-sale, post-sale, RevOps and marketing. You understand how AI and automation apply across GTM systems.
  • Understanding of the GTM tech stack and architecture and ability to assess build vs. buy options.
  • Tools: Hands-on Clay experience in a production environment (workflow design, enrichment, scoring, credit management); Strong Salesforce skills (HubSpot or Marketo is a plus).
  • Comfort with APIs, JSON and SQL, plus some scripting (JavaScript or Python is a plus).
  • Experience using LLMs in production workflows, including prompt design and output validation, and daily use of current AI tools and MCPs.
  • A builder’s track record: you’ve scoped, shipped, and driven adoption of something new.
  • Understanding of the enterprise B2B software sales cycle.
  • Ability to turn business problems into scalable systems and explain tradeoffs to non-technical leaders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and end-to-end ownership.

Location: Anywhere US/Remote. Hybrid if located near Atlanta or Mountain View offices

Travel: as needed for business or team meetings
Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, or engineering, or a related degree and equivalent experience (5+ years)

jobs.excerpt: Role Overview The HR & AI Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for shaping and evolving Fortive’s HR technology ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The HR & AI Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for shaping and evolving Fortive’s HR technology ecosystem. Reporting to the Director of HR Technology (Engineering & Platform), this position sits at the intersection of HR systems, enterprise integration, and AI innovation, leading architecture decisions across Oracle HCM Cloud, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, LMS platforms, and the broader IT landscape.

This role is the primary technical authority for HR platform architecture — defining how systems connect, how AI augments HR workflows, and how data flows reliably across the enterprise. The architect partners closely with HR Product Owners, IT/Enterprise Architecture, and vendor teams to deliver scalable, future-ready solutions that support Fortive’s operating companies and HR functions globally.

Core Technology Landscape

  • Oracle HCM Suite
  • Boomi Middleware
  • ServiceNow HRSD
  • Eightfold AI Platform
  • LMS Solutions
  • Integration APIs
  • Power BI Reporting
  • Oracle Analytics

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Systems & Platform Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end architectural design of Fortive’s HR technology landscape, including Oracle HCM Cloud (Core HR, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, Benefits), ServiceNow HRSD, Eightfold, and LMS platforms.
  • Develop and maintain architectural blueprints, data flow diagrams, and modernization roadmaps aligned to cloud-native, API-first principles.
  • Establish design standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the HR tech portfolio.
  • Partner with IT’s Azure-based infrastructure teams to ensure HR systems align with enterprise architecture standards and security posture.

2. Integration Architecture & Engineering

  • Define and drive integration strategy across HR systems, moving from point-to-point patterns toward reusable, API-first services.
  • Lead architecture and hands-on implementation using Boomi (atoms, molecules, connectors, process routing) as the primary middleware platform.
  • Design scalable integration patterns — real-time APIs, event-driven integrations, and batch/file-based flows — connecting Oracle HCM to Eightfold, LMS, payroll, benefits, and IT/ERP systems.
  • Maintain data integrity, auditability, and compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) across all integration flows.
  • Supervise and guide integration developers through the full development lifecycle, including code reviews, design reviews, and documentation standards.

3. AI Solutions & Automation

  • Identify and deliver high-value AI and automation use cases across the HR lifecycle — intelligent onboarding, workflow automation, AI-assisted case triage, talent insights, and conversational self-service.
  • Architect and implement AI capabilities within Oracle HCM Cloud, Eightfold’s talent intelligence platform, and ServiceNow HRSD.
  • Build and prototype solutions leveraging HR-specific AI platforms, taking ideas from POC to production.
  • Embed AI/ML, NLP, and chatbot capabilities into HR workflows and digital employee experience channels, aligned with enterprise AI governance standards.
  • Establish AI performance monitoring and responsible AI frameworks for HR use cases.

4. Data Architecture & Governance

  • Design HR data models, master data management (MDM) strategies, and data lineage documentation in partnership with Data Engineering and BI teams.
  • Enable secure, governed access to HR data for analytics (Power BI, Oracle Analytics).
  • Define and enforce HR data contracts, quality standards, and privacy controls across all systems and integration points.

5. Stakeholder Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to HR leadership, Product Owners, and IT on HR technology architecture, AI strategy, and platform decisions.
  • Translate complex architecture and AI concepts into clear business outcomes tied to KPIs and strategic priorities.
  • Provide technical guidance on vendor selection and partnership for Oracle, ServiceNow, Eightfold, and integration tooling.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, L&D, Total Rewards) to embed AI capabilities within HR programs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10–12 years of progressive experience in HR technology and enterprise systems architecture.
  • Must be available to work full U.S. Eastern Time (EST) hours each day.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud, including integrations, HCM Extracts, Security, and configuration across at least three functional modules.
  • Proven experience with Boomi or a similar enterprise integration platform (Dell Boomi preferred), including building and supporting production integrations.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, including REST and SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, synchronous and asynchronous processing, and data transformation.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI/ML and automation solutions within HR or other enterprise business systems.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML and automation solutions within HR systems.
  • Experience with digital assistants or AI-driven employee experience platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceNow HRSD, including case management, virtual agent, and HR service delivery configuration.

  • Experience leading or mentoring small technical teams, including integration engineers and developers.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Eightfold AI or comparable talent intelligence platforms.
  • Experience with LMS platform architecture (e.g., Absorb, Cornerstone, or similar).
  • Background in Agile/SAFe delivery, DevOps practices, and CI/CD for integration pipelines.
  • Experience with RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or enterprise BI architecture for HR data products.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you will have mapped the current HR architecture landscape, identified integration gaps and technical debt, and proposed a prioritized modernization roadmap. Within the first year, you will have elevated integration maturity toward API-first and reusable services, shipped at least two meaningful AI-powered HR use cases into production, and established architectural standards that guide the broader HR engineering team.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. jobs.description:
Are you experienced in OT cybersecurity and industrial network architecture? Do you enjoy designing secure networks, solving complex technical challenges, and turning cybersecurity best practices into practical solutions?

At Alight, you’ll help protect the infrastructure behind some of the Nordics’ most ambitious solar and battery storage projects.

Join us as an OT Specialist and take an active role in shaping how we secure, standardize, and manage our growing portfolio of renewable energy assets across Europe.

About Alight

Alight is an entrepreneurial renewable energy company on a mission to decarbonize the grid by helping energy-intensive businesses transition to solar power.

Founded in 2013, we have helped shape the Nordic solar industry through some of the region’s largest solar installations, innovative financing solutions, and pioneering hybrid solar and battery energy storage (BESS) projects.

As a leading independent power producer (IPP) in the Nordics, we own and operate the assets that generate renewable energy. This means our operational technology (OT) systems are a critical part of the energy infrastructure we manage—and protecting them is essential to keeping our solar parks secure, reliable, and operational.

Your impact

As our OT Specialist, you’ll help build and strengthen the cybersecurity foundations of our solar parks. Working closely with our existing OT Specialist, you’ll take shared ownership of OT security across our portfolio, from improving the architecture of existing installations to designing secure networks for new projects.

This is a technically focused role with a strong emphasis on network architecture and security. You’ll work with industrial networks, firewalls, network segmentation, secure remote access, SCADA systems, and the wider OT environment, ensuring that security is built into our assets from the outset and continuously improved throughout their lifecycle.

You’ll divide your time between strategic improvements, project work, and operational support. This means collaborating with engineering and project teams on new installations while working with Asset Management to strengthen the security and resilience of existing sites.

The role is open to candidates based in Sweden, Finland, Norway, or Denmark, with flexible remote and hybrid working options. Our headquarters are in Stockholm, with a smaller office in Helsinki. The role also involves occasional travel to our project sites and solar parks across the Nordics.

You’ll help shape the next generation of OT security at Alight, with responsibilities including:

Industrial network architecture and security

  • Design, review, and improve network architectures for existing and new solar parks, including SCADA systems, dataloggers, and other OT components.

  • Implement and improve network security measures, including firewalls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

  • Establish consistent security standards and network configurations across our growing portfolio of assets.

  • Work with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) teams to ensure security is integrated into new projects from the design stage.

OT cybersecurity and risk management

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize vulnerabilities across OT devices, software, and networks, coordinating remediation and patching activities.

  • Conduct OT security risk assessments and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

  • Strengthen access management by supporting centralized management of privileged access and OT credentials.

  • Contribute to security monitoring, incident response, and the development of practical recovery procedures for scenarios affecting site operations.

Asset management and continuous improvement

  • Develop and maintain an accurate inventory of OT assets, networks, software, and configurations.

  • Ensure OT documentation, including network diagrams, firewall rules, and security policies, is accurate and accessible.

  • Improve standardization across sites by developing repeatable processes, technical guidelines, and security best practices.

  • Collaborate with Asset Management, IT, Engineering, and external partners to balance security improvements with operational reliability.

We’re looking for you

We’re looking for someone who understands how industrial networks are built and secured, and who can translate that knowledge into robust, scalable solutions.

You may currently work in OT cybersecurity, industrial networking, SCADA infrastructure, automation, or network engineering within the energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Whatever your background, you’re comfortable looking at an industrial network architecture, understanding how its components communicate, identifying weaknesses, and determining how to improve its security.

We believe you’ll bring:

  • A degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in OT cybersecurity, industrial networking, or securing technical infrastructure within the energy, utilities, or industrial sectors.

  • Strong knowledge of network architecture, including the ability to interpret network diagrams and understand how firewalls, switches, and connected devices interact.

  • A solid understanding of network security principles, including firewalls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

  • Experience designing, implementing, or securing industrial networks, ideally involving SCADA systems, dataloggers, or other OT infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, OT security tools, and vulnerability management.

  • An analytical and structured approach to identifying risks, solving technical problems, and prioritizing security improvements.

  • The ability to communicate technical concepts and security risks clearly to colleagues and stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work across projects, operations, and multiple technical teams.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Extra points if you also have

  • Experience with renewable energy systems, such as solar PV, battery energy storage, or wind power.

  • Knowledge of the IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards.

  • An understanding of electrical systems and industrial control environments.

  • Experience with centralized privileged access management (PAM), OT asset inventories, or configuration management databases (CMDBs).

  • Familiarity with command-line tools and industrial network troubleshooting.


Sounds like a fit? Apply today!

This is intended to be a long-term engagement. Because of the learning curve involved in understanding Minnesota workers' compensation law and the firm's internal processes, the firm is not looking to repeat this training with frequent turnover. jobs.description:
About Paired

Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

The client

Advertising and consultancy services company working with RevOps infrastructure for B2B teams. They build the systems that make growth work.

The founder has reached the point most agency founders reach eventually. Their days are full of client emails, chasing the team, managing delivery risk and keeping projects from slipping. None of it is optional and all of it is in their head. The problem is not only the hours it eats. It is that managing risk and creating growth are opposite modes of thinking, and they cannot do both well in the same week.

They're hiring the person who takes operations off them.

Why this role is part-time, and what it becomes

Right now there genuinely is not forty hours a week of work here. We are coming out of a contraction and back into expansion, and they would rather hire someone part-time and pay them properly than hire full-time and have them sitting idle, which is unfair to both of us.

The plan is that this grows. Part-time now, full-time as the client base expands, then Head of Operations. They're not dangling that vaguely: they'll will set out the milestones, what hitting them does to your compensation, and roughly when they expect each step. You should hold them to it.

What they're asking for in return is commitment. If you take this and a full-time offer appears a month later and you disappear, it damages us. If you are doing one other part-time role alongside this, that is fine and I understand it. What I do not want is someone juggling five clients who gives this one the leftovers. I have seen fractional done badly and I would rather pay for focus.

What you will own

Client and stakeholder management

  • Be the operational point of contact for our clients, so that I am not
  • Keep every client informed, handle the back and forth, and escalate to me only what genuinely needs me
  • We currently run around four clients at once, a mix of large and small projects. Six is the most we have ever carried. As we scale, the model is roughly one project manager per five clients

Project delivery

  • Own timelines, scope and deliverables across those accounts
  • Know the status of everything without being asked, and chase it when it slips
  • Spot delivery risk early and bring me a proposed fix rather than a problem

Team coordination

  • Keep the team pointed at the right work and hold them to what they committed to
  • Run the follow-up so that nothing dies in a thread

Revenue operations

  • Keep our pipeline, CRM and reporting accurate and current
  • Build and tidy the systems and automations that hold delivery together
  • Turn what is currently in my head into documented, repeatable process

Requirements

Who this is for

  • You have done revenue operations or operational project management in an agency or client services environment, and have carried multiple accounts at once
  • You are comfortable being the operational face to clients. This is a stakeholder-facing role, not a back-office one
  • Excellent written English. We work with international clients and are moving into the US market
  • You are organised to the point of being slightly annoying about it, and you follow through without being chased
  • You can work independently. There is no operations team to lean on. For a while, you are it
  • You want this to grow into something bigger, and you are willing to commit while it does

Who this is not for

  • You are a fractional operator running five clients and this would be number six
  • You want a purely strategic seat. For now this is hands-on: emails, trackers, chasing, process writing
  • You need a manager checking your work
  • You are looking for full-time immediately and would leave the moment one appeared

Benefits

  • Part-time, remote, on a contractor basis. We will agree the weekly hours and the working pattern together, but you will need reliable overlap with Barcelona for client calls and with the team. If you are in Latin America, your mornings cover our afternoons, which works well, and it positions us for the US clients we are moving towards.
  • Growth path for full-time and Head of Operations role
  • Compensation for part-time up to USD1.5k/month

What success looks like

  • The founder stops being the person clients email first
  • Projects land on their dates, and when they will not, they hear it early with a plan attached
  • Our operations run on documented process rather than on my memory
  • The founder spends his weeks on expansion instead of firefighting

Voxel Art & Creative Development

jobs.excerpt: Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns.
jobs.description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at .

About this position:

As an Enterprise Account Director at Later, you will own a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise client relationships, typically representing $5M-$15M in annual business depending on account size and complexity.

You will operate as the CEO of the account, with significant autonomy and accountability for setting the account strategy, building executive relationships, driving expansion, and determining how Later should invest to deepen and grow each partnership.

This is a senior commercial and strategic leadership role within the evolving creator and influencer marketing ecosystem. You will advise some of the world’s leading brands on how influencer and creator marketing can support broader brand, commerce, customer acquisition, and growth objectives, while helping them navigate a rapidly changing social landscape.

You will bring a strong point of view on creator strategy, social trends, measurement, and the influencer ecosystem, while translating client business priorities into meaningful opportunities for Later. Success in this role requires strong commercial instincts, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise organizations with a high degree of independence.

What you'll be doing:

Enterprise Account Strategy & Growth

  • Own the long-term strategy and growth plan for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients representing approximately $5M-$15M in annual business.
  • Develop a clear growth thesis for each account, including expansion opportunities, stakeholder strategy, competitive dynamics, risks, and areas where Later can create additional value.
  • Drive expansion by identifying whitespace, developing opportunities, and building the executive alignment required to increase Later’s strategic and commercial footprint.
  • Connect client business priorities to opportunities across influencer marketing, creator strategy, social, commerce, and Later’s broader capabilities.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of each partnership, anticipating changes in client priorities, organizational structure, competitive dynamics, and the broader creator and social landscape.
  • Partner with Sales on commercial strategy, renewals, and expansion while maintaining overall ownership of the client relationship and account direction.

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with VP, C-suite, and senior decision-makers across complex enterprise organizations.
  • Develop multi-threaded relationships that extend beyond individual champions and create durable executive sponsorship for Later.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, bringing proactive recommendations and a clear point of view on creator strategy, influencer marketing, social trends, measurement, and emerging opportunities.
  • Help senior marketers understand how creator and influencer programs can support broader brand, performance, commerce, and customer growth objectives.
  • Lead strategic business reviews, executive strategy sessions, workshops, and other high-value client engagements.
  • Navigate complex or sensitive client conversations with confidence, judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach.

CEO of the Account

  • Operate with significant autonomy in determining how Later approaches, supports, and grows each assigned account.
  • Set the strategic direction for the partnership and mobilize the right internal teams and executive stakeholders to deliver against that vision.
  • Maintain a holistic understanding of account performance, client sentiment, commercial opportunity, stakeholder dynamics, competitive risk, and delivery health.
  • Identify risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional action before they become material client or commercial issues.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about where Later should invest time, expertise, and resources to maximize the long-term value of the partnership.

Creator & Influencer Strategic Leadership

  • Bring a strong understanding of the creator and influencer ecosystem and how it is evolving across social, media, commerce, and culture.
  • Translate market trends, platform shifts, creator behavior, and performance insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Challenge client thinking when appropriate and help them identify new ways to use creator and influencer marketing to solve business problems.
  • Partner with Strategy, Services, Data, and Product teams to develop differentiated solutions that reflect client objectives and emerging market opportunities.
  • Use client feedback and market insight to help shape Later’s services, products, and strategic priorities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Orchestrate Sales, Strategy, Services, Data, Product, and executive leadership around a unified account strategy and clear client outcomes.
  • Establish clarity on priorities, responsibilities, risks, and opportunities across the teams supporting each account.
  • Partner closely with delivery leadership to ensure strategic objectives, client expectations, and commercial commitments remain aligned.
  • Ensure Later shows up to the client as one integrated strategic partner rather than a collection of individual teams.
  • Escalate and resolve issues appropriately while maintaining executive-level ownership of the relationship.

What success looks like:

  • Enterprise clients consistently renew, expand, and deepen their partnership with Later.
  • Clients view you as a trusted advisor who proactively brings insights—not just solutions.
  • Executive stakeholders engage you early in strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Internal teams see you as a clear, prepared, and reliable partner who elevates execution.
  • Client feedback and insights directly influence product improvements and innovation.

Industry & Market Influence

  • Stay close to developments across influencer marketing, the creator economy, social platforms, measurement, commerce, and digital marketing.
  • Bring relevant industry intelligence and competitive insight into client conversations and account strategy.
  • Represent Later at relevant industry events, executive forums, panels, and strategic networking opportunities.
  • Help strengthen Later’s position as a trusted voice in creator and influencer marketing.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management, customer success, or enterprise sales, with direct ownership of revenue retention and growth.
  • Proven experience working with enterprise brands in influencer or social marketing.
  • Demonstrated success navigating complex enterprise buying cycles and multi-stakeholder decision-making environments.
  • Track record of building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and anticipating organizational changes.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to command executive-level conversations.
  • Strong operational discipline and time management skills to deliver against KPIs and defined business outcomes.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Data, and Delivery teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support key client relationships.

How you work:

  • Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
  • Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
  • Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
  • Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
  • Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:

$175,000- $225,000 OTE

*Co-op team members, independent contractors, and freelancers are not eligible for company benefits.

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.
