jobs.excerpt: About the Role: As our Program Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of projects across a specific customer portfolio with diverse building and project types.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

As our Program Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of projects across a specific customer portfolio with diverse building and project types. You’ll act as a technical and program-level integrator—bridging Engineering Delivery, Program Management, Controls, Applications, and Solutions and Growth teams to ensure alignment from early opportunity through execution and go-live. This role is highly cross-functional and requires strong functional design expertise, commercial awareness, and the ability to proactively identify risks, align stakeholders, and drive clarity across project phases. You will provide engineering oversight across multiple concurrent precontract opportunities and active projects, helping ensure solutions are well-defined, executable, and aligned to DCS standards and customer expectations.

Sound like you? Read on.

In this role, you will:

Serve as a technical and program partner across projects and opportunities within a vertical ensuring alignment, visibility, and execution readiness across engineering and program teams. Your key accountabilities and responsibilities will include:

Key Accountabilities

  • Customer and Employee Experience: Accountable for leading by example in delivering exceptional employee and customer experiences, and modeling DCS values and cultural behaviors.
  • Program Alignment & Visibility: Accountable for maintaining visibility across all active and upcoming projects, ensuring alignment between engineering, program management, and customer expectations.
  • Engineering Quality & Design Integrity: Accountable for ensuring functional designs are robust, aligned to best practices, and executable across engineering and controls.
  • Pre-Execution Planning & Estimation Accuracy: Accountable for supporting accurate engineering estimates including schedules, resource skillset, and scope definitions during proposal and front-end phases.
  • Risk Identification & Mitigation: Accountable for proactively identifying design, schedule, and vendor risks and ensuring they are communicated and addressed early.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Accountable for enabling effective collaboration between Mechanical Engineering, Project Engineering, Controls, PMs, and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain active participation in heartbeat meetings to track project updates, risks, and resourcing needs.
  • Coordinate across PMs, Controls, and Engineering teams to align priorities for upcoming and active projects.
  • Participate in coordination meetings and forecast reviews to ensure alignment on workload and resource planning.
  • Own the program lessons-learned process, identifying recurring engineering, vendor, and execution risks and driving improvements that strengthen future project performance.
  • Identify future resource constraints and communicate staffing, skill, and capacity risks to leadership.
  • Evaluate and support increase of capability and capacity within engineering teams to support growth within customer profile projections.
  • Regularly review program dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools that provide visibility into project status, engineering demand, risks, customer requirements, and execution readiness.
  • Mentor engineers and project team members on customer standards, program expectations, and lessons learned.
  • Share customer, program, and engineering knowledge across project teams to improve consistency and execution quality.
  • Facilitate feedback and growth of program team including program manager, sales, and program engineers.
  • Advise sales, applications, and program management on pursuit strategy, solution fit, execution risk, and customer priorities based on program experience and historical performance.
  • Review risk and consult leadership on new expansions within customer portfolio.
  • Attend and advise system design reviews across projects, providing guidance on functional design and execution best practices.
  • Participate in internal and customer design reviews and firm engineering calls to ensure alignment on solution intent and standards.
  • Support development of functional design breakouts for firm engineering phases.
  • Provide input and pushback where needed to maintain design integrity and adherence to DCS standards.
  • Develop expert-level understanding of customer specifications and requirements.
  • Support creation of customer specifications when not provided.
  • Increase engagement and visibility with assigned vertical customers to ensure alignment and confidence in solutions.
  • Maintain visibility and communicate changes to customer standards, specifications, engineering practices, and program requirements to ensure consistent execution across all projects within the portfolio.
  • Own engineering hour estimation for opportunities, including ME, PE, Product Design, and site-related costs.
  • Support ROM pricing evaluations and provide validation of labor and material assumptions.
  • Review proposals and contribute to functional scope definition and mechanical clarifications.
  • Participate in precontract review meetings, including Go/No-Go (GNG), Vendor Bid Reviews (VBR), and Financial Reviews (FR), with focus on clarifying costs and mitigating risks while supporting the capture strategy from a technical perspective.
  • Review and consult on project schedules to validate durations for FE, execution, procurement, and controls integration.
  • Support go/no-go evaluations by assessing RFPs, sales inputs, and associated risks.
  • Ensure readiness for execution by aligning scope, schedule, and engineering deliverables.
  • Participate in design reviews and customer FE calls throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of engineering demand, testing support, travel requirements, and go-live activities across the program portfolio.
  • Support testing plans, site activities, and go-live execution as needed.
  • Provide on-site or remote support during critical execution phases.
  • Serve as the Engineering point of escalation and support for all projects within the program portfolio.
  • Evaluate proposed vendors and provide input on technical fit and execution risk of bidding and backlog projects.
  • Support vendor training and knowledge sharing across the engineering team.
  • Partner with Supplier Development to onboard and assess vendors and suppliers based on project needs and past performance.

We’re Excited About You Because:

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • You have 5+ years in material handling system design and delivery engineering.
  • You have strong engineering and design expertise and understand how systems translate from concept to execution.
  • You are comfortable operating across multiple projects and priorities, balancing detail with big-picture program alignment.
  • You excel in cross-functional communication and can influence without direct authority.
  • You have strong commercial awareness, including estimating, proposal support, and cost evaluation.
  • You are proactive in identifying risks and driving alignment before issues impact execution.
  • You enjoy work that includes travel expectations between 30-40% of your typical year.
  • You are highly organized and capable of tracking multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously.

This job description is not exhaustive. Other duties may be assigned as needed, and responsibilities may evolve to support the business and employee experience.

About Us:

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982 and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More reasons to join our team:

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%
  • Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program
  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year
  • We know how to throw company events

Individuals seeking employment at Designed Conveyor Systems are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Accommodation is available to applicants with a disability condition, when applying, testing, or interviewing for a position. Please let us know if you need accommodation.

jobs.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

As a therapist within our Pediatric Outpatient Service Line, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of children, teens, young adults, and their families while working as part of an integrated clinical team.

You'll provide evidence-based, developmentally appropriate therapy that helps members build resilience, strengthen relationships, develop effective coping skills, and make progress toward individualized treatment goals. Depending on the member's age and clinical needs, treatment may also involve partnering with parents or caregivers to reinforce skills, support treatment goals, and promote meaningful change outside of therapy sessions.

Therapists are an integral part of our collaborative care model. You'll work closely with behavioral case managers, psychiatric providers, nurses, coaches, and other clinical team members to ensure members receive coordinated care that reflects their individual, developmental, and family needs.

This role is a great fit for an independently NY licensed behavioral health clinician who is passionate about supporting children, teens, and young adults, values collaboration, and is comfortable adapting treatment across developmental stages. You'll have opportunities to expand your clinical expertise through consultation, ongoing training, evidence-based care practices, and collaboration with an interdisciplinary team.

We are looking for a part-time licensed therapist to join our Pediatric Care Services clinical team. This role sits within the Pediatric Outpatient Service Line and reports to a Clinical Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and family therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and caregivers.

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral health assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.

  • Utilize evidence-based modalities, including CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, trauma-informed interventions, and other approaches appropriate to the member's clinical and developmental needs.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists, behavioral case managers, coaches, nurses, and other interdisciplinary team members to provide coordinated care.

  • Engage caregivers as active partners in treatment when clinically and developmentally appropriate through psychoeducation, collaborative goal setting, and skills coaching.

  • Maintain timely, accurate, clinically meaningful, and compliant documentation.

  • Participate in clinical consultation, supervision, ongoing training, and professional development.

  • Support quality improvement initiatives and the continued delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care.

Requirements:

  • Ability to work part-time, 24 hours per week.

  • Availability to provide care during afternoon and evening hours to support member scheduling needs.

  • Potential opportunity to work Saturdays based on program needs.

  • Ability to maintain a private, professional workspace appropriate for providing confidential telehealth services.

  • Ability to maintain reliable internet connectivity necessary to provide consistent, high-quality virtual care.

  • Must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States

  • Ability to meet applicable state licensing, credentialing, payer enrollment requirements, and interstate practice requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Current, active New York license and registration in good standing that permits independent clinical practice and diagnosis, such as LCSW, Licensed Psychologist, LMHC, or LMFT. LMHCs and LMFTs must hold New York’s diagnostic privilege. License must have no current restrictions or pending disciplinary action.

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Mental Health Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy, Clinical Mental Health Counseling, or another behavioral health discipline that meets New York licensure requirements; or a doctoral degree (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) in Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a related psychology discipline.

  • Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health treatment to children, adolescents, young adults, and families.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and developmentally appropriate care that recognizes and respects members' identities, lived experiences, family structures, and backgrounds.

  • Experience utilizing evidence-based interventions such as CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, EMDR, and other clinically appropriate treatment approaches.

  • Experience engaging caregivers as collaborative partners in treatment while promoting developmentally appropriate member autonomy.

  • Experience working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary care team.

  • Strong clinical judgment with excellent communication, organization, and documentation skills.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable utilizing telehealth platforms, electronic health records, and other digital tools to deliver high-quality virtual care.

  • Warm, engaging, and collaborative clinical style with the ability to build therapeutic rapport across developmental stages.

deine aufgaben beinhalten:

Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

SO SIEHT ERFOLG IN DIESER ROLLE AUS:

  • Wichtige Stakeholder nutzen Brainsuite aktiv und erkennen einen klaren Mehrwert für ihr Business

  • Starkes Interesse an oder Erfahrung in den Bereichen Consumer Insights, Marketing Effectiveness, Brand Management oder Marketing Technology

was wir als plus betrachten:

  • Erfahrung in einer B2B-SaaS-Umgebung, idealerweise mit daten- oder KI-gestützten Produkten

was ist für dich drin?

  • Ein internationales Team, das gemeinsam Großes erreichen kann: Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen aus aller Welt, die Vielfalt leben und schätzen. Flache Hierarchien und eine offene, unterstützende Arbeitskultur schaffen Raum für die Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitigen Respekt.
  • Gestalte die Zukunft aktiv mit: Ob Künstliche Intelligenz, kreative Effektivität, Verhaltenswissenschaft oder Marketing-Transformation – bei uns arbeitest du an zukunftsweisenden Themen, die die Branche bewegen.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz? Überall in Deutschland: Wir setzen auf 100% Remote Work und geben dir die Freiheit, deinen Arbeitsort flexibel zu wählen. Persönlicher Austausch kommt dabei nicht zu kurz – bei Teamtreffen und unseren Sommer- und Winterfeiern sehen wir uns auch persönlich.
  • Wachse mit uns: Für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung stellen wir dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget zur Verfügung, das du flexibel für Trainings, Kurse oder Konferenzen nutzen kannst.
  • Mehr Zeit für dich: Genieße 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr plus zwei zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Workation: Du brauchst einen Tapetenwechsel? Kein Problem! Bei uns kannst du bis zu 28 Tage im Jahr im EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • Jobticket: Wir bezuschussen dein JobTicket, damit du günstiger und nachhaltiger mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln unterwegs bist.
  • Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten auf eine Vielzahl an Produkten und Dienstleistungen – dank unserer Partnerschaften mit corporate benefits und FutureBens.

so läuft der einstellungsprozess ab:

  • Kompetenzgespräch (45 Min.) mit Karel Ellis-Gray, Head of Customer Success.
  • Kennenlerngespräch (30 Min.)  mit Dr. Dirk Held (Co-Founder & Chief Strategy Officer) and Monika Vasatkova (People & Culture Manager).

du erfüllst nicht alle anforderungen?

Bei Brainsuite.ai setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, gleichberechtigtes und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein. Uns ist bewusst, dass verschiedene Faktoren die Entscheidung sich auf eine Stelle zu bewerben, beeinflussen können. Daher ermutigen wir alle Menschen mit jeglichem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben, unabhängig davon, ob sie alle Qualifikationen erfüllen.

Wir sind überzeugt: Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und stärkt unsere Innovationskraft. Wenn auch du unsereWerte teilst, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.

Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein für alle zugängliches Umfeld zu schaffen, auch für Menschen mit Behinderung. Wenn du bestimmte Bedürfnisse hast, teile uns bitte mit, wie wir dich während des Bewerbungsverfahrens oder im Arbeitsalltag unterstützen können.

OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens.
At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

OpenX is hiring a Global Head of Customer Success Engineering (CSE) with significant technical & business operations experience in the programmatic ecosystem to join our Commercial Operations leadership team. You will manage OpenX’s Solutions Architects, Support Engineering, and Deal Operations organizations, and will act as the technical backbone behind our customer-facing partners, including publishers, DSPs, and strategic partners. You will be building world class teams to drive revenue, maximize integration health, and act as the client facing technical expert and thought leader. The role will report directly to the VP, Commercial Operations.

We want someone who is deeply technical, highly strategic and business-oriented, and strives to raise the bar across the entire business through thoughtful leadership, critical thinking, and heavy collaboration. You will be a player-coach, with a deep technical understanding of the programmatic SSP landscape with a strong expertise in publisher & DSP OpenRTB integrations across all programmatic channels. You will work closely with almost all OpenX teams, including sales, account management, product, engineering, and legal, as well as directly with our partners. A proven track record of managing technical teams and achieving targets is required.

Own the escalation path into Engineering for complex integration, data, and auction issues.

    • Comfort with ambiguity and disagreement. You are able to disagree openly and respectfully, including with senior leaders across Commercial, Product, and Engineering.

    • Ability to demonstrate a record of disciplined prioritization. You triage by revenue, risk, and effort, and communicate clearly what is being worked on and what isn’t.

    • Experience leading global teams across multiple business lines, remits, and focus areas, including hiring, coaching, and developing managers.

    • Comfort being a connector. You see how work in one team affects another, bring people together early, and make sure nothing falls between teams.

    • A product mindset. You can turn recurring issues into a prioritized ask and push back constructively on product and engineering.

jobs.title: Marketing Technologist | Regulated DTC Consumer Brand
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:

This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands-on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that's armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can't, and numbers everyone can actually trust.

A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren't style guidance — they're hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn't the right seat.

You'll:

  • Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

  • Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and post-visit follow-up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

  • Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back, dunning recovery, pause-instead-of-cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

  • Produce creative in-house with AI tools against the brand's existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

  • Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone's checklist

  • Own first-party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

  • Real, hands-on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

  • 3+ years hands-on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

  • Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

  • Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

  • Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

  • APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

  • A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

  • Background marketing in a regulated or high-constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

  • DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win-back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

  • Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

  • Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

  • A hands-on, builder-first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

  • Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

  • The chance to help build out the company's own agent and automation stack from the ground up

  • Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Apply with a short note naming one thing you've built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)

  • 2️⃣ Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail

  • 3️⃣ Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review

  • 4️⃣ Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code

We have a wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies. Our differentiated battle management and cyber solutions deliver timely, mission-enabling information and provide superior situational awareness and understanding to protect the U.S. and its global allies.

Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking a Systems SW Analyst / Principal Systems SW Analyst (UX Designer) for a fully remote position that can be performed virtually.

The opportunity

Our client is looking for a producer who can discover an extraordinary human story and help the person behind it tell it to the world. Sometimes that starts with a TikTok, a comment or a passing reference to something someone has lived through. Your job is to recognize the bigger story, get in touch, build trust, interview them and guide them through filming the footage that brings it to life, then work with editors to turn it into a compelling film of roughly ten minutes for YouTube and Snapchat.

About the organization

Our client helps the 99% be seen by empowering people to tell their own stories, because traditional media focuses on the 1%. The team has published almost 8,000 videos, filmed by people themselves on their mobile phones and remotely guided through the process. Its channels cover mental and physical health and survivor stories.

What you will do

  • Discover original human stories across TikTok, other social platforms and online communities, using social search, AI-assisted research and emerging tools to find promising contributors.
  • Run high-volume outreach: the team works toward roughly 30 contacted sources per day, knowing that around one in ten converts to a signed content license agreement and interview, with a goal ofthree published stories per day.
  • Assess whether a story has the depth, access and visual potential to become a strong film, and convince contributors to take part.
  • Research and verify stories rigorously: check claims against documented evidence, make sure health stories match documented symptoms, and keep survivor stories safe from legal risk, working through checklists with a QC layer above you.
  • Conduct thoughtful interviews that uncover specific experiences, meaningful moments and a clear narrative.
  • Remotely direct contributors to film themselves and their everyday lives on their phones, using clear filming briefs written for people with no production experience.
  • Develop story outlines and edit scripts with strong hooks, progression and a satisfying ending, and work with editors to shape interviews and user-generated footage into compelling films
  • Read retention and performance data from platform dashboards and use it to improve story selection, structure and delivery.

What you bring

  • At least three years of relevant experience in journalism, interviews and developing human stories, including remotely directing contributors and producing user-generated content.
  • Genuine fluency in US culture and social media: you know what is on the pulse with American audiences right now, especially Gen Z, and how to cater content to it, not just how the platforms work.
  • A thorough understanding of TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and Facebook, and experience structuring unscripted content for social audiences.
  • Strong confidence using AI in your workflow: research, condensing interviews, drafting outreach and speeding up editing. You do not need to be an AI specialist, but you should instinctively reach for AI tools to work faster.
  • Comfort with editorial responsibility: verification, factual accuracy and keeping sensitive stories legally safe.
  • Sensitivity when working with people sharing traumatic or deeply personal experiences.
  • The organization to manage contributors, footage and production deadlines across multiple stories at once.
  • Your application must include your portfolio: links to published work together with the performance results behind it.

Helpful, but not essential

  • Experience reading and acting on analytics from platform-native dashboards and third-party tools for YouTube, Snapchat and Facebook.
  • Experience with lighter lifestyle verticals such as travel, food or fashion.
  • Experience managing or growing a Discord or similar community.
How the engagement works

You will contract directly with Apricot, which manages contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables. You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity and a secure working environment, and follow required security controls, including two-factor authentication.

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

About the Role:

Sales Compensation Analyst – Financial Modelling and Planning


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

This is a role for a quantitative specialist who thinks in models, simulates before deciding, and translates data into decisions. As S&P Global Market Intelligence's financial engine for sales compensation planning, you will design and run the simulation and scenario models that govern incentive spend across the global sales force — stress-testing plan structures, forecasting commission accruals, and delivering the predictive analytics that keep compensation spend aligned with divisional financial targets. This role works in both directions: modelling what could happen before a decision is made, and measuring what actually happened afterward — so that every plan design choice is grounded in evidence, not assumption.

  • Build and execute dynamic financial forecasting models using Python (NumPy/Pandas) and advanced Excel/Power Query — simulating sales compensation expense under variable performance distributions, modelling global commission accruals, and cross-referencing run-rate performance with historic seasonality trends to support FP&A alignment and month-end payout estimates.
  • Perform multi-variable stress-testing and sensitivity analyses on proposed compensation structures — including shifts in accelerator tiers, commission caps, milestone bonuses, and quota changes — to forecast risk boundaries and tail-risk exposure, while constructing statistical attainment distributions to surface plan distortions, windfall payouts, and quota cliffs across global sales territories.
  • Design and compute plan effectiveness metrics — analysing the correlation between compensation expense, product line profitability, and net new Annual Contract Value (ACV), and evaluating the ROI and behavioural impact of non-standard incentive programs including SPIFFs, strategic account bonuses, and multi-year contract multipliers.
  • Develop and maintain automated Power BI executive dashboards tracking global commission expense ratios, average realisation rates, CAC/COC ratios, and quota attainment curves — translating complex quantitative modelling outputs into clear, narrative-driven executive presentations and briefing decks for Commercial and Finance leadership.
  • Build reusable, script-based scenario calculators using Python, SQL, and Alteryx — enabling compensation strategists to rapidly simulate mid-year crediting and plan adjustments — while maintaining version-controlled mathematical repositories for longitudinal baseline comparisons across fiscal cycles.
  • Partner with Data Architecture teams to automate data ingestion from enterprise data warehouses into financial modelling workspaces, ensuring pipeline integrity, data freshness, and modelling accuracy across all forecasting and planning outputs.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in financial modelling, quantitative compensation analysis, corporate FP&A, or incentive strategy within a multinational organisation.
  • Advanced Financial Modelling: Proven experience building nested logic models, dynamic array models, and Monte Carlo or multi-variable sensitivity simulations for large-scale compensation expense forecasting and risk quantification.
  • Coding and Automation: Hands-on experience using Python (Pandas/NumPy) or Alteryx for data manipulation and programmatic financial modelling, combined with advanced SQL querying capability across large, multi-table datasets.
  • Power BI Development: Demonstrated experience building sophisticated Power BI data visualisation models using advanced DAX measures and star-schema architectures for executive-level reporting.
  • Strategic Communication: Demonstrated experience synthesising complex quantitative modelling outputs — including forecast results, stress-test findings, and attainment analyses — into clear, structured recommendations for senior Finance and Commercial executives.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using corporate financial planning tools — Adaptive Insights, Anaplan, or Workday Adaptive — in a compensation or revenue planning context.
  • Experience applying Monte Carlo simulation or probabilistic modelling techniques to sales compensation forecasting and tail-risk exposure quantification.
  • Experience constructing attainment distribution analyses and quota cliff assessments to identify plan design distortions across global sales territories.
  • Experience analysing the correlation between compensation expense ratios — including CAC and COC ratios — and product line profitability or net new ACV in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based sales environment.
  • Experience building and maintaining version-controlled financial modelling repositories with longitudinal baseline data for multi-year compensation plan performance comparisons.
  • Experience partnering with Data Architecture or Data Engineering teams to design automated data ingestion pipelines from enterprise data warehouses into financial modelling workspaces.
  • Experience using Python SciPy, Statsmodels, or R for advanced statistical modelling — including regression analysis and distribution fitting — in a sales compensation or FP&A context.

Right to Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.

Meta Description:Register your interest in advising SME CEOs through Rutherford International’s Enterprise Advisory Board programme. Share your leadership and specialist expertise.

Enterprise Advisory Board — Remunerated Adviser
Evergreen Expression of Interest — Rutherford Talent Guild™
Canada · United States · United Kingdom

Owner-managed and founder-led businesses regularly face decisions that stretch the experience available within their teams: entering a new market, securing financing, planning succession or transforming operations.

Rutherford International welcomes expressions of interest from experienced professionals who can provide relevant expertise, practical perspective and candid, independent challenge to an SME owner or CEO.

This is an Evergreen Expression of Interest, not an advertisement for a current vacancy or advisory appointment.

Who should register
  • Executives, former business owners and senior specialists with demonstrated expertise in growth, financing, operations, technology, people, succession or transformation.
  • Professionals who can adapt their experience to the resources and operating realities of an owner-managed business.
  • Experienced advisers interested in serving individually or within a small advisory group.
  • Professionals with the experience to chair an advisory group and encourage productive discussion.

Professionals based in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom may register.

The adviser’s contribution

Depending on the mandate, advisers may help an owner or CEO examine strategic and operational decisions by:

  • Understanding the business, its objectives and constraints before offering recommendations.
  • Testing assumptions and identifying practical alternatives.
  • Explaining the evidence, trade-offs and limitations behind their advice.
  • Challenging candidly and respectfully while leaving decisions with the authorised decision-maker.
  • Preparing thoroughly for meetings and following through on agreed contributions.
  • Maintaining confidentiality and declaring potential conflicts of interest.
  • Working constructively with other advisers while allowing differing views to be heard.

Advisory appointments provide non-binding recommendations. They do not, by themselves, confer the authority of a statutory director or responsibility for managing the business.

Relevant experience and qualities

There is no single career route into this role. We look for specific examples of sound judgement, useful advice and contribution to consequential business decisions.

A senior title alone is insufficient. Relevant experience must translate into practical advice suited to the enterprise’s circumstances.

Qualities we value include clear thinking and communication, independent judgement, candour delivered with tact, reliable preparation, openness to contrary evidence and an understanding of the limits of one’s expertise.

Applicants interested in chairing an advisory group should also demonstrate the ability to set focused agendas, balance participation and manage disagreement.

Remuneration

The enterprise pays appointed advisers for their agreed contribution.Remuneration is established for each mandate according to expertise, preparation, time commitment and responsibilities. Arrangements may include retainers, meeting fees or time-based fees.

Advisers do not pay to occupy an advisory seat. This differs from the separate CEO Peer Advisory / Mastermind programme, where members pay to participate.

Registration and consideration

Select“I’m interested”to submit your résumé and professional information through Rutherford International’s Talent Registration form.

Following initial review, a curator may invite you to provide further information and undertake the RutherfordINTEL Assessment. Assessment findings are considered alongside your experience, achievements, objectives and suitability for particular mandates.

Registration is not admission. Progression and membership remain subject to curator review.

Registering does not guarantee membership, representation, an introduction or an advisory appointment.

jobs.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.

Program Background:

The National Virtual Program for Professional Advancement (NVPPA) is a nationwide, fully virtual program through which the International Rescue Committee (IRC) serves newly arrived refugees under a cooperative agreement with the Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR). Participants receive career navigation, training, job placement support, and direct financial assistance to advance an individualized career goal. NVPPA operates alongside other federally funded programs, such as initial resettlement services and Matching Grant, and is designed to complement rather than replace or duplicate these programs.


Job overview

Program Assistant role provides the administrative backbone for NVPPA's direct financial assistance. Working from requests submitted by Career Navigators, this position is responsible for preparing requests for disbursement: confirming that required documentation is on file, that the requested use of funds aligns with the participant's approved Professional Advancement Plan (PAP) and ORR's eligible use categories, and that the vendor or training provider is an active, appropriately licensed or accredited entity. This role will work closely with the Finance team, Business Operations team, and will report directly to the Deputy Director.


Major responsibilities

Direct financial assistance processing

  • Receive direct financial assistance requests from Career Navigators and prepare them for administrative review and processing.
  • Initiate a Purchase Request or Purchase Order (PR/PO) or a non-PO invoice in the system for expense processing.
  • Liaise closely with Finance Coordinators to ensure direct financial assistance requests are correctly recorded in the system using appropriate budget codes and accurate client IDs.
  • Follow IRC Global Supply Chain protocols and IRC financial controls in all transactions.

Vendor Management

  • Make sure new vendors are created in the system before initiating a direct financial assistance request. This will require completing forms within and outside the system, collecting up-to-date information from the vendors, and ensuring there are no discrepancies.
  • Liaise closely with the Master Data Management Team to ensure vendor cards are active and updated.

Records and reporting support

  • Maintain complete and audit-ready financial assistance records for each participant, including request forms, approvals, vendor documentation, invoices, and proof of payment.
  • Liaise closely with Career Navigators to ensure a signed client Receipt of Payment is received and kept on file.
  • Record assistance transactions and service data accurately and on time in IRC's financial system and in Efforts to Outcomes (ETO), as assigned.
  • Flag anomalies, incomplete requests, duplicate requests, or vendor concerns to the Finance Manager and program leadership.

Coordination and administrative support

  • Coordinate with Career Navigators to resolve missing documentation or eligibility questions so that participant requests are not delayed.
  • Respond to vendor and training provider inquiries about payment status.
  • Attend regularly scheduled virtual meetings as part of the review, evaluation, and program maintenance process.

Job Requirements

  • 1-2 years of demonstrated experience in a human services field, preferably in a nonprofit or social services setting.
  • Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to build rapport with clients by phone and video.
  • Ability to deliver services remotely to clients across states and time zones, protect client confidentiality and sensitive documents, and work independently as part of a fully virtual team.
  • Experience managing a high-volume of requests, with strong organization, prioritization, time management, and follow-through.
  • Ability to build and maintain productive internal and external relationships.
  • Ability to research and navigate workforce, education, and social service systems in unfamiliar local markets.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, video conferencing, and remote collaboration tools, and with tracking and reporting information in a database.
  • Commitment to anti-racism, ongoing learning, and equitable service to all eligible clients.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.

Preferred

  • Undergraduate degree in a related field
  • Experience in workforce development, career coaching, or case management.
  • Lived experience as a refugee or immigrant.
  • Experience with Efforts to Outcomes (ETO).
  • Familiarity with credential evaluation, professional licensing, or recertification pathways.

Compensation: (Pay Rate: $19-$28/hr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Benefits: IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.


Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About the role

Our Customer Experience team is growing fast, and we want our technology to grow its capacity as well. We're looking for a Director of CX Technology and Systems to own the CX technology stack: set the multi-year vision, then personally configure, test, integrate, and ship against it.

You'll lead our biggest contact center initiatives, including modernizing our CCaaS and telephony platforms, expanding AI agent capabilities, and deepening integrations across our e-commerce, OMS, and ERP systems in partnership with our Product / Engineering teams. This is an owner-operator role, not a vendor-management role. You'll build the first version yourself and grow into leading a team as the business need dictates.

You'll measure success by the efficiency you gain, the friction you remove for agents and customers, and the long-term capacity you create.

About FCP Euro

FCP Euro is the trusted home and online destination for European car owners and professionals. Family-owned since 1986, our mission is to make European vehicle ownership more enjoyable and enduring by delivering the highest quality parts, knowledge, and support people can rely on. At FCP Euro, we exist to empower owners and professionals with the confidence and support to care for their European cars properly. That commitment has made us more than a retailer, but a long-term partner for those who value quality, expertise, and trust throughout the life of their vehicle.

What you'll do

Lead platform migrations and implementation

  • Lead CCaaS and telephony upgrades and migrations through every phase: discovery, requirements, design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare.
  • Personally design and configure contact flows, IVR logic, queues, routing profiles, skills-based and priority routing, and disaster recovery behavior.
  • Build test and cutover plans, including parallel run strategy, rollback criteria, and service-level protection during transition.
  • Manage implementation partners and vendors, owning scopes of work, milestones, acceptance criteria, and post-launch support.
  • Lead agent and supervisor training with our Knowledge Management and Learning team, and set platform administration standards with IT.

Put AI and agent augmentation to work

  • Own optimization of Zendesk Copilot and other agent assist tools, from procedure design and macro hygiene to suggested-response tuning and adoption tracking.
  • Identify, pilot, and launch AI agent and agent augmentation capabilities across voice, email, chat, and self-service.
  • Define how every automation is measured: containment, deflection, escalation rate, resolution quality, CSAT, and handle time.
  • Partner with Voice of Customer and QA to make sure automation improves the customer experience, and speak up when a tool isn't meeting the bar.
  • Maintain an efficiency ledger showing capacity created, cost per contact impact, and headcount avoided.

Set the CX technology strategy

  • Own a rolling multi-year roadmap for the CX stack, sequenced against growth plans, contact volume forecasts, and the budget cycle.
  • Build business cases for major investments, covering total cost of ownership, implementation effort, and expected efficiency gains.
  • Scan the CCaaS, agent assist, and AI agent market, run structured evaluations and pilots, and make clear build, buy, or defer recommendations.
  • Define the target-state architecture for how Zendesk (or alternative platform), telephony, Solidus, Coresense, and future systems share data.

Connect systems and listen to the front line

  • Serve as the primary CX partner to Product and Engineering, writing requirements and user stories and following work through to adoption.
  • Drive integrations so agents can resolve orders, returns, replacements, and Lifetime Replacement Guarantee claims without switching systems.
  • Spend regular time on the floor and on the phones, and run a transparent process for capturing and prioritizing friction reported by the team.

jobs.description:
About the Company:

OSEA was founded in 1996 with a mission to create clean, clinically proven skincare powered by the sea. We are female-founded, rooted in California (with a distributed workforce and a Venice, CA office) and inspired by the ocean, wellness, and sustainability. As we continue to grow, we stay grounded in gratitude, passion, and purpose. Our award-winning formulas blend nutrient-rich seaweed with active botanicals to deliver visible results. Come ride the wave with us!

About the role:

Join our fast growing beauty brand on a contract basis. We are looking for a savvy, passionate Senior Manager, Wholesale Operations (Contract) to provide leave coverage from approximately November 2026 through May 2027. You will step into an established role and keep our Wholesale business running without disruption, owning account and SKU setup, retailer systems, order and inventory management, and cross-functional execution across retail partners including Ulta, Nordstrom, and specialty and international accounts. The ideal candidate hits the ground running, brings hands-on experience with beauty retailer operations, and is comfortable taking ownership of a full workload quickly. Our mission is to create effective, results-driven skincare that is safe for the planet and humankind.

Requirements

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison across Wholesale, Operations & Fulfillment, Finance, and Trade/Brand Marketing teams, ensuring clear, proactive communication while identifying gaps, aligning priorities, and guiding cross-functional decision-making.
  • Act as the Wholesale process and project manager for product lifecycle changes, including launches, positioning changes, reformulations, name changes, discontinuations, and price changes; own timelines, task tracking in Asana, and internal and external communication.
  • Lead commercial setup for new accounts and SKUs, including retail and non-sell item setup, new account setup in NetSuite and Shopify in partnership with New Business, and accurate item data across all retail partners.
  • Own retailer portals and systems as the central point of contact, including SPS Commerce, Novi, Syndigo, Provenance, and Intertrade; maintain access, data accuracy, and compliance with each retailer's requirements.
  • Partner with Trade Marketing and Account Managers to set up and update retailer PDPs, and manage the Canto wholesale asset portal so retail partners always have current, on-spec content.
  • Oversee end-to-end order management, owning risk identification and resolution related to order accuracy, fulfillment timing, and inventory constraints; communicate out-of-stock and back-in-stock updates to accounts, manage delivery changes, and resolve Ulta OFR adjustments when SKUs are removed from purchase orders.
  • Resolve EDI and SPS item errors and maintain retailer cross-references in partnership with Operations.
  • Create and set up Wholesale GWP SKUs following established SOPs (intake, COGS, and SKU tracking), and coordinate sampling and newness sample sendouts ahead of bulk inventory.
  • Act as liaison for Wholesale retailer sustainability and compliance programs (e.g., Ulta Conscious Beauty, Grove, MECCA), including WERCs and Novi requests and SDS/MSDS documentation, partnering with Product Development and Sustainability teams.
  • Lead and manage special projects, including subscription box programs, corporate gifting and bulk orders, and Wholesale Shopify portal updates, bringing structure, prioritization, and strategic oversight to ad hoc initiatives.
  • Monitor ratings and reviews across retail partners (e.g., Bazaarvoice, PowerReviews/Ulta exports) and share insights with Account Managers and Marketing.
  • Manage recurring Wholesale vendor and tool charges and reconciliation in partnership with Finance.
  • Identify and troubleshoot operational and executional issues, leading cross-functional solutions to minimize disruption; document SOPs and leverage AI tools to build scalable, efficient workflows.
  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with internal and retail partners, serving as a reliable and solutions-oriented point of contact from day one.
  • Complete a structured knowledge transfer before the leave begins, and keep trackers, SOPs, and open-item logs current so responsibilities transition back seamlessly at the end of the engagement.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, retail operations, or sales support, preferably within beauty, personal care, or CPG.
  • Ability to ramp quickly and operate independently with minimal training; prior contract or leave-coverage experience a plus.
  • Direct experience working with major beauty retailers (Ulta, Nordstrom, Sephora, etc.) and their vendor portals, item setup, and compliance requirements.
  • Working knowledge of EDI (SPS Commerce preferred), ERP (NetSuite preferred), and Shopify B2B; experience with product content syndication platforms (e.g., Syndigo) a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage detailed timelines and complex, cross-functional workflows with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; confident managing daily retailer conversations and cross-functional coordination.
  • Analytical skills with the ability to maintain revenue and forecast trackers, interpret sales and inventory performance, and identify executional opportunities or risks.
  • Strong experience with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, Google Suite, and Asana; PowerBI preferred.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, or a strong willingness to learn.
  • Highly organized, proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Must be able to work within a 9a-6p US Pacific-Eastern time zone to be considered for this position.
  • Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Availability to start by early November 2026 for knowledge transfer and commit through June 2027.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this position is $80,000–$100,000 per year. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a few factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role

Directly sells enterprise security software solutions across the breadth of the company’s products and drives incremental revenue with new customers, primarily through flexible and scalable licensing models.


This field sales role has primary accountability for the planning, prospecting, qualification, and closing of revenue on new business accounts. Additionally, this role develops the post close relationship within newly won accounts during the first twelve months by partnering with internal stakeholders who are accountable for onboarding, accelerated adoption, expansion, and drawdown of flexible licensing models.


Incumbents effectively collaborate with other teams, including Account Managers, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, Channel / Alliances sales teams, Finance and Customer Support, as well as external parties such as Alliance and Channel Partners.


This role is located in or around Paris, France (remote).


What You’ll Do:

  • Prospects, identifies, qualifies, and closes new customer revenue within assigned accounts by building relationships with key decision makers, typically using flexible and scalable licensing models (e.g. Falcon Flex).
  • Develops and executes a comprehensive business plan for each account, including identifying core customer requirements and mapping the benefits of CrowdStrike’s solutions to customer business requirements.
  • Coordinates with internal stakeholders during customer onboarding, accelerated adoption of products, expansion, and eventual transition of accounts after the first twelve months to expansion/renewal focused Account Managers.
  • Timely documentation within CRM / Marketing software of customer contact and activity data is required of the role (e.g. names, titles, contact information, opportunity value, product information, sales stages, probability, business pain, firm-future commitments, etc.).
  • Accountable for accurate forecasting, regular quarterly revenue delivery, and the implementation of agreed account and business plans.
  • Promotes CrowdStrike’s products, maximizes brand recognition and mindshare at all levels, and publicizes success stories.
  • Provides customer feedback to internal stakeholders for product, systems, and process improvements.
  • Work is primarily performed in the field away from home office or company office location in order to accomplish the duties of the position.
  • At this level, incumbents will have expert-level knowledge of selling the company’s products and services.
  • Assigned accounts are larger and of the most complex nature, where assigned quota is typically higher than lesser-scoped portfolio sales role levels. (Size of quota may be relative to complexity and nature of account set.)
  • Incumbents routinely sell-to and interact with executive-level customer decision makers, to include up to CXO levels and are typically assigned to Enterprise accounts segmentation.

What You’ll Need:

  • Holds expert-level experience and uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.
  • Deep industry knowledge and understanding of a customer’s decision-making process, goals, strategies, and business objectives.
  • Expert-level presentation, customer service, financial/business acumen, and negotiation skills at all levels of customer engagement.

About Foodsmart:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:
The Revenue Cycle Operations team is a highly collaborative, cross-functional group that manages end-to-end insurance billing and the patient billing experience at Foodsmart. We’re looking for a Revenue Cycle Specialist to be a hands-on part of that team, helping us submit, track, and resolve claims so we can secure timely and accurate reimbursement.

This isn’t a traditional billing seat. Along with day-to-day claims work, you’ll dig into the “why” behind denials and rejections, take on ad hoc problems as they come up, and help us find better ways to work. If you like untangling messy billing puzzles and are curious about how technology and automation can make the process better, this is a great place to build your RCM career.

You will:

  • Process and submit claims: Prepare and submit claims to health plans accurately and on time, and keep the work moving through the billing cycle.
  • Work denials and rejections: Research denied and rejected claims, identify the root cause, make corrections, and resubmit. Flag recurring patterns to the team so we can fix issues at the source.
  • Follow up on reimbursement: Monitor claim status, follow up with health plans and RCM partners, and help resolve payment issues.
  • Support reporting and month-end close: Help prepare claims and billing reports, and keep documentation clean and up to date.
  • Take on ad hoc projects: Jump in on investigations, one-off cleanups, and special projects as they arise. Examples include researching a batch of aged claims or digging into a payer-specific issue.
  • Partner across teams: Work with finance, product, and engineering to share what you’re seeing in the data and in day-to-day claims, and help test and give feedback on process or system improvements.
  • Support the patient and health plan experience: Help with billing communications and questions so patients and health plans have a smooth experience.

You are:

  • A clear communicator and a good teammate
  • Detail-oriented, with an analytical streak
  • Comfortable switching priorities when something urgent comes up
  • Curious and eager to learn, and happy to ask “why does it work this way?”
  • Able to work independently on assigned work and know when to pull in help

You have:

  • 1-3 years of experience in medical billing, claims submission, or denials management
  • Working knowledge of claim lifecycle basics (CMS-1500/837 claims, CPT/ICD-10 coding, EOBs/ERAs, common denial reason codes)
  • Comfort with Google Suite and Excel (sorting, filtering, and ideally pivot tables and VLOOKUPs)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, ideally also with comfort working with health plans to resolve payment issues
  • Experience with EMR or RCM software (i.e. Candid) is a plus
  • Experience with Medicaid or Medicare billing is a plus
  • Experience with registered dietician, nutrition services and/or food billing is a plus
