jobs.excerpt: Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence.
jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

The Client Engagement Manager (Post-Pay), Specialist is the primary client-facing lead responsible for translating payer needs into clear, complete, and implementable requirements across the full implementation lifecycle. This role owns requirements discovery, implementation artifacts, client communications, decision tracking, and cross-functional alignment from initial design through testing, go-live, hypercare, and ongoing support.


The role requires expert-level knowledge of the post-payment payment integrity continuum, including Coordination of Benefits (COB), data mining, DRG and coding or clinical chart review, and Lyric's Replay product suite. The position connects client business objectives with Lyric's product, business analysis, data, engineering, configuration, quality assurance, and operations teams. This person must understand healthcare data domains, source data assets, data mapping, claim and member workflows, and product functionality well enough to ask the right questions, identify gaps, explain how the solution works, and ensure that requirements preserve the client's intent. This person works closely with cross-functional teams—including Implementation, Go-to Market, Product, Engineering, Analytics and others —to configure, deploy, and drive adoption of products in alignment with client roadmaps.

The successful candidate is a trusted advisor and practical sounding board for the client. They bring structure to ambiguity, maintain disciplined governance through requirements, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies, and remain engaged after go-live to support adoption, stabilization, and continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Partnership and Implementation Leadership

  • Serve as the primary payment integrity implementation lead and day-to-day point of contact for assigned payer clients.
  • Lead discovery sessions, working meetings, demonstrations, status reviews, decision forums, and executive-ready updates.
  • Build trusted relationships with client leaders, SMEs, project managers, data and technology teams, and operational users.
  • Set clear expectations, confirm ownership and due dates, follow through on commitments, and communicate changes, barriers, and decisions promptly.
  • Advise clients on implementation choices, workflow design, and practical tradeoffs while keeping the solution aligned with contracted scope and business outcomes.

Requirements Ownership and Artifact Governance

  • Own the end-to-end requirements lifecycle, documentation, traceability, validation, change control, and formal approval.
  • Support client and Lyric teams to capture business, operational, product, reporting, data, integration, security, testing, and readiness requirements in clear language that both client and technical teams can use.
  • Partner with the Business Analyst to translate client needs into detailed requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, data specifications, and configuration decisions.
  • Complete an internal quality and feasibility review with the Business Analyst and accountable technical or product owners before requesting client approval.
  • Maintain the authoritative set of implementation artifacts, including requirements, workflow documentation, data dictionaries and mappings, decision logs, RAID logs, action trackers, meeting notes, test evidence, approvals, training materials, and transition documentation.
  • Control requirement changes by documenting the business need, impact, decision, owner, approval, and downstream effect on scope, timeline, configuration, testing, and operations.

Payment Integrity and Product Expertise

  • Serve as an expert resource across the post-payment continuum, including COB, data mining, DRG review, coding or clinical chart review, provider outreach, overpayment validation, recovery, appeals, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Lyric Replay products and explain product capabilities, workflows, configuration options, dependencies, limitations, and expected user experience.
  • Answer client and internal questions about how the platform and implementation workflows function, and coordinate timely validation when a question requires product or technical confirmation.
  • Identify where client policy, reimbursement methodology, operating model, data availability, or contractual requirements may affect solution design and downstream results.
  • Ensure implementation decisions support accurate, defensible, scalable, and auditable payment integrity outcomes.

Data Discovery, Mapping, and Validation

  • Lead business-oriented discovery of claims, claim-line, member, eligibility, provider, group, benefit, contract, payment, clinical, recovery, and reference data required by the solution.
  • Understand data domains, source systems, file layouts, data lineage, key relationships, code sets, field definitions, timing, completeness, and known data limitations.
  • Partner with client data teams and Lyric technical teams to document source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, default values, exclusions, reconciliation logic, and data-quality expectations.
  • Confirm that data requirements reflect the intended payment integrity workflows and that gaps or assumptions are documented, resolved, and approved.
  • Support data profiling, mapping reviews, validation, defect triage, and readiness decisions using business and domain expertise.

Cross-Functional Delivery and Governance

  • Act as the communication bridge between the client and Lyric product, Business Analysis, engineering, data, configuration, quality assurance, security, operations, and customer success teams.
  • Maintain the RAID log and decision log; proactively identify, assess, assign, escalate, and drive risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies to resolution.
  • Coordinate implementation milestones and dependencies across discovery, design, configuration, integration, testing, training, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Facilitate timely decisions and prevent gaps in understanding by confirming requirements, owners, due dates, handoffs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide concise status reporting that distinguishes completed work, upcoming work, decisions needed, risks, and client or internal actions.

Testing, Readiness, Go-Live, and Post-Go-Live Support

  • Partner with quality assurance, the Business Analyst, technical teams, operations, and the client to define test scenarios and acceptance criteria that trace to approved requirements.
  • Support system testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, validation of fixes, and documentation of client acceptance.
  • Assess business and operational readiness, including users, workflows, access, data, configuration, reporting, training, support, and escalation paths.
  • Coordinate cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities, including issue triage, clear communications, decision tracking, and stabilization reporting.
  • Direct Service Delivery teams and supporting teams to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction. Operate effectively within a matrixed project environment in Closed Loop Execution.
  • Ensure all requests, insights, and decisions are acknowledged, documented, and followed through to closure.
  • Collaborate transparently across internal teams and communicate externally only after confirming full internal alignment.
  • Lead or support escalations with structured discovery, solution proposals, and documented resolution paths
  • Remain a knowledgeable client and internal resource after go-live, support the ongoing account and operations teams, and help identify adoption, optimization, and expansion opportunities.

Key Performance Outcomes

  • Client requirements are complete, internally validated, traceable, approved, and implemented as intended.
  • Implementation artifacts remain current, accurate, organized, audit-ready, and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
  • Risks, decisions, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and changes are identified early and driven to timely resolution.
  • Client and internal teams have a shared understanding of scope, solution behavior, data requirements, responsibilities, and readiness.
  • Testing, go-live, and transition activities are completed with clear evidence, controlled handoffs, and minimal avoidable rework.
  • Clients view the role as a credible payment integrity and product advisor throughout implementation and stabilization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, information systems, data analytics, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive experience in healthcare payment integrity, payer claims operations, healthcare technology implementation, business analysis, consulting, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years leading complex, client-facing healthcare implementations or workstreams from discovery and requirements through testing, go-live, and post-go-live support.
  • Expert-level knowledge of post-payment payment integrity with demonstrated experience across multiple domains such as COB, data mining, DRG review, coding or clinical chart review, overpayment recovery, appeals, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, analyze, document, validate, and obtain approval for complex business and technical requirements.
  • Experience partnering with Business Analysts and technical teams to develop process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, data specifications, and traceability.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare claims and supporting data domains, data mapping, source-to-target logic, data validation, and common integration methods such as secure file transfer and APIs.
  • Experience maintaining RAID logs, decision logs, action trackers, change controls, requirements repositories, test evidence, and implementation documentation.
  • Ability to explain sophisticated payment integrity workflows and product behavior clearly to business, operational, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Excellent facilitation, written communication, presentation, relationship management, negotiation, and issue-resolution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, organize complex information, operate with limited direction, and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and structured project or requirements management tools.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy, security, and data-handling requirements.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20 percent, including client-site travel as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience implementing payment integrity software or services for national or regional health plans across Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, or Marketplace lines of business.
  • Direct experience with Lyric Replay or similar post-payment audit, recovery, workflow, or analytics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational data models, business intelligence tools, data profiling, and reconciliation techniques.
  • Experience with claim-adjudication platforms, payer data warehouses, eligibility systems, provider data, clinical records, and recovery systems.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing client-ready implementation playbooks, training materials, process documentation, and operational transition plans.
  • PMP, PMI-PBA, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or Agile certification.
  • Payment integrity, coding, clinical, health information management, or claims-related credential appropriate to the candidate's domain background.

jobs.description:
Washington Rural Healthcare IT and HIM Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Washington to identify experienced information technology and health information leaders who understand the unique needs of rural healthcare.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming IT, information systems, health information management, medical records, clinical informatics, and data leadership opportunities across Washington.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, community hospitals, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

This Is More Than an IT or HIM Role

Technology and health information are central to nearly every part of modern healthcare.

In a rural organization, IT and HIM leaders help ensure employees have dependable systems, patients' information is protected, records are accurate, and technology supports safe, efficient care.

These leaders may oversee everything from infrastructure, cybersecurity, EHR systems, and technical support to medical records, privacy, coding oversight, data integrity, and information governance.

The strongest rural IT and HIM leaders understand that technology is not simply about systems. It is about people, communication, trust, and making sure staff have the tools and information they need to serve their community.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Chief Information Officer
  • Information Technology Director or Manager
  • Information Systems Director or Manager
  • Health Information Management Director or Manager
  • Medical Records Director or Manager
  • Clinical Informatics Director or Manager
  • EHR or Applications Manager
  • Network or Infrastructure Manager
  • Cybersecurity leadership
  • Privacy Officer
  • Data Governance or Analytics leadership
  • Systems Administrator leadership
  • IT Project or Implementation Manager
  • Senior IT, HIM, informatics, or records supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for IT, HIM, or information systems
  • Supporting reliable technology, infrastructure, networks, devices, and applications
  • Leading EHR optimization, implementation, upgrades, and user support
  • Strengthening cybersecurity, access controls, backup, recovery, and business continuity
  • Protecting patient information and supporting HIPAA compliance
  • Overseeing medical records, document integrity, release of information, and retention
  • Supporting accurate data, reporting, analytics, and information governance
  • Managing vendors, contracts, budgets, projects, and technology planning
  • Leading help desk, systems administration, applications, or technical support teams
  • Developing policies, procedures, and internal controls
  • Supporting privacy, security, audit, and regulatory readiness
  • Collaborating with clinical, operational, finance, revenue cycle, and executive leaders
  • Training employees and helping teams adopt new systems and workflows
  • Improving the connection between technology, information, and patient care
  • Helping the organization prepare for growth, modernization, or system transition

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive experience in healthcare IT, information systems, HIM, medical records, clinical informatics, privacy, cybersecurity, or data management
  • Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, supervisor, CIO, or comparable professional
  • Experience with healthcare systems, EHR platforms, networks, data, privacy, or records management
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, information security, health information regulations, or documentation standards
  • Experience managing projects, vendors, budgets, implementations, or system upgrades
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and team-development skills
  • Experience working with clinical, operational, and executive leaders
  • Rural hospital, Critical Access Hospital, FQHC, public hospital district, long-term care, or community healthcare experience
  • Relevant education, certification, or technical credentials based on the position
  • A practical, collaborative, and service-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may prefer credentials such as RHIA, RHIT, CHPS, CPHIMS, CISSP, PMP, or other healthcare information, privacy, security, or technology certifications. Requirements will depend on the specific role.

Why Rural Washington?

Washington's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, islands, and coastlines. These organizations may operate with smaller teams and limited resources while depending on technology and accurate information every day.

IT and HIM leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to modernize systems, support employees, protect patient information, and strengthen care across an entire organization.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming IT and HIM leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Washington communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, technology or information needs, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Work Where It Matters.

jobs.excerpt: About Ellucian Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students.
jobs.description:
About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

Ellucian's Professional Services team is looking for a Platform Technical Architect to help higher education institutions successfully adopt and implement the Ellucian SaaS Platform. You will work directly with customers as a trusted technical advisor, helping them understand their technology landscape, shape practical architecture approaches, and make informed decisions throughout implementation.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role that combines strong software and enterprise technology fundamentals with consulting, architecture, configuration, and delivery leadership. You will lead and contribute to technical workshops, guide environment and identity strategies, and personally configure, secure, connect, troubleshoot, and validate Ellucian SaaS platform services so they operate as a cohesive, secure, and supportable ecosystem throughout implementation.

You do not need to arrive knowing every Ellucian product. We value accomplished developers, technical consultants, and enterprise technologists who bring curiosity, structured problem solving, clear communication, and the ability to learn quickly. With support from experienced colleagues, you will progressively build the platform expertise and architectural independence needed to lead increasingly complex engagements.

Where You Will Make an Impact

Customer Consulting and Technical Leadership

  • Build trusted customer relationships, understand institutional needs, and align technical architecture and implementation with business outcomes.

  • Lead technical kickoffs, architecture workshops, platform presentations, and alignment discussions, communicating technical approaches, decisions, risks, and implementation roadmaps.

  • Collaborate with customers, Project Managers, Architects, Cloud Operations, Product Engineering, and specialists to resolve challenges and achieve delivery milestones.

Platform Architecture and Technical Governance

  • Design, document, and progressively lead Ellucian SaaS technical architecture, including diagrams, blueprints, design principles, standards, and technical decisions.

  • Perform hands-on configuration, administration, implementation, and integration of Banner or Colleague SaaS, Experience, Insights, identity services, and supporting platform products.

  • Validate platform capabilities and connections, troubleshoot issues, maintain technical documentation, and assess architectural impacts, dependencies, and risks.

Identity, Security, and Environment Strategy

  • Lead technical discussions and implement configurations for identity federation, SSO, access management, user provisioning, permissions, and platform security.

  • Define environment strategies covering configuration consistency, deployment sequencing, and technical readiness.

  • Execute and validate configuration changes across environments, partnering with delivery teams and Cloud Operations to support testing, cutover, and go-live.

Implementation Readiness and Problem Solving

  • Apply expertise in software, APIs, integrations, databases, scripting, and application architecture to troubleshoot cross-platform issues and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.

  • Own hands-on platform readiness for testing, production deployment, go-live, and operational transition, validating platform configurations and connections.

  • Partner with the Applications Architect on integration and extensibility dependencies, while keeping custom integration, API, and extensibility design and development within their scope.

  • Leverage AI tools to automate tasks, streamline technical processes, and improve SaaS implementation efficiency, quality, and consistency with appropriate validation and security controls.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical experience configuring, implementing, integrating, and troubleshooting enterprise applications or SaaS platforms, with a foundation in software development, technical consulting, or related disciplines and the ability to translate architecture into working solutions.

  • Working knowledge of application architecture, APIs, web services, integrations, scripting/programming, relational databases, SQL, and SaaS/cloud environments.

  • Understanding of enterprise platform interactions, identity services, and security, with practical experience configuring and validating IAM, SSO, SAML federation, RBAC, user provisioning, and access controls.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools for technical analysis, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and solution development, ensuring output validation and customer data security.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the curiosity and adaptability to explore technologies, validate assumptions, and develop practical solutions.

  • Strong presentation, workshop facilitation, and communication skills, including architecture diagramming, explaining technical concepts, and guiding discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaborative, accountable team player with strong interpersonal skills, active listening, knowledge sharing, and experience working across multidisciplinary, globally distributed teams.

  • Ability to understand customer business processes, identify needs, and align technical solutions and implementation decisions with business outcomes.

  • Learning agility, sound judgment, and the ambition to grow into broader platform architecture and technical leadership responsibilities.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, balanced with the ability to maintain a strategic view of project objectives, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Monday-Friday 8:00-5:00

Remote

CSC Corptax is the platform behind corporate tax for many of the largest enterprises in the world, handling provision, compliance, planning, and strategy all in the same solution. In addition to tax, we pioneer new solutions in the corporate software space.

We are looking for a software engineer to help us build the next generation of revolutionary tax preparation products.

The Team

We're a driven team that works test first, so quality belongs to everyone rather than to a separate function. Development is agent-led, using tools like Claude Code. However, we stand behind every line of code we ship.

Tech Stack

We choose tools to fit the problem, so the stack is flexible. Today it centers on Python, Node.js/TypeScript, C#/.Net, and React, running on cloud infrastructure with modern CI/CD. Experience with these specifically is a plus, but strong engineers who pick up new tools quickly are what matter most.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain core product systems across data ingestion, computation, user interfaces, and regulatory output.
  • Own features end-to-end, from shaping requirements with the team through design, build, release, and iteration based on client feedback.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and own the tests and tooling the team depends on.
  • Work with systems where data security is of utmost priority.
  • Turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable production code.
  • Write and review design documents and take part in code reviews.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards, and engineering practices.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance, security, and reliability.
  • Document systems and decisions so the team can move quickly and safely.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field with at least 1-3 years of industry experience (equivalent practical experience will be considered as well).
  • Have contributed to shipping production systems where you helped design, build, and maintain the solution.
  • Proficiency in one or more modern languages, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C#/.Net.
  • Experience with agent-led development tools, such as Claude Code.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, relational databases, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Quality tests written as you build, not as an afterthought.
  • A product mindset: you care about whether what you build solves the user's problem, not only whether the code works.
  • Comfort learning an unfamiliar, complex domain quickly and independently.
  • Experience working alongside researchers or on problems without settled answers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.
  • Experience building data-dense interfaces for expert users.
  • Experience with systems where correctness is audited or regulated.
  • Experience with containerization, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling.
  • Experience in an early-stage product or startup environment.
  • Experience integrating with ERP, general ledger, or other financial systems.
  • Background in tax, regulatory, legal, accounting, or another rule-governed domain.

What You Get Out of This

  • A funded product with real regulatory stakes.
  • Ownership of meaningful parts of a product from early on.
  • A small team that shares ownership of quality.
  • Daily access to researchers, tax experts, and the world-class team behind the Corptax product suite.
  • The budget and infrastructure to do the job properly.
  • Fully remote in the U.S., with occasional on-site time or time-zone overlap as needed.

A Note from the Team

Corporate software is unforgiving. A wrong number is a real problem for a real client, so everything we ship must be correct and traceable. We need engineers who test by habit, own their work, and learn a challenging domain quickly. If that sounds like the team you want to join, go ahead and apply!

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

jobs.excerpt: Empromptu AI helps regulated institutions where a wrong answer is expensive and where data cannot leave the building build AI applications that train models they own.
jobs.description:
Empromptu AI helps regulated institutions where a wrong answer is expensive and where data cannot leave the building build AI applications that train models they own. Every correction an expert makes becomes training data, so the model gets more accurate the longer it runs. Our customers include Communicare Health across 140 facilities, along with enterprises in manufacturing, government, finance, and education.

Role Impact

This is not a traditional “marketing manager” role. You will own the entire go-to-market motion end to end.

About the role

You'll own how Empromptu AI shows up in the world, from the story we tell to how developers and enterprises discover, adopt, and champion what we build. There's no team to inherit and no playbook to run. You'll work at all altitudes, setting the high-level strategy and then doing the tactical work yourself, from positioning down to the copy.

What you'll own

  • Narrative and content: shape the company blog, thought pieces, and our unique perspective on AI, and position our founders and researchers as leading voices
  • Product marketing: define our category and translate deeply technical capabilities into messaging that developers resonate with
  • Brand and channels: own our company brand, website, and social cadence across X and LinkedIn
  • Launches and announcements: coordinate product releases and announcements from press to podcasts to events
  • Demand generation: build developer and enterprise interest to build our pipeline

We are looking for people who

  • Ideally have experience targeting CIOs, and/or developers
  • Ideally have run their own marketing agency for clients or have built a marketing function from zero at a start-up and can both set strategy and execute it
  • Are tactically broad, can own narrative, launches, demand, and growth experiments across channels from social to SEO to email
  • Have 5+ years of professional expertise and operating in ambiguous environments
  • Write exceptionally well, clear, technical, and fast
  • Have taste: know what's credible, what's hype, and what's premature
  • Are fluent in the AI industry, leverage tools yourself, and can credibly talk models and APIs with our engineers and researchers
  • Show complete ownership, think at the level of goals, not tasks or tickets
  • Has an analytical mind. You can create systems to clearly show ROI while balancing creative

Success Metrics

After 3 months

  • Drive and capture demand
  • Build and manage partnerships and creator relationships
  • Handle and manage customer support
  • Set up and run marketing automations and GTM tooling

After 6 months

  • Execute and own a full product launch
  • Drive consistent inbound demand
  • Establish Empromptu as a credible voice in AI for B2B SaaS

After 12 months

  • Help drive the company to its ARR goal
  • Own a repeatable GTM motion that ties content, launches, partnerships, and automation to revenue

Must-Have vs. Nice-to-Have Skills

Must-Have

  • Product marketing and go-to-market experience
  • Experience bringing a new product to market
  • Proven ability to generate and grow revenue
  • Ability to execute independently with limited direction
  • Comfort owning multiple functions in a zero-to-one environment

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with tools like Attio, Intercom, Customer.io, Zapier, or similar automation platforms
  • Experience working with early-stage B2B SaaS companies
  • Background in technical or developer-focused products

Team & Culture Context

  • This is the only marketing role at Empromptu today
  • You will work closely with the CEO, product, and engineering
  • The culture favors ownership, clarity of thinking, and bias toward action
  • You should be comfortable making decisions, testing ideas quickly, and iterating in real time

People who thrive here are builders — they like blank pages, unclear playbooks, and real responsibility.

Growth Potential

This role is designed to grow.

As Empromptu scales, this position can evolve into:

  • Head of Marketing
  • VP of Marketing

You’ll have direct influence over strategy, positioning, and future team structure, with opportunities to build and lead a marketing organization over time.

Compensation Transparency

  • Salary range: $120,000 – $180,000
  • Benefits included
  • Fully remote

Inclusive Candidate Signals

We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and paths into marketing and technology. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We care far more about how you think, execute, and learn than about checking every box.

Application Process

Our interview process is straightforward:

  1. Initial interview
  2. Whiteboard or case study interview
  3. Coworker interview
  4. Final interview with the CEO

Hiring timeline: ASAP

If you’re excited to build, launch, and scale a category-defining AI platform and want real ownership from day one, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary: $120,000 – $180,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent.
jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.



The Job

The Program Manager - Claims is accountable for claims escalations, provider abrasion, service issues, pricing, payment policy interpretation, and the investigation and resolution of complex, high-dollar claims. This role ensures claims are adjudicated according to policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements; collaborates with internal and external partners to resolve issues; and analyzes data to identify trends, operational problems, cost savings, and process improvement opportunities.


The position leads claims triage and management for AEP/OEP, supports Total Cost of Care initiatives, and works directly with senior leadership to develop resolution solutions for escalated cases


You Will

  • Manage claims escalations, provider abrasion, service issues, pricing matters, and payment policy interpretation.
  • Investigate and resolve complex, high-dollar claims and ensure claims are adjudicated according to policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with providers, members, Medical Management, Coding, Billing, and Finance to resolve claims issues.
  • Analyze claims and operational data to identify trends, operational problems, cost savings, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Network Management and work directly with external partners, as needed, to address claims-related issues.
  • Lead claims triage and management for the Annual Enrollment Period and Open Enrollment Period (AEP/OEP).
  • Support Total Cost of Care initiatives by identifying and implementing opportunities to improve efficiencies.
  • Support staffing plans and resource allocation for claims programs and initiatives.
  • Manage vendor or third-party claims relationships, when applicable.
  • Support system implementations and claims-platform upgrades, including leading testing and workflow changes, and partner with senior leadership to develop resolution solutions for escalated cases.
  • We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.
  • Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2-3 years of leadership experience.
  • 5 or more years of progressive experience in healthcare claims operations, claims analysis, or a related health plan function.
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs, complex claims issues, vendors, or claims-related initiatives.
  • Experience with Medicare Advantage claims operations and regulatory requirements preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of claims adjudication, claims operations, pricing, and applicable policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to interpret National Coverage Determinations and Local Coverage Determinations (NCD/LCD) and other payment policies.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex, high-dollar, and escalated claims.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, operational problems, cost savings, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with providers, members, Medical Management, Coding, Billing, Finance, Network Management, vendors, and external partners.
  • Program and project management skills, including the ability to lead multiple priorities and deliver results.
  • Ability to support staffing plans, and resource allocation.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, testing, claims-platform upgrades, and workflow changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present issues and resolution solutions to senior leadership.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage sensitive or highly escalated matters.
  • Leadership - Skilled to develops others
  • Problem Solving - Strong problem-solving skills
  • Optimizes Work Processes - Identifies and creates processes necessary to get work done
  • Advanced Microsoft Office Suite, Visio, and SQL experience are required.

What's in it for you?


  • Base salary range: $106,200 to $153,705 per year
  • Work Mode: Mostly Remote
  • An annual employee bonus program
  • Robust Wellness Program
  • Generous paid-time-off (PTO)
  • Eleven paid holidays per year, plus 1 floating holiday, plus 1 birthday holiday
  • Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match and contribution
  • Robust employee recognition program
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

jobs.description:
Overview

Senior Production Support Analyst

(Remote)

About Us:

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

Why Work at Matrix?

  • The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
  • A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
  • Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
  • Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

Responsibilities

About the role:

Type: Full Time, Salary

Compensation: $101,000-$151,000; Bonus 10%

Location: Fully Remote, must be in the United States

Hours: Full Time Days

Benefits Offered to include: Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

What to expect:

The Senior Production Support Analyst is the senior operational owner for the member scheduling and access platform, the front door of the member journey, covering scheduling for in-home and telehealth assessments, primary care visits, and quality and care-gap closure visits. The analyst leads Tier 2 and Tier 3 incident response, owns root cause and problem management, and sets the monitoring, runbook, and release validation standards for the platform and its integrations.

The role works daily with the Senior Product Owner, the scheduling platform engineering team, the central Data and Quality Assurance (QA) teams, the IT Service Desk, and external scheduling and health plan partners. Because scheduling failures reduce completed visits, the analyst ties incident and defect data to conversion impact so the Senior Product Owner can prioritize fixes on measurable outcomes. The analyst also mentors less experienced support staff.

Systems and Processes Supported

  • Core scheduling platform: initial scheduling, in-home and telehealth assessment scheduling, and quality and care-gap closure visit scheduling.
  • Provider access and demand-capture scheduling engine: geographic capacity balancing, progressive scheduling windows, and travel versus non-travel service rules.
  • Real-time scheduling integrations with health plan partners, and the partner API gateway.
  • Self-service channels: SMS self-scheduling, the member self-scheduling portal, and the preference center.
  • External integrations with EHR platforms and third-party consumer scheduling networks.
  • The platform’s event-driven architecture, and the canonical data standards and test automation practices shared with the central Data and QA teams.
  • Agile delivery with the engineering team: sprints, backlog grooming, and release planning.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Tier 2 and Tier 3 incident intake, triage, and diagnosis. Act as incident lead on high-severity events, coordinating engineering, partners, and business stakeholders through resolution and post-incident review.
  • Monitor platform availability, SMS delivery, the member portal, provider capacity outputs, event processing, and health plan, EHR, and scheduling network integration feeds. Define alert thresholds, service level indicators, and dashboards with engineering.
  • Diagnose integration failures by analyzing API requests, responses, logs, and event flows to determine whether a fault sits in the platform, a partner system, or the data.
  • Resolve complex scheduling data errors, including duplicate or orphaned appointments, capacity and scheduling window rule errors, and member access cases, using SQL and approved tooling under PHI handling controls. Build repeatable fixes in place of one-off corrections.
  • Own problem management. Lead root cause analysis with engineering, track repeat incidents to closure, and submit findings to the Senior Product Owner as prioritized backlog items with defined impact.
  • Quantify conversion impact. Use scheduling and outreach analytics to measure how incidents and defects affect scheduling conversion and completed visits, and supply that data to the Senior Product Owner’s conversion optimization work and business cases.
  • Serve as first contact and escalation point for health plan, EHR, and scheduling network partners. Track partner SLAs and open items to closure and lead partner troubleshooting.
  • Take part in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and release planning. Define production readiness and validation criteria, validate releases, run smoke tests with QA, and watch for post-release regressions. Recommend test automation coverage with the central Data and QA teams.
  • Own runbooks, known-issue lists, and escalation paths. Automate recurring support tasks with scripting and AI-enabled productivity tools where appropriate.
  • Report monthly to the Senior Product Owner and IT leadership on incidents, root causes, repeat issues, mean time to detect and resolve, and engineering time spent on production issues.
  • Mentor and train support staff and the IT Service Desk on platform triage, and document knowledge so coverage does not depend on one person.
  • Work with the IT Service Desk on assigned items and meet all Service Level Agreements.
  • Follow corporate security policies and HIPAA requirements when handling protected health information (PHI).
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of technical support experience in a corporate environment, including at least 3 years in Tier 2, Tier 3, or production support for business-critical applications.
  • 3+ years writing SQL queries, including joins and common table expressions, to diagnose and resolve data issues in production.
  • Demonstrated experience leading high-severity incidents and conducting root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
  • Proven ability to identify trends in submitted issues, document them clearly, and present findings to Product Management and Product Engineering teams in a format that supports prioritization decisions.
  • Experience with an IT service management or ticketing tool and with incident, problem, and change management practices aligned to ITIL.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting API and system integrations, including request, response, and log analysis, and working with external partners to resolve failures.
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and log analysis.
  • Experience working with engineering teams in an Agile or Scrum model, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience supporting systems that handle PHI, with working knowledge of HIPAA requirements.
  • Ability to communicate incident status and business impact to senior leadership, and to write clear runbooks and root cause reports.
  • Strong troubleshooting, decision-making, and independent judgment, with the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare scheduling, contact center, or EHR integration technology.
  • Experience supporting event-driven or message-based architectures, including queues and event streams.
  • Experience with conversion funnel or outreach analytics, and reporting tools such as SQL Reporting Services.
  • Scripting experience (Python or PowerShell) to automate support tasks.
  • Experience with generative AI and AI-enabled productivity platforms.
  • Experience with Internet Information Services (IIS), and reading or debugging Java or VB/.NET code.
  • Experience mentoring or leading less experienced support staff.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
  • AI or automation-related certification.

Education

Bachelor’s degree preferred (Information Technology, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field), or equivalent experience in a senior application or production support role with SQL troubleshooting, ideally in healthcare.

Our Culture:

  • We have a clear vision of where we are going, and we are guided by core values that embody our organization and our culture.
  • We emphasizes innovation and growth, and you will be given the opportunities and tools to develop personally and professionally.
  • We encourage and celebrate collaboration.
  • We have a deep commitment to positively impact the communities in which we work and to make a difference in the lives of who we serve.

It is the policy of Matrix to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Job Description:

Chief Technology Officer


Position Summary


ICS is an established B2B retail software provider at a pivotal moment. The company is investing strategically in technology to fuel growth, improve customer experience, and optimize operations — and that investment requires modernizing a mature, business-critical platform. We are looking for a transformational Chief Technology Officer to own that mandate.


Reporting directly to the President, the CTO will own the engineering vision and strategy, shape the target architecture and modernization path, and lead the continued cultural transformation to AI-driven development (AI-DLC) across the organization. This is a hands-on, player-coach executive role: the CTO sets direction and leads through managers and team leads while remaining close enough to architecture, cloud, security, product, and delivery decisions to challenge assumptions and intervene when required. The primary mandate is to modernize the legacy platform and the engineering organization around it, while protecting business continuity, customer confidence, and future scalability.


The ideal candidate is a balanced transformation leader who combines executive judgment, product orientation, technical credibility, and disciplined execution — someone who raises standards and makes difficult trade-offs while building trust, developing leaders, and guiding the organization through change with clarity, even under uncertainty.



Key Responsibilities


  • Own technology strategy, software engineering, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, and delivery across the organization.
  • Set product direction and roadmap prioritization, aligning technology investment with commercial priorities.
  • Lead platform modernization, including migration off the legacy platform, by evaluating rewrite, replatform, refactor, and phased-modernization options and recommending a target architecture and delivery path.
  • Establish CI/CD pipelines, observability, and automation to support reliable, predictable weekly releases, and set the cloud and hosting modernization roadmap, including sequencing, migration controls, and rollback readiness.
  • Embed AI tooling into the development process (AI-DLC) — automated testing, smarter code review, faster iteration cycles — and make AI-assisted development standard practice across engineering.
  • Own cybersecurity, IT general controls, compliance, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risk governance for a platform serving both trade customers and end consumers.
  • Reduce tribal knowledge by getting institutional knowledge out of people’s heads and into documentation and runbooks, making the platform easier to maintain, improve, and ramp new engineers into.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a distributed 14-person engineering organization spanning internal, offshore, and external partner resources, setting clear expectations and building a team that ships consistently and owns its work.
  • Evaluate and prioritize commercially viable customer-facing AI capabilities on their commercial merit, separate from internal AI-DLC tooling adoption.
  • Maintain selective involvement in strategic customers, major escalations, product advisory discussions, and technically complex opportunities.
  • Provide periodic Board and executive exposure on modernization, technology investment, strategy, cybersecurity, and risk.


AI and Operating Expectations

About the Role

The Cloud Access Administrator is a key operational role focused on day‑to‑day identity lifecycle administration, access operations, and security support. The position is similar in nature to a technical service desk or provisioning role, but without direct phone support, and with a strong emphasis on technical execution, case handling, documentation, and operational accuracy.

This role acts as an important interface between Security, Cloud Operations, Engineering, Sales Operations, and Support teams, ensuring that identity and access services are delivered, maintained, and administered correctly according to defined security policies and service descriptions.

  • Governance, Policy, and Compliance: Support the maintenance of IAM policies, standards, and controls to ensure alignment with corporate requirements and regulatory compliance, while assisting with internal audits.

  • Identity Lifecycle Management: Manage end-to-end identity lifecycle processes (Joiners, Movers, Leavers), user provisioning, account maintenance, and access requests via ServiceNow or similar ITSM ticketing system.

  • Advanced Access Controls: Implement and manage core capabilities including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance, and Access Reviews.

  • Security Monitoring and Incident Response: Monitor IAM solutions, investigate security events, execute corrective actions, and collaborate with the other departments to ensure controls are strictly followed.

  • Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot, resolve, and escalate identity and access-related issues while maintaining accurate IAM records and documentation.

  • Order Support: Work with sales order forms, service requests, and operational handovers from Sales or Delivery teams.

Technical & Operational Skills:

  • Previous experience in IT operations, or service desk–type roles.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting core IAM technologies and platforms (Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM)

  • Hands-on experience managing Active Directory and Windows Server environments, including Domain Controller maintenance, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), organizational unit (OU) structures, and user/computer object lifecycles.

  • Understanding Privileged Access Management (PAM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Just-In-Time (JIT) access, and Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP).

  • Hands‑on experience working with ServiceNow (or similar ITSM tools) for Case, Request, Problem and Incident management.

  • Ability to perform standard technical fixes and administrative tasks by following documented procedures and runbooks with strong process discipline and attention to detail.

Reporting & Data Handling:

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including working with reports, structured data, and basic analysis.

  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex identity data into clear, structured reporting views designed for stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in scripting languages (such as PowerShell or Python) to automate user provisioning, audit log retrieval, and identity lifecycle workflows.

Documentation & Communication:

  • Demonstrated ability to provide transparent instructions, training materials, and escalation paths for end-users and IT teams navigating identity, access management, and ticketing workflows.

  • Proven experience creating, updating, and maintaining comprehensive IAM governance frameworks, operating procedures, technical standards, and policy documentation to align with evolving regulatory requirements

  • Clear and professional written communication skills (English required).

Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a hands-on technical lead role. This role has broad scope across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, database, integrations, and hosting, for the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. The role emphasizes autonomy and ownership while setting technical direction, driving platform consistency, and mentoring engineers to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
This position blends day-to-day software engineering with technical leadership. It involves modernizing legacy systems, reducing technical debt, and establishing consistent platform patterns. These efforts span across two independent health plan technology stacks. The role also promotes modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure and security as code, automated testing, and observability) and expects responsible use of Humana-approved AI and code generation tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is responsible for design, development, and modernization of applications and platforms that support the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and trust, owning solutions end-to-end across the full stack rather than being confined to a single application or technology area.


The Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team functions as a highly empowered, end-to-end technology organization supporting two acquired health plans with independent core administration systems and technology stacks. As a result, this role works across the full spectrum of core platforms and supporting systems—collaborating with peers, enterprise architecture, and platform partners to define technical direction, align to enterprise standards where appropriate, and reduce system complexity and operational burden.


This position regularly wears multiple hats—building and modernizing software across front-end, back-end, database, integration, and hosting layers; contributing architectural vision; addressing technical debt; and improving reliability and scalability across environments. The engineer will lead by example through hands-on delivery, strong code review practices, and mentoring. Additionally, they will drive software-driven automation, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure, and security as code. Furthermore, they will adopt cloud-native patterns, such as containers and orchestration, where they fit the market's needs. The role will also champion practical, responsible use of Humana-approved AI-assisted development and code generation tools (Google-based tooling in Humana's standard stack) to increase throughput and strengthen code quality.


Success in this role is driven not only by technical outcomes, but also by how the individual shows up: bringing curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and a growth mindset. This role is well suited for a lead engineer who can translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs, communicate tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor teammates through design and delivery, and progressively take on broader platform and architecture responsibility while remaining hands-on.


Additional Job Responsibilities


  • Lead hands-on design and delivery of applications and platforms across the Wisconsin Medicaid Market (front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting)
  • Work across multiple insurance core administration platforms and supporting services rather than a single domain
  • Identify and address technical debt and reliability gaps that improve scalability, supportability, and operational outcomes
  • Support modernization efforts (including migration from legacy implementations to modern patterns where applicable), with an emphasis on automation and repeatability
  • Partner with IT leadership, enterprise architects, and platform teams to align decisions with enterprise standards and long-term direction

  • Balance hands-on delivery with technical leadership (architecture decisions, alignment, and coaching) as priorities evolve

Team Culture & Expectations


On the Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team, how you show up is as important as what you accomplish. We value ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and a strong desire to learn and make a meaningful difference. Team members are trusted to operate with autonomy, take accountability for outcomes, and work across domains to solve problems end‑to‑end.


A growth mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to continuously learn new technologies and approaches are essential for success in this role—including embracing and effectively leveraging Humana‑approved AI‑assisted development and code generation as a standard part of how the team delivers high‑quality outcomes.


Use your skills to make an impact

Deep experience building and modernizing applications across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting. Strong experience with the Microsoft technology stack (e.g., .NET, SQL Server, Windows-based services) and cloud-hosted solutions (especially Azure). Comfortable working across application, integration, and platform layers in complex environments.

DevOps, Automation, and Infrastructure/Security as Code

Experience designing delivery pipelines and operational automation (CI/CD), applying infrastructure as code and security as code practices, and improving developer experience through repeatable, self-service patterns.


Cloud-Native Patterns (Containers & Orchestration)

Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration concepts (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes/AKS) and when to apply them to improve scalability, resilience, and consistency across environments, especially Azure.


Reliability, Observability & Operational Excellence

Ability to improve production supportability through monitoring, logging, alerting, and runbook-style documentation; experience reducing incident volume via root-cause analysis, automation, and resilient design.


Cross‑Domain Systems Thinking

Ability to understand and navigate interactions across multiple insurance core systems, platforms, and supporting services, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows and reduce system sprawl.


Modernization, Reliability & Code Quality

Experience modernizing legacy technologies and improving reliability, performance, and operational supportability through thoughtful design, refactoring, and automation.


AI‑Assisted Development & Code Generation

Comfort actively leveraging AI‑assisted development and code generation tools to improve productivity, code quality, analysis, and learning. Sprints run two weeks with four to five features each, and coding agents write most of the first draft. If you'd rather have a QA team or a release manager handle testing and store submissions, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and a backend developer, who's your counterpart on the sync and upload APIs. jobs.excerpt: CONFISA Group busca incorporar un Programador de Aplicaciones Web con Inteligencia Artificial para participar en el desarrollo de una plataforma tecnológica propia, orientada a ofrecer soluciones digitales innovadoras mediante inteligencia artificial.
jobs.description:
CONFISA Group busca incorporar un Programador de Aplicaciones Web con Inteligencia Artificial para participar en el desarrollo de una plataforma tecnológica propia, orientada a ofrecer soluciones digitales innovadoras mediante inteligencia artificial.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia práctica en desarrollo de aplicaciones web, capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y entusiasmo por construir un producto desde sus primeras etapas hasta su lanzamiento comercial.

Principales responsabilidades:

  • Diseñar y desarrollar una aplicación web moderna, intuitiva, segura y escalable.

  • Programar tanto el frontend como el backend de la plataforma.

  • Integrar herramientas y APIs de inteligencia artificial para automatización, análisis de información y generación de contenido.

  • Desarrollar funcionalidades de registro, autenticación y administración de usuarios.

  • Implementar módulos para gestión de documentos, búsquedas personalizadas y seguimiento de actividades.

  • Diseñar e integrar bases de datos y servicios externos.

  • Realizar pruebas, identificar errores y mejorar continuamente el funcionamiento de la aplicación.

  • Documentar el desarrollo y mantener el código organizado mediante herramientas de control de versiones.

  • Colaborar directamente con la dirección del proyecto para transformar necesidades de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas funcionales.

Se trata de un proyecto con visión de crecimiento y posibilidades de colaboración a largo plazo, en el que valoramos especialmente la iniciativa, la capacidad de resolver problemas y la orientación a resultados.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiencia comprobable en desarrollo de aplicaciones web completas (Full Stack).

  • Conocimientos sólidos de JavaScript y/o TypeScript.

  • Experiencia utilizando React o Next.js para desarrollo frontend.

  • Conocimientos de backend con Node.js y/o Python.

  • Manejo de bases de datos como PostgreSQL, MySQL o Supabase.

  • Experiencia integrando APIs y servicios externos.

  • Conocimientos prácticos en integración de herramientas de inteligencia artificial, como OpenAI u otras plataformas similares.

  • Experiencia implementando sistemas de registro, autenticación y administración de usuarios.

  • Manejo de Git y GitHub para control de versiones.

  • Conocimientos básicos de seguridad, protección de datos y despliegue de aplicaciones web.

Competencias personales:

  • Capacidad para desarrollar soluciones de manera autónoma.

  • Pensamiento lógico y habilidad para resolver problemas técnicos.

  • Organización, responsabilidad y cumplimiento de objetivos.

  • Buena comunicación y disposición para colaborar con equipos no técnicos.

  • Iniciativa para proponer mejoras y alternativas de desarrollo.

  • Interés en participar en un proyecto tecnológico con posibilidades de crecimiento.

Se valorará adicionalmente:

  • Experiencia desarrollando plataformas SaaS.

  • Conocimientos de Vercel, servicios en la nube y pasarelas de pago.

  • Experiencia con procesamiento de documentos PDF y Word mediante inteligencia artificial.

  • Portafolio, repositorio GitHub o ejemplos verificables de aplicaciones desarrolladas.

Formación académica: Ingeniería en Sistemas, Software, Informática, Tecnologías de la Información o carreras afines. También se considerarán candidatos autodidactas con experiencia demostrable.

No es indispensable contar con experiencia en grandes empresas; valoramos especialmente la capacidad técnica, los proyectos realizados y los resultados obtenidos.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% remoto, desde cualquier ciudad de México.

Tipo de colaboración: Contratación inicial por proyecto, con posibilidad de continuidad a largo plazo.

Dedicación: Preferentemente medio tiempo, aproximadamente 20 horas semanales, con horarios flexibles y objetivos definidos.

Remuneración: Pago por hora, de acuerdo con la experiencia, las competencias técnicas y la disponibilidad del candidato. Rango de referencia: $100 a $180 MXN por hora.

Etapa inicial: Periodo de 30 días para desarrollar y entregar avances funcionales, con objetivos y fechas previamente acordados.

Para participar en el proceso, solicitamos:

  • CV actualizado.

  • Portafolio, GitHub o ejemplos de aplicaciones desarrolladas.

  • Indicar ciudad de residencia.

  • Disponibilidad de horas semanales.

  • Expectativa económica por hora en pesos mexicanos.

  • Breve descripción de su experiencia desarrollando aplicaciones web e integrando inteligencia artificial.

Proceso de selección: Entrevista inicial, revisión de proyectos realizados y evaluación técnica práctica remunerada para candidatos finalistas.

Ofrecemos la oportunidad de participar directamente en la creación de una plataforma tecnológica con proyección comercial, colaboración cercana con la dirección del proyecto y posibilidades de crecimiento profesional.

Se valorará especialmente la capacidad de ejecución, el compromiso, la creatividad y la orientación a resultados.

CONFISA Group es un grupo empresarial especializado en soluciones integrales de talento, búsqueda y selección de ejecutivos (Executive Search), reclutamiento especializado (Staffing Services) y desarrollo profesional.

Con una trayectoria de más de cuatro décadas en el mercado, combinamos experiencia, conocimiento empresarial y una red de relaciones profesionales para conectar talento con oportunidades y ayudar a las organizaciones a fortalecer sus equipos.

Actualmente impulsamos nuevos proyectos de transformación digital e inteligencia artificial, orientados a desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras para el mercado laboral y el crecimiento profesional.

Buscamos incorporar talento tecnológico que quiera participar en proyectos reales, aportar ideas y crecer profesionalmente junto con nuestra organización.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a QA/Test Automation Engineer to validate accession-processing workflows, business rules, integrations, and exception paths for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a QA/Test Automation Engineer to validate accession-processing workflows, business rules, integrations, and exception paths for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role prepares traceable functional test cases and test data, conducts exploratory and regression testing, supports automated test coverage, and documents objective evidence of software quality.

The QA/Test Automation Engineer works with requirements analysts, developers, senior testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, mission stakeholders, and Government users. The position supports defect identification and verification, sprint demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and release-readiness activities.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The QA/Test Automation Engineer will:

  • Analyze requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflows, and technical documentation to determine testing needs.
  • Develop and maintain functional test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, test data, and expected results.
  • Validate accession-processing workflows, business rules, calculations, decision logic, integrations, data relationships, and exception paths.
  • Ensure test cases are traceable to approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and identified risks.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, test results, defects, corrections, and release outcomes.
  • Conduct functional, integration, system, exploratory, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
  • Develop, execute, maintain, or improve automated regression tests where appropriate.
  • Identify repeatable, stable, and high-value test scenarios suitable for automation.
  • Support the execution of automated tests through approved build, test, or continuous-integration pipelines.
  • Prepare representative test data while protecting sensitive information.
  • Execute tests in development, integration, test, staging, or other Government-approved environments.
  • Document test results and retain complete, repeatable, and auditable test evidence.
  • Capture screenshots, logs, system responses, data comparisons, and other evidence needed to demonstrate test outcomes.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Prepare defect reports with reproducible steps, expected results, actual results, severity, evidence, and affected requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers and senior testers to reproduce issues, clarify expected behavior, and support root-cause analysis.
  • Verify defect corrections and perform targeted regression testing to identify unintended impacts.
  • Participate in defect-triage meetings and communicate testing progress, unresolved issues, and quality concerns.
  • Support Government user acceptance testing by preparing test cases and data, assisting users, documenting results, and tracking findings.
  • Distinguish potential defects from training, configuration, data, environment, or requirements issues.
  • Support sprint demonstrations, capability reviews, operational validation, and stakeholder-feedback activities.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to verify approved security corrections and associated regression impacts.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain test artifacts, defect records, evidence, status information, and quality metrics in approved tools and repositories.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of test coverage, automation, defect prevention, evidence management, and quality practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least six years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing functional software testing.
  • Experience validating complex workflows, business rules, decision logic, integrations, or exception paths.
  • Experience developing and executing functional test cases and test data.
  • Experience conducting exploratory and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting test results and retaining objective test evidence.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and verifying software defects.
  • Ability to maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, test results, defects, and corrections.
  • Ability to develop, execute, maintain, or support automated regression tests.
  • Ability to analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to determine test coverage.
  • Ability to support Government or customer user acceptance testing.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with analysts, developers, senior testers, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • A recognized software-testing certification, such as an ISTQB certification, Certified Software Tester (CSTE), Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or an equivalent credential.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development or modernization programs.
  • Experience testing military accession processing, personnel processing, regulated workflows, or other rules-intensive mission systems.
  • Experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing automated tests using Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another supported programming language.
  • Experience testing web applications, APIs, databases, interfaces, batch processes, or event-driven services.
  • Experience with requirements traceability matrices and test-management platforms.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Confluence, or comparable testing and collaboration tools.
  • Experience integrating automated tests with continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.
  • Familiarity with performance, security, accessibility, compatibility, or resilience testing.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility testing and assistive-technology validation.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, configuration-management, and secure software-development practices.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
