jobs.description:
Lead AI Solutions Engineer

About the project
An international client engagement building an enterprise AI capability for a global professional services organisation. You will join a three-person core team (Enterprise AI Architect plus two Lead AI Solutions Engineers) and own a workstream end to end.

About the role
We are looking for a Lead AI Solutions Engineer to turn business knowledge into reliable, reusable AI skills that real users adopt. You will work directly with business stakeholders and domain experts, from the first conversation to a shipped, tested and adopted solution. This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of software development, prompt and context engineering, and business process automation. You run your own client conversations and pilot cycles, and you work within the architecture and standards set by the Architect, pushing back with a reasoned case when warranted.

What you will do

  • Work directly with business stakeholders and domain experts to understand objectives, processes, constraints and expected outcomes

  • Analyse requirements, documentation, examples, templates and other reference materials

  • Identify which workflows are worth automating with AI and which are better served by conventional software, and say so plainly

  • Translate complex, ambiguous business processes into structured, executable instructions for AI agents

  • Design, implement, test and maintain reusable AI skills: instructions, supporting scripts, validation logic, reference data and shared workflow components

  • Build evaluation for your workstream: realistic scenarios, golden cases, acceptance criteria and regression checks

  • Debug agent behaviour: establish why a workflow produced the wrong result and fix the root cause

  • Run pilots with real users, collect structured feedback and ship improved versions

  • Own the outcomes of your workstream: adoption, measurable time saved, and reliability for real users

  • Follow the team's standards for authoring, reviewing, versioning and releasing skills, and contribute to improving them

  • Integrate with the client's platforms and data sources

What we expect

  • Proven hands-on software engineering experience: you build, review, test and maintain production-quality solutions today

  • Strong engineering foundation in at least one modern stack. Our delivery stack is TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS, Angular); fluency is an advantage, not a requirement. Backgrounds in Python, Java or .NET are very welcome

  • Solid engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD

  • Real LLM-backed systems shipped to real users, not just prototypes

  • Hands-on experience with modern AI tools and platforms and a working map of the current landscape, not tied to a single vendor

  • Working command of agentic patterns: tool use / function calling, MCP, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured instruction design, orchestration

  • Experience evaluating and improving non-deterministic systems with test sets and measurable acceptance criteria

  • Sound judgement on where AI fits and where conventional software is the better answer

  • Direct experience with external clients and business stakeholders: you run your own client conversations without an intermediary

  • Experience shaping and pitching solutions, not only delivering pre-scoped work

  • Ability to turn ambiguous requirements and tacit domain knowledge into a clear design and an executable workflow, and to ask the questions that close the gap

  • Ability to explain technical approaches and trade-offs to a non-technical audience

  • Product mindset: you optimise for user adoption and business outcome, not technical elegance

  • English C1: you run client conversations unaided

  • Sustained working-hours overlap with the client (US / Western Europe)

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code, especially authoring Skills, plugins or MCP servers

  • Experience with LLM evaluation tooling (promptfoo, LangSmith, custom harnesses)

  • Consulting or professional services background

  • Exposure to HR tech, compensation & benefits, payroll or workforce analytics

  • Experience building internal developer tooling or standing up a platform capability

  • Public work: open-source agent tooling, published skills or plugins, conference talks, technical writing on agentic engineering

    💼 What we offer

jobs.excerpt: We're hiring a senior Search & Relevance Engineer for a fast-growing, US-based B2B SaaS company.
jobs.description:
We're hiring a senior Search & Relevance Engineer for a fast-growing, US-based B2B SaaS company.

You'll own one question: when a user describes who they're looking for, do we give them the right results? You'll measure relevance, find what's broken and ship the fix yourself, working with AI coding agents every day. This is a full-time remote role.

What you'll do

  • Own search quality across filter search (Elasticsearch) and AI search (natural language to filters).
  • Build the measurement: relevance benchmarks, labeled query sets, offline evals and online metrics. Online, that means tracking whether searches end in a saved result, a refined search, or an abandoned search.
  • Tune Elasticsearch: mappings, analyzers, keyword and industry matching, scoring, synonyms, and handling of messy company names and domains.
  • Build semantic and hybrid search: embed company and person profiles, run vector search alongside keyword search, and tune how the two are blended.
  • Use embeddings to classify companies (industry, business type, B2B/B2C), group similar companies, and power companies like this one.
  • Improve AI search through prompts, schema, model choice and evals. For example, Series A fintechs in Berlin with 50 to 200 employees should become the right set of filters.
  • Find where the data is missing or wrong, measure the impact, and recommend what to fix, enrich or buy.
  • Benchmark data coverage, accuracy and freshness against external sources, and turn the results into a roadmap.
  • Ship code, not just reports, across a TypeScript backend and Python analysis tooling. Use AI to label data, analyze queries and run evals at a scale one person couldn't manage by hand.

You may be a fit if

  • You're AI-native. You build with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) every day, run agents for analysis and labeling, and can show how that makes you faster.
  • You have a product mindset. You start from what the user was trying to do and why the search failed them, then pick the fix that changes their outcome and explain the trade-off to product and leadership.
  • You have 4+ years working on search, ranking or recommendations, with production Elasticsearch or OpenSearch experience (Solr or Vespa also count).
  • You have production experience with embeddings. That covers choosing and evaluating models, vector indexes (Elasticsearch dense_vector/kNN, pgvector, Qdrant), hybrid ranking such as reciprocal rank fusion, and managing index size, latency and re-embedding cost at hundreds of millions of rows.
  • You've built relevance evaluations (judgment sets, precision@k, nDCG) and changed a product because of what they showed.
  • You have strong SQL and Python, and you're comfortable shipping in a TypeScript/Node backend with AI agents.
  • You've shipped LLM features: prompting, structured outputs, eval harnesses, and cost and latency trade-offs.
  • You're comfortable with messy entity data: company matching, deduplication, classification and industry taxonomies.

Nice to have

  • Experience on a marketplace, e-commerce or B2B SaaS search team.
  • Entity resolution or learning-to-rank experience.
  • You've evaluated or integrated third-party data vendors.

What we offer

  • A full-time, fully remote role.
  • End-to-end ownership of search quality for a product used at large scale.
  • An AI-native team where shipping with agents is the default.
  • Direct work with product and leadership.

At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRONDH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

Highlights

Build the cloud platform powering healthcare for millions. Shape the foundation. Make impact on a global scale.

jobs.title: Ingénierie GTM - ShareGate
jobs.excerpt: À propos de ShareGateShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.
jobs.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. Il aide à mettre en place la fondation pour déployer avec confiance l’assistant d'IA de Microsoft.

ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

Les utilisateurs de ShareGate génèrent plusieurs signaux pertinents (utilisation du produit, interactions avec le soutien, dates de renouvellement), mais ces signaux ne sont pas encore reliés dans un moteur qui sécurise et fait croître les revenus qu’on a déjà. Comme Architecte GTM, Expansion et rétention, tu vas concevoir, bâtir et livrer des agents IA et des flux de travail agentiques qui transforment ces signaux en renouvellements sauvés et en pipeline de ventes croisées. C’est un rôle d’ingénierie intégré au GTM, pas un rôle d’opérations en arrière-plan : tu appliqueras à la clientèle qu’on a déjà l’approche axée sur les signaux et centrée sur les agents qu’on utilise pour l’acquisition de nouveaux clients.

Ton impact :

  • Sécuriser les renouvellements en bâtissant des agents IA qui surveillent en continu la santé des renouvellements et signalent tôt les comptes à risque aux gestionnaires de comptes, avec le contexte, les prochaines étapes recommandées et assez de temps pour agir.
  • Faire croître les revenus de notre clientèle existante en concevant et en exploitant une démarche de vente croisée agentique : évaluer l’adéquation avec notre deuxième ligne de produits, faire la recherche sur chaque compte, personnaliser les messages sortants, qualifier l’intérêt et acheminer les vraies intentions d’achat vers la bonne personne en ventes, avec tout le contexte nécessaire pour conclure.
  • Assumer l’ownership du flux de données entre nos systèmes d’utilisation du produit et notre CRM pour que l’évaluation du risque de renouvellement et le ciblage de la vente croisée soient précis et fiables, y compris la qualité des données, la réputation d’expéditeur et la justesse de l’attribution.
  • Remplacer les processus manuels par des agents IA et des modules de pipeline réutilisables (pas des automatisations ponctuelles) que la gestion de comptes et les ventes peuvent exécuter et gérer de façon autonome.
  • Optimiser les deux démarches en prenant en charge les rapports sur le pipeline généré, la conversion, les résultats de renouvellement et l’impact sur les revenus, et en menant des expériences contrôlées sans ajouter d’effectifs.
  • Favoriser l’adoption en transformant tout ce que tu bâtis en procédures normalisées, démos et playbooks, pour que l’équipe utilise ce que tu livres, et pas seulement l’apprécie.

Ton équipe

Tu te joins à un effort d’ingénierie GTM qui applique déjà une approche axée sur les signaux et centrée sur les agents à l’acquisition de nouvelle clientèle, et qui la tourne maintenant vers la clientèle qu’on a déjà. Le défi : relier les signaux d’utilisation, de soutien et de renouvellement dans des agents qui réduisent la friction entre le signal et l’action. Les outils, les tactiques et les canaux vont évoluer ; la mission, elle, restera.

Notre stack technique : orchestration low-code (n8n, Make, Zapier ou équivalent), Python ou TypeScript, SQL sur notre entrepôt de données et notre CRM (HubSpot).

Ce que tu apportes

  • Parcours en RevOps, en opérations GTM ou marketing, en opérations de succès client ou en ingénierie GTM, avec de l’expérience concrète en conception d’automatisations ;
  • Expérience concrète de l’orchestration low-code (n8n, Make, Zapier ou équivalent), et bonne connaissance de Python ou de TypeScript pour les intégrations d’API et la transformation de données ;
  • Aisance avec les outils agentiques et les connecteurs MCP. Solide conception de flux de travail avec des LLM (orchestration d’agents, utilisation d’outils, évaluation), bon jugement pour savoir quand l’IA apporte de la valeur plutôt que de la complexité, et preuves concrètes d’agents IA ou de flux LLM livrés à de vraies personnes, pas seulement des prototypes ;
  • SQL fonctionnel pour interroger et valider les données d’utilisation, de soutien et de renouvellement, afin de bâtir tes agents sur des données auxquelles tu peux faire confiance ;
  • Profondeur en systèmes RevOps : grande aisance avec un CRM et la modélisation de données (HubSpot, un atout), intégrations propres entre les données d’utilisation du produit et le CRM ;
  • Compréhension des métriques d’affaires par abonnement (taux de renouvellement, rétention nette, valeur à vie de la clientèle), et expérience ou fort intérêt pour les approches de mise en marché sortantes et axées sur les signaux ;
  • Capacité à travailler directement avec les ventes et la gestion de comptes, à vulgariser des solutions complexes et à gagner l’adhésion grâce à des démos et des documents de transfert, sans gestionnaire de produit pour faire le pont ;
  • Atout : expérience en conception de systèmes de qualification ou de pointage pilotés par l’IA ; parcours en SaaS B2B avec plusieurs lignes de produits, idéalement axé sur le produit ou les démos ; contenu technique publié qui rend des systèmes complexes accessibles.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 110 000$ - 140 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
    • OTE : 120 000 $ – 155 000 $ CAD
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Note: Le titre interne de ce poste est Architecte GTM.

Ce qui nous anime

On construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Card Solutions (Global Expansion)
jobs.excerpt: About ReapReap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries.
jobs.description:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap?

Our platform empowers businesses with borderless card issuing, seamless payments, and rich expense management tooling. At the core of our offering is the Reap Card—a modern, stablecoin-enabled Visa commercial card solution that unlocks flexible spend controls, global acceptance, and real-time reconciliation for businesses of all sizes.

For developers and partners, Reap also offers a powerful Card Issuing API and white-labelled card program infrastructure—enabling businesses to launch their own branded corporate card experiences with full control over issuance, authorization, funding, and user management. Whether through our dashboard or API, Reap helps companies embed financial services into their workflows with scale, compliance, and flexibility.

The Card team is now scaling Reap's card infrastructure into new markets — bringing card issuing capability to new regulatory environments, BIN sponsors, and client segments.

What You’ll Do

As an Engineering Manager for Card Market Expansion, you will lead the engineering effort to launch and sustain Reap's card programs across new markets. You'll own the end-to-end engineering delivery for market entry: from local regulatory integration and processor configuration, to coordinating cross-team dependencies (Treasury, Onboarding, Compliance, Infrastructure, and Data Warehouse), to ensuring stable, supported operations after go-live.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on leadership role that sits at the intersection of product delivery, compliance requirements, and cross-functional engineering. You'll guide engineering strategy, participate in technical design, and be instrumental in shaping how Reap scales its card issuing infrastructure across multiple regulatory environments.

1. Market Localisation & Regulatory Integration

  • Own the engineering workstream for card program compliance across new markets — including local Visa/Mastercard network rules, BIN sponsor obligations, open banking requirements, and regional regulatory frameworks

  • Integrate with local vendors, issuer processors, and BIN sponsor systems to meet market-specific technical requirements

  • Partner with Product, Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into clearly scoped engineering deliverables

2. Cross-Team Launch Coordination

  • Drive sequenced delivery across all dependent teams: Card Platform, Treasury/Ledger, Onboarding/KYC-KYB, Regulatory Reporting, Chargeback/Disputes, Infrastructure, Data Warehouse, and Security Governance

  • Own the cross-team engineering plan for each market launch — surfacing blockers early, managing timelines, and keeping stakeholders aligned

  • Partner with Product and Country Leads to translate market requirements into scoped, deliverable milestones

3. BAU Ownership & Post-Launch Stability

  • Establish on-call runbooks, incident response playbooks, and SLAs for each live market

  • Own engineering stability post-launch: monitoring, alerting, and incident management across active regions

  • Drive continuous improvement based on production signals — auth failures, chargebacks, reconciliation issues, and SLA breaches

4. Core Card System Enhancements

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the core card platform in parallel with market expansion work — identifying gaps, proposing improvements, and collaborating with other Card EMs on shared infrastructure

  • Ensure market-specific requirements are implemented in a way that strengthens the core system — favouring extensible, reusable solutions over one-off localisations

  • Balance market delivery velocity with long-term platform health and engineering quality

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years in a technical leadership or management role

  • Proven experience in building and operating systems in one or more of the following: payments, risk/fraud systems, card infrastructure, financial reconciliation, or API platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering initiatives and drive architectural decisions

  • Strong systems thinking; ability to design fault-tolerant, observable, and scalable services

  • Hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and peer review, and value working closely with others who do the same

  • Communicate clearly, challenge ideas respectfully, and help raise the quality of the whole team

  • Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, and AWS, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over any specific toolset

Nice to Have

  • Experience working on high-availability financial systems with real-time transaction processing

  • Experience with card networks (Visa, Mastercard) and card lifecycle management

  • Exposure to 3DS, tokenization, digital wallets, and PCI compliance

  • Experience leading teams in high-growth, fast-paced environments

  • Familiarity with observability tools (e.g., NewRelic, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) and CI/CD automation

  • Experience launching card programs in new geographies — including regulatory onboarding, issuer processor integration, and BIN sponsor coordination

  • Familiarity with financial regulations across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., PSD2, GDPR, open banking frameworks, US money transmission, FinCEN requirements, regional Visa/Mastercard rules)

  • Track record of driving cross-functional delivery across teams with shared dependencies (ledger, KYC, compliance, infrastructure)

  • AI/LLM-assisted development familiarity

Your Adventure Benefits

  • A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech startup

  • Flexible remote work environment with a global, collaborative team

  • Insurance coverage after probation

  • Reap Card stipend

  • Use of AI tools at work — and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them

  • A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning

jobs.description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.


You bring more than your expertise to your role, and that matters here. Your story, perspectives, and lived experiences help shape belonging at BECU and deepen how we connect with and support our employees, our members, and our communities.


PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $189,000.00-$230,700.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $146,600.00 - $273,000.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – because people helping people starts with supporting you

  • 401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU

  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • PTO Program + Exchange Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

As a Principal Solutions Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of BECU’s lending and credit card technology ecosystem. You’ll bridge architecture and engineering, transforming complex business needs into scalable, secure, and innovative solutions that improve experiences for both members and internal partners. Your expertise will help drive modernization efforts, strengthen production stability, and accelerate the delivery of new financial products and digital capabilities. Through hands-on technical leadership, you’ll influence enterprise-wide design decisions, mentor engineering teams, and bring forward-thinking ideas that help BECU grow and differentiate itself in the market. You’ll have the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on critical platforms that support millions of member interactions and future business growth.

To join our dynamic team, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, AZ, TX, GA, SC, NC, CA or VA. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance from Tukwila, we are requesting that you come into our HQ on Tuesdays & Wednesdays. For those candidates that live outside the commute distance of TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead Solution Design: Design and deliver complex, enterprise-scale solutions that support lending and credit card platforms while aligning technical strategy with business objectives.
  • Architect for Scale: Translate business and stakeholder needs into detailed technical designs, ensuring solutions meet performance, security, reliability, and scalability requirements.
  • Drive Modernization Efforts: Identify opportunities to simplify complex systems, improve platform architecture, and introduce modern engineering practices that enhance speed and efficiency.
  • Shape Cloud-First Solutions: Lead the design of cloud-ready financial solutions, leveraging modern application architectures, integrations, and services to support future growth.
  • Partner Across Teams: Collaborate with architects, engineers, delivery teams, infrastructure partners, and business stakeholders to drive successful execution across interconnected systems.
  • Guide API and Integration Strategy: Design, develop, and troubleshoot APIs and enterprise integrations that power critical lending and credit card experiences.
  • Support Production Excellence: Analyze production challenges, identify root causes, and lead efforts to improve operational stability while balancing strategic project work.
  • Build Innovative Solutions: Create prototypes and proof-of-concepts that solve complex business challenges and help advance BECU’s technology capabilities.
  • Influence Technical Direction: Use your deep technical expertise and business acumen to recommend solutions that improve member experiences and business outcomes.
  • Mentor and Elevate Others: Provide technical leadership, code reviews, architectural guidance, and mentorship to engineers across the organization.
  • Champion Industry Best Practices: Stay current on emerging technologies, architecture trends, and engineering practices to help BECU continuously evolve and innovate.
  • Communicate with Impact: Present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment and confidence across the organization.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:

  • The opportunity to help shape the future of BECU’s lending and credit card platforms through high-visibility, strategic initiatives.
  • The ability to operate at the intersection of architecture and engineering while remaining hands-on with technology.
  • Exposure to large-scale cloud transformation efforts centered around Azure and modern distributed systems.
  • A platform to influence enterprise design decisions and drive meaningful modernization initiatives.
  • Opportunities to partner with cross-functional teams across technology, infrastructure, architecture, and business organizations.
  • The chance to mentor engineers and technical leaders while expanding your own leadership impact.
  • Meaningful work that directly improves member experiences through innovative financial products and digital capabilities.
  • The ability to balance strategic solution design with real-world operational challenges and production excellence.
  • A collaborative environment where your ideas, expertise, and vision can directly influence long-term technology strategy.
  • The opportunity to bring proven best practices and innovative approaches that help BECU scale for future growth.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a computer science or equivalent work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of information technology experience with demonstrated expertise in application design required.
  • Experience with Financial products, i.e., Credit Card, Mortgage, Loan, Deposits, etc., required.
  • Demonstrated experience in consumer financial products with expertise in UX, integration, and API layer required.
  • Experience with public cloud (Azure/AWS/Google Cloud) technologies including Iaas, Paas, Saas offerings required.
  • Experience leading and collaborating with multiple teams for enterprise-wide initiatives, including business unit teams, to deliver solutions through all aspects of the SDLC required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience with .NET, C#, node.js and modern JavaScript Frameworks in TypeScript or Javascript (React, Angular, etc.), or Python. System administration and automation with Powershell or bash preferred.
  • Strong understanding in SOLID design principles, Object-Oriented Programming and Design. Expertise with SOA patterns and distributed systems design preferred.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems and tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Teamcity preferred.
  • Industry conference experience presenting in front of technically adept, and non-technical audiences preferred.

JOIN THE JOURNEY

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be a part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role, but fuel the growth and success of BECU?

jobs.excerpt: Senior Engineer (Ingestion)TypeScript, Node. js, ClickHouse, Event-Driven Data Pipelines Why join LevellrLevellr is the enterprise community intelligence platform for Discord, Reddit and a growing range of community platforms, trusted by major gaming companies like Scopely, Krafton, and Epic, alongside global brands such as Google, YouTube, and SoundCloud to grow and monetise their communities.
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer (Ingestion)

TypeScript, Node.js, ClickHouse, Event-Driven Data Pipelines

Why join Levellr

Levellr is the enterprise community intelligence platform for Discord, Reddit and a growing range of community platforms, trusted by major gaming companies like Scopely, Krafton, and Epic, alongside global brands such as Google, YouTube, and SoundCloud to grow and monetise their communities.

With millions of messages generated, turning raw activity into clear insight is difficult. Levellr helps teams understand members, spot trends, improve engagement, and make data-driven commercial decisions.

This depends on reliable data ingestion. Our dashboards, reporting, and AI tools require timely, accurate data processing. As we expand customers and sources, ingestion sits at the core of our platform growth.

What you'll work on

You'll join our ingestion squad as a Senior Engineer owning end-to-end data collection, processing, and storage across our integrations.

As we transition to an event-driven architecture, you will design event flows, queuing, retries, failure recovery, and data consistency at scale.

Handling millions of messages, you'll focus on throughput, latency, deduplication, backfills, schema design, and data-store performance while building pipeline observability.

Collaborating with product and AI teams, you'll identify pipeline bottlenecks and deliver continuous incremental updates in ambiguous problem spaces.

You’ll also help us add new platforms fast (Discord, Reddit, Steam, X and customers’ own sources), building the system that makes each new integration quick and cheap, increasingly with AI agents doing the build.

How we ship

Levellr has a strong bias towards shipping and learning from production. We ship early, iterate rapidly, and learn from production. Core systems like Levellr AI moved from initial concept to shipped foundations in weeks.

For ingestion, this pace requires care. Our transition to event-driven architectures must be incremental to ensure continuous data flow.

This demands strong engineering judgement—knowing when to simplify, invest in core foundations, refactor, or adjust approaches quickly.

The level we're looking for

We need a hands-on Senior Engineer who has owned high-volume production data pipelines and can take immediate system ownership.

You can detail past systems you owned, including throughput volume, load patterns, performance bottlenecks, and structural optimizations.

Production experience with messaging queues, pub/sub, or streams is essential, alongside understanding ordering, idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling.

You proactively address risks, communicate technical trade-offs, and take accountability for operational health in production.

What good looks like in you

  • Solid backend engineering experience with significant focus on data pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js across backend services and database stores.

  • AI-native engineering day to day: you build with coding agents and know where they help and where they bite.

  • Strong data-store skills at scale (schema design, query optimisation, indexing, partitioning), ideally across both relational and analytical stores such as ClickHouse.

  • Hands-on ownership of ingestion edge cases: rate limits, schema drifts, backfills, and partial failures.

  • Focus on pipeline observability, monitoring data freshness, and maintaining strict data quality standards.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, establish technical clarity, and drive progress independently.

  • Preference for incremental delivery based on real-world usage rather than lengthy isolated development cycles.

  • Clear communication through concise PRs, technical docs, and async updates that elevate team performance.

  • Located in European timezones with core overlap with UK business hours.

This role probably isn't right if

  • Your experience centers primarily on standard SaaS features without backend data complexity.

  • Your core focus is building AI applications rather than underlying data ingestion systems.

  • You haven't directly owned high-volume data pipelines in production environments.

  • You haven't worked with data at a scale where schema design, indexing and query optimisation really mattered.

  • You require extensive pre-defined structure to operate and deliver.

  • You prefer extended planning cycles or total rewrites over continuous production deployment.

  • You struggle making quick technical trade-offs under dynamic conditions.

The tools we use

  • TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and React across the product.

  • PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redis and PubSub across data, analytics and messaging.

  • Google Cloud, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions and Cloudflare for infrastructure and delivery.

  • Google Agent Platform (Vertex AI), OpenAI, Anthropic and other LLM platforms across our AI systems.

Nice to have

  • Experience with GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or equivalent event-streaming technologies.

  • Familiarity with Temporal or other durable execution frameworks.

  • Hands-on work with third-party platform APIs, handling rate limits and dynamic payloads.

  • Direct experience managing Discord, Reddit, or social media datasets.

  • Exposure to how ingested data feeds downstream AI or search systems.

  • Background in high-growth startup environments driving fast-paced technical decisions.

  • Experience migrating live systems toward event-driven architectures without service interruption.

  • Track record of impactful technical writing, open-source projects, or engineering documentation.

Who we are

Levellr was founded by Tom (CEO) and Ben (CTO), who have experience in both start-ups and large scale companies (YouTube, Eleven Sports). Since 2021 we’ve grown the team to 30+ employees and are backed by a number of successful angels (Mark Pincus, Dylan Collins, Mitch Lasky, Bing Gordon, Frank Gibeau to name a few). The product that we are building is growing in multiple verticals, seeing a 6x growth over the last 3 years and on track to continue.

We believe in substance over hype. We're a product-led company building a sustainable business by solving our customers' most pressing problems. This allows us to create a culture and a company that we're proud to build together. Some of the values we stand for:

We have ownership. We embrace change and take bold risks.

We get shit done. We have a bias for action and love creating value from our code and our conversations.

We disagree and commit. We give radically honest feedback and challenge assumptions, then get behind the result & move on.

We grow in uncertainty. We embrace change, learn from feedback, and continuously improve what we do for our customers.

We care. We care about our team, our customers, and the communities we serve.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive basic salary - full details shared at the initial interview stage

  • 25 days annual leave plus UK public holidays.

  • Remote or hybrid working, with flexible working hours.

  • Co-working space access, including Soho Works locations across London and the US.

  • Stock option plan.

  • Home office budget once you pass probation.

  • Mental health support through Spill.

  • Twice-yearly company meet-ups.

Interview process

  • Screening call with our Talent Partner (Matt)

  • Introductory conversation with our Engineering Manager (Miro): product, technical direction and how the team works

  • A 90-minute async build task, in your own time

  • 60-minute technical follow-up with two of our engineers, on your task and your experience

  • 60 minutes with Ben, our CTO

  • 30 minutes with Isabelle, our Head of People

We aim to complete the process within two weeks and provide clear feedback after each stage.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to federal contract requirements supporting Department of Homeland Security (DHS) agency programs, applicants must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Currently reside within the United States.
  • Have lived within the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Be eligible to obtain and maintain the required U.S. government Public Trust suitability determination.

Your Route Into Cloud Platform & Data Engineering

Welcome to Via Logic, where innovation meets collaboration. We are seeking a Cloud Platform and Data Engineer with 3–5 years of relevant professional experience to support our federal government client. Hands-on experience with both the Salesforce platform and AWS is required. In this role, you will contribute to the deployment, automation, integration, and ongoing support of secure cloud environments and Salesforce-connected applications. You’ll collaborate with developers, platform specialists, and other technical team members to maintain reliable infrastructure, improve data flows, troubleshoot issues, and strengthen delivery processes. Our environment brings together AWS, Salesforce, APIs, databases, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD tooling. You’ll apply your understanding of the Salesforce platform alongside cloud engineering and automation skills to support reliable connections between applications, infrastructure, and data. This is a great opportunity for an engineer with a solid technical foundation who is ready to deepen their experience while supporting meaningful, mission-driven work.

Your Mission Today

Your Responsibilities

  • AWS Infrastructure: Build, deploy, maintain, and optimize AWS infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and databases, to support secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  • Salesforce Platform Support: Work with Salesforce-based solutions and connected systems, collaborating with platform and development teams to support application workflows, integrations, and data access.

  • CI/CD & Delivery Automation: Build and maintain automated pipelines that incorporate testing, security checks, and deployment validation using tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD.

  • Monitoring & Reliability: Use monitoring, logging, and diagnostics to identify performance issues, improve availability, and support efficient resource utilization.
  • Production Support & Troubleshooting: Investigate and help resolve infrastructure, application, API, integration, and database issues. Automate recurring operational tasks where practical.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply secure networking, access controls, encryption, and secrets management practices while supporting applicable federal security and compliance requirements.
  • Testing & Documentation: Contribute automated tests for infrastructure and deployment processes, validate changes, and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
  • Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Agile teams, sprint activities, technical reviews, and cross-functional collaboration.

What Helps Explorers Succeed Here

Required Skills & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Data: Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and ETL processes.
  • Troubleshooting: Experience using monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools to investigate infrastructure, application, integration, or data issues.
  • Security: Understanding of cloud security practices, including identity and access management, encryption, secure networking, and secrets management.

Preferred Experience

Certifications

How We Work

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Agile Coach to lead the next stage of agile maturity across Cast & Crew’s Engineering organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering Operations, and working across teams in our US and India offices, you’ll partner with engineering triads, squads, tribes, and chapters — and with Engineering leadership — to improve how work flows from idea to production.


This is a player-coach role. You’ll coach squads directly while also shaping the organization-level operating model: how engineering teams plan, deliver, measure, and continuously improve. You’ll help scale our internal coaching capability, bring data to every improvement conversation, and lead the responsible adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. Above all, this role is about outcomes over output — helping teams ship better software, not just more of it.


What You’ll Do

Agile Transformation & Operating Model

  • Define and evolve Cast & Crew’s ways of working — definitions of ready and done, working agreements, cadences, and an end-to-end delivery value stream from idea to production
  • Run periodic squad maturity and health assessments, using the results to target coaching where it will have the greatest impact
  • Guide teams in executing within the flow framework, while keeping consistency on the practices that matter for organizational visibility and predictability
  • Support adoption of Team Topologies principles — cognitive load awareness, clear team interactions, and fast flow of value — at the squad and tribe level
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to establish process governance, such as a process improvement council, so standards are owned, reviewed, and sustained
  • Recommend opportunities to simplify and consolidate engineering delivery tooling and workflows, reducing friction and cost

Team Flow & Delivery

  • Coach multiple squads to plan, deliver, and continuously improve — helping them execute against committed work with predictability and confidence
  • Make flow visible at the team and org level — where work enters, queues up, gets blocked, and exits — so teams and leaders can see and improve delivery
  • Facilitate quarterly and program-level planning, helping teams identify, visualize, and proactively manage cross-team dependencies that affect delivery predictability and release readiness
  • Help teams identify and resolve impediments, escalating systemic blockers to Engineering Operations and Engineering leadership when patterns emerge across teams
  • Foster healthy collaboration within the triad (Product & UX, Engineering, QA) and with the team Anchor, ensuring each squad operates as a high-trust, balanced unit

Flow Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the agile and flow metrics framework for coached teams — cycle time, lead time, throughput, work-in-progress, predictability, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and defect trends
  • Lead engaging, blameless retrospectives and root cause analyses that produce concrete, owned action items — and follow through cycle over cycle
  • Run improvement experiments grounded in evidence, coaching teams to read metrics as signals for learning, not as performance scorecards, and to guard against perverse incentives and gaming
  • Use flow data to identify manual bottlenecks and wait states that are good candidates for automation, and track the impact of automation on cycle time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate
  • Track and report technical debt trends, such as the volume logged, the share of capacity spent on paydown, and the link to defect rates and cycle time, so leadership can see its impact on delivery

Coaching Capability & Training & Communities of Practice

  • Coach and mentor internal agile coaches, Engineering Managers, Anchors, and team leaders so they can independently facilitate team operations and continuous improvement
  • Design and deliver hands-on training and workshops on agile fundamentals, squad ceremonies, estimation, and flow metrics, using interactive, cohort-style formats
  • Contribute to the Engineering Operations coaching library — standards, playbooks, templates, and facilitation guides

Engineering Standards & Outcomes Over Output

  • Facilitate adherence to engineering and delivery standards: definition of ready, definition of done, story sizing, code review practices, and release management requirements
  • Champion Cast & Crew’s release train cadence, code freeze policies, and shift-left quality practices at the team level
  • Coach teams to replace manual, repetitive steps in their delivery process with automation, including automated testing, build and deployment pipelines, and Jira workflow rules. The goal is to reduce handoffs, wait time, and human error
  • Partner with Engineering Operations, DevOps, and QA leadership to help teams adopt CI/CD practices and increase test automation coverage, supporting the long-term vision of fully automated, on-demand releases
  • Help teams define what counts as technical debt, using a consistent way to identify, categorize, and log it in Jira so it’s visible and not tribal knowledge
  • Coach teams and Engineering Managers to manage technical debt deliberately. That means sizing and prioritizing it alongside feature work, setting aside a sustainable share of capacity for paydown, and making the tradeoffs explicit in planning conversations
  • Help teams hold a high quality bar through good engineering hygiene, including test coverage, peer-reviewed work, and disciplined definitions of done, so new debt isn’t created faster than it’s retired
  • Coach teams to measure success by value delivered, defect rates, and customer impact — not by story point velocity alone
  • Reframe team conversations around tradeoffs — scope, quality, capacity, risk, and timelines — so commitments are honest and outcomes are real
  • Foster safe team environments where people can raise risks, surface blockers, and challenge assumptions constructively

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years coaching agile software development teams (Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Delivery Coach, or equivalent), including experience leading agile transformation across multiple teams
  • Deep working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, lean, and scaled agile practices, with strong fluency in flow concepts (WIP limits, queues, batch size, cycle time)
  • Demonstrated experience using flow and delivery metrics (cycle time, lead time, throughput, defect trends, DORA metrics) to drive measurable team and organizational improvement
  • Strong facilitation skills, with proven ability to run productive planning sessions and retrospectives and to resolve team conflict constructively
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence, including workflow configuration, automation, and dashboarding
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools within agile coaching or engineering operations work — able to speak to specific tools used, workflow integration, and measurable business impact — with a drive to keep experimenting with emerging AI capabilities
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to coach across roles — from individual engineers to Engineering Managers and engineering leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal coaching capability, such as mentoring junior coaches or establishing an Agile Center of Excellence or guild structure
  • Experience working in a distributed, multi-time-zone organization (including India-based teams)
  • Experience with Jellyfish, eazyBI, or comparable engineering intelligence and reporting platforms
  • Familiarity with Team Topologies, the Spotify model, Extreme Programming (XP), DevOps, and CI/CD practices
  • Experience coaching teams through DevOps and CI/CD adoption, including test automation practices such as TDD, BDD, and ATDD
  • Background in B2B SaaS, payments, payroll, or entertainment/production-related industries
  • Relevant certifications (SAFe SPC, ICAgile ICP-ACC or ICP-ATF, CSM/CSP, Kanban University) are a plus but not required

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in flow metrics — cycle time, throughput, and predictability — across coached squads and at the org level
  • A clear, adopted operating model for planning and delivery that engineering teams recognize and follow
  • Leadership has trusted, timely visibility into delivery health through dashboards and reviews that inform real decisions

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.title: Lead AI Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Build the Data Foundation for a New Mobile Game! We're not looking for someone who has "built a dashboard".
jobs.description:
Build the Data Foundation for a New Mobile Game!

We're not looking for someone who has "built a dashboard". And we're not looking for someone who keeps an existing data stack running. We're looking for someone who already uses agentic workflows as a core part of how they work: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, custom agents, MCP servers, skills, planning loops, review gates, and AI-assisted engineering. Someone with strong opinions on which AI workflows hold up in production and which fall apart when real decisions depend on the numbers.

This is a greenfield build. Our new mobile game is heading into launch, and there is no data warehouse yet. You will choose the stack, set it up, and build the analytics foundation from the first tracked event to the first board-level KPI, with agents as your team. You'll define how gameplay, monetization, attribution, and player behavior data are collected, structured, and transformed into trustworthy insights, automated reporting, and AI-powered analytics tools.

You will work at the intersection of AI, analytics, and game development, building the data foundation of a new game from scratch. You'll define its technical direction and drive the evolution of its analytics and AI capabilities from concept to production.

Unlike a traditional analytics role, you'll use agents to dramatically increase your throughput while remaining the architect, reviewer, and final owner of correctness. The agents generate volume; you provide judgement. If you have been waiting for the chance to design analytics the way it should work with agentic AI, instead of retrofitting AI onto a legacy setup, this is it.

YOUR MISSION

Build the Data Foundation

  • Design and operate the end-to-end gameplay analytics ecosystem.

  • Define tracking, storage, processing, and reporting architecture.

  • Own data correctness and make judgement calls when quality checks flag anomalies.

Drive AI-Native Analytics

  • Build the semantic layer that translates raw gameplay data into validated gameplay and business concepts.

  • Develop AI-driven automated reporting, dashboards, and insight-generation workflows.

  • Evaluate and implement AI tools, agents, and workflows that improve analytics speed, reliability, and depth.

  • Review AI-generated code and analytics on critical paths before they reach production.

Generate Product Intelligence

  • Identify opportunities, risks, anomalies, and trends across gameplay and player behavior.

  • Support product, balancing, design, and leadership teams with data-driven recommendations.

  • Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights.

Set the Agentic Bar

  • Help define how the wider engineering organization adopts agentic practices.

  • Establish standards for tooling, review processes, quality gates, and what "done" means when agents generate most of the implementation.

YOUR BACKSTORY

  • You have built an analytics or data platform from scratch at least once: choosing the stack, setting up the warehouse and pipelines, and taking it into production. Running or extending an existing setup alone is not enough.

  • Several years of experience building analytics or data-driven systems in production environments, ideally in gaming or mobile.

  • Analytics experience on free-to-play mobile games, ideally including a launch (soft launch to global). You know what the data has to answer in the weeks around launch and UA scaling.

  • AI-first is how you already work today, not something you plan to learn. Deep comfort with LLMs, agents, and AI-assisted engineering workflows in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience using agentic workflows and AI coding tools in real-world projects. You can show agentic analytics work you've shipped and used for real decisions.

  • The ability to discuss concretely how you:

    • structure prompts and context,

    • manage autonomous and multi-agent workflows, including when to intervene,

    • use MCP servers, custom tools, skills, or subagents,

    • review AI-generated code and queries without becoming a bottleneck.

  • Strong experience working with behavioral, transactional, or event-based datasets and deriving actionable insights from complex data.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills. You read and own code you did not write and verify outputs independently rather than blindly trusting generated results.

  • Experience designing scalable data architectures, pipelines, data models, dashboards, analytical frameworks, or automated insight-generation systems.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and storage.

  • Strong analytical decomposition skills and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into precise analytical problems.

  • Strong instinct for data quality, system reliability, and independent verification. You don't simply accept whatever the agent produces.

  • Comfortable operating independently, driving technical initiatives from concept to production, and owning outcomes rather than tasks. You bring the drive to build something new at high speed, and you push it forward without waiting to be asked.

  • Excellent English communication skills.

  • Passion for gaming.

Nice to have

  • Depth in monetization, economy, and LiveOps analytics.

  • Event-driven and streaming data architectures.

  • Real-time telemetry or anti-cheat / anomaly-detection systems.

  • Published or shared work on agentic workflows – blog posts, OSS subagents/skills, internal tooling you've open-sourced.

HOW WE INTERVIEW

Expect to walk us through an agentic workflow you've actually built and used – the specs and context you feed it, how you structure the loop, where it breaks, how you catch it, and what you'd never let an agent do unsupervised on data people make decisions from. Bring screen-shares, repos, prompts, whatever shows the real thing. We're more interested in your judgement and battle scars than in polished slides.

Goodgame Studiosis known for data-driven game development and successful live-service strategy titles. We self-publish our games in-house with all relevant disciplines under one roof. Our studio is based in Hamburg, Germany, and we welcome applications from international candidates. English is our working language. As part ofStillfront Group, one of Europe's leading game publishers with 200M+ registered players, an €1B+ in lifetime revenue, we work on long-term IP growth with a strong focus on execution.

jobs.excerpt: Propr. xyz is building a new Operating System for prop firms, helping them leverage blockchain technology to make them more efficient.
jobs.description:
Propr.xyz is building a new Operating System for prop firms, helping them leverage blockchain technology to make them more efficient. We enable prop firms to leverage perpetual futures on Hyperliquid, prediction markets, and spot assets. We are actively deploying our technologies to the largest prop firms in the world. The pace is intense, but the journey is exciting. We only hire A-players. You need to be exceptional.

Responsibilities

  • Support and enhance the real-time risk engine processing 10k+ position updates/second across perpetuals, spots, and prediction markets.
  • Design and implement risk metrics: portfolio VaR, stress VaR, expected shortfall, Greeks aggregation, cross-asset correlations.
  • Build position limit frameworks: notional caps, delta limits, concentration limits, leverage constraints, drawdown thresholds.
  • Develop statistical models for tail-risk scenarios: fat-tailed distributions, regime switching, correlation breakdowns.
  • Implement margin calculation engines: cross-margining logic, liquidation price models, maintenance margin monitoring.
  • Work closely with trading infrastructure team to ensure <50ms P99 latency for risk calculations on critical paths.
  • Create real-time dashboards and alerting systems: exposure heatmaps, PnL attribution, limit breaches, anomaly detection.
  • Backtest risk models against historical liquidation events and high-volatility periods to validate accuracy.
  • Design circuit breakers and kill switches for extreme market conditions or system anomalies.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in quantitative risk, trading systems, or financial engineering.
  • Strong foundation in statistics, probability theory, and risk modeling (VaR, CVaR, ES, stress testing).
  • Proficiency in Python with NumPy, Pandas, SciPy for quantitative analysis and backtesting.
  • Experience with real-time risk systems processing 1000+ updates/second with <50ms latency.
  • Deep understanding of derivatives pricing: perpetual funding rates, mark-to-market, liquidation mechanics.
  • Portfolio risk metrics: Greeks (delta, gamma, vega), correlation matrices, beta hedging, tail risk.
  • Experience with crypto perpetuals (funding rates, cross-margining, liquidation cascades).
  • Familiarity with prediction markets (AMM mechanics, Kelly criterion, order book dynamics).
  • Time-series analysis: volatility modeling (GARCH, EWMA), regime detection, autocorrelation.
  • SQL proficiency for risk aggregation queries across millions of position updates.
  • Ability to translate complex risk concepts into real-time monitoring systems.
  • Understanding of margin calculations, position sizing, and drawdown controls.

Bonus

    • Experience with Hyperliquid API (WebSocket feeds, vault risk monitoring, liquidation engine).
    • Background in prop trading, market making, or hedge fund risk management (2-sigma+ shops preferred).
    • Knowledge of blockchain-specific risks: oracle failures, MEV, liquidation cascades, network congestion.
    • Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS for building production risk services.
    • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues (Redis Streams, Kafka), CQRS patterns.
    • Time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) for storing tick-level risk snapshots.
    • Machine learning for anomaly detection: isolation forests, autoencoders, change point detection.
    • Understanding of regulatory frameworks (CFTC, SEC, MiFID II) and compliance monitoring.
    • Experience with Monte Carlo simulations, copula models, or extreme value theory.
    • Published research or contributions to quantitative finance / risk management literature.
    • DevOps: Docker, AWS (ECS, Aurora), Terraform, monitoring tools (Grafana, Datadog).

How to apply

    We ask candidates to submit their application via a POST request to our API. This helps us identify candidates who read job descriptions carefully and have basic technical skills.

    {  "roleSlug": "quant-risk",  "name": "Your Name",  "email": "",  "link": "",  "coverNote": "Why Propr?",  "exceptionalNote": "What makes you exceptional?",  "telegramHandle": "@yourhandle",  "appUid": "optional-trading-terminal-uid"}
